verse.dictionaryTitle: The Hebrew Dictionary of Old Testment Words

keynum.meaning: Indexes for Dictionary.
; a primitive word; father, in a literal and immediate, or figurative and remote application: - chief, (fore-) father(-less), [idiom] patrimony, principal. Compare names in 'Abi-'.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h0001 (אָב) {father}: - father.
; from the same as h0024 (אָבִיב); a green plant: - greenness, fruit.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h0003 (אֵב) {a green plant}: - fruit.
; of foreign origin; Abagtha, a eunuch of Xerxes: - Abagtha.

; a primitive root; properly, to wander away, i.e. lose oneself; by implication to perish (causative, destroy): - break, destroy(-uction), [phrase] not escape, fail, lose, (cause to, make) perish, spend, [idiom] and surely, take, be undone, [idiom] utterly, be void of, have no way to flee.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h0006 (אָבַד) {properly, to wander away, i.e. lose oneself; by implication to perish (causative, destroy)}: - destroy, perish.
; active of participle of h0006 (אָבַד); (concrete) wretched or (abstract) destruction: - perish.
; from h0006 (אָבַד); Compare h0010 (אֲבַדֹּה). concrete, something lost; abstract, destruction, i.e. Hades: - lost.
; the same as h0009 (אֲבֵדָה), miswritten for h0011 (אֲבַדּוֹן); a perishing: - destruction.
; intensive from h0006 (אָבַד); abstract, a perishing; concrete, Hades: - destruction.
; from h0006 (אָבַד); a perishing: - destruction.
; from h0006 (אָבַד); a perishing: - destruction.
; a primitive root; to breathe after, i.e. (figuratively) to be acquiescent: - consent, rest content will, be willing.
; from h0014 (אָבָה); longing: - desire.
; from h0014 (אָבָה) (in the sense of bending toward); the papyrus: - swift.
; from h0014 (אָבָה) (in the sense of desiring); want: - sorrow.
; from h0075 (אָבַס); a manger or stall: - crib.
; from an unused root (apparently meaning to turn); brandishing of a sword: - point.
; of uncertain derivation; a melon (only plural): - melon.
; from h0001 (אָב); fatherly; Abi, Hezekiah's mother: - Abi.
; from h0001 (אָב) and h0410 (אֵל); father (i.e. possessor) of God; Abiel, the name of two Israelites: - Abiel.
; from h0001 (אָב) and h0622 (אָסַף); father of gathering (i.e. gatherer); Abiasaph, an Israelite: - Abiasaph.
; from an unused root (meaning to be tender); green, i.e. a young ear of grain; hence, the name of the month Abib or Nisan: - Abib, ear, green ears of corn (not maize).
; from h0001 (אָב) and h1391 (גִּבְעוֹן); father (i.e. founder) of Gibon; Abi-Gibon, perhaps an Israelite: - father of Gibeon.
; or shorter אֲבִיגַל; from h0001 (אָב) and h1524 (גִּיל); father (i.e. source) of joy; Abigail or Abigal, the name of two Israelitesses: - Abigal.
; from h0001 (אָב) and h1777 (דִּין); father of judgment (i.e. judge); Abidan, an Israelite: - Abidan.
; from h0001 (אָב) and h3045 (יָדַע); father of knowledge (i.e. knowing); Abida, a son of Abraham by Keturah: - Abida, Abidah.
; or prolonged אֲבִיָּהוּ ; from h0001 (אָב) and h3050 (יָהּ); father (i.e. worshipper) of Jah; Abijah, the name of several Israelite men and two Israelitesses: - Abiah, Abijah.
; from h0001 (אָב) and h1931 (הוּא); father (i.e. worshipper) of Him (i.e. God); Abihu, a son of Aaron: - Abihu.
; from h0001 (אָב) and h1935 (הוֹד); father (i.e. possessor) of renown; Abihud, the name of two Israelites: - Abihud.
; or (more correctly) אֲבִיחַיִל ; from h0001 (אָב) and h2428 (חַיִל); father (i.e. possessor) of might; Abihail or Abichail, the name of three Israelites and two Israelitesses: - Abihail.
; from h0044 (אֲבִיעֶזֶר) with the article inserted; father of the Ezrite; an Abiezrite or descendant of Abiezer: - Abiezrite.
; from h0014 (אָבָה), in the sense of want (especially in feeling); destitute: - beggar, needy, poor (man).
; from h0014 (אָבָה); provocative of desire; the caper berry (from its stimulative taste): - desire.
; from h0001 (אָב) and h2898 (טוּב); father of goodness (i.e. good); Abitub, an Israelite: - Abitub.
; from h0001 (אָב) and h2919 (טַל); father of dew (i.e. fresh); Abital, a wife of King David: - Abital.
; from h0001 (אָב) and h3220 (יָם); father of (the) sea (i.e. seaman); Abijam (or Abijah), a king of Judah: - Abijam.
; from h0001 (אָב) and an elsewhere unused (probably foreign) word; father of Mael (apparently some Arab tribe); Abimael, a son of Joktan: - Abimael.
; from h0001 (אָב) and h4428 (מֶלֶךְ); father of (the) king; Abimelek, the name of two Philistine kings and of two Israelites: - Abimelech.
; from h0001 (אָב) and h5068 (נָדַב); father of generosity (i.e. liberal); Abinadab, the name of four Israelites: - Abinadab.
; from h0001 (אָב) and h5278 (נֹעַם); father of pleasantness (i.e. gracious); Abinoam, an Israelite: - Abinoam.
; contracted from h0023 (אֲבִיאָסָף); Ebjasaph, an Israelite: - Ebiasaph.
; from h0001 (אָב) and h5829 (עֵזֶר); father of help (i.e. helpful); Abiezer, the name of two Israelites: - Abiezer.
; from h0001 (אָב) and an unused root of uncertain derivation; probably, father of strength (i.e. valiant); Abialbon, an Israelite: - Abialbon.
; from h0082 (אָבַר); mighty (spoken of God): - mighty (one).
; for h0046 (אָבִיר) {mighty (spoken of God)}: - angel, bull, chiefest, mighty (one), stout(-hearted), strong (one), valiant.
; from h0001 (אָב) and h7311 (רוּם); father of height (i.e. lofty); Abiram, the name of two Israelites: - Abiram.
; from h0001 (אָב) and h7686 (שָׁגָה); father of error (i.e. blundering); Abishag, a concubine of David: - Abishag.
; from h0001 (אָב) and h7771 (שׁוֹעַ); father of plenty (i.e. prosperous); Abishua, the name of two Israelites: - Abishua.
; from h0001 (אָב) and h7791 (שׁוּר); father of (the) wall (i.e. perhaps mason); Abishur, an Israelite: - Abishur.
; or (shorter) אַבְשַׁי ; from h0001 (אָב) and h7862 (שַׁי); father of a gift (i.e. probably generous); Abishai, an Israelite: - Abishai.
; or (shortened) אַבְשָׁלוֹם ; from h0001 (אָב) and h7965 (שָׁלוֹם); father of peace (i.e. friendly); Abshalom, a son of David; also (the fuller form) a later Israelite: - Abishalom, Absalom.
; contracted from h0001 (אָב) and h3498 (יָתַר); father of abundance (i.e. liberal); Ebjathar, an Israelite: - Abiathar.
; a primitive root; probably to coil upward: - mount up.
; a primitive root; to bewail: - lament, mourn.
; from h0056 (אָבַל); lamenting: - mourn(-er, -ing).
; from an unused root (meaning to be grassy); a meadow: - plain. Compare also the proper names beginning with Abel-.
; from h0058 (אָבֵל); a meadow; Abel, the name of two places in Palestine.: - Abel.
; from h0056 (אָבַל); lamentation: - mourning.
; apparently from h0056 (אָבַל) through the idea of negation; nay, i.e. truly or yet: - but, indeed, nevertheless, verily.
; from h0058 (אָבֵל) and h1004 (בַּיִת) and h4601 (מַעֲכָה); meadow of Beth-Maakah; Abel of Beth-maakah, a place in Palestine: - Abel-beth-maachah, Abel of Beth-maachah,
; from h0058 (אָבֵל) and the plural of h7848 (שִׁטָּה), with the article inserted; meadow of the acacias; Abel hash-Shittim, a place in Palestine: - Abelshittim.
; from h0058 (אָבֵל) and the plural of h3754 (כֶּרֶם); meadow of vineyards; Abel-Keramim, a place in Palestine: - plain of the vineyards.
; from h0058 (אָבֵל) and h4246 (מְחֹלָה)xlit mᵉchôwlâh corrected to mᵉchôlâh; meadow of dancing; Abel-Mecholah, a place in Palestine: - Abel-meholah.
; from h0058 (אָבֵל) and h4325 (מַיִם); meadow of water; Abel-Majim, a place in Palestine: - Abel-maim.
; from h0058 (אָבֵל) and h4714 (מִצְרַיִם); meadow of Egypt; Abel-Mitsrajim, a place in Palestine: - Abel-mizraim.
; from the root of h1129 (בָּנָה) through the meaning to build; a stone: - [phrase] carbuncle, [phrase] mason, [phrase] plummet, (chalk-, hail-, head-, sling-) stone(-ny), (divers) weight(-s).
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h0068 (אֶבֶן) {a stone}: - stone.
; from the same as h0068 (אֶבֶן); a pair of stones (only dual); a potter's wheel or a midwife's stool (consisting alike of two horizontal disks with a support between): - wheel, stool.
; perhaps feminine of h0068 (אֶבֶן); stony; Compare h0549 (אֲמָנָה). Abanah, a river near Damascus: - Abana.
; from h0068 (אֶבֶן) and h5828 (עֵזֶר) with the article inserted; stone of the help; Eben-ha-Ezer, a place in Palestine: - Ebenezer.
; of uncertain derivation; a belt: - girdle.
; or (fully) אֲבִינֵר ; from h0001 (אָב) and h5216 (נִיר); father of light (i.e. enlightening); Abner, an Israelite: - Abner.
; a primitive root; to fodder: - fatted, stalled.
; (by reduplication) from an unused root (meaning to belch forth); an inflammatory pustule (as eruption): - blains.
; from an unused root probably meaning to gleam; conspicuous; Ebets, a place in Palestine: - Abez.
; from the same as h0076 (אֲבַעְבֻּעָה); splendid; Ibtsan, an Israelite: - Ibzan.
; a primitive root, probably to float away (as vapor), but used only as denominative from h0080 (אָבָק); to bedust, i.e. grapple: - wrestle.
; from root of h0079 (אָבַק); light particles (as volatile): - (small) dust, powder.
; feminine of h0080 (אָבָק) {light particles (as volatile)}: - powder.
; a primitive root; to soar: - fly.
; from h0082 (אָבַר); a pinion: - (long-) wing(-ed).
; feminine of h0083 (אֵבֶר) {a pinion}: - feather, wing.
; contracted from h0001 (אָב) and an unused root (probably meaning to be populous); father of a multitude; Abraham, the later name of Abram: - Abraham.
; probably an Egyptian word meaning kneel: - bow the knee.
; contracted from h0048 (אֲבִירָם); high father; Abram, the original name of Abraham: - Abram.
; plural of h0178 (אוֹב); water-skins; Oboth, a place in the Desert: - Oboth.
; of uncertain derivation (compare h0090 (אֲגַג)); Age, an Israelite: - Agee.
; or אֲגָג; of uncertain derivation (compare h0089 (אָגֵא)); flame; Agag, a title of Amalekitish kings: - Agag.
; patrial or patronymic from h0090 (אֲגַג); an Agagite or descendent (subject) of Agag: - Agagite.
; feminine passive participle of an unused root (meaning to bind); a band, bundle, knot, or arch: - bunch, burden, troop.
; prob of Persian origin; a nut: - nut.
; passive participle of h0103 (אָגַר); gathered (i.e. received among the sages); Agur, a fanciful name for Solomon: - Agur.
; from the same as h0094 (אָגוּר); properly, something gathered, i.e. perhaps a grain or berry; used only of a small (silver) coin: - piece (of) silver.
; from an unused root (meaning to flow down or together as drops); a reservoir: - drop.
; dual of h0096 (אֶגֶל).; a double pond; Eglajim, a place in Moab: - Eglaim.
; from an unused root (meaning to collect as water); a marsh; hence a rush (as growing in swamps); hence a stockade of reeds: - pond, pool, standing (water).
; probably from the same as h0098 (אֲגַם) (in the sense of stagnant water); figuratively, sad: - pond.

; from the same as h0098 (אֲגַם); a marshy pool (others from a different root, a kettle); by implication a bulrush (as growing there); collectively a rope of bulrushes: - bulrush, caldron, hook, rush.
; probably from h5059 (נָגַן); a bowl (as pounded out hollow): - basin, cup, goblet.
; probably from h5062 (נָגַף) (through the idea of impending); a cover or heap; i.e. (only plural) wings of an army, or crowds of troops: - bands.
; a primitive root; to harvest: - gather.
; (Aramaic) of Persian origin; an epistle (as carried by a state courier or postman): - letter.
; of uncertain derivation; a basin: - charger.
; from h1640 (גָּרַף) (in the sense of grasping); the clenched hand: - fist.
; feminine of h0104 (אִגְּרָא); an epistle: - letter.
; from the same as h0181 (אוּד) (in the sense of enveloping); a fog: - mist, vapor.
; a primitive root; to languish: - grieve.
; probably from h0109 (אָדַב) (in the sense of chastisement) and h0410 (אֵל); disciplined of God; Adbeel, a son of Ishmael: - Adbeel.
; probably an orthographical variation for h2301 (חֲדַד); Adad (or Hadad), an Edomite: - Hadad.
; of uncertain derivation; Iddo, an Israelite: - Iddo.
; or (shortened) אָדֹן; from an unused root (meaning to rule); sovereign, i.e. controller (human or divine): - lord, master, owner. Compare also names beginning with 'Adoni-'.
; probably intensive for h0113 (אָדוֹן); powerful; Addon, apparently an Israelite: - Addon.
; dual from h0142 (אָדַר) (in the sense of eminence); double mound; Adorajim, a place in Palestine: - Adoraim.
; (Aramaic) of uncertain derivation; then (of time): - now, that time, then.
; from h0142 (אָדַר); wide or (generally) large; figuratively, powerful: - excellent, famous, gallant, glorious, goodly, lordly, mighty(-ier one), noble, principal, worthy.
; of Persian derivation; Adalja, a son of Haman: - Adalia.
; to show blood (in the face), i.e. flush or turn rosy: - be (dyed, made) red (ruddy).

; from h0119 (אָדַם); ruddy i.e. a human being (an individual or the species, mankind, etc.): - [idiom] another, [phrase] hypocrite, [phrase] common sort, [idiom] low, man (mean, of low degree), person.
; the same as h0120 (אָדָם); Adam the name of the first man, also of a place in Palestine: - Adam.
; from h0119 (אָדַם); rosy: - red, ruddy.
; or (fully) אֱדוֹם ; from h0122 (אָדֹם); red (see Genesis 25:25); Edom, the elder twin-brother of Jacob; hence the region (Idumaea) occupied by him: - Edom, Edomites, Idumea.
; from h0119 (אָדַם); redness, i.e. the ruby, garnet, or some other red gem: - sardius.
; reduplicated from h0119 (אָדַם); reddish: - (somewhat) reddish.
; contracted for h0127 (אֲדָמָה); earthy; Admah, a place near the Dead Sea: - Admah.
; from h0119 (אָדַם); soil (from its general redness): - country, earth, ground, husband(-man) (-ry), land.
; the same as h0127 (אֲדָמָה); Adamah, a place in Palestine: - Adamah.
; from h0127 (אֲדָמָה); earthy; Adami, a place in Palestine: - Adami.
; or (fully) אֱדוֹמִי ; patronymic from h0123 (אֱדֹם); See h0726 (אֲרוֹמִי). an Edomite, or descendants from (or inhabitants of) Edom: - Edomite.
; plural of h0121 (אָדָם); red spots; Adummim, a pass in Palestine: - Adummim.
; or (fully) אַדְמוֹנִי ; from h0119 (אָדַם); reddish (of the hair or the complexion): - red, ruddy.
; probably of Persian derivation; Admatha, a Persian nobleman: - Admatha.
; from the same as h0113 (אָדוֹן) (in the sense of strength); a basis (of a building, a column, etc.): - foundation, socket.
; intensive from the same as h0134 (אֶדֶן); firm; Addan, an Israelite: - Addan.
; an emphatic form of h0113 (אָדוֹן); the Lord (used as a proper name of God only): - (my) Lord.
; from h0113 (אָדוֹן) and h0966 (בֶּזֶק); lord of Bezek; Adoni-Bezek; a Canaanitish king: - Adonibezek.
; original (prolonged) אֲדֹנִיָּהוּ ; from h0113 (אָדוֹן) and h3050 (יָהּ); lord (i.e. worshipper) of Jah; Adonijah, the name of three Israelites: - Adonijah.
; from h0113 (אָדוֹן) and h6664 (צֶדֶק); lord of justice; Adoni-Tsedek, a Canaanitish king: - Adonizedec.
; from h0113 (אָדוֹן) and h6965 (קוּם); lord of rising (i.e. high); Adonikam, the name of one or two Israelites: - Adonikam.
; from h0113 (אָדוֹן) and h7311 (רוּם); lord of height; Adoniram, an Israelite: - Adoniram.
; a primitive root; to expand, i.e. be great or (figuratively) magnificent: - (become) glorious, honourable.
; probably of foreign derivation; perhaps meaning fire; Adar, the 12th Hebrew month: - Adar.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h0143 (אֲדָר) {Adar, the 12th Hebrew month}: - Adar.
; from h0142 (אָדַר); amplitude, i.e. (concrete) a mantle; also (figuratively) splendor: - goodly, robe.
; intensive from h0142 (אָדַר); ample; Addar, a place in Palestine; also an Israelite: - Addar.
; (Aramaic) intensive, from a root corresponding to h0142 (אָדַר); ample, i.e. a threshing-floor: - threshingfloor.
; (Aramaic) from the same as h0147 (אִדַּר), and h1505 (גְּזַר); a chief diviner, or astrologer: - judge.
; (Aramaic) probably of Persian origin; quickly or carefully: - diligently.
; of Persian origin; a daric or Persian coin: - dram.
; contracted for h0141 (אֲדֹנִירָם); Adoram (or Adoniram), an Israelite: - Adoram.
; from h0142 (אָדַר) and h4428 (מֶלֶךְ); splendor of (the) king; Adrammelek, the name of an Assyrian idol, also of a son of Sennacherib: - Adrammelech.
; (Aramaic) an orthographical variation for h1872 (דְּרַע); an arm, i.e. (figuratively) power: - force.
; from the equivalent of h0153 (אֶדְרָע); mighty; Edrei, the name of two places in Palestine: - Edrei.
; feminine of h0117 (אַדִּיר); ; also the same as h0145 (אֶדֶר) something ample (as a large vine, a wide dress): - garment, glory, goodly, mantle, robe.
; a primitive root; to tread out (grain): - thresh.
; or אָהֵב ; a primitive root; to have affection for (sexually or otherwise): - (be-) love(-d, -ly, -r), like, friend.
; from h0157 (אָהַב); affection (in a good or a bad sense): - love(-r).
; from h0156 (אָדַשׁ); meaning the same as h0158 (אַהַב) {affection (in a good or a bad sense)}: - love.
; feminine of h0158 (אַהַב) and meaning the same {affection (in a good or a bad sense)}: - love.
; from an unused root meaning to be united; unity; Ohad, an Israelite: - Ohad.
; apparently a primitive word expressing pain exclamatorily; Oh!: - ah, alas.
; probably of foreign origin; Ahava, a river of Babylonia: - Ahava.
; from the same as h0161 (אֹהַד); united; Ehud, the name of two or three Israelites: - Ehud.
; apparently an orthographical variation for h0346 (אַיֵּה); where: - I will be (Hosea 13:10,14) (which is often the rendering of the same Hebrew form from h1961 (הָיָה)).
; a primitive root; to be clear: - shine.
; a denominative from h0168 (אֹהֶל); to tent: - pitch (remove) a tent.
; from h0166 (אָהַל); a tent (as clearly conspicuous from a distance): - covering, (dwelling) (place), home, tabernacle, tent.
; the same as h0168 (אֹהֶל); Ohel, an Israelite: - Ohel.
; in form a feminine of h0168 (אֹהֶל), but in fact for אׇהֳלָהּ; from h0168 (אֹהֶל); her tent (i.e. idolatrous sanctuary); Oholah, a symbolic name for Samaria: - Aholah.
; from h0168 (אֹהֶל) and h0001 (אָב); tent of (his) father; Oholiab, an Israelite: - Aholiab.
; (similarly with h0170 (אׇהֳלָה)) for אׇהֳלִיבָהּ ; from h0168 (אֹהֶל); my tent (is) in her; Oholibah, a symbolic name for Judah: - Aholibah.
; from h0168 (אֹהֶל) and h1116 (בָּמָה); tent of (the) height; Oholibamah, a wife of Esau: - Aholibamah.
; or (feminine) אֲהָלוֹת (only used thus in the plural); of foreign origin; aloe wood (i.e. sticks): - (tree of lign-) aloes.
; of uncertain derivation; Aharon, the brother of Moses: - Aaron.

; presumed to be the 'constructive' or genitival form of אַו ; short for h0185 (אַוָּה); desire (and so probably in Proverbs 31:4); hence (by way of alternative) or, also if: - also, and, either, if, at the least, [idiom] nor, or, otherwise, then, whether.
; from h0176 (אוֹ) and h0410 (אֵל); wish of God; Uel, and Israelite: - Uel.

; from the same as h0001 (אָב) (apparently through the idea of prattling a father's name); properly, a mumble, i.e. a water skin (from its hollow sound); hence a necromancer (ventriloquist, as from a jar): - bottle, familiar spirit.
; probably from h0056 (אָבַל); mournful; Obil, an Ishmaelite: - Obil.
; or (shortened) אֻבָל ; from h2986 (יָבַל) (in the sense of h2988 (יָבָל)); a stream: - river.
; from an unused root meaning to rake together; a poker (for turning or gathering embers): - (fire-) brand.
; or (shortened) אֹדוֹת (only thus in the plural); from the same as h0181 (אוּד); turnings (i.e. occasions); (adverb) on account of: - (be-) cause, concerning, sake.
; a primitive root; to wish for: - covet, (greatly) desire, be desirous, long, lust (after).
; a primitive root; to extend or mark out: - point out.
; from h0183 (אָוָה); longing: - desire, lust after, pleasure.
; perhaps by permutation for h5813 (עֻזִּי), strong; Uzai, an Israelite: - Uzai.
; of uncertain derivation; Uzal, a son of Joktan: - Uzal.
; probably from h0183 (אָוָה) (in the sense of crying out after); lamentation; also interjectionally Oh!: - alas, woe.
; probably from h0183 (אָוָה); desirous; Evi, a Midianitish chief: - Evi.
; feminine of h0188 (אוֹי) {lamentation; also interjectionally Oh!}: - woe.
; from an unused root (meaning to be perverse); (figuratively) silly: - fool(-ish) (man).
; of Aramaic derivation and probably meaning soldier of Merodak; Evil-Merodak, a Babylonian king: - Evil-merodach.
; from an unused root meaning to twist, i.e. (by implication) be strong; the body (as being rolled together); also powerful: - mighty, strength.
; or (shortened) אֻלַי; from h0176 (אוֹ); if not; hence perhaps: - if so be, may be, peradventure, unless.
; of Persian derivation; the Ulai (or Eulaeus), a river of Persia: - Ulai.
; from h0191 (אֱוִיל); silly, foolish; hence (morally) impious: - foolish.
; or (shortened), אֻלָם ; from h0481 (אָלַם) (in the sense of tying); a vestibule (as bound to the building): - porch.
; appar, from h0481 (אָלַם) (in the sense of dumbness); solitary; Ulam, the name of two Israelites: - Ulam.
; apparently a variation of h0194 (אוּלַי); however or on the contrary: - as for, but, howbeit, in very deed, surely, truly, wherefore.
; from the same as h0191 (אֱוִיל); silliness: - folly, foolishly(-ness).
; from h0559 (אָמַר); talkative; Omar, a grandson of Esau: - Omar.
; probably from the same as h0205 (אָוֶן) (in the sense of effort, but successful); ability, power, (figuratively) wealth: - force, goods, might, strength, substance.
; the same as h0202 (אוֹן); On, an Israelite: - On.
; or (shortened); אֹן; of Egyptian derivation; On, a city of Egypt: - On.

; from an unused root perhaps meaning properly, to pant (hence, to exert oneself, usually in vain; to come to naught); strictly nothingness; also trouble. vanity, wickedness; specifically an idol: - affliction, evil, false, idol, iniquity, mischief, mourners(-ing), naught, sorrow, unjust, unrighteous, vain, vanity, wicked(-ness). Compare h0369 (אַיִן).

; the same as h0205 (אָוֶן); idolatry; Aven, the contemptuous synonym of three places, one in Coele-Syria, one in Egypt (On), and one in Palestine (Bethel): - Aven. See also h0204 (אוֹן), h1007 (בֵּית אָוֶן).
; or (shortened) אֹנוֹ; prolonged from h0202 (אוֹן); strong; Ono, a place in Palestine: - Ono.
; a variation of h0209 (אוֹנָן); strong; Onam, the name of an Edomite and of an Israelite: - Onam.
; a variation of h0207 (אוֹנוֹ); strong; Onan, a son of Judah: - Onan.
; perhaps a corruption of h0211 (אוֹפִיר); Uphaz, a famous gold region: - Uphaz.
; or (shortened) אֹפִיר; and אוֹפִר; of uncertain derivation; Ophir, the name of a son of Joktan, and of a gold region in the East: - Ophir.
; or (shortened) אֹפָן; from an unused root meaning to revolve; a wheel: - wheel.
; a primitive root; to press; (by implication) to be close, hurry, withdraw: - (make) haste(-n, -y), labor, be narrow.
; from h0686 (אָצַר); a depository: - armory, cellar, garner, store(-house), treasure(-house) (-y).
; a primitive root; to be (causative, make) luminous (literally and metaphorically): - [idiom] break of day, glorious, kindle, (be, en-, give, show) light (-en, -ened), set on fire, shine.
; from h0215 (אוֹר); illumination or (concrete) luminary (in every sense, including lightning, happiness, etc.): - bright, clear, [phrase] day, light (-ning), morning, sun.
; from h0215 (אוֹר); flame; hence (in the plural) the East (as being the region of light): - fire, light. See also h0224 (אוּרִים).
; the same as h0217 (אוּר); Ur, a place in Chaldaea; also an Israelite: - Ur.
; feminine of h0216 (אוֹר); luminousness, i.e. (figuratively) prosperity; also a plant (as being bright): - herb, light.
; by transposition for h0723 (אֻרְוָה); a stall: - cote.
; from h0217 (אוּר); fiery; Uri, the name of three Israelites: - Uri.
; from h0217 (אוּר) and h0410 (אֵל); flame of God; Uriel, the name of two Israelites: - Uriel.
; or (prolonged) אוּרִיָּהוּ ; from h0217 (אוּר) and h3050 (יָהּ); flame of Jah; Urijah, the name of one Hittite and five Israelites: - Uriah, Urijah.
; plural of h0217 (אוּר); lights; Urim, the oracular brilliancy of the figures in the high-priest's breastplate: - Urim.
; a primitive root; properly, to come, i.e. (implied) to assent: - consent.
; probably from h0225 (אוּת) (in the sense of appearing); a signal (literally or figuratively), as aflag, beacon, monument, omen, prodigy, evidence, etc.: - mark, miracle, (en-) sign, token.
; a demonstrative adverb; at that time or place; also as a conjunction, therefore: - beginning, for, from, hitherto, now, of old, once, since, then, at which time, yet.
; (Aramaic) or אֲזָה (Aramaic); to kindle; (by implication) to heat: - heat, hot.
; probably from h0231 (אֵזוֹב); hyssop-like; Ezbai, an Israelite: - Ezbai.
; (Aramaic) of uncertain derivation; firm: - be gone.
; probably of foreign derivation; hyssop: - hyssop.
; from h0246 (אֲזִקִּים); something girt; a belt, also a band: - girdle.
; probably from h0227 (אָז); at that time: - then.
; from h2142 (זָכַר); a reminder; specifically remembrance-offering: - memorial.
; a primitive root; to go away, hence, to disappear: - fail, gad about, go to and fro (but in Ezekiel 27:19 the word is rendered by many 'from Uzal,' by others 'yarn'), be gone (spent).
; (Aramaic) the same as h0235 (אָזַל); to depart: - go (up).
; from h0235 (אָזַל); departure; Ezel, a memorial stone in Palestine: - Ezel.

; a primitive root; probably to expand; but used only as a denominative from h0241 (אֹזֶן); to broaden out the ear (with the hand), i.e. (by implication) to listen: - give (perceive by the) ear, hear(-ken). See h0239 (אָזַן).
; a primitive root (rather identical with h0238 (אָזַן) through the idea of scales as if two ears); to weigh, i.e. (figuratively) ponder: - give good heed.
; from h0238 (אָזַן); a spade or paddle (as having a broad end): - weapon.
; from h0238 (אָזַן); broadness. i.e. (concrete) the ear (from its form in man): - [phrase] advertise, audience, [phrase] displease, ear, hearing, [phrase] show.
; from h0238 (אָזַן) and h7609 (שֶׁאֱרָה); plot of Sheerah (i.e. settled by him); Uzzen-Sheerah, a place in Palestine: - Uzzen-sherah.
; from h0238 (אָזַן) and h8396 (תָּבוֹר); flats (i.e. tops) of Tabor (i.e. situated on it); Aznoth-Tabor, a place in Palestine: - Aznoth-tabor.
; from h0241 (אֹזֶן); having (quick) ears; Ozni, an Israelite; also an Oznite (collectively), his descendant: - Ozni, Oznites.
; from h0238 (אָזַן) and h3050 (יָהּ); heard by Jah; Azanjah, an Israelite: - Azaniah.
; a variation for h2131 (זִיקָה); manacles: - chains.
; a primitive root; to belt: - bind (compass) about, gird (up, with).
; a variation for h2220 (זְרוֹעַ); the arm: - arm.
; from h2224 (זָרַח) (in the sense of springing up); a spontaneous growth, i.e. native (tree or persons): - bay tree, (home-) born (in the land), of the (one's own) country (nation).
; patronymic from h2246 (חֹבָב); an Ezrachite or descendant of Zerach: - Ezrahite.

; a primitive word; a brother (used in the widest sense of literal relationship and metaphorical affinity or resemblance (like father)): - another, brother(-ly); kindred, like, other. Compare also the proper names beginning with 'Ah-' or 'Ahi-'.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h0251 (אָח) {a brother (used in the widest sense of literal relationship and metaphorical affinity or resemblance)}: - brother.
; a variation for h0162 (אֲהָהּ); Oh! (expressive of grief or surprise): - ah, alas.
; of uncertain derivation; a fire-pot or chafing dish: - hearth.
; probably from h0253 (אָח); a howler or lonesome wild animal: - doleful creature.
; once (by contraction) אֶחָב (Jeremiah 29:22); from h0251 (אָח) and h0001 (אָב); brother (i.e. friend) of (his) father; Achab, the name of a king of Israel and of a prophet at Babylon: - Ahab.
; from h0251 (אָח) and h0995 (בִּין); brother (i.e. possessor) of understanding; Achban, an Israelite: - Ahban.
; perhaps a primitive root; to unify, i.e. (figuratively) collect (one's thoughts): - go one way or other.

; a numeral from h0258 (אָחַד); properly, united, i.e. one; or (as an ordinal) first: - a, alike, alone, altogether, and, any(-thing), apiece, a certain, (dai-) ly, each (one), [phrase] eleven, every, few, first, [phrase] highway, a man, once, one, only, other, some, together,
; of uncertain (perhaps Egyptian) derivation; a bulrush or any marshy grass (particularly that along the Nile): - flag, meadow.
; from h0258 (אָחַד); united; Echud, the name of three Israelites: - Ehud.
; from h2331 (חָוָה) (in the sense of h2324 (חֲוָא)); an utterance: - declaration.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h0262 (אַחְוָה); solution (of riddles): - showing.
; from h0251 (אָח); fraternity: - brotherhood.
; by reduplication from h0251 (אָח); brotherly; Achoach, an Israelite: - Ahoah.
; patronymic from h0264 (אַחֲוָה); an Achochite or descendant of Achoach: - Ahohite.
; perhaps from h0251 (אָח) and h4325 (מַיִם); brother (i.e. neighbour) of water; Achumai, an Israelite: - Ahumai.

; or (shortened) אָחֹר ; from h0299 (אֲחִירַע); the hinder part; hence (adverb) behind, backward; also (as facing north) the West: - after(-ward), back (part, -side, -ward), hereafter, (be-) hind(-er part), time to come, without.
; irregular feminine of h0251 (אָח); a sister (used very widely (like brother), literally and figuratively): - (an-) other, sister, together.

; a primitive root; to seize (often with the accessory idea of holding in possession): - [phrase] be affrighted, bar, (catch, lay, take) hold (back), come upon, fasten, handle, portion, (get, have or take) possess(-ion).
; from h0270 (אָחַז); possessor; Achaz, the name of a Jewish king and of an Israelite: - Ahaz.
; feminine passive participle from h0270 (אָחַז); something seized, i.e. a possession (especially of land): - possession.
; from h0270 (אָחַז); seizer; Achzai, an Israelite: - Ahasai.
; or (prolonged) אֲחַזְיָהוּ ; from h0270 (אָחַז) and h3050 (יָהּ); Jah has seized; Achazjah, the name of a Jewish and an Israelite king: - Ahaziah.
; from h0270 (אָחַז); seizure; Achuzzam, an Israelite: - Ahuzam.
; a variation of h0272 (אֲחֻזָּה); possession; Achuzzath, a Philistine: - Ahuzzath.
; from h0251 (אָח); brotherly; Achi, the name of two Israelites: - Ahi.
; probably the same as h0277 (אֲחִי); Echi, an Israelite: - Ehi.
; from h0251 (אָח) and h0517 (אֵם); brother of the mother (i.e. uncle); Achiam, an Israelite: - Ahiam.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h2420 (חִידָה), an enigma: - hard sentence.
; or (prolonged) אֲחִיָּהוּ ; from h0251 (אָח) and h3050 (יָהּ); brother (i.e. worshipper) of Jah; Achijah, the name of nine Israelites: - Ahiah, Ahijah.
; from h0251 (אָח) and h1935 (הוֹד); brother (i.e. possessor) of renown; Achihud, an Israelite: - Ahihud.
; prolonged from h0251 (אָח); brotherly; Achio, the name of three Israelites: - Ahio.
; from h0251 (אָח) and h2330 (חוּד); brother of a riddle (i.e. mysterious); Achichud, an Israelite: - Ahihud.
; from h0251 (אָח) and h2898 (טוּב); brother of goodness; Achitub, the name of several priests: - Ahitub.
; from h0251 (אָח) and h3205 (יָלַד); brother of one born; Achilud, an Israelite: - Ahilud.
; from h0251 (אָח) and h4191 (מוּת); brother of death; Achimoth, an Israelite: - Ahimoth.
; from h0251 (אָח) and h4428 (מֶלֶךְ); brother of (the) king; Achimelek, the name of an Israelite and of a Hittite: - Ahimelech.
; or אֲחִימָן ; from h0251 (אָח) and h4480 (מִן); brother of a portion (i.e. gift); Achiman, the name of an Anakite and of an Israelite: - Ahiman.
; from h0251 (אָח) and the equivalent of h4619 (מַעַץ); brother of anger; Achimaats, the name of three Israelites: - Ahimaaz.
; from h0251 (אָח); brotherly; Achjan, an Israelite: - Ahian.
; from h0251 (אָח) and h5068 (נָדַב); brother of liberality; Achinadab, an Israelite: - Ahinadab.
; from h0251 (אָח) and h5278 (נֹעַם); brother of pleasantness; Achinoam, the name of two Israelitesses: - Ahinoam.
; from h0251 (אָח) and h5564 (סָמַךְ); brother of support; Achisamak, an Israelite: - Ahisamach.
; from h0251 (אָח) and h5828 (עֵזֶר); brother of help; Achiezer, the name of two Israelites: - Ahiezer.
; from h0251 (אָח) and h6965 (קוּם); brother of rising (i.e. high); Achikam, an Israelite: - Ahikam.
; from h0251 (אָח) and h7311 (רוּם); brother of height (i.e. high); Achiram, an Israelite: - Ahiram.
; patronymic from h0297 (אֲחִירָם); an Achiramite or descendant (collectively) of Achiram: - Ahiramites.
; from h0251 (אָח) and h7451 (רַע); brother of wrong; Achira, an Israelite: - Ahira.
; from h0251 (אָח) and h7837 (שַׁחַר); brother of (the) dawn; Achishachar, an Israelite: - Ahishar.
; from h0251 (אָח) and h7891 (שִׁיר); brother of (the) singer; Achishar, an Israelite: - Ahishar.
; from h0251 (אָח) and h8602 (תָּפֵל); brother of folly; Achithophel, an Israelite: - Ahithophel.
; from the same root as h2459 (חֶלֶב); fatness (i.e. fertile); Achlab, a place in Palestine: - Ahlab.
; the same as h0305 (אַחֲלַי); wishful; Achlai, the name of an Israelitess and of an Israelite: - Ahlai.
; or אַחֲלֵי; prob from h0253 (אָח) and a variation of h3863 (לוּא); would that!: - O that, would God.
; perhaps from h2492 (חָלַם) (and thus dream-stone); a gem, probably the amethyst: - amethyst.
; of Persian derivation; Achmetha (i.e. Ecbatana), the summer capital of Persia: - Achmetha.
; of uncertain derivation; Achasbai, an Israelite: - Ahasbai.
; a primitive root; to loiter (i.e. be behind); by implication to procrastinate: - continue, defer, delay, hinder, be late (slack), stay (there), tarry (longer).

; from h0309 (אָחַר); properly, the hind part; generally used as an adverb or conjunction, after (in various senses): - after (that, -ward), again, at, away from, back (from, -side), behind, beside, by, follow (after, -ing), forasmuch, from, hereafter, hinder end, [phrase] out (over) live, [phrase] persecute, posterity, pursuing, remnant, seeing, since, thence(-forth), when, with.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h0310 (אַחַר); after: - (here-) after.
; from h0309 (אָחַר); properly, hinder; generally, next, other, etc.: - (an-) other man, following, next, strange.
; the same as h0312 (אַחֵר); Acher, an Israelite: - Aher.

; or (shortened) אַחֲרֹן; from h0309 (אָחַר); hinder; generally, late or last; specifically (as facing the east) western: - after (-ward), to come, following, hind(-er, -ermost, -most), last, latter, rereward, ut(ter) most.
; from h0310 (אַחַר) and h0251 (אָח); after (his) brother; Achrach, an Israelite: - Aharah.
; from h0310 (אַחַר) and h2426 (חֵיל); behind (the) intrenchment (i.e. safe); Acharchel, an Israelite: - Aharhel,
; (Aramaic) from h0311 (אַחַר); other: - (an-) other.
; (Aramaic) or (shortened) אׇחֳרֵן; (Aramaic) from h0317 (אׇחֳרִי); last: - at last.
; from h0310 (אַחַר); the last or end, hence, the future; also posterity: - (last, latter) end (time), hinder (utter) -most, length, posterity, remnant, residue, reward.
; (Aramaic) from h0311 (אַחַר); the same as h0319 (אַחֲרִית); later: - latter.
; (Aramaic) from h0311 (אַחַר); the same as h0317 (אׇחֳרִי); other: - (an-) other.
; prolonged from h0268 (אָחוֹר); backwards: - back (-ward, again).
; of Persian derivation; a satrap or governorof amain province (of Persia): - lieutenant.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h0323 (אֲחַשְׁדַּרְפַּן) {a satrap or governorof amain province (of Persia)}: - prince.
; or (shortened) אַחַשְׁרֹשׁ (Esther 10:1); of Persian origin; Achashverosh (i.e. Ahasuerus or Artaxerxes, but in this case Xerxes), the title (rather than name) of a Persian king: - Ahasuerus.
; probably of Persian derivation; an achastarite (i.e. courier); the designation (rather than name) of an Israelite: - Haakashtari (includ. the article).
; of Persian origin; a mule: - camel.
; from an unused root perhaps meaning to move softly; (as a noun) a necromancer (from their soft incantations), (as an adverb) gently: - charmer, gently, secret, softly.
; from an unused root probably meaning to pierce or make fast; a thorn-tree (especially the buckthorn): - Atad, bramble, thorn.
; from an unused root (probably meaning to bind); properly, twisted (yarn), i.e. tapestry: - fine linen.
; a primitive root; to close (the lips or ears); by analology to contract (a window by bevelled jambs): - narrow, shut, stop.
; a primitive root; to close up: - shut.
; from h0332 (אָטַר); maimed; Ater, the name of three Israelites: - Ater.
; from h0332 (אָטַר); shut up, i.e. impeded (as to the use of the right hand): - [phrase] left-handed.
; perhaps from h0370 (אַיִן); where? hence how?: - how, what, whence, where, whether, which (way).
; probably identical with h0335 (אַי) (through the idea of a query); not: - island (Job 22:30).
; short from h0188 (אוֹי); alas!: - woe.
; probably identical with h0337 (אִי) (through the idea of a doleful sound); a howler (used only in the plural), i.e. any solitary wild creature: - wild beast of the islands.
; from h0183 (אָוָה); properly, a habitable spot (as desirable); dry land, a coast, an island: - country, isle, island.
; a primitive root; to hate (as one of an opposite tribe or party); hence to be hostile: - be an enemy.
; or (fully) אוֹיֵב; active participle of h0340 (אָיַב); hating; an adversary: - enemy, foe.
; from h0340 (אָיַב); hostility: - emnity, hatred.
; from the same as h0181 (אוּד) (in the sense of bending down); oppression; by implication misfortune, ruin: - calamity, destruction.
; perhaps from h0337 (אִי); the screamer, i.e. a hawk: - kite, vulture.
; the same as h0344 (אַיָּה); Ajah, the name of two Israelites: - Aiah, Ajah.
; prolonged from h0335 (אַי); where?: - where.
; from h0340 (אָיַב); hated (i.e. persecuted); Ijob, the patriarch famous for his patience: - Job.
; from h0336 (אִי)lemma אי missing vowel, corrected to אִי and h2083 (זְבֻל); Izebel, the wife of king Ahab: - Jezebel.
; also אֵיכָה ; and אֵיכָכָה ; prolonged from h0335 (אַי); how? or how!; also where: - how, what.
; from h0336 (אִי)lemma אי missing vowel, corrected to אִי and h3519 (כָּבוֹד); (there is) no glory, i.e. inglorious; Ikabod, a son of Phineas: - I-chabod.
; probably a variation for h0349 (אֵיךְ), but not as an interogative; where: - where.

; from the same as h0193 (אוּל); properly, strength; hence, anything strong; specifically a chief (politically); also a ram (from his strength); a pilaster (as a strong support); an oak or other strong tree: - mighty (man), lintel, oak, post, ram, tree.
; a variation of h0352 (אַיִל); strength: - strength.
; an intensive form of h0352 (אַיִל) (in the sense of ram); a stag or male deer: - hart.
; feminine of h0354 (אַיָּל); a doe or female deer: - hind.
; or (shortened) אֵלוֹן ; or אֵילֹן ; from h0352 (אַיִל); oak-grove; Elon, the name of a place in Palestine, and also of one Hittite, two Israelites: - Elon.
; from h0354 (אַיָּל); deer-field; Ajalon, the name of five places in Palestine: - Aijalon, Ajalon.
; from h0356 (אֵילוֹן), h1004 (בַּיִת), and h2603 (חָנַן); oak-grove of (the) house of favor; Elon of Beth-chanan, a place in Palestine: - Elon-bethhanan.
; or אֵילַת ; from h0352 (אַיִל); trees or a grove (i.e. palms); Eloth or Elath, a place on the Red Sea: - Elath, Eloth.
; feminine of h0353 (אֱיָל); power; by implication, protection: - strength.
; or (shortened) אֵלָם ; or (feminine) אֵלַמָּה ; probably from h0352 (אַיִל); a pillar-space (or colonnade), i.e. a pale (or portico): - arch.
; plural of h0352 (אַיִל); palm-trees; Elim, a place in the Desert: - Elim.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h0356 (אֵילוֹן); a tree: - tree.
; from h0352 (אַיִל) and h6290 (פָּארָן); oak of Paran; El-Paran, a portion of the district of Paran: - El-paran.
; the same as h0355 (אַיָּלָה); a doe: - hind, Aijeleth.
; from an unused root (meaning to frighten); frightful: - terrible.
; or (shortened) אֵמָה; from the same as h0366 (אָיֹם); fright; concrete, an idol (as a bugbear): - dread, fear, horror, idol, terrible, terror.
; plural of h0367 (אֵימָה); terrors; Emim, an early Canaanitish (or Maobitish) tribe: - Emims.

; as if from a primitive root meaning to be nothing or not exist; a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle: - else, except, fail, (father-) less, be gone, in(-curable), neither, never, no (where), none, nor, (any, thing), not, nothing, to nought, past, un(-searchable), well-nigh, without. Compare h0370 (אַיִן).

; probably identical with h0369 (אַיִן) in the sense of query (compare h0336 (אִי)lemma אי missing vowel, corrected to אִי) where? (only in connection with prepositional prefix, whence): - whence, where.
; apparently a shortened form of h0369 (אַיִן); but (like h0370 (אַיִן)) an interrogative; is it not?: - not.
; from h0336 (אִי)lemma אי missing vowel, corrected to אִי and h5828 (עֵזֶר); helpless; Iezer, an Israelite: - Jeezer.
; patronymic from h0372 (אִיעֶזֵר); an Iezrite or descendant of Iezer: - Jezerite.
; or (shortened) אֵפָה ; of Egyptian derivation; an ephah or measure for grain; hence, a measure in general: - ephah, (divers) measure(-s).
; from h0335 (אַי) and h6311 (פֹּה); what place?; also (of time) when?; or (of means) how?: - what manner, where.

; contracted for h0582 (אֱנוֹשׁ) (or perhaps rather from an unused root meaning to be extant); a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term (and in such cases frequently not expressed in translation): - also, another, any (man), a certain, [phrase] champion, consent, each, every (one), fellow, (foot-, husband-) man, (good-, great, mighty) man, he, high (degree), him (that is), husband, man(-kind), [phrase] none, one, people, person, [phrase] steward, what (man) soever, whoso(-ever), worthy. Compare h0802 (אִשָּׁה).
; denominative from h0376 (אִישׁ); to be a man, i.e. act in amanly way: - show (one) self a man.
; from h0376 (אִישׁ) and h1322 (בֹּשֶׁת); man of shame; Ish-Bosheth, a son of King Saul: - Ish-bosheth.
; from h0376 (אִישׁ) and h1935 (הוֹד); man of renown; Ishod, an Israelite: - Ishod.
; diminutive from h0376 (אִישׁ); the little man of the eye; the pupil or ball; hence, the middle (of night): - apple (of the eye), black, obscure.

; from h0376 (אִישׁ) and h2428 (חַיִל); man of might; by defective transcription (2 Samuel 23:20) אִישׁ־חַיxlit ʼÎsh-Chay corrected to ʼÎysh-Chay; as if from h0376 (אִישׁ) and h2416 (חַי); living man; Ishchail (or Ish-chai), an Israelite: - a valiant man.
; from h0376 (אִישׁ) and h2897 (טוֹב); man of Tob; Ish-Tob, a place in Palestine: - Ish-tob.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h3426 (יֵשׁ); properly, entity; used only as aparticle of affirmation, there is: - art thou, can, do ye, have, it be, there is (are), [idiom] we will not.
; perhaps from h0837 (אֹשֶׁר) and h0410 (אֵל); God has arrived; Ithiel, the name of an Israelite, also of a symbolical person: - Ithiel.
; from h0339 (אִי) and h8558 (תָּמָר); coast of the palm-tree; Ithamar, a son of Aaron: - Ithamar.
; or (shortened) אֵתָן ; from an unused root (meaning to continue); permanence; hence (concrete) permanent; specifically a chieftain: - hard, mighty, rough, strength, strong.
; the same as h0386 (אֵיתָן); permanent; Ethan, the name of four Israelites: - Ethan.
; plural of h0386 (אֵיתָן); always with the article; the permanent brooks; Ethanim, the name of a month: - Ethanim.

; akin to h0403 (אָכֵן); a particle of affirmation, surely; hence (by limitation) only: - also, in any wise, at least, but, certainly, even, howbeit, nevertheless, notwithstanding, only, save, surely, of a surety, truly, verily, [phrase] wherefore, yet (but).
; from an unused root probably meaning to strengthen; a fortress; Accad, a place in Babylon: - Accad.
; from h3576 (כָּזַב); falsehood; by implication treachery: - liar, lie.
; from h0391 (אַכְזָב); deceitful (in the sense of a winter-torrent which fails in summer); Akzib, the name of two places in Palestine: - Achzib.
; from an unused root (apparently meaning to act harshly); violent; by implication deadly; also (in a good sense) brave: - cruel, fierce.
; from h0393 (אַכְזָר); terrible: - cruel (one).
; from h0394 (אַכְזָרִי); fierceness: - cruel.
; feminine from h0398 (אָכַל); something eatable, i.e. food: - meat.
; of uncertain derivation; Akish, a Philistine king: - Achish.

; a primitive root; to eat (literally or figuratively): - [idiom] at all, burn up, consume, devour(-er, up), dine, eat(-er, up), feed (with), food, [idiom] freely, [idiom] in...wise(-deed, plenty), (lay) meat, [idiom] quite.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h0398 (אָכַל) {to eat (literally or figuratively)}: - [phrase] accuse, devour, eat.
; from h0398 (אָכַל); food: - eating, food, meal(-time), meat, prey, victuals.
; or אֻכָּל; apparently from h0398 (אָכַל); devoured; Ucal, a fancy name: - Ucal.
; feminine of h0401 (אֻכָל); food: - consume, devour, eat, food, meat.
; from h3559 (כּוּן) (compare h3651 (כֵּן)); firmly; figuratively, surely; also (advers.) but: - but, certainly, nevertheless, surely, truly, verily.
; a primitive root; apparently meaning to curve (as with a burden); to urge: - crave.
; from h0404 (אָכַף); a load; by implication, a stroke (others dignity): - hand.
; from an unused root meaning to dig; a farmer: - husbandman, ploughman.
; from h3784 (כָּשַׁף); fascination; Acshaph, a place in Palestine: - Achshaph.

; a negative particle (akin to h3808 (לֹא)); not (the qualified negation, used as a deprecative); once (Job 24:25) as a noun, nothing: - nay, neither, [phrase] never, no, nor, not, nothing (worth), rather than.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h0408 (אַל) {not (the qualified negation, used as a deprecative); once (Job 24:25) as a noun, nothing}: - not.

; shortened from h0352 (אַיִל); strength; as adjective, mighty; especially the Almighty (but used also of any deity): - God (god), [idiom] goodly, [idiom] great, idol, might(-y one), power, strong. Compare names in '-el.'
; a demonstrative particle (but only in a plural sense) these or those: - these, those. Compare h0428 (אֵלֶּה).
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h0411 (אֵל) {these or those}: - these.

; (but only used in the shortened constructive form אֶל ); a primitive particle; properly, denoting motion towards, but occasionally used of a quiescent position, i.e. near, with or among; often in general, to: - about, according to, after, against, among, as for, at, because(-fore, -side), both...and, by, concerning, for, from, [idiom] hath, in(-to), near, (out) of, over, through, to(-ward), under, unto, upon, whether, with(-in).
; a variation of h0424 (אֵלָה)lemma אִלָה first vowel, corrected to אֵלָה; oak; Ela, an Israelite: - Elah.

keynum.phon: ʼÊl ʼĕlôhêy Yisrâʼêl, ale el-o-hay' yis-rawale'
keynum.meaning: ; from h0410 (אֵל) and h0430 (אֱלֹהִים) and h3478 (יִשְׂרָאֵל); the mighty god if Jisrael; El-Elohi-Jisrael, the title given to a consecrated spot by Jacob: - Elelohe-israel.
; from h0410 (אֵל) and h1008 (בֵּית־אֵל); the God of Bethel; El-Bethel, the title given to a consecrated spot by Jacob: - El-beth-el.
; from h0410 (אֵל) and h1378 (גָּבִישׁ); hail (as if a great pearl): - great hail(-stones).
; by transposition for h0484 (אַלְמֻגִּים); sticks of algum wood: - algum (trees).
; from h0410 (אֵל) and h1730 (דּוֹד); God has loved; Eldad, an Israelite: - Eldad.
; from h0410 (אֵל) and h3045 (יָדַע); God of knowledge; Eldaah, a son of Midian: - Eldaah.
; a primitive root (rather identical with h0422 (אָלָה) through the idea of invocation); to bewail: - lament.
; a primitive root; properly, to adjure, i.e. (usually in a bad sense) imprecate: - adjure, curse, swear.
; from h0422 (אָלָה); an imprecation: - curse, cursing, execration, oath, swearing.
; feminine of h0352 (אַיִל); an oak or other strong tree: - elm, oak, teil-tree.
; the same as h0424 (אֵלָה)lemma אִלָה first vowel, corrected to אֵלָה; Elah, the name of an Edomite, of four Israelites, and also of a place in Palestine: - Elah.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h0433 (אֱלוֹהַּ); God: - God, god.
; A variation of h0424 (אֵלָה)lemma אִלָה first vowel, corrected to אֵלָה {an oak or other strong tree}: - oak.
; prolonged from h0411 (אֵל); these or those: - an-(the) other; one sort, so, some, such, them, these (same), they, this, those, thus, which, who(-m).
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h0428 (אֵלֶּה) {these or those}: - these.

; plural of h0433 (אֱלוֹהַּ); gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative: - angels, [idiom] exceeding, God (gods) (-dess, -ly), [idiom] (very) great, judges, [idiom] mighty.
; (Aramaic) probably prolonged from h0412 (אֵל); lo!: - behold.
; probably from h0408 (אַל); nay, i.e. (softened) if: - but if, yea though.
; rarely (shortened) אֱלֹהַּ; probably prolonged (emphatic) from h0410 (אֵל); a deity or the Deity: - God, god. See h0430 (אֱלֹהִים).
; for h0457 (אֱלִיל); good for nothing: - thing of nought.
; probably of foreign derivation; Elul, the sixth Jewish month: - Elul.
; prolonged from h0352 (אַיִל); an oak or other strong tree: - plain. See also h0356 (אֵילוֹן).
; a variation of h0436 (אֵלוֹן) {an oak or other strong tree}: - oak.
; the same as h0437 (אַלּוֹן); Allon, an Israelite, also a place in Palestine: - Allon.
; from h0437 (אַלּוֹן) and a variation of h1068 (בְּכִית); oak of weeping; Allon-Bakuth, a monumental tree: - Allon-bachuth.
; or rather (shortened) אֵלֹנִי; patron from h0438 (אַלּוֹן); an Elonite or descendant (collectively) of Elon: - Elonites.

; or (shortened) אַלֻּף; from h0502 (אָלַף); familiar; a friend, also gentle; hence, a bullock (as being tame; applied, although masculine, to a cow); and so, a chieftain (as notable, like neat cattle): - captain, duke, (chief) friend, governor, guide, ox.
; of uncertain derivation; Alush, a place in the Desert: - Alush.
; from h0410 (אֵל) and h2064 (זָבַד); God has bestowed; Elzabad, the name of two Israelites: - Elzabad.
; a primitive root; to muddle, i.e. (figuratively and intransitive) to turn (morally) corrupt: - become filthy.
; from h0410 (אֵל) and h2603 (חָנַן); God (is) gracious; Elchanan, an Israelite: - Elkanan.
; from h0410 (אֵל) and h0001 (אָב); God of (his) father; Eliab, the name of six Israelites: - Eliab.
; from h0410 (אֵל) repeated; God of (his) God; Eliel, the name of nine Israelites: - Eliel.
; or (contraction) אֱלִיָּתָה; from h0410 (אֵל) and h0225 (אוּת); God of (his) consent; Eliathah, an Israelite: - Eliathah.
; from the same as h0419 (אֶלְדָּד); God of (his) love; Elidad, an Israelite: - Elidad.
; from h0410 (אֵל) and h3045 (יָדַע); God (is) knowing; Eljada, the name of two Israelites and of an Aramaean leader: - Eliada.
; from h0422 (אָלָה) (in the original sense of strength); the stout part, i.e. the fat tail of the Oriental sheep: - rump.
; or prolonged אֵלִיָּהוּ; from h0410 (אֵל) and h3050 (יָהּ); God of Jehovah; Elijah, the name of the famous prophet and of two other Israelites: - Elijah, Eliah.
; or (fully) אֱלִיהוּא; from h0410 (אֵל) and h1931 (הוּא); God of him; Elihu, the name of one of Job's friends, and of three Israelites: - Elihu.
; or (shortened) אֶלְיוֹעֵינַי; from h0413 (אֵל) and h3068 (יְהֹוָה) and h5869 (עַיִן); towards Jehovah (are) my eyes; Eljehoenai or Eljoenai, the name of seven Israelites: - Elihoenai, Elionai.
; from h0410 (אֵל) and h2244 (חָבָא); God will hide; Eljachba, an Israelite: - Eliahbah.
; from h0410 (אֵל) and h2779 (חֹרֶף); God of autumn; Elichoreph, an Israelite: - Elihoreph.
; apparently from h0408 (אַל); good for nothing, by anal. vain or vanity; specifically an idol: - idol, no value, thing of nought.
; from h0410 (אֵל) and h4428 (מֶלֶךְ); God of (the) king; Elimelek, an Israelite: - Elimelech.
; (Aramaic) or shorter אִלֵּן; prolonged from h0412 (אֵל); these: - the, these.
; from h0410 (אֵל) and h3254 (יָסַף); God (is) gatherer; Eljasaph, the name of two Israelites: - Eliasaph.
; from h0410 (אֵל) and h5828 (עֵזֶר); God of help; Eliezer, the name of a Damascene and of ten Israelites: - Eliezer.
; probably contracted for h0454 (אֶלְיְהוֹעֵינַי); Elienai, an Israelite: - Elienai.
; from h0410 (אֵל) and h5971 (עַם); God of (the) people; Eliam, an Israelite: - Eliam.
; from h0410 (אֵל) and h6337 (פָּז); God of gold; Eliphaz, the name of one of Job's friends, and of a son of Esau: - Eliphaz.
; from h0410 (אֵל) and h6419 (פָּלַל); God of judgment; Eliphal, an Israelite: - Eliphal.
; from h0410 (אֵל) and h6395 (פָּלָה); God of his distinction; Eliphelehu, an Israelite: - Elipheleh.
; or (shortened) אֱלְפֶּלֶט; from h0410 (אֵל) and h6405 (פַּלֵּט); God of deliverance; Eliphelet or Elpelet, the name of six Israelites: - Eliphalet, Eliphelet, Elpalet.
; from h0410 (אֵל) and h6697 (צוּר); God of (the) rock; Elitsur, an Israelite: - Elizur.
; or (shortened) אֶלְצָפָן; from h0410 (אֵל) and h6845 (צָפַן); God of treasure; Elitsaphan or Eltsaphan, an Israelite: - Elizaphan, Elzaphan.
; from h0410 (אֵל) and h6958 (קוֹא); God of rejection; Elika, an Israelite: - Elika.
; from h0410 (אֵל) and h6965 (קוּם); God of raising; Eljakim, the name of four Israelites: - Eliakim.
; from h0410 (אֵל) and h7651 (שֶׁבַע) (in the sense of h7650 (שָׁבַע)); God of (the) oath; Elisheba, the wife of Aaron: - Elisheba.
; probably of foreign derivation; Elishah, a son of Javan: - Elishah.
; from h0410 (אֵל) and h7769 (שׁוּעַ); God of supplication (or of riches); Elishua, the son of King David: - Elishua.
; from h0410 (אֵל) and h7725 (שׁוּב); God will restore; Eljashib, the name of six Israelites: - Eliashib.
; from h0410 (אֵל) and h8085 (שָׁמַע); God of hearing; Elishama, the name of seven Israelites: - Elishama.
; contracted for h0474 (אֱלִישׁוּעַ).; Elisha, the famous prophet: - Elisha.
; from h0410 (אֵל) and h8199 (שָׁפַט); God of judgment; Elishaphat, an Israelite: - Elishaphat.
; (Aramaic) prolonged from h0412 (אֵל); these: - these, those.
; by reduplication from h0421 (אָלָה); alas!: - woe.
; a primitive root; to tie fast; hence (of the mouth) to be tongue-tied: - bind, be dumb, put to silence.
; from h0481 (אָלַם); silence (i.e. mute justice): - congregation. Compare h3128 (יוֹנַת אֵלֶם רְחֹקִים).
; from h0481 (אָלַם); speechless: - dumb (man).
; probably of foreign derivation (used thus only in the plural); almug (i.e. probably sandle-wood) sticks: - almug trees. Compare h0418 (אַלְגּוּמִּים).
; or (masculine) אָלֻם; passive participle of h0481 (אָלַם); something bound; a sheaf: - sheaf.
; probably of foreign derivation Almodad, a son of Joktan: - Almodad.
; from h0427 (אַלָּה) and h4428 (מֶלֶךְ); oak of (the) king; Allammelek, a place in Palestine: - Alammelech.
; prolonged from h0481 (אָלַם) in the sense of bereavement; discarded (as a divorced person): - forsaken.
; from h0481 (אָלַם) as in h0488 (אַלְמָן); bereavement: - widowhood.
; feminine of h0488 (אַלְמָן); a widow; also a desolate place: - desolate house (palace), widow.
; feminine of h0488 (אַלְמָן); concrete, a widow; abstract, widowhood: - widow, widowhood.
; from h0489 (אַלְמֹן) in the sense of concealment; some one (i.e. so and so, without giving the name of the person or place): - one, and such.
; from h0410 (אֵל) and h5276 (נָעֵם); God (is his) delight; Elnaam, an Israelite: - Elnaam.
; from h0410 (אֵל) and h5414 (נָתַן); God (is the) giver; Elnathan, the name of four Israelites: - Elnathan.
; probably of foreign derivation; Ellasar, an early country of Asia: - Ellasar.
; from h0410 (אֵל) and h5749 (עוּד); God has testified; Elad, an Israelite: - Elead.
; from h0410 (אֵל) and h5710 (עָדָה); God has decked; Eladah, an Israelite: - Eladah.
; from h0410 (אֵל) and h5756 (עוּז) (in the sense of h5797 (עֹז)); God (is) defensive; Eluzai, an Israelite: - Eluzai.
; from h0410 (אֵל) and h5826 (עָזַר); God (is) helper; Elazar, the name of seven Israelites: - Eleazar.
; or (more properly) אֶלְעָלֵה; from h0410 (אֵל) and h5927 (עָלָה); God (is) going up; Elale or Elaleh, a place east of the Jordan: - Elealeh.
; from h0410 (אֵל) and h6213 (עָשָׂה); God has made; Elasah, the name of four Israelites: - Elasah, Eleasah.
; a primitive root, to associate with; hence, to learn (and causatively to teach): - learn, teach, utter.
; denominative from h0505 (אֶלֶף); causative, to make athousandfold: - bring forth thousands.
; from h0502 (אָלַף); a family; also (from the sense of yoking or taming) an ox or cow: - family, kine, oxen.
; prop, the same as h0504 (אֶלֶף); hence (the ox's head being the first letter of the alphabet, and this eventually used as a numeral) a thousand: - thousand.
; (Aramaic) or אֶלֶף; (Aramaic), corresponding to h0505 (אֶלֶף) {hence (the ox's head being the first letter of the alphabet, and this eventually used as a numeral) a thousand}: - thousand.
; the same as h0505 (אֶלֶף); Eleph, a place in Palestine: - Eleph.
; from h0410 (אֵל) and h6466 (פָּעַל); God (is) act; Elpaal, an Israelite: - Elpaal.
; a primitive root; to press: - urge.
; probably from h0408 (אַל) and h6965 (קוּם); a non-rising (i.e. resistlessness): - no rising up.
; from h0410 (אֵל) and h7069 (קָנָה); God has obtained; Elkanah, the name of several Israelites: - Elkanah.
; patrial from a name of uncertain derivation; an Elkoshite or native of Elkosh: - Elkoshite.
; probably from h0410 (אֵל) and a masculine form of h8435 (תּוֹלְדָה) (compare h8434 (תּוֹלָד)); God (is) generator; Eltolad, a place in Palestine: - Eltolad.
; or (more properly) אֶלְתְּקֵה; of uncertain derivation; Eltekeh or Elteke, a place in Palestine: - Eltekeh.
; from h0410 (אֵל) and h8626 (תָּקַן); God (is) straight; Eltekon, a place in Palestine: - Eltekon.
; from h0408 (אַל) and h7843 (שָׁחַת); 'Thou must not destroy'; probably the opening words to a popular song: - Al-taschith.
; a primitive word; a mother (as the bond of the family); in a wide sense (both literally and figuratively (like father)): - dam, mother, [idiom] parting.

; a primitive particle; used very widely as demonstrative, lo!; interrogative, whether?; or conditional, if, although; also Oh that!, when; hence, as a negative, not: - (and, can-, doubtless, if, that) (not), [phrase] but, either, [phrase] except, [phrase] more(-over if, than), neither, nevertheless, nor, oh that, or, [phrase] save (only, -ing), seeing, since, sith, [phrase] surely (no more, none, not), though, [phrase] of a truth, [phrase] unless, [phrase] verily, when, whereas, whether, while, [phrase] yet.
; apparently a primitive word; a maidservant or female slave: - (hand-) bondmaid(-woman), maid(-servant).

; prolonged from h0517 (אֵם); properly, a mother (i.e. unit of measure, or the fore-arm (below the elbow), i.e. a cubit; also a door-base (as a bond of the entrance): - cubit, [phrase] hundred (by exchange for h3967 (מֵאָה)), measure, post.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h0520 (אַמָּה) {properly, a mother (i.e. unit of measure, or the fore-arm (below the elbow), i.e. a cubit; also a door-base (as a bond of the entrance)}: - cubit.
; the same as h0520 (אַמָּה); Ammah, a hill in Palestine: - Ammah.
; from the same as h0517 (אֵם); a collection, i.e. community of persons: - nation, people.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h0523 (אֻמַּה) {a collection, i.e. community of persons}: - nation.
; from h0539 (אָמַן), probably in the sense of training; like h0542 (אָמָן) skilled, i.e. an architect: - one brought up.
; the same as h0525 (אָמוֹן); Amon, the name of three Israelites: - Amon.
; a variation for h1995 (הָמוֹן); a throng of people: - multitude.
; of Egyptian derivation; used only as an adjunct of h4996 (נֹא) Amon (i.e. Ammon or Amn), a deity of Egypt: - multitude, populous.
; from h0539 (אָמַן); established, i.e. (figuratively) trusty; also (abstractly) trustworthiness: - faith(-ful), truth.

; or (shortened) אֱמֻנָה; feminine of h0529 (אֵמוּן); literally firmness; figuratively security; morally fidelity: - faith(-ful, -ly, -ness, (man)), set office, stability, steady, truly, truth, verily.
; from h0553 (אָמַץ); strong; Amots, an Israelite: - Amoz.
; an abbreviated form for h0526 (אָמוֹן); Ami, an Israelite: - Ami.
; or (shortened) אַמִּץ; from h0553 (אָמַץ); strong or (abstractly) strength: - courageous, mighty, strong (one).
; apparently from h0559 (אָמַר) (in the sense of self-exaltation); a summit (of a tree or mountain: - bough, branch.
; a primitive root; to droop; by implication to be sick, to mourn: - languish, be weak, wax feeble.
; from h0535 (אָמַל); sick: - weak.
; from h0535 (אָמַל); languid: - feeble.
; from h0517 (אֵם); gathering-spot; Amam, a place in Palestine: - Amam.

; a primitive root; (Isaiah 30:21; interchangeable with h0541 (אָמַן), to go to the right hand) properly, to build up or support; to foster as a parent or nurse; figuratively to render (or be) firm or faithful, to trust or believe, to be permanent or quiet; morally to be true or certain;: - hence, assurance, believe, bring up, establish, [phrase] fail, be faithful (of long continuance, stedfast, sure, surely, trusty, verified), nurse, (-ing father), (put), trust, turn to the right.

; (Aramaic) corresponding to h0539 (אָמַן) {properly, to build up or support; to foster as a parent or nurse; figuratively to render (or be) firm or faithful, to trust or believe, to be permanent or quiet; morally to be true or certain};: - believe, faithful, sure.
; denominative from h3225 (יָמִין); to take the right hand road: - turn to the right. See h0539 (אָמַן).
; from h0539 (אָמַן) (in the sense of training); an expert: - cunning workman.
; from h0539 (אָמַן); sure; abstract, faithfulness; adverb, truly: - Amen, so be it, truth.
; from h0539 (אָמַן); verity: - truth.
; feminine of h0544 (אֹמֶן) (in the specific sense of training); tutelage: - brought up.
; feminine form of h0544 (אֹמֶן) (in its usual sense); adverb, surely: - indeed.
; feminine active participle of h0544 (אֹמֶן) (in the original sense of supporting); a column: - pillar.
; feminine of h0543 (אָמֵן); something fixed, i.e. a covenant. an allowance: - certain portion, sure.
; the same as h0548 (אֲמָנָה); Amanah, a mountain near Damascus: - Amana.
; or אֲמִינוֹן; from h0539 (אָמַן); faithful; Amnon (or Aminon), a son of David: - Amnon.
; adverb from h0544 (אֹמֶן); verily: - indeed, no doubt, surely, (it is, of a) true(-ly, -th).
; an orthographical variation of h0551 (אׇמְנָם) {verily}: - in (very) deed; of a surety.

; a primitive root; to be alert, physically (on foot) or mentally (in courage): - confirm, be courageous (of good courage, stedfastly minded, strong, stronger), establish, fortify, harden, increase, prevail, strengthen (self), make strong (obstinate, speed).
; probably from h0553 (אָמַץ); of a strong color, i.e. red (others fleet): - bay.
; from h0553 (אָמַץ); strength: - stronger.
; from h0553 (אָמַץ); force: - strength.
; from h0553 (אָמַץ); strong; Amtsi, an Israelite: - Amzi.
; or אֲמַצְיָהוּ; from h0553 (אָמַץ) and h3050 (יָהּ); strength of Jah; Amatsjah, the name of four Israelites: - Amaziah.

; a primitive root; to say (used with great latitude): - answer, appoint, avouch, bid, boast self, call, certify, challenge, charge, [phrase] (at the, give) command(-ment), commune, consider, declare, demand, [idiom] desire, determine, [idiom] expressly, [idiom] indeed, [idiom] intend, name, [idiom] plainly, promise, publish, report, require, say, speak (against, of), [idiom] still, [idiom] suppose, talk, tell, term, [idiom] that is, [idiom] think, use (speech), utter, [idiom] verily, [idiom] yet.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h0559 (אָמַר) {to say (used with great latitude)}: - command, declare, say, speak, tell.
; from h0559 (אָמַר); something said: - answer, [idiom] appointed unto him, saying, speech, word.
; the same as h0561 (אֵמֶר) {something said}: - promise, speech, thing, word.
; (Aramaic) perhaps from h0560 (אֲמַר) (in the sense of bringing forth); a lamb: - lamb.
; from h0559 (אָמַר); talkative; Immer, the name of five Israelites: - Immer.
; or אֶמְרָה; feminine of h0561 (אֵמֶר), and meaning the same {something said}: - commandment, speech, word.
; from h0564 (אִמֵּר); Imri, the name of two Israelites: - Imri.
; probably a patronymic from an unused name derived from h0559 (אָמַר) in the sense of publicity, i.e. prominence; thus, a mountaineer; an Emorite, one of the Canaanitish tribes: - Amorite.
; or prolonged אֲמַרְיָהוּ; from h0559 (אָמַר) and h3050 (יָהּ); Jah has said (i.e. promised); Amarjah, the name of nine Israelites: - Amariah.
; of uncertain (perhaps foreign) derivation; Amraphel, a king of Shinar: - Amraphel.
; time past, i.e. yesterday or last night: - former time, yesterday(-night)
; contracted from h0539 (אָמַן); stability; (figuratively) certainty, truth, trustworthiness: - assured(-ly), establishment, faithful, right, sure, true (-ly, -th), verity.
; from h4969 (מָתַח); properly, something expansive, i.e. a bag: - sack.
; from h0571 (אֶמֶת); veracious; Amittai, an Israelite: - Amittai.
; (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to that of h4975 (מֹתֶן); well-loined (i.e. burly) or mighty: - terrible.
; or אָנָה; contracted from h0370 (אַיִן); where?; hence, whither?, when?; also hither and thither: - [phrase] any (no) whither, now, where, whither(-soever).
; (Aramaic) or אֲנָה; (Aramaic), corresponding to h0589 (אֲנִי)lemma אֲנַי second vowel, corrected to אֲנִי; I: - I, as for me.
; or אָנָּה; apparent contracted from h0160 (אַהֲבָה) and h4994 (נָא); oh now!: - I (me) beseech (pray) thee, O.
; a primitive root; to groan: - lament, mourn.
; a primitive root (perhaps rather identical with h0578 (אָנָה) through the idea of contraction in anguish); to approach; hence, to meet in various senses: - befall, deliver, happen, seek a quarrel.
; contracted for h0587 (אֲנַחְנוּ); we: - we.
; (Aramaic) or (feminine) אִנִּיןlemma אֵנִּין first vowel, corrected to אִנִּין; (Aramaic), corresponding to h1992 (הֵם); they: - [idiom] are, them, these.

; from h0605 (אָנַשׁ); properly, a mortal (and thus differing from the more dignified h0120 (אָדָם)); hence, a man in general (singly or collectively): - another, [idiom] (blood-) thirsty, certain, chap(-man); divers, fellow, [idiom] in the flower of their age, husband, (certain, mortal) man, people, person, servant, some ([idiom] of them), [phrase] stranger, those, [phrase] their trade. It is often unexpressed in the English versions, especially when used in apposition with another word. Compare h0376 (אִישׁ).
; the same as h0582 (אֱנוֹשׁ); Enosh, a son of Seth: - Enos.
; a primitive root; to sigh: - groan, mourn, sigh.
; from h0585 (אֲנָחָה); sighing: - groaning, mourn, sigh.
; (Aramaic) or אֲנַחְנָה; (Aramaic), corresponding to h0587 (אֲנַחְנוּ); we: - we.
; apparently from h0595 (אָנֹכִי); we: - ourselves, us, we.
; probably from the same root as h5170 (נַחַר); a gorge or narrow pass; Anacharath, a place in Palestine: - Anaharath.
; contracted from h0595 (אָנֹכִי); I: - I, (as for) me, mine, myself, we, [idiom] which, [idiom] who.
; probably from h0579 (אָנָה) (in the sense of conveyance); -a ship or (collectively) a fleet: - galley, navy (of ships).
; feminine of h0590 (אֳנִי); a ship: - ship(-men).
; from h0578 (אָנָה); groaning: - lamentation, sorrow.
; from h0578 (אָנָה) and h5971 (עַם); groaning of (the) people; Aniam, an Israelite: - Aniam.
; probably from an unused root meaning to be narrow; according to most a plumb-line, and to others a hook: - plumb-line
; sometimes, ; a primitive pronoun; I: - I, me, [idiom] which.
; a primitive root; to mourn, i.e. complain: - complain.
; to insist: - compel.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h0597 (אָנַס); figuratively, to distress: - trouble.
; a primitive root; to breathe hard, i.e. be enraged: - be angry (displeased).
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h0639 (אַף) (only in the plural as a singular); the face: - face, visage.
; from h0599 (אָנַף); an unclean bird, perhaps the parrot (from its irascibility): - heron.
; a primitive root; to shriek: - cry, groan.
; from h0602 (אָנַק); shrieking: - crying out, groaning, sighing.
; the same as h0603 (אֲנָקָה); some kind of lizard, probably the gecko (from its wail): - ferret.
; a primitive root; to be frail, feeble, or (figuratively) melancholy: - desperate(-ly wicked), incurable, sick, woeful.
; (Aramaic) or אֱנַשׁ; (Aramaic), corresponding to h0582 (אֱנוֹשׁ); a man: - man, [phrase] whosoever.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h0859 (אַתָּה); thou: - as for thee, thou.
; (Aramaic) plural of h0607 (אַנְתָּה); ye: - ye.
; of uncertain derivation; Asa, the name of a king and of a Levite: - Asa.
; from h5480 (סוּךְ); anointed, i.e. an oil-flask: - pot.
; of uncertain derivation; hurt: - mischief.
; from h0631 (אָסַר); a bond (especially manacles of a prisoner): - band, [phrase] prison.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h0612 (אֵסוּר) {a bond (especially manacles of a prisoner)}: - band, imprisonment.
; or אָסִף; from h0622 (אָסַף); gathered, i.e. (abstractly) a gathering in of crops: - ingathering.
; from h0631 (אָסַר); bound, i.e. a captive: - (those which are) bound, prisoner.
; for h0615 (אָסִיר) {bound, i.e. a captive}: - prisoner.
; the same as h0616 (אַסִּיר); prisoner; Assir, the name of two Israelites: - Assir.
; from an unused root meaning to heap together; a storehouse (only in the plural): - barn, storehouse.
; of uncertain derivation; Asnah, one of the Nethinim: - Asnah.
; of foreign derivation; Osnappar, an Assyrian king: - Asnapper.
; of Egyptian derivation; Asenath, the wife of Joseph: - Asenath.

; a primitive root; to gather for any purpose; hence, to receive, take away, i.e. remove (destroy, leave behind, put up, restore, etc.): - assemble, bring, consume, destroy, felch, gather (in, together, up again), [idiom] generally, get (him), lose, put all together, receive, recover (another from leprosy), (be) rereward, [idiom] surely, take (away, into, up), [idiom] utterly, withdraw.
; from h0622 (אָסַף); collector; Asaph, the name of three Israelites, and of the family of the first: - Asaph.
; passive participle of h0622 (אָסַף); collected (only in the plural), i.e. a collection of offerings): - threshold, Asuppim.
; from h0622 (אָסַף); a collection (of fruits): - gathering.
; from h0622 (אָסַף); a collection of people (only adverbial): - [idiom] together.
; feminine of h0624 (אָסֻף); a collection of (learned) men (only in the plural): - assembly.
; by reduplication from h0624 (אָסֻף); gathered up together, i.e. a promiscuous assemblage (of people): - mixt multitude.
; (Aramaic) of Persian derivation; diligently: - fast, forthwith, speed(-ily).
; of Persian derivation; Aspatha, a son of Haman: - Aspatha.

; a primitive root; to yoke or hitch; by analogy, to fasten in any sense, to join battle: - bind, fast, gird, harness, hold, keep, make ready, order, prepare, prison(-er), put in bonds, set in array, tie.
; or אִסָּר; from h0631 (אָסַר); an obligation or vow (of abstinence): - binding, bond.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h0632 (אֱסָר) in a legal sense; an interdict: - decree.
; of foreign derivation; Esar-chaddon, an Assyrian king: - Esar-haddon.
; of Persian derivation; Ester, the Jewish heroine: - Esther.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h6086 (עֵץ); a tree or wood: - timber, wood.

; a primitive particle; meaning accession (used as an adverb or conjunction); also or yea; adversatively though: - also, [phrase] although, and (furthermore, yet), but, even, [phrase] how much less (more, rather than), moreover, with, yea.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h0637 (אַף) {meaning accession (used as an adverb or conjunction); also or yea; adversatively though}: - also.

; from h0599 (אָנַף); properly, the nose or nostril; hence, the face, and occasionally a person; also (from the rapid breathing in passion) ire: - anger(-gry), [phrase] before, countenance, face, [phrase] forebearing, forehead, [phrase] (long-) suffering, nose, nostril, snout, [idiom] worthy, wrath.
; a primitive root (rather a denominative from h0646 (אֵפוֹד)); to gird on (the ephod): - bind, gird.
; the same as h0646 (אֵפוֹד) shortened; Ephod, an Israelite: - Ephod.
; feminine of h0646 (אֵפוֹד); a girding on (of the ephod); hence, generally, a plating (of metal): - ephod, ornament.
; apparently of foreign derivation; a pavilion or palace-tent: - palace.
; a primitive root; to cook, especially to bake: - bake(-r, (-meats)).
; or אֵפוֹא; from h6311 (פֹּה); strictly a demonstrative particle, here; but used of time, now or then: - here, now, where?
; rarely אֵפֹד; probably of foreign derivation a girdle; specifically the ephod or highpriest's shoulder-piece; also generally, an image: - ephod.
; perhaps from h6315 (פּוּחַ); breeze; Aphiach, an Israelite: - Aphiah.
; from the same as h0651 (אָפֵל) (in the sense of weakness); unripe: - not grown up.
; dual of h0639 (אַף); two nostrils; Appajim, an Israelite: - Appaim.
; from h0622 (אָסַף); properly, containing, i.e. a tube; also a bed or valley of astream; also a strong thing or a hero: - brook, channel, mighty, river, [phrase] scale, stream, strong piece.
; from an unused root meaning to set as the sun; dusky: - very dark.
; from the same as h0651 (אָפֵל); dusk: - darkness, obscurity, privily.
; feminine of h0651 (אָפֵל); duskiness, figuratively, misfortune; concrete, concealment: - dark, darkness, gloominess, [idiom] thick.
; from h6419 (פָּלַל); judge; Ephlal, an Israelite: - Ephlal.
; from an unused root meaning to revolve; a turn, i.e. a season: - [phrase] fitly.
; a primitive root; to disappear, i.e. cease: - be clean gone (at an end, brought to nought), fail.

; from h0656 (אָפֵס); (sometimes like h6466 (פָּעַל)) cessation, i.e. an end (especially of the earth); often used adverb, no further; also the ankle (in the dual), as being the extremity of the leg or foot: - ankle, but (only), end, howbeit, less than nothing, nevertheless (where), no, none (beside), not (any, -withstanding), thing of nought, save(-ing), there, uttermost part, want, without (cause).
; from h0657 (אֶפֶס) and the plural of h1818 (דָּם); boundary of blood-drops; Ephes-Dammim, a place in Palestine: - Ephes-dammim.
; from an unused root probably meaning to breathe; properly, a breath, i.e. nothing: - of nought.
; from h0659 (אֵפַע) (in the sense of hissing); an asp or other venomous serpent: - viper.
; a primitive root; to surround: - compass.
; a primitive root; to contain, i.e. (reflex.) abstain: - force (oneself), restrain.
; or אֲפִיק; from h0662 (אָפַק) (in the sense of strength); fortress; Aphek (or Aphik), the name of three places in Palestine: - Aphek, Aphik.
; feminine of h0663 (אֲפֵק); fortress; Aphekah, a place in Palestine: - Aphekah.
; from an unused root meaning to bestrew; ashes: - ashes.
; from the same as h0665 (אֵפֶר) (in the sense of covering); a turban: - ashes.
; from h6524 (פָּרַח) (in the sense of bursting the shell); the brood of a bird: - young (one).
; probably of Egyptian derivation; a palanquin: - chariot.
; dual of masculine form of h0672 (אֶפְרָת); double fruit; Ephrajim, a son of Joseph; also the tribe descended from him, and its territory: - Ephraim, Ephraimites.
; (Aramaic) of foreign origin (only in the plural); an Apherasite or inhabitant of an unknown region of Assyria: - Apharsite.
; (Aramaic) or אֲפַרְסַתְכַי; (Aramaic), of foreign origin (only in the plural); an Apharsekite or Apharsathkite, an unknown Assyrian tribe: - Apharsachites, Apharasthchites.
; or אֶפְרָתָה; from h6509 (פָּרָה); fruitfulness; Ephrath, another name for Bethlehem;: - once (Psalm 132:6) perhaps for Ephraim; also of an Israelitish woman; Ephrath, Ephratah.
; patrial from h0672 (אֶפְרָת); an Ephrathite or an Ephraimite: - Ephraimite, Ephrathite.
; (Aramaic) of Persian origin; revenue; others at the last: - revenue.
; or אֶצְבֹּן; of uncertain derivation; Etsbon, the name of two Israelites: - Ezbon.
; from the same as h6648 (צֶבַע) (in the sense of grasping); something to sieze with, i.e. a finger; by analogy, a toe: - finger, toe.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h0676 (אֶצְבַּע) {something to sieze with, i.e. a finger; by analogy, a toe}: - finger, toe.
; from h0680 (אָצַל) (in its secondary sense of separation); an extremity (Isaiah 41:9), also a noble: - chief man, noble.
; from h0680 (אָצַל) (in its primary sense of uniting); a joint of the hand (i.e. knuckle); also (according to some) a party-wall (Ezekiel 41:8): - (arm) hole, great.
; a primitive root; properly, to join; used only as a denominative from h0681 (אֵצֶל); to separate; hence, to select, refuse, contract: - keep, reserve, straiten, take.
; from h0680 (אָצַל) (in the sense of joining); a side; (as a preposition) near: - at, (hard) by, (from) (beside), near (unto), toward, with. See also h1018 (בֵּית הָאֵצֶל).
; from h0680 (אָצַל); noble; Atsel, the name of an Israelite, and of a place in Palestine: - Azal, Azel.
; from h0680 (אָצַל) and h3050 (יָהּ) prolonged; Jah has reserved; Atsaljah, an Israelite: - Azaliah.
; from an unused root probably meaning to be strong; strength (i.e. strong); Otsem, the name of two Israelites: - Ozem.
; a variation from h6807 (צְעָדָה); properly, a step-chain; by analogy, a bracelet: - bracelet, chain.
; a primitive root; to store up: - (lay up in) store, [phrase] (make) treasure(-r).
; from h0686 (אָצַר); treasure; Etser, an Idumaean: - Ezer.
; from h6916 (קִדָּה); burning, i.e. a carbuncle or other fiery gem: - carbuncle.
; probably from h0602 (אָנַק); slender, i.e. the ibex: - wild goat.
; probably for h0738 (אֲרִי); lion; Ara, an Israelite: - Ara.
; probably for h0739 (אֲרִיאֵל); a hero (collectively): - valiant one.
; from h0691 (אֶרְאֵל); heroic; Areli (or an Arelite, collectively), an Israelite and his descendants: - Areli, Arelites.
; a primitive root; to lurk: - (lie in) ambush(-ment), lay (lie in) wait.
; from h0693 (אָרַב); ambush; Arab, a place in Palestine: - Arab.
; from h0693 (אָרַב); ambuscade: - den, lie in wait.
; the same as h0695 (אֶרֶב) {ambuscade}: - wait.
; from h7235 (רָבָה); a locust (from its rapid increase): - grasshopper, locust.
; feminine of h0696 (אֹרֶב) (only in the plural); ambuscades: - spoils.

; feminine participle passive of h0693 (אָרַב) (as if for lurking); a lattice; (by implication) a window, dovecot (because of the pigeon-holes), chimney (with its apertures for smoke), sluice (with openings for water): - chimney, window.
; plural of h0699 (אֲרֻבָּה); Arubboth, a place in Palestine: - Aruboth.
; patrial from h0694 (אֲרָב); an Arbite or native of Arab: - Arbite.
; masculine אַרְבָּעָה; from h7251 (רָבַע); four: - four.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h0702 (אַרְבַּע) {four}: - four.
; the same as h0702 (אַרְבַּע); Arba, one of the Anakim: - Arba.
; multiple of h0702 (אַרְבַּע); forty: - -forty.
; dual of h0702 (אַרְבַּע); fourfold: - fourfold.
; a primitive root; to plait or weave: - weaver(-r).
; from h0707 (אָרַג); a weaving; a braid; also a shuttle: - beam, weaver's shuttle.
; from the same as h7263 (רֶגֶב); stony; Argob, a district of Palestine: - Argob.
; a variation for h0713 (אַרְגָּמָן); purple: - purple.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h0710 (אַרְגְּוָן) {purple}: - purple.
; perhaps from h7264 (רָגַז) (in the sense of being suspended), a box (as a pannier): - coffer.
; of foreign origin; purple (the color or the dyed stuff): - purple.
; from an unused root probably meaning to wander; fugitive; Ard, the name of two Israelites: - Ard.
; from the same as h0714 (אַרְדְּ); roaming; Ardon, an Israelite: - Ardon.
; patronymic from h0714 (אַרְדְּ); an Ardite (collectively) or descendant of Ard: - Ardites.
; a primitive root; to pluck: - gather, pluck.
; (Aramaic) probably akin to h0431 (אֲלוּ); lo!: - behold, lo.
; probably from h7300 (רוּד); a refuge for the roving; Arvad, an island-city of Palestine: - Arvad.
; an orthographical variation of h0719 (אַרְוַד); fugitive; Arod, an Israelite: - Arod.
; patrial from h0719 (אַרְוַד); an Arvadite or citizen of Arvad: - Arvadite.
; patronymic from h0721 (אַרְוָדִי); an Arodite or descendant of Arod: - Arodi, Arodites.
; or אֲרָיָה; from h0717 (אָרָה) (in the sense of feeding); a herding-place for an animal: - stall.
; or אֲרֻכָה; feminine passive participle of h0748 (אָרַךְ) (in the sense of restoring to soundness); wholeness (literally or figuratively): - health, made up, perfected.
; a variation of h7316 (רוּמָה); height; Arumah, a place in Palestine: - Arumah.
; a clerical error for h0130 (אֱדֹמִי); an Edomite (as in the margin): - Syrian.
; or אָרֹן; from h0717 (אָרָה) (in the sense of gathering); a box: - ark, chest, coffin.
