; or (by transposition) אוֹרְנָה; or אַרְנִיָּהlemma אַנִיָּה missing resh, corrected to אַרְנִיָּה; all by orthographical variation for h0771 (אׇרְנָן); Aravnah (or Arnijah or Ornah), a Jebusite: - Araunah.
; a primitive root; to be firm; used only in the passive participle as a denominative from h0730 (אֶרֶז); of cedar: - made of cedar.
; from h0729 (אָרַז); a cedar tree (from the tenacity of its roots): - cedar (tree).
; feminine of h0730 (אֶרֶז); cedar wainscoating: - cedar work.
; a primitive root; to travel: - go, wayfaring (man).
; from h0732 (אָרַח); way faring; Arach, the name of three Israelites: - Arah.
; from h0732 (אָרַח); a well-trodden road (literally or figuratively); also a caravan: - manner, path, race, rank, traveller, troop, (by-, high-) way.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h0734 (אֹרַח); a road: - way.
; feminine active participle of h0732 (אָרַח); a caravan: - (travelling) company.
; feminine passive participle of h0732 (אָרַח) (in the sense of appointing); a ration of food: - allowance, diet, dinner, victuals.

; a primitive root; to divide (in variation senses literally or figuratively, separate, distinguish, differ, select, etc.): - (make, put) difference, divide (asunder), (make) separate (self, -ation), sever (out), [idiom] utterly.
; from h0914 (בָּדַל); a part: - piece.
; probably from h0914 (בָּדַל); something in pieces, i.e. bdellium, a (fragrant) gum (perhaps amber); others a pearl: - bdellium.
; probably shortened for h5658 (עַבְדוֹן); servile; Bedan, the name of two Israelites: - Bedan.
; a primitive root; to gap open; used only as a denominative from h0919 (בֶּדֶק); to mend a breach: - repair.
; from h0918 (בָּדַק); a gap or leak (in a building or a ship): - breach, [phrase] calker.
; probably from h1856 (דָּקַר) with a prepositional prefix; by stabbing, i.e. assassin; Bidkar, an Israelite: - Bidkar.
; (Aramaic) corresponding (by transposition) to h6504 (פָּרַד); to scatter: - scatter.
; from an unused root (meaning to be empty); a vacuity, i.e. (superficially) an undistinguishable ruin: - emptiness, void.
; from an unused root (probably meaning to glisten); white marble or perhaps alabaster: - red (marble).
; (Aramaic) from h0927 (בְּהַל); a hurry; only adverb, hastily: - in haste.
; from an unused root (meaning to be bright); shining: - bright.

; a primitive root; to tremble inwardly (or palpitate), i.e. (figuratively) be (causative, make) (suddenly) alarmed or agitated; by implication to hasten anxiously: - be (make) affrighted (afraid, amazed, dismayed, rash), (be, get, make) haste(-n, -y, -ily), (give) speedy(-ily), thrust out, trouble, vex.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h0926 (בָּהַל); to terrify, hasten: - in haste, trouble.
; from h0926 (בָּהַל); panic, destruction: - terror, trouble.
; from an unused root (probably meaning to be mute); properly, a dumb beast; especially any large quadruped or animal (often collective): - beast, cattle.
; in form a plural or h0929 (בְּהֵמָה), but really a singular of Egyptian derivation; a water-ox, i.e. the hippopotamus or Nile-horse: - Behemoth.
; from an unused root apparently meaning to be thick; the thumb of the hand or great toe of the foot: - thumb, great toe.
; an orthographical variation of h0931 (בֹּהֶן); thumb, Bohan, an Israelite: - Bohan.
; from an unused root meaning to be pale; white scurf: - freckled spot.
; feminine active participle of the same as h0925 (בָּהִיר); a whitish spot on the skin: - bright spot.

; a primitive root; to go or come (in a wide variety of applications): - abide, apply, attain, [idiom] be, befall, [phrase] besiege, bring (forth, in, into, to pass), call, carry, [idiom] certainly, (cause, let, thing for) to come (against, in, out, upon, to pass), depart, [idiom] doubtless again, [phrase] eat, [phrase] employ, (cause to) enter (in, into, -tering, -trance, -try), be fallen, fetch, [phrase] follow, get, give, go (down, in, to war), grant, [phrase] have, [idiom] indeed, (in-) vade, lead, lift (up), mention, pull in, put, resort, run (down), send, set, [idiom] (well) stricken (in age), [idiom] surely, take (in), way.
; a primitive root; to disrespect: - contemn, despise, [idiom] utterly.
; from h0936 (בּוּז); disrespect: - contempt(-uously), despised, shamed.
; the same as h0937 (בּוּז); Buz, the name of a son of Nahor, and of an Israelite: - Buz.
; feminine passive participle of h0936 (בּוּז); something scorned; an object of contempt: - despised.
; patronymic from h0938 (בּוּז); a Buzite or descendant of Buz: - Buzite.
; the same as h0940 (בּוּזִי); Buzi, an Israelite: - Buzi.
; probably of Persian origin; Bavvai, an Israelite: - Bavai.
; a primitive root; to involve (literally or figuratively): - be entangled, (perplexed).
; for h2981 (יְבוּל); produce (of the earth, etc.): - food, stock.
; the same as h0944 (בּוּל) (in the sense of rain); Bul, the eighth Hebrew month: - Bul.
; from h0995 (בִּין); discretion; Bunah, an Israelite: - Bunah.
; a primitive root; to trample (literally or figuratively): - loath, tread (down, under (foot)), be polluted.
; from an unused root (of the same form) meaning to bleach, i.e. (intransitive) be white; probably cotton (of some sort): - fine (white) linen.
; from the same as h0948 (בּוּץ); shining; Botsets, a rock near Michmash: - Bozez.
; feminine passive participle of an unused root (meaning to be hollow); emptiness (as adjective): - empty.
; properly, active participle from h1239 (בָּקַר) as denominative from h1241 (בָּקָר); a cattle-tender: - herdman.
; a primitive root; to bore, i.e. (figuratively) examine: - declare.
; from h0952 (בּוּר) (in the sense of h0877 (בֹּאר)); a pit hole (especially one used as a cistern or a prison): - cistern, dungeon, fountain, pit, well.

; a primitive root; properly, to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed; also (by implication) to be disappointed or delayed: - (be, make, bring to, cause, put to, with, a-) shamed(-d), be (put to) confounded(-fusion), become dry, delay, be long.
; feminine participle passive of h0954 (בּוּשׁ); shame: - shame.
; (Aramaic) apparent denominative from h1005 (בַּיִת); to lodge over night: - pass the night.
; from h0962 (בָּזַז); plunder: - booty, prey, spoil(-ed).
; a primitive root; probably to cleave: - spoil.
; a primitive root; to disesteem: - despise, disdain, contemn(-ptible), [phrase] think to scorn, vile person.
; from h0959 (בָּזָה); scorned: - despise.
; feminine of h0957 (בַּז); booty: - prey, spoil.
; a primitive root; to plunder: - catch, gather, (take) for a prey, rob(-ber), spoil, take (away, spoil), [idiom] utterly.
; from h0959 (בָּזָה) disesteem: - contempt.
; from h0959 (בָּזָה) and h3050 (יָהּ); contempts of Jah; Bizjothjah, a place in Palestine: - Bizjothjah.
; from an unused root meaning to lighten; a flash of lightning: - flash of lightning.
; from h0965 (בָּזָק); lightning; Bezek, a place in Palestine: - Bezek.
; a primitive root; to disperse: - scatter.
; of Persian origin; Biztha, a eunuch of Xerxes: - Biztha.
; from h0974 (בָּחַן); an assayer or metals: - tower.
; or בָּחֻר; participle passive of h0977 (בָּחַר); properly, selected, i.e. a youth (often collective): - (choice) young (man), chosen, [idiom] hole.
; another form of h0975 (בַּחַן); a watch-tower of besiegers: - tower.
; from h0977 (בָּחַר); select: - choose, chosen one, elect.
; a primitive root; to loath: - abhor, get hastily (from the margin for h0926 (בָּהַל)).
; a primitive root; to test (especially metals); generally and figuratively, to investigate: - examine, prove, tempt, try (trial).
; from h0974 (בָּחַן) (in the sense of keeping a look-out); a watch-tower: - tower.
; from h0974 (בָּחַן); trial: - tried.
; a primitive root; properly, to try, i.e. (by implication) select: - acceptable, appoint, choose (choice), excellent, join, be rather, require.
; patrial from h0980 (בַּחֻרִים) (by transposition); a Bacharumite or inhabitant of Bachurim: - Baharumite.
; or בְּחוּרוֹת; feminine plural of h0970 (בָּחוּר); also (masculine plural) בְּחֻרִים; youth (collectively and abstractly): - young men, youth.
; or בַּחוּרִים; masculine plural of h0970 (בָּחוּר); young men; Bachurim, a place in Palestine: - Bahurim.
; or בָּטָה; a primitive root; to babble; hence, to vociferate angrily: - pronounce, speak (unadvisedly).

; a primitive root; properly, to hide for refuge (but not so precipitately as h2620 (חָסָה)); figuratively, to trust, be confident or sure: - be bold (confident, secure, sure), careless (one, woman), put confidence, (make to) hope, (put, make to) trust.

; from h0982 (בָּטַח); properly, a place of refuge; abstract, safety, both the fact (security) and the feeling (trust); often (adverb with or without preposition) safely: - assurance, boldly, (without) care(-less), confidence, hope, safe(-ly, -ty), secure, surely.
; the same as h0983 (בֶּטַח); Betach, a place in Syria: - Betah.
; feminine of h0984 (בֶּטַח); trust: - confidence.
; from h0982 (בָּטַח); trust: - confidence, hope.
; feminine plural from h0982 (בָּטַח); security: - secure.
; a primitive root; to desist from labor: - cease.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h0988 (בָּטֵל); to stop: - (cause, make to), cease, hinder.
; from an unused root probably meaning to be hollow; the belly, especially the womb; also the bosom or body of anything: - belly, body, [phrase] as they be born, [phrase] within, womb.
; the same as h0990 (בֶּטֶן); Beten. a place in Palestine: - Beten.
; from h0990 (בֶּטֶן); (only in plural) a pistachio-nut (from its form): - nut.
; probably plural from h0992 (בֹּטֶן); hollows; Betonim, a place in Palestine: - Betonim.
; perhaps from h1158 (בָּעָה) (in the sense of asking); properly, a request; used only adverbially (always with 'my Lord'); oh that!; with leave, or if it please: - alas, O, oh.

; a primitive root; to separate mentally (or distinguish), i.e.(generally) understand: - attend, consider, be cunning, diligently, direct, discern, eloquent, feel, inform, instruct, have intelligence, know, look well to, mark, perceive, be prudent, regard, (can) skill(-full), teach, think, (cause, make to, get, give, have) understand(-ing), view, (deal) wise(-ly, man).

; (sometimes in the plural masculine or feminine); properly, the constructive form of an otherwise unused noun from h0995 (בִּין); a distinction; but used only as a preposition, between (repeated before each noun, often with other particles); also as a conjunction, either...or: - among, asunder, at, between (-twixt...and), [phrase] from (the widest), [idiom] in, out of, whether (it be...or), within.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h0996 (בֵּין) {between (repeated before each noun, often with other particles); also as a conjunction, either...or}: - among, between.
; from h0995 (בִּין); understanding: - knowledge, meaning, [idiom] perfectly, understanding, wisdom.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h0998 (בִּינָה) {understanding}: - knowledge.
; from the same as h0948 (בּוּץ); an egg (from its whiteness): - egg.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h1002 (בִּירָה); a palace: - palace.
; of foreign origin; a castle or palace: - palace.
; from h1002 (בִּירָה); a fortress: - castle.

; probably from h1129 (בָּנָה) abbreviated; a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.): - court, daughter, door, [phrase] dungeon, family, [phrase] forth of, [idiom] great as would contain, hangings, home(born), (winter) house(-hold), inside(-ward), palace, place, [phrase] prison, [phrase] steward, [phrase] tablet, temple, web, [phrase] within(-out).
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h1004 (בַּיִת) {a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.)}: - house.
; the same as h1004 (בַּיִת); Bajith, a place in Palestine: - Bajith.
; from h1004 (בַּיִת) and h0205 (אָוֶן); house of vanity; Beth-Aven, a place in Palestine: - Beth-aven.
; from h1004 (בַּיִת) and h0410 (אֵל); house of God; Beth-El, a place in Palestine: - Beth-el.
; from h1004 (בַּיִת) and h0695 (אֶרֶב) and h0410 (אֵל); house of God's ambush; Beth-Arbel, a place in Palestine: - Beth-Arbel.

keynum.phon: Bêyth Baʻal Mᵉʻôwn, bayth bah'-al me-own'
keynum.meaning: ; from h1004 (בַּיִת) and h1168 (בַּעַל) and h4583 (מָעוֹן); house of Baal of (the) habitation of (apparently by transposition); or (shorter) בֵּית מְעוֹןlemma בֵּית מעוֹן missing vowel, corrected to בֵּית מְעוֹן; house of habitation of (Baal); Beth-Baal-Meon, a place in Palestine: - Beth-baal-meon. Compare h1186 (בַּעַל מְעוֹן) and h1194 (בְּעֹן).
; from h1004 (בַּיִת) and h1254 (בָּרָא); house of a creative one; Beth-Biri, a place in Palestine: - Bethbirei.
; probably from h1004 (בַּיִת) and h5679 (עֲבָרָה); house of (the) ford; Beth-Barah, a place in Palestine: - Beth-barah.
; from h1004 (בַּיִת) and h1447 (גָּדֵר); house of (the) wall; Beth-Gader, a place in Palestine: - Beth-gader.
; from h1004 (בַּיִת) and the passive participle of h1576 (גְּמוּל); house of (the) weaned; Beth-Gamul, a place East of the Jordan: - Beth-gamul.
; from h1004 (בַּיִת) and the dual of h1690 (דְּבֵלָה); house of (the) two figcakes; Beth-Diblathajim, a place East of the Jordan: - Beth-diblathaim.
; from h1004 (בַּיִת) and h1712 (דָּגוֹן); house of Dagon; Beth-Dagon, the name of two places in Palestine: - Beth-dagon.
; patrial from h1008 (בֵּית־אֵל) with the article interposed; a Beth-elite, or inhabitant of Bethel: - Bethelite.
; from h1004 (בַּיִת) and h0681 (אֵצֶל) with the article interposed; house of the side; Beth-ha-Etsel, a place in Palestine: - Beth-ezel.
; from h1004 (בַּיִת) and h1537 (גִּלְגָּל) with the article interposed; house of Gilgal (or rolling); Beth-hag-Gilgal, a place in Palestine: - Beth-gilgal.
; from h1004 (בַּיִת) and the plural of h3451 (יְשִׁימַה) with the article interposed; house of the deserts; Beth-ha-Jeshimoth, a town East of the Jordan: - Beth-jeshimoth.
; from h1004 (בַּיִת) and h3754 (כֶּרֶם) with the article interposed; house of the vineyard; Beth-hak-Kerem, a place in Palestine: - Beth-haccerem.
; patrial from h1035 (בֵּית לֶחֶם) with the article inserted; a Beth-lechemite, or native of Bethlechem: - Bethlehemite.
; from h1004 (בַּיִת) and h4801 (מֶרְחָק) with the article interposed; house of the breadth; Beth-ham-Merchak, a place in Palestine: - place that was far off.

; or (shortened) בֵּית מַרְכָּבוֹת; from h1004 (בַּיִת) and the plural of h4818 (מֶרְכָּבָה) (with or without the article interposed); place of (the) chariots; Beth-ham-Markaboth or Beth-Markaboth, a place in Palestine: - Bethmarcaboth.
; from h1004 (בַּיִת) and h6010 (עֵמֶק) with the article interposed; house of the valley; Beth-ha-Emek, a place in Palestine: - Beth-emek.
; from h1004 (בַּיִת) and h6160 (עֲרָבָה) with the article interposed; house of the Desert; Beth-ha-Arabah, a place in Palestine: - Beth-arabah.
; from h1004 (בַּיִת) and h7311 (רוּם) with the article interposed; house of the height; Beth-ha-Ram, a place East of the Jordan: - Beth-aram.
; probably for h1027 (בֵּית הָרָם); Beth-ha-Ram, a place East of the Jordan: - Beth-haran.
; from h1004 (בַּיִת) and h7848 (שִׁטָּה) with the article interposed; house of the acacia; Beth-hash-Shittah, a place in Palestine: - Beth-shittah.
; patrial from h1053 (בֵּית שֶׁמֶשׁ) with the article inserted; a Beth-shimshite, or inhabitant of Bethshemesh: - Bethshemite.
; from h1004 (בַּיִת) and the same as h2295 (חׇגְלָה); house of a partridge; Beth-Choglah, a place in Palestine: - Beth-hoglah.
; from h1004 (בַּיִת) and h2356 (חוֹר); house of hollowness; Beth-Choron, the name of two adjoining places in Palestine: - Beth-horon.
; from h1004 (בַּיִת) and h3733 (כַּר); house of pasture; Beth-Car, a place in Palestine: - Beth-car.
; from h1004 (בַּיִת) and the plural of h3833 (לָבִיא); house of lionesses; Beth-Lebaoth, a place in Palestine: - Beth-lebaoth. Compare h3822 (לְבָאוֹת).
; from h1004 (בַּיִת) and h3899 (לֶחֶם); house of bread; Beth-Lechem, a place in Palestine: - Bethlehem.
; from h1004 (בַּיִת) and the feminine of h6083 (עָפָר) (with preposition interposed); house to (i.e. of) dust; Beth-le-Aphrah, a place in Palestine: - house of Aphrah.
; or בֵּית מִלֹּא; from h1004 (בַּיִת) and h4407 (מִלּוֹא); house of (the) rampart; Beth-Millo, the name of two citadels: - house of Millo.
; from h1004 (בַּיִת) and h4601 (מַעֲכָה); house of Maakah; Beth-Maakah, a place in Palestine: - Beth-maachah.
; from h1004 (בַּיִת) and the feminine of h5246 (נָמֵר); house of (the) leopard; Beth-Nimrah, a place east of the Jordan: - Beth-Nimrah. Compare h5247 (נִמְרָה).
; from h1004 (בַּיִת) and h5730 (עֵדֶן); house of pleasure; Beth-Eden, a place in Syria: - Beth-eden.
; from h1004 (בַּיִת) and h5820 (עַזְמָוֶת); house of Azmaveth, a place in Palestine: - Bethaz-maveth. Compare h5820 (עַזְמָוֶת).
; from h1004 (בַּיִת) and a plural from h6030 (עָנָה); house of replies; Beth-Anoth, a place in Palestine: - Beth-anoth.
; an orthographical variation for h1042 (בֵּית עֲנוֹת); Beth-Anath, a place in Palestine: - Beth-anath.
; from h1004 (בַּיִת) and a derivative of h6123 (עָקַד); house of (the) binding (for sheep-shearing); Beth-Eked, a place in Palestine: - shearing house.
; ; from h1004 (בַּיִת) and h6252 (עַשְׁתָּרוֹת); house of Ashtoreths; Beth-Ashtaroth, a place in Palestine: - house of Ashtaroth. Compare h1203 (בְּעֶשְׁתְּרָה), h6252 (עַשְׁתָּרוֹת).
; from h1004 (בַּיִת) and h6412 (פָּלִיט); house of escape; Beth-Palet, a place in Palestine: - Beth-palet.
; from h1004 (בַּיִת) and h6465 (פְּעוֹר); house of Peor; Beth-Peor, a place East of the Jordan: - Bethpeor.
; from h1004 (בַּיִת) and a derivative from h6327 (פּוּץ); house of dispersion; Beth-Patstsets, a place in Palestine: - Beth-pazzez.
; from h1004 (בַּיִת) and h6697 (צוּר); house of (the) rock; Beth-Tsur, a place in Palestine: - Beth-zur.
; from h1004 (בַּיִת) and h7339 (רְחֹב); house of (the) street; Beth-Rechob, a place in Palestine: - Beth-rehob.
; from h1004 (בַּיִת) and h7497 (רָפָא); house of (the) giant; Beth-Rapha, an Israelite: - Beth-rapha.
; or בֵּית שָׁן; from h1004 (בַּיִת) and h7599 (שָׁאַן); house of ease; Beth-Shean or Beth-Shan, a place in Palestine: - Beth-shean, Beth-Shan.
; from h1004 (בַּיִת) and h8121 (שֶׁמֶשׁ); house of (the) sun; Beth-Shemesh, a place in Palestine: - Beth-shemesh.
; from h1004 (בַּיִת) and h8598 (תַּפּוּחַ); house of (the) apple; Beth-Tappuach, a place in Palestine: - Beth-tappuah.
; probably from h1004 (בַּיִת); a palace (i.e. large house): - palace.
; from h1058 (בָּכָה), weeping; Baca, a valley in Palestine: - Baca.
; the same as h1056 (בָּכָא); the weeping tree (some gum-distilling tree, perhaps the balsam): - mulberry tree.
; a primitive root; to weep; generally to bemoan: - [idiom] at all, bewail, complain, make lamentation, [idiom] more, mourn, [idiom] sore, [idiom] with tears, weep.
; from h1058 (בָּכָה); a weeping: - [idiom] sore.
; from h1069 (בָּכַר); firstborn; hence, chief: - eldest (son), firstborn(-ling).
; from h1069 (בָּכַר); the first-fruits of the crop: - first fruit (-ripe (figuratively)), hasty fruit.
; or (short) בְּכֹרָה; feminine of h1060 (בְּכוֹר); the firstling of man or beast; abstractly primogeniture: - birthright, firstborn(-ling).
; feminine of h1061 (בִּכּוּר); the early fig: - firstripe (fruit).
; feminine of h1062 (בְּכוֹרָה); primogeniture; Bekorath, an Israelite: - Bechorath.
; from h1058 (בָּכָה); a weeping; by analogy, a dripping: - overflowing, [idiom] sore, (continual) weeping, wept.
; plural active participle of h1058 (בָּכָה); (with the article) the weepers; Bo-kim, a place in Palestine: - Bochim.
; feminine from h1069 (בָּכַר); the eldest daughter: - firstborn.
; from h1058 (בָּכָה); a weeping: - mourning.

; a primitive root; properly, to burst the womb, i.e. (causatively) bear or make early fruit (of woman or tree); also (as denominative from h1061 (בִּכּוּר)) to give the birthright: - make firstborn, be firstling, bring forth first child (new fruit).
; from h1069 (בָּכַר) (in the sense of youth); a young camel: - dromedary.
; the same as h1070 (בֶּכֶר); Beker, the name of two Israelites: - Becher.
; feminine of h1070 (בֶּכֶר); a young she-camel: - dromedary.
; by orthographical variation for h1063 (בִּכּוּרָה); a first-ripe fig: - firstripe.
; from h1069 (בָּכַר); first-born; Bokeru, an Israelite: - Bocheru.
; from h1069 (בָּכַר); youth-ful; Bikri, an Israelite: - Bichri.
; patronymically from h1071 (בֶכֶר); a Bakrite (collectively) or descendants of Beker: - Bachrites.
; from h1086 (בָּלָה); properly, a failure; by implication nothing; usually (adverb) not at all; also lest: - lest, neither, no, none (that...), not (any), nothing.
; by contraction for h1168 (בַּעַל); Bel, the Baal of the Babylonians: - Bel.
; (Aramaic) from h1080 (בְּלָא); properly, anxiety, i.e. (by implication) the heart (as its seat): - heart.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h1086 (בָּלָה) (but used only in a mental sense); to afflict: - wear out.
; from h1078 (בֵּל) and h0113 (אָדוֹן) (contracted); Bel (is his) lord; Baladan, the name of a Babylonian prince: - Baladan.
; a primitive root; to break off or loose (in a favorable or unfavorable sense), i.e. desist (from grief) or invade (with destruction): - comfort, (recover) strength(-en).
; from h1082 (בָּלַג); desistance; Bilgah, the name of two Israelites: - Bilgah.
; from h1082 (בָּלַג); desistant; Bilgai, an Israelite: - Bilgai.
; of uncertain derivation; Bildad, one of Job's friends: - Bildad.
; a primitive root; to fail; by implication to wear out, decay (causatively, consume, spend): - consume, enjoy long, become (make, wax) old, spend, waste.
; from h1086 (בָּלָה); worn out: - old.
; feminine of h1087 (בָּלֶה); failure; Balah, a place in Palestine: - Balah.
; a primitive root (rather by transposition for h0926 (בָּהַל)); to palpitate; hence, (causatively) to terrify: - trouble.
; from h1089 (בָּלַהּ); timid; Bilhah, the name of one of Jacob's concubines; also of a place in Palestine: - Bilhah.
; from h1089 (בָּלַהּ); alarm; hence, destruction: - terror, trouble.
; from h1089 (בָּלַהּ); timid; Bilhan, the name of an Edomite and of an Israelite: - Bilhan.
; (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to h1086 (בָּלָה); excise (on articles consumed): - tribute.
; or (fully) בְּלוֹי; from h1086 (בָּלָה); (only in plural construction) rags: - old.
; of foreign derivation; Belteshatstsar, the Babylonian name of Daniel: - Belteshazzar.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h1095 (בֵּלְטְשַׁאצַּר) {Belteshatstsar, the Babylonian name of Daniel}: - Belteshazzar.

; from h1086 (בָּלָה); properly, failure, i.e. nothing or destruction; usually (with preposition) without, not yet, because not, as long as, etc.: - corruption, ig(norantly), for lack of, where no...is, so that no, none, not, un(awares), without.
; from h1101 (בָּלַל); mixed, i.e. (specifically) feed (for cattle): - corn, fodder, provender.
; from h1097 (בְּלִי) and h4100 (מָה); (as indefinitely) nothing whatever: - nothing.

; from h1097 (בְּלִי) and h3276 (יַעַל);(often in connection with h0376 (אִישׁ), h0802 (אִשָּׁה), h1121 (בֵּן), etc.) without profit, worthlessness; by extension, destruction, wickedness: - Belial, evil, naughty, ungodly (men), wicked.

; a primitive root; (also denominatively from h1098 (בְּלִיל)) to fodder to overflow (specifically with oil.); by implication, to mix; to fodder: - anoint, confound, [idiom] fade, mingle, mix (self), give provender, temper.
; a primitive root; to muzzle: - be held in.
; a primitive root; to pinch sycamore figs (a process necessary to ripen them): - gatherer.
; a primitive root; to make away with (specifically by swallowing); generally, to destroy: - cover, destroy, devour, eat up, be at end, spend up, swallow down (up).
; from h1104 (בָּלַע); a gulp; figuratively, destruction: - devouring, that which he hath swallowed up.
; the same as h1105 (בֶּלַע); Bela, the name of a place, also of an Edomite and of two Israelites: - Bela.
; or בַּלְעֲדֵי; constructive plural from h1077 (בַּל) and h5703 (עַד), not till, i.e. (as preposition or adverb) except, without, besides: - beside, not (in), save, without.
; patronymically from h1106 (בֶּלַע); a Belaite (collectively) or descendants of Bela: - Belaites.
; probably from h1077 (בַּל) and h5971 (עַם); not (of the) people, i.e. foreigner; Bilam, a Mesopotamian prophet; also a place in Palestine: - Balaam, Bileam.
; a primitive root; to annihilate: - (make) waste.
; from h1110 (בָּלַק); waster; Balak, a Moabitish king: - Balak.
; or בֵּלְאשַׁצַּרlemma בֵּלְאשַׁצּר missing vowel, corrected to בֵּלְאשַׁצַּר; of foreign origin (compare h1095 (בֵּלְטְשַׁאצַּר)); Belshatstsar, a Babylonian king: - Belshazzar.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h1112 (בֵּלְשַׁאצַּר) {Belshatstsar, a Babylonian king}: - Belshazzar.
; of uncertain derivation; Bilshan, an Israelite: - Bilshan.

; constructive feminine of h1086 (בָּלָה) (equivalent to h1097 (בְּלִי)); properly, a failure of, i.e. (used only as a negative particle, usually with a prepositional prefix) not, except, without, unless, besides, because not, until, etc.: - because un(satiable), beside, but, [phrase] continual, except, from, lest, neither, no more, none, not, nothing, save, that no, without.
; from an unused root (meaning to be high); an elevation: - height, high place, wave.
; the same as h1116 (בָּמָה); Bamah, a place in Palestine: - Bamah. See also h1120 (בָּמוֹת).
; probably from h4107 (מָהַל) with prepositional prefix; with pruning; Bimhal, an Israelite: - Bimhal.
; prolongation for prepositional prefix; in, with, by, etc.: - for, in into, through.
; plural of h1116 (בָּמָה); heights; or (fully) בָּמוֹת בַּעַל; from the same and h1168 (בַּעַל); heights of Baal; Bamoth or Bamoth-Baal, a place East of the Jordan: - Bamoth, Bamoth-baal.

; from h1129 (בָּנָה); a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.): - [phrase] afflicted, age, (Ahoh-) (Ammon-) (Hachmon-) (Lev-) ite, (anoint-) ed one, appointed to, ([phrase]) arrow, (Assyr-) (Babylon-) (Egypt-) (Grec-) ian, one born, bough, branch, breed, [phrase] (young) bullock, [phrase] (young) calf, [idiom] came up in, child, colt, [idiom] common, [idiom] corn, daughter, [idiom] of first, [phrase] firstborn, foal, [phrase] very fruitful, [phrase] postage, [idiom] in, [phrase] kid, [phrase] lamb, ([phrase]) man, meet, [phrase] mighty, [phrase] nephew, old, ([phrase]) people, [phrase] rebel, [phrase] robber, [idiom] servant born, [idiom] soldier, son, [phrase] spark, [phrase] steward, [phrase] stranger, [idiom] surely, them of, [phrase] tumultuous one, [phrase] valiant(-est), whelp, worthy, young (one), youth.
; the same as h1121 (בֵּן); Ben, an Israelite: - Ben.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h1121 (בֵּן) {a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense}: - child, son, young.
; (Aramaic) or בְּנָה; (Aramaic), corresponding to h1129 (בָּנָה); to build: - build, make.
; from h1121 (בֵּן) and h0040 (אֲבִימֶלֶךְ); (the) son of Abinadab; Ben-Abinadab, an Israelite: - the son of Abinadab.
; from h1121 (בֵּן) and h0205 (אָוֶן); son of my sorrow; Ben-Oni, the original name of Benjamin: - Ben-oni.
; from h1121 (בֵּן) and h1397 (גֶּבֶר); son of (the) hero; Ben-Geber, an Israelite: - the son of Geber.
; from h1121 (בֵּן) and a derivative of h1856 (דָּקַר); son of piercing (or of a lance); Ben-Deker, an Israelite: - the son of Dekar.
; a primitive root; to build (literally and figuratively): - (begin to) build(-er), obtain children, make, repair, set (up), [idiom] surely.
; from h1121 (בֵּן) and h1908 (הֲדַד); son of Hadad; Ben-Hadad, the name of several Syrian kings: - Benhadad.
; from h1129 (בָּנָה); built up; Binnui, an Israelite: - Binnui.
; from h1121 (בֵּן) and h2105 (זוֹחֵת); son of Zocheth; Ben-Zocheth, an Israelite: - Ben-zoketh.
; from h1121 (בֵּן) and h2354 (חוּר); son of Chur; Ben-Chur, an Israelite: - the son of Hur.
; from h1121 (בֵּן) and h2428 (חַיִל); son of might; Ben-Chail, an Israelite: - Ben-hail.
; from h1121 (בֵּן) and h2605 (חָנָן); son of Chanan; Ben-Chanan, an Israelite: - Ben-hanan.
; from h1121 (בֵּן) and h2617 (חֵסֵד); son of kindness; Ben-Chesed, an Israelite: - the son of Hesed.
; from h1129 (בָּנָה); built; Bani, the name of five Israelites: - Bani.
; or (fuller) בּוּנִי; from h1129 (בָּנָה); built; Bunni or Buni, an Israelite: - Bunni.
; from the plural construction of h1121 (בֵּן) and h1300 (בָּרָק); sons of lightning, Bene-berak, a place in Palestine: - Bene-barak.
; feminine from h1129 (בָּנָה); a structure: - building.
; or בּנָיָהוּ; (prolonged) from h1129 (בָּנָה) and h3050 (יָהּ); Jah has built; Benajah, the name of twelve Israelites: - Benaiah.
; from the plural of h1121 (בֵּן) and h3292 (יַעֲקָן); sons of Yaakan; Bene-Jaakan, a place in the Desert: - Bene-jaakan.
; dual of h0996 (בֵּין); a double interval, i.e. the space between two armies: - [phrase] champion.
; from h1121 (בֵּן) and h3225 (יָמִין); son of (the) right hand; Binjamin, youngest son of Jacob; also the tribe descended from him, and its territory: - Benjamin.

; sometimes (with the article inserted) בֵּן־הַיּמִינִי; with h0376 (אִישׁ) inserted (1 Samuel 9:1) בֶּן־אִישׁ ימִינִי; son of a man of Jemini; or shortened אִישׁ יְמִינִי; (1 Samuel 9:4; Esther 2:5) a man of Jemini, or (1 Samuel 20:1) simply יְמִינִיxlit Yᵉmînîy corrected to Yᵉmîynîy; a Jeminite; (plural) בְּנֵי יְמִינִיxlit Bᵉnîy corrected to Bᵉnêy; patron from h1144 (בִּנְיָמִין); a Benjaminite, or descendent of Benjamin: - Benjamite, of Benjamin.
; from h1129 (בָּנָה); an edifice: - building.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h1146 (בִּנְיָן) {an edifice}: - building.
; probably from h1121 (בֵּן) with pron. suff.; our son; Beninu, an Israelite: - Beninu.
; (Aramaic) of uncertain affinity; to be enraged: - be angry.
; or בִּנְעָה; of uncertain derivation; Bina or Binah, an Israelite: - Binea, Bineah.
; from h1121 (בֵּן) and h5971 (עַם) with pronomial suffix; son of my people; Ben-Ammi, a son of Lot: - Ben-ammi.
; from h5475 (סוֹד) and h3050 (יָהּ) with prepositional prefix; in (the) counsel of Jehovah; Besodejah, an Israelite: - Besodeiah.
; from h0947 (בּוּס); domineering; Besai, one of the Nethinim: - Besai.
; from an unused root meaning to be sour; an immature grape: - unripe grape.
; from the same as h1154 (בֶּסֶר) {an immature grape}: - sour grape.
; (Aramaic) or בְּעָה; (Aramaic), corresponding to h1158 (בָּעָה); to seek or ask: - ask, desire, make (petition), pray, request, seek.
; from h5704 (עַד) with prepositional prefix; in up to or over against; generally at, beside, among, behind, for, etc.: - about, at by (means of), for, over, through, up (-on), within.
; a primitive root; to gush over, i.e. to swell; (figuratively) to desire earnestly; by implication to ask: - cause, inquire, seek up, swell out.
; (Aramaic) from h1156 (בְּעָא); a request: - petition.
; from h1197 (בָּעַר) (in the sense of burning); a lamp; Beor, the name of the father of an Edomitish king; also of that of Balaam: - Beor.
; masculine plural from h1204 (בָּעַת); alarms: - terrors.
; from an unused root of uncertain meaning; Boaz, the ancestor of David; also the name of a pillar in front of the temple: - Boaz.
; a primitive root; to trample down, i.e. (figuratively) despise: - kick.
; from h1158 (בָּעָה); a prayer: - grave.
; from h1197 (בָּעַר) (in the sense of eating); cattle: - beast, cattle.
; a primitive root; also as denominative from h1167 (בַּעַל) to be master; hence, to marry: - have dominion (over), be husband, marry(-ried, [idiom] wife).

; from h1166 (בָּעַל); a master; hence, a husband, or (figuratively) owner (often used with another noun in modifications of this latter sense): - [phrase] archer, [phrase] babbler, [phrase] bird, captain, chief man, [phrase] confederate, [phrase] have to do, [phrase] dreamer, those to whom it is due, [phrase] furious, those that are given to it, great, [phrase] hairy, he that hath it, have, [phrase] horseman, husband, lord, man, [phrase] married, master, person, [phrase] sworn, they of.
; the same as h1167 (בַּעַל); Baal, a Phoenician deity: - Baal, (plural) Baalim.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h1167 (בַּעַל) {a master; hence, a husband,}: - [phrase] chancellor.
; from h1168 (בַּעַל) and h1285 (בְּרִית); Baal of (the) covenant; Baal-Berith, a special deity of the Shechemites: - Baal-berith.
; from h1168 (בַּעַל) and h1409 (גָּד); Baal of Fortune; Baal-Gad, a place in Syria: - Baal-gad.
; feminine of h1167 (בַּעַל); a mistress: - that hath, mistress.
; the same as h1172 (בַּעֲלָה); Baalah, the name of three places in Palestine: - Baalah.
; from h1167 (בַּעַל) and h1995 (הָמוֹן); possessor of a multitude; Baal-Hamon, a place in Palestine: - Baal-hamon.
; plural of h1172 (בַּעֲלָה); mistresses; Bealoth, a place in Palestine: - Bealoth, in Aloth (by mistake for a plural from h5927 (עָלָה) with prepositional prefix).
; from h1168 (בַּעַל) and h2070 (זְבוּב); Baal of (the) Fly; Baal-Zebub, a special deity of the Ekronites: - Baal-zebub.
; from h1167 (בַּעַל) and h2603 (חָנַן); possessor of grace; Baal-Chanan, the name of an Edomite, also of an Israelite: - Baal-hanan.
; from h1167 (בַּעַל) and a modification of h2691 (חָצֵר); possessor of a village; Baal-Chatsor, a place in Palestine: - Baal-hazor.
; from h1167 (בַּעַל) and h2768 (חֶרְמוֹן); possessor of Hermon; Baal-Chermon, a place in Palestine: - Baal-hermon.
; from h1167 (בַּעַל) with pron. suff.; my master; Baali, a symbolical name for Jehovah: - Baali.
; from the plural of h1168 (בַּעַל) and the plural of h1116 (בָּמָה); Baals of (the) heights; Baale-Bamoth, a place East of the Jordan: - lords of the high places.
; from h1168 (בַּעַל) and h3045 (יָדַע); Baal has known; Beeljada, an Israelite: - Beeliada.
; from h1167 (בַּעַל) and h3050 (יָהּ); Jah (is) master; Bealjah, an Israelite: - Bealiah.
; from the plural of h1167 (בַּעַל) and h3063 (יְהוּדָה); masters of Judah; Baale-Jehudah, a place in Palestine: - Baale of Judah.
; probably from a derivative of h5965 (עָלַס) with prepositional prefix; in exultation; Baalis, an Ammonitish king: - Baalis.
; from h1168 (בַּעַל) and h4583 (מָעוֹן); Baal of (the) habitation (of) (compare h1010 (בֵּית בַּעַל מְעוֹן)); Baal-Meon, a place East of the Jordan: - Baal-meon.
; from h1168 (בַּעַל) and h6465 (פְּעוֹר); Baal of Peor; Baal-Peor, a Moabitish deity: - Baal-peor.
; from h1167 (בַּעַל) and the plural of h6556 (פֶּרֶץ); possessor of breaches; Baal-Peratsim, a place in Palestine: - Baal-perazim.
; from h1168 (בַּעַל) and h6828 (צָפוֹן) (in the sense of cold) (according to others an Egyptian form of Typhon, the destroyer); Baal of winter; Baal-Tsephon, a place in Eqypt: - Baal-zephon.
; from h1168 (בַּעַל) and h8031 (שָׁלִשָׁה); Baal of Shalishah, Baal-Shalishah, a place in Palestine: - Baal-shalisha.
; a modification of h1172 (בַּעֲלָה); mistressship; Baalath, a place in Palestine: - Baalath.
; from h1172 (בַּעֲלָה) and h0875 (בְּאֵר); mistress of a well; Baalath-Beer, a place in Palestine: - Baalath-beer.
; from h1167 (בַּעַל) and h8558 (תָּמָר); possessor of (the) palm-tree; Baal-Tamar, a place in Palestine: - Baal-tamar.
; probably a contraction of h1010 (בֵּית בַּעַל מְעוֹן); Beon, a place East of the Jordan: - Beon.
; the same as h1196 (בַּעֲנָה); Banana, the name of four Israelite: - Baana, Baanah.
; from a derivative of h6031 (עָנָה) with prepositional prefix; in affliction Baanah, the name of four Israelites: - Baanah.

; a primitive root; also as denominative from h1198 (בַּעַר) to kindle, i.e. consume (by fire or by eating); to be(-come) brutish: - be brutish, bring (put, take) away, burn, (cause to) eat (up), feed, heat, kindle, set (on fire), waste.
; from h1197 (בָּעַר); properly, foot (as consumed); i.e. (by exten.) of cattle brutishness; (concretely) stupid: - brutish (person), foolish.
; from h1198 (בַּעַר); brutish; Baara, an Israelitish woman: - Baara.
; from h1197 (בָּעַר); a burning: - fire.
; from an unused root meaning to stink; offensiveness; Basha, a king of Israel: - Baasha.
; from h6213 (עָשָׂה) and h3050 (יָהּ) with a prepositional prefix; in (the) work of Jah; Baasejah, an Israelite: - Baaseiah.
; from h6251 (עַשְׁתְּרָה) (as singular of h6252 (עַשְׁתָּרוֹת)) with a prepositional prefix; with Ashtoreth; Beeshterah, a place East of the Jordan: - Beeshterah.
; a primitive root; to fear: - affright, be (make) afraid, terrify, trouble.
; from h1204 (בָּעַת); fear: - trouble.
; probably the same as h0948 (בּוּץ); mud (as whitish clay): - mire.
; intensive from h1206 (בֹץ); a swamp: - fen, mire(-ry place).
; from h1219 (בָּצַר); inaccessible, i.e. lofty: - vintage (by confusion with h1210 (בָּצִיר)).
; perhaps the same as h1153 (בְּסַי); Betsai, the name of two Israelites: - Bezai.
; from h1219 (בָּצַר); clipped, i.e. the grape crop: - vintage.
; from an unused root apparently meaning to peel; an onion: - onion.
; probably from h6738 (צֵל) and h0410 (אֵל) with a prepositional prefix; in (the) shadow (i.e. protection) of God; Betsalel, the name of two Israelites: - Bezaleel.
; or בַּצְלִית; from the same as h1211 (בֶּצֶל)xlit bᵉtsel corrected to betsel; a peeling; Batsluth or Batslith, an Israelite: - Bazlith, Bazluth.

; a primitive root to break off, i.e. (usually) plunder; figuratively, to finish, or (intransitively) stop: - (be) covet(-ous), cut (off), finish, fulfill, gain (greedily), get, be given to (covetousness), greedy, perform, be wounded.
; from h1214 (בָּצַע); plunder; by extension, gain (usually unjust): - covetousness, (dishonest) gain, lucre, profit.
; a primitive root; perhaps to swell up, i.e. blister: - swell.
; from h1216 (בָּצֵק); dough (as swelling by fermentation): - dough, flour.
; from h1216 (בָּצֵק); a swell of ground; Botscath, a place in Palestine: - Bozcath, Boskath.

; a primitive root; to clip off; specifically (as denominative from h1210 (בָּצִיר)) to gather grapes; also to be isolated (i.e. inaccessible by height or fortification): - cut off, (de-) fenced, fortify, (grape) gather(-er), mighty things, restrain, strong, wall (up), withhold.
; from h1219 (בָּצַר); strictly a clipping, i.e. gold (as dug out): - gold defence.
; the same as h1220 (בֶּצֶר), an inaccessible spot; Betser, a place in Palestine; also an Israelite: - Bezer.
; another form for h1220 (בֶּצֶר); gold: - gold.
; feminine from h1219 (בָּצַר); an enclosure, i.e. sheep fold: - Bozrah.
; the same as h1223 (בׇּצְרָה); Botsrah, a place in Edom: - Bozrah.
; masculine intensive from h1219 (בָּצַר); a fortress: - stronghold.
; feminine intensive from h1219 (בָּצַר); restraint (of rain), i.e. drought: - dearth, drought.
; the same as h1228 (בַּקְבֻּק)xlit baqbûk corrected to baqbuq; Bakbuk, one of the Nethinim: - Bakbuk.
; from h1238 (בָּקַק); a bottle (from the gurgling in emptying): - bottle, cruse.
; from h1228 (בַּקְבֻּק)xlit baqbûk corrected to baqbuq and h3050 (יָהּ); emptying (i.e. wasting) of Jah; Bakbukjah, an Israelite: - Bakbukiah.
; reduplicated from h1239 (בָּקַר); searcher; Bakbakkar, an Israelite: - Bakbakkar.
; from h1238 (בָּקַק); wasteful; Bukki, the name of two Israelites: - Bukki.
; from h1238 (בָּקַק) and h3050 (יָהּ); wasting of Jah; Bukkijah, an Israelite: - Bukkiah.
; from h1234 (בָּקַע); a fissure: - breach, cleft.

; a primitive root; to cleave; generally, to rend, break, rip or open: - make a breach, break forth (into, out, in pieces, through, up), be ready to burst, cleave (asunder), cut out, divide, hatch, rend (asunder), rip up, tear, win.
; from h1234 (בָּקַע); a section (half) of ashekel, i.e. a beka (a weight and a coin): - bekah, half a shekel.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h1237 (בִּקְעָה) {properly, a split, i.e. a wide level valley between mountains}: - plain.
; from h1234 (בָּקַע); properly, a split, i.e. a wide level valley between mountains: - plain, valley.
; a primitive root; to pour out, i.e. to empty, figuratively, to depopulate; by analogy, to spread out (as a fruitful vine): - (make) empty (out), fail, [idiom] utterly, make void.
; a primitive root; properly, to plough, or (generally) break forth, i.e. (figuratively) to inspect, admire, care for, consider: - (make) inquire (-ry), (make) search, seek out.

; or (shortened) גִּדֻּף; and (feminine) גִּדּוּפָהxlit giddûphâh corrected to giddûwphâh; or גִּדֻּפָה; from h1422 (גְּדוּפָה); vilification: - reproach, reviling.

; from an unused root (meaning to heap up); a stack of sheaves; by analogy, a tomb: - shock (stack) (of corn), tomb.

; from h1431 (גָּדַל); I have made great; Giddalti, an Israelite: - Giddalti.

; ; the same as h1444 (גֶּדֶר); Geder, a place in Palestine: - Geder.

; rarely (shortened) גֹּי; apparently from the same root as h1465 (גֵּוָה) (in the sense of massing); a foreign nation; hence, a Gentile; also (figuratively) a troop of animals, or a flight of locusts: - Gentile, heathen, nation, people.

; a primitive root; properly, to turn aside from the road (for a lodging or any other purpose), i.e. sojourn (as a guest); also to shrink, fear (as in a strange place); also to gather forhostility (as afraid): - abide, assemble, be afraid, dwell, fear, gather (together), inhabitant, remain, sojourn, stand in awe, (be) stranger, [idiom] surely.

; or (shortened) גֹּרָל; from an unused root meaning to be rough (as stone); properly, a pebble, i.e. a lot (small stones being used for that purpose); figuratively, a portion or destiny (as if determined by lot): - lot.
; or rather (by permutation) גִּישׁ; of uncertain derivation; a mass of earth: - clod.

; a primitive root; to pluck off; specifically to flay, strip or rob: - catch, consume, exercise (robbery), pluck (off), rob, spoil, take away (by force, violence), tear.
; from h1497 (גָּזַל); robbery, or (concretely) plunder: - robbery, thing taken away by violence.

; feminine of h1498 (גָּזֵל) and mean the same {robbery, or (concretely) plunder}: - that (he had robbed) (which he took violently away), spoil, violence.
; from an unused root meaning to devour; a kind of locust: - palmer-worm.
; from the same as h1501 (גָּזָם); devourer Gazzam, one of the Nethinim: - Gazzam.
; from an unused root meaning to cut down (trees); the trunk or stump of atree (as felled or as planted): - stem, stock.
; a primitive root; to cut down or off; (figuratively) to destroy, divide, exclude, or decide: - cut down (off), decree, divide, snatch.

; (in the m patrial from h1507 (גֶּזֶר); a Gezerite (collectively) or inhabitants of Gezer; but better (as in the text) bytransposition גִּזְרִיxlit Girzîy corrected to Gizrîy; patrial of h1630 (גְּרִזִים); a Grizite (collectively) or member of a native tribe in Palestine: - Gezrites.
; probably from h1518 (גִּיחַ)lemma גּיחַ missing vowel, corrected to גִּיחַ; (compare h1521 (גִּיחוֹן)) the external abdomen, belly (as the source of the faetus ): - belly.

; or גֵּחֲזִי; apparently from h1516 (גַּיְא) and h2372 (חָזָה); valley of a visionary; Gechazi, the servant of Elisha: - Gehazi.
; or (by permutation) גּוּל; a primitive root; properly, to spin round (under the influence of any violent emotion), i.e. usually rejoice, or (as cringing) fear: - be glad, joy, be joyful, rejoice.

; by reduplication from h1556 (גָּלַל); a skull (as round); by implication, a head (in enumeration of persons): - head, every man, poll, skull.

; a primitive root; to denude (especially in a disgraceful sense); by implication, to exile (captives being usually stripped); figuratively, to reveal: - [phrase] advertise, appear, bewray, bring, (carry, lead, go) captive (into captivity), depart, disclose, discover, exile, be gone, open, [idiom] plainly, publish, remove, reveal, [idiom] shamelessly, shew, [idiom] surely, tell, uncover.

; (Aramaic) or גְּלָא; (Aramaic), corresponding to h1540 (גָּלָה) {to denude (especially in a disgraceful sense); by implication, to exile (captives being usually stripped); figuratively, to reveal}: - bring over, carry away, reveal.

; or (prolonged) גָּלִילָה; the same as h1550 (גָּלִיל); a circle (with the article); Galil (as a special circuit) in the North of Palestine: - Galilee.

; perhaps from h1540 (גָּלָה); exile; Goljath, a Philistine: - Goliath.
; a primitive root; to roll (literally or figuratively): - commit, remove, roll (away, down, together), run down, seek occasion, trust, wallow.

; a primitive root; to be obstinate: - (inter-) meddle (with).

; probably from h1567 (גַּלְעֵד); Gilad, a region East of the Jordan; also the name of three Israelites: - Gilead, Gileadite.
; patronymically from h1568 (גִּלְעָד); a Giladite or descendant of Gilad: - Gileadite.
; a primitive root; probably to caper (as a goat): - appear.

; by contraction from an unused root meaning to gather; properly, assemblage; used only adverbially also, even, yea, though; often repeated as correl. both...and: - again, alike, also, (so much) as (soon), both (so)...and, but, either...or, even, for all, (in) likewise (manner), moreover, nay...neither, one, then(-refore), though, what, with, yea.
; a primitive root (literally or figuratively) to absorb to absorb: - swallow, drink.

; from h1580 (גָּמַל); treatment, i.e. an act (of good or ill); by implication, service or requital: - [phrase] as hast served, benefit, desert, deserving, that which he hath given, recompense, reward.

; from h1589 (גָּנַב); stealing, i.e. (concretely) something stolen: - theft.
; from h1589 (גָּנַב); theft; Genubath, an Edomitish prince: - Genubath.
; feminine of h1588 (גַּן); a garden: - garden.
; another form for h1593 (גַּנָּה) {a garden}: - garden.
; from an unused root meaning to store; treasure; by implication, a coffer: - chest, treasury.

; prolonged from h1595 (גֶּנֶז); a treasury: - treasury.
; a primitive root; to hedge about, i.e. (generally) protect: - defend.
; or גִּנְּתוֹ; from h1598 (גָּנַן); gardener; Ginnethon or Ginnetho, an Israelite: - Ginnetho, Ginnethon.
; a primitive root; to bellow (as cattle): - low.

; a primitive root; to detest; by implication, to reject: - abhor, fail, lothe, vilely cast away.

; perhaps from h3564 (כּוּר); lime (from being burned in a kiln): - chalk(-stone).
; or (fully) geyr (gare); from h1481 (גּוּר); properly, a guest; by implication, a foreigner: - alien, sojourner, stranger.

; from an unused root meaning to scratch; scurf (from itching): - scab, scurvy.
; from the same as h1618 (גָּרָב); scabby; Gareb, the name of an Israelite, also of a hill near Jerusalem: - Gareb.
; by reduplication from h1641 (גָּרַר); a berry (as if a pellet of rumination): - berry.

; or (shortened) גָּרֹן; from h1641 (גָּרַר); (compare h1621 (גַּרְגְּרוֹת)) the throat (as roughened by swallowing): - [idiom] aloud, mouth, neck, throat.
; from h1481 (גּוּר); a (temporary) residence: - habitation.

; probably from h1641 (גָּרַר); a rolling country; Gerar, a Philistine city: - Gerar.

; a primitive root; to drive out from a possession; especially to expatriate or divorce: - cast up (out), divorced (woman), drive away (forth, out), expel, [idiom] surely put away, trouble, thrust out.

; a primitive root; perhaps properly, to arrange; but used figuratively (of words), to speak; rarely (in a destructive sense) to subdue: - answer, appoint, bid, command, commune, declare, destroy, give, name, promise, pronounce, rehearse, say, speak, be spokesman, subdue, talk, teach, tell, think, use (entreaties), utter, [idiom] well, [idiom] work.

; from h1696 (דָבַר); a word; by implication, a matter (as spoken of) or thing; adverbially, a cause: - act, advice, affair, answer, [idiom] any such (thing), because of, book, business, care, case, cause, certain rate, [phrase] chronicles, commandment, [idiom] commune(-ication), [phrase] concern(-ing), [phrase] confer, counsel, [phrase] dearth, decree, deed, [idiom] disease, due, duty, effect, [phrase] eloquent, errand, (evil favoured-) ness, [phrase] glory, [phrase] harm, hurt, [phrase] iniquity, [phrase] judgment, language, [phrase] lying, manner, matter, message, (no) thing, oracle, [idiom] ought, [idiom] parts, [phrase] pertaining, [phrase] please, portion, [phrase] power, promise, provision, purpose, question, rate, reason, report, request, [idiom] (as hast) said, sake, saying, sentence, [phrase] sign, [phrase] so, some (uncleanness), somewhat to say, [phrase] song, speech, [idiom] spoken, talk, task, [phrase] that, [idiom] there done, thing (concerning), thought, [phrase] thus, tidings, what(-soever), [phrase] wherewith, which, word, work.

; or (fully) דָּאג; (Nehemiah 13:16), from h1711 (דָּגָה); a fish (as prolific); or perhaps rather from h1672 (דָּאַג) (as timid); but still better from h1672 (דָּאַג) (in the sense of squirming, i.e. moving by the vibratory action of the tail); a fish (often used collectively): - fish.

; or (shortened) דֹּד; from an unused root meaning properly, to boil, i.e. (figuratively) to love; by implication, a love-token, lover, friend; specifically an uncle: - (well-) beloved, father's brother, love, uncle.

; (Aramaic) from the equivalent of h1760 (דָּחָה); probably a musical instrument (as being struck): - instrument of music.

; (Aramaic) or דָּךְ; (Aramaic), prolonged from h1668 (דָּא); this: - the same, this.

; the same as h1865 (דְּרוֹר), applied to a bird; the swift, a kind of swallow: - swallow.

; from h1869 (דָּרַךְ); a road (as trodden); figuratively, a course of life or mode of action, often adverb: - along, away, because of, [phrase] by, conversation, custom, (east-) ward, journey, manner, passenger, through, toward, (high-) (path-) way(-side), whither(-soever).

; a primitive root; properly, to tread or frequent; usually to follow (for pursuit or search); by implication, to seek or ask; specifically to worship: - ask, [idiom] at all, care for, [idiom] diligently, inquire, make inquisition, (necro-) mancer, question, require, search, seek (for, out), [idiom] surely.
; a primitive root; to sprout: - bring forth, spring.

; a primitive root; also denominatively (from h1880 (דֶּשֶׁן)) to be fat; transitively, to fatten (or regard as fat); specifically to anoint; figuratively, to satisfy; to remove (fat) ashes (of sacrifices): - accept, anoint, take away the (receive) ashes (from), make (wax) fat.
; from h1878 (דָּשֵׁן); fat; figuratively, rich, fertile: - fat.

; a primitive particle; lo!: - behold, lo.

; of which the feminine (beyond the Pentateuch) is הִיא; a primitive word, the third person pronoun singular; he (she or it); only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also (intensively) self, or (especially with the article) the same; sometimes (as demonstrative) this or that; occasionally (instead of copula) as or are: - he, as for her, him(-self), it, the same, she (herself), such, that (...it), these, they, this, those, which (is), who.

; (Aramaic) or (feminine) הִיא; (Aramaic), corresponding to h1931 (הוּא) {he (she or it); self, or (especially with the article) the same; sometimes (as demonstrative) this or that; occasionally (instead of copula) as or are}: - [idiom] are, it, this.
; or הָוָה; a primitive root (compare h0183 (אָוָה), h1961 (הָיָה)) supposed to mean properly, to breathe; to be (in the sense of existence): - be, [idiom] have.

; from h1933 (הָוָא) (in the sense of eagerly coveting and rushing upon; by implication, of falling); desire; also ruin: - calamity, iniquity, mischief, mischievous (thing), naughtiness, naughty, noisome, perverse thing, substance, very wickedness.

; from an unused root (meaning to shout); acclamation: - shout(-ing).

; a primitive root (compare h1933 (הָוָא)); to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary): - beacon, [idiom] altogether, be(-come), accomplished, committed, like), break, cause, come (to pass), do, faint, fall, [phrase] follow, happen, [idiom] have, last, pertain, quit (one-) self, require, [idiom] use.
; another form for h1943 (הֹוָה); ruin: - calamity.

; probably of Egyptian origin; a hin or liquid measure: - hin.

; probably denominatively from h1973 (הָלְאָה)xlit hâlᵉâh corrected to hâlᵉʼâh; to remove or be remote: - cast far off.

; from h1984 (הָלַל) (in the sense of rejoicing); a celebration of thanksgiving for harvest: - merry, praise.

; (Aramaic) corresponding to h1980 (הָלַךְ) (compare h1946 (הוּךְ)); to walk: - walk.
; from h1980 (הָלַךְ); properly, a journey, i.e. (by implication) a wayfarer; also a flowing: - [idiom] dropped, traveller.

; a primitive root; to be clear (orig. of sound, but usually of color); to shine; hence, to make ashow, to boast; and thus to be (clamorously) foolish; to rave; causatively, to celebrate; also to stultify: - (make) boast (self), celebrate, commend, (deal, make), fool(-ish, -ly), glory, give (light), be (make, feign self) mad (against), give in marriage, (sing, be worthy of) praise, rage, renowned, shine.
; from h1984 (הָלַל); praising (namely God); Hillel, an Israelite: - Hillel.

; or חִזְקִיָּהוּ; also יְחִזְקִיָּה; or יְחִזְקִיָּהוּ; from h2388 (חָזַק) and h3050 (יָהּ); strengthened of Jah; Chizkijah, a king of Judah, also the name of two other Israelites: - Hezekiah, Hizkiah, Hizkijah. Compare h3169 (יְחִזְקִיָּה).
; once (Ezekiel 29:4) חָחִי; from the same as h2336 (חוֹחַ); a ring for the nose (or lips): - bracelet, chain, hook.

; a primitive root; properly, to miss; hence (figuratively and generally) to sin; by inference, to forfeit, lack, expiate, repent, (causatively) lead astray, condemn: - bear the blame, cleanse, commit (sin), by fault, harm he hath done, loss, miss, (make) offend(-er), offer for sin, purge, purify (self), make reconciliation, (cause, make) sin(-ful, -ness), trespass.
; from h2398 (חָטָא); a crime or its penalty: - fault, [idiom] grievously, offence, (punishment of) sin.
; intensively from h2398 (חָטָא); a criminal, or one accounted guilty: - offender, sinful, sinner.
; feminine of h2399 (חֵטְא); an offence, or a sacrifice forit: - sin (offering).
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h2401 (חֲטָאָה); an offence, and the penalty or sacrifice forit: - sin (offering).

; or חַטָּאת; from h2398 (חָטָא); an offence (sometimes habitual sinfulness), and its penalty, occasion, sacrifice, or expiation; also (concretely) an offender: - punishment (of sin), purifying(-fication for sin), sin(-ner, offering).
; a primitive root; to chop or carve wood: - cut down, hew(-er), polish.
; feminine passive participle of h2404 (חָטַב); properly, a carving; hence, a tapestry (as figured): - carved.

; (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to h2398 (חָטָא); an offence: - sin.

; from an unused root apparently meaning to dig out; explorer; Chatita, a temple porter: - Hatita.
; from an unused root apparently meaning to wave; fluctuating; Chattil, one of 'Solomon's servants': - Hattil.

; a primitive root; to stop: - refrain.

; from an unused root of uncertain signification; a twig: - rod.

; from h2421 (חָיָה); alive; hence, raw (flesh); fresh (plant, water, year), strong; also (as noun, especially in the feminine singular and masculine plural) life (or living thing), whether literally or figuratively: - [phrase] age, alive, appetite, (wild) beast, company, congregation, life(-time), live(-ly), living (creature, thing), maintenance, [phrase] merry, multitude, [phrase] (be) old, quick, raw, running, springing, troop.
; (Aramaic) from h2418 (חֲיָא); alive; also (as noun in plural) life: - life, that liveth, living.
; (Aramaic) or חֲיָה; (Aramaic), corresponding to h2421 (חָיָה); to live: - live, keep alive.
; from h2416 (חַי) and h0410 (אֵל); living of God; Chiel, an Israelite: - Hiel.
; from h2330 (חוּד); a puzzle, hence, a trick, conundrum, sententious maxim: - dark saying (sentence, speech), hard question, proverb, riddle.

; a primitive root (compare h2331 (חָוָה), h2421 (חָיָה)); to live, whether literally or figuratively; causatively, to revive: - keep (leave, make) alive, [idiom] certainly, give (promise) life, (let, suffer to) live, nourish up, preserve (alive), quicken, recover, repair, restore (to life), revive, ([idiom] God) save (alive, life, lives), [idiom] surely, be whole.

; a primitive root (compare h2421 (חָיָה)); to live; causatively to revive: - live, save life.

; from h2342 (חוּל); probably a force, whether of men, means or other resources; an army, wealth, virtue, valor, strength: - able, activity, ([phrase]) army, band of men (soldiers), company, (great) forces, goods, host, might, power, riches, strength, strong, substance, train, ([phrase]) valiant(-ly), valour, virtuous(-ly), war, worthy(-ily).
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h2428 (חַיִל); an army, or strength: - aloud, army, [idiom] most (mighty), power.

; or חֵלָאםxlit Chêlʼâm corrected to Chêlâʼm; from h2428 (חַיִל); fortress; Chelam, a place East of Palestine: - Helam.

; from h2357 (חָוַר) in the sense of splendor; Chirah, an Adullamite: - Hirah.

; a primitive root (apparently akin to h2707 (חָקָה) through the idea of piercing); properly, to adhere to; hence, to await: - long, tarry, wait.

; from the same as h2447 (חַכְלִיל); dark; Chakilah, a hill in Palestine: - Hachilah.

; or חַכְמוֹת; collateral forms of h2451 (חׇכְמָה); wisdom: - wisdom, every wise (woman).
; from h2490 (חָלַל); properly, exposed; hence, profane: - common, profane (place), unholy.

; a primitive root (compare h2342 (חוּל), h2470 (חָלָה), h2490 (חָלַל)); properly, to be rubbed or worn; hence (figuratively) to be weak, sick, afflicted; or (causatively) to grieve, make sick; also to stroke (in flattering), entreat: - beseech, (be) diseased, (put to) grief, be grieved, (be) grievous, infirmity, intreat, lay to, put to pain, [idiom] pray, make prayer, be (fall, make) sick, sore, be sorry, make suit ([idiom] supplication), woman in travail, be (become) weak, be wounded.
; from h2490 (חָלַל); a cake (as usually punctured): - cake.

; a window (as perforated): - window.
; from h2498 (חָלַף); properly, surviving; by implication (collectively) orphans: - [idiom] destruction.

; a primitive root; to snatch at: - catch.

; feminine of h2481 (חֲלִי); a trinket: - jewel.
; from h2490 (חָלַל); a flute (as perforated): - pipe.
; or חָלִלָה; a directive from h2490 (חָלַל); literal fora profaned thing; used (interj.) far be it!: - be far, ([idiom] God) forbid.

; a primitive root (compare h2470 (חָלָה)); also denominative (from h2485 (חָלִיל)) properly, to bore, i.e. (by implication) to wound, to dissolve; figuratively, to profane (a person, place or thing), to break (one's word), to begin (as if by an 'opening wedge'); to play (the flute): - begin ([idiom] men began), defile, [idiom] break, defile, [idiom] eat (as common things), [idiom] first, [idiom] gather the grape thereof, [idiom] take inheritance, pipe, player on instruments, pollute, (cast as) profane (self), prostitute, slay (slain), sorrow, stain, wound.

; a primitive root; properly, to bind firmly, i.e. (by implication) to be (causatively to make) plump; also (through the figurative sense of dumbness) to dream: - (cause to) dream(-er), be in good liking, recover.

; from h2492 (חָלַם); a dream; Chelem, an Israelite: - Helem. Compare h2469 (חֶלְדַּי).
; from h2492 (חָלַם) (in the sense of insipidity); probably purslain: - egg.
; probably from h2492 (חָלַם) (in the sense of hardness); flint: - flint(-y), rock.
; from h2428 (חַיִל); strong; Chelon, an Israelite: - Helon.

; a primitive root; properly, to slide by, i.e. (by implication) to hasten away, pass on, spring up, pierce or change: - abolish, alter, change, cut off, go on forward, grow up, be over, pass (away, on, through), renew, sprout, strike through.

; from h2498 (חָלַף); properly, exchange; hence (as preposition) instead of: - [idiom] for.
; the same as h2500 (חֵלֶף); change; Cheleph, a place in Palestine: - Heleph.

; a primitive root; to pull off; hence (intensively) to strip, (reflex.) to depart; by implication, to deliver, equip (for fight); present, strengthen: - arm (self), (go, ready) armed ([idiom] man, soldier), deliver, draw out, make fat, loose, (ready) prepared, put off, take away, withdraw self.
; or חֵלֶץ; from h2502 (חָלַץ); perhaps, strength; Chelets, the name of two Israelites: - Helez.
; from h2502 (חָלַץ) (in the sense of strength); only in the dual; the loins (as the seat of vigor): - loins, reins.

; a primitive root; to be smooth (figuratively); by implication (as smooth stones were used for lots) to apportion or separate: - deal, distribute, divide, flatter, give, (have, im-) part(-ner), take away a portion, receive, separate self, (be) smooth(-er).

; from h2505 (חָלַק); smooth (especially of tongue): - flattering, smooth.

; from h2505 (חָלַק); smooth: - smooth.
; from h2505 (חָלַק); smooth: - smooth.

; feminine of h2506 (חֵלֶק); properly, smoothness; figuratively, flattery; also an allotment: - field, flattering(-ry), ground, parcel, part, piece of land (ground), plat, portion, slippery place, smooth (thing).

; or חִלְקִיָּהוּ; from h2506 (חֵלֶק) and h3050 (יָהּ); portion of Jah; Chilhijah, the name of eight Israelites: - Hillkiah.
; by reduplication from h2505 (חָלַק); properly, something very smooth; i.e. a treacherous spot; figuratively, blandishment: - flattery, slippery.

; (Aramaic) or חֲמָה; (Aramaic), corresponding to h2534 (חֵמָה); anger: - fury.

; or (Daniel 11:44) חֵמָא; from h3179 (יָחַם); heat; figuratively, anger, poison (from its fever): - anger, bottles, hot displeasure, furious(-ly, -ry), heat, indignation, poison, rage, wrath(-ful). See h2529 (חֶמְאָה).

; from h2554 (חָמַס); violence; by implication, wrong; by meton. unjust gain: - cruel(-ty), damage, false, injustice, [idiom] oppressor, unrighteous, violence (against, done), violent (dealing), wrong.

; from h2556 (חָמֵץ); vinegar: - vinegar.
