; from h2567 (חָמַשׁ); a fifth tax: - fifth participle
; from an unused root probably meaning, to be stout; the abdomen (as obese): - fifth (rib).
; passive participle of the same as h2570 (חֹמֶשׁ); staunch, i.e. able-bodied soldiers: - armed (men), harnessed.
; multiple of h2568 (חָמֵשׁ); fifty: - fifty.
; from the same as h2346 (חוֹמָה); a skin bottle (as tied up): - bottle.
; from the same as h2346 (חוֹמָה); walled; Chamath, a place in Syria: - Hamath, Hemath.
; a variation for the first part of h2576 (חַמֹּת דֹּאר); hot springs; Chammath, a place in Palestine: - Hammath.
; from the plural of h2535 (חַמָּה) and h1756 (דּוֹר); hot springs of Dor; Chammath-Dor, a place in Palestine: - Hamath-Dor.
; patrial from h2574 (חֲמָת); a Chamathite or native of Chamath: - Hamathite.
; from h2574 (חֲמָת) and h6678 (צוֹבָא); Chamath of Tsobah; probably the same as h2574 (חֲמָת) Chamath-Tsobah: - Hamath-Zobah.
; from h2574 (חֲמָת) and h7237 (רַבָּה); Chamath of Rabbah; probably the same as h2574 (חֲמָת). Chamath-Rabbah: -
; from h2603 (חָנַן); graciousness, i.e. subjective (kindness, favor) or objective (beauty): - favour, grace(-ious), pleasant, precious, (well-) favoured.
; the same as h2580 (חֵן); grace; Chen, a figurative name for an Israelite: - Hen.
; probably from h2580 (חֵן) and h1908 (הֲדַד); favor of Hadad; Chenadad, an Israelite: - Henadad.

; a primitive root (compare h2603 (חָנַן)); properly, to incline; by implication, to decline (of the slanting rays of evening); specifically, to pitch atent; gen. to encamp (for abode or siege): - abide (in tents), camp, dwell, encamp, grow to an end, lie, pitch (tent), rest in tent.
; from h2603 (חָנַן); favored; Channah, an Israelitess: - Hannah.
; from h2596 (חָנַךְ); initiated; Chanok, an antediluvian patriach: - Enoch.
; from h2603 (חָנַן); favored; Chanun, the name of an Ammonite and of two Israelites: - Hanun.
; from h2603 (חָנַן); gracious: - gracious.
; from h2583 (חָנָה); properly, a vault or cell (with an arch); by implication, a prison: - cabin.
; from h2603 (חָנַן) (in the sense of prayer); supplication: - be gracious, intreated.
; a primitive root; to spice; by implication, to embalm; also to ripen: - embalm, put forth.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h2406 (חִטָּה); wheat: - wheat.
; from h2603 (חָנַן) and h0410 (אֵל); favor of God; Channiel, the name of two Israelites: - Hanniel.
; from h2596 (חָנַךְ); initiated; i.e. practiced: - trained.
; from h2603 (חָנַן); graciousness: - favour.
; from h2583 (חָנָה); a lance (for thrusting, like pitching a tent): - javelin, spear.
; a primitive root; (compare h2614 (חָנַק)) properly, to narrow; figuratively, to initiate or discipline: - dedicate, train up.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h2598 (חֲנֻכָּה); consecration: - dedication.
; from h2596 (חָנַךְ); initiation, i.e. consecration: - dedicating(-tion).
; patronymically from h2585 (חֲנוֹךְ); a Chanokite (collectively) or descendants of Chanok: - Hanochites.
; from h2580 (חֵן); gratis, i.e. devoid of cost, reason or advantage: - without a cause (cost, wages), causeless, to cost nothing, free(-ly), innocent, for nothing (nought, in vain.
; probably by orthographical variation for h2606 (חֲנַנְאֵל); Chanamel, an Israelite: - Hanameel.
; of uncertain derivation; perhaps the aphis or plantlouse: - frost.

; a primitive root (compare h2583 (חָנָה)); properly, to bend or stoop in kindness to an inferior; to favor, bestow; causatively to implore (i.e. move to favor by petition): - beseech, [idiom] fair, (be, find, shew) favour(-able), be (deal, give, grant (gracious(-ly), intreat, (be) merciful, have (shew) mercy (on, upon), have pity upon, pray, make supplication, [idiom] very.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h2603 (חָנַן); to favor or (causatively) to entreat: - shew mercy, make supplication.
; from h2603 (חָנַן); favor; Chanan, the name of seven Israelites: - Canan.
; from h2603 (חָנַן) and h0410 (אֵל); God has favored; Chananel, probably an Israelite, from whom a tower of Jerusalem was named: - Hananeel.
; from h2603 (חָנַן); gracious; Chanani, the name of six Israelites: - Hanani.
; or חֲנַנְיָהוּ; from h2603 (חָנַן) and h3050 (יָהּ); Jah has favored; Chananjah, the name of thirteen Israelites: - Hananiah.
; of Egyptian derivation; Chanes, a place in Egypt: - Hanes.
; a primitive root; to soil, especially in a moral sense: - corrupt, defile, [idiom] greatly, pollute, profane.
; from h2610 (חָנֵף); soiled (i.e. with sin), impious: - hypocrite(-ical).
; from h2610 (חָנֵף); moral filth, i.e. wickedness: - hypocrisy.
; feminine from h2610 (חָנֵף); impiety: - profaneness.
; a primitive root (compare h2596 (חָנַךְ)); to be narrow; by implication, to throttle, or (reflex.) to choke oneself to death (by a rope): - hang self, strangle.
; probably from h2603 (חָנַן); favored; Channathon, a place in Palestine: - Hannathon.

; a primitive root; (compare h2603 (חָנַן)); (compare h1288 (בָרַךְ)) properly, perhaps to bow (the neck only in courtesy to an equal), i.e. to be kind; also (by euphemistically, but rarely) to reprove: - shew self merciful, put to shame.

; from h2616 (חָסַד); kindness; by implication (towards God) piety; rarely (by opposition) reproof, or (subject.) beauty: - favour, good deed(-liness, -ness), kindly, (loving-) kindness, merciful (kindness), mercy, pity, reproach, wicked thing.
; the same as h2617 (חֵסֵד); favor; Chesed, an Israelite: - Hesed.
; from h2617 (חֵסֵד) and h3050 (יָהּ); Jah has favored; Chasadjah, an Israelite: - Hasadiah.
; a primitive root; (compare h0982 (בָּטַח)) to flee for protection; figuratively, to confide in: - have hope, make refuge, (put) trust.
; from h2620 (חָסָה); hopeful; Chosah, an Israelite; also a place in Palestine: - Hosah.
; from h2620 (חָסָה); confidence: - trust.
; from h2616 (חָסַד); properly, kind, i.e. (religiously) pious (a saint): - godly (man), good, holy (one), merciful, saint, (un-) godly.
; feminine of h2623 (חָסִיד); the kind (maternal) bird, i.e. a stork: - [idiom] feather, stork.
; from h2628 (חָסַל); the ravager, i.e. a locust: - caterpillar.
; from h2630 (חָסַן); properly, firm, i.e. (by implication) mighty: - strong.
; (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to h2637 (חָסֵר); deficient: - wanting.
; a primitive root; to eat off: - consume.
; a primitive root; to muzzle; by analogy, to stop the nose: - muzzle, stop.
; a primitive root; properly, to (be) compact; by implication, to hoard: - lay up.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h2630 (חָסַן); to hold in occupancy: - possess.
; (Aramaic) from h2631 (חֲסַן); strength: - power.
; from h2630 (חָסַן); wealth: - riches, strength, treasure.
; from h2630 (חָסַן); powerful: - strong.
; (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to that of h2636 (חַסְפַּס); a clod: - clay.
; reduplicated from an unused root meaning apparently to peel; a shred or scale: - round thing.
; a primitive root; to lack; by implication, to fail, want, lessen: - be abated, bereave, decrease, (cause to) fail, (have) lack, make lower, want.
; from h2637 (חָסֵר); lacking; hence, without: - destitute, fail, lack, have need, void, want.
; from h2637 (חָסֵר); lack; hence, destitution: - poverty, want.
; from h2637 (חָסֵר); poverty: - in want of.
; from h2637 (חָסֵר); want Chasrah, an Israelite: - Hasrah.
; from h2637 (חָסֵר); deficiency: - wanting.
; from h2653 (חׇפַף) (in the moral sense of covered from soil); pure: - innocent.
; an orthographical variation of h2645 (חָפָה); properly, to cover, i.e. (in a sinister sense) to act covertly: - do secretly.
; a primitive root (compare h2644 (חָפָא), h2653 (חׇפַף)); to cover; by implication, to veil, to encase, protect: - ceil, cover, overlay.
; from h2645 (חָפָה); a canopy: - chamber, closet, defence.
; the same as h2646 (חֻפָּה); Chuppah, an Israelite: - Huppah.
; a primitive root; properly, to start up suddenly, i.e. (by implication) to hasten away, to fear: - (make) haste (away), tremble.
; from h2468 (חֻלְדָּה); hasty flight: - haste.
; plural of h2646 (חֻפָּה) (compare h2349 (חוּפָם)); Chuppim, an Israelite: - Huppim.
; from an unused root of uncertain signification; a fist (only in the dual): - fists, (both) hands, hand(-ful).
; from h2651 (חֹפֶן); perhaps pugilist; Chophni, an Israelite: - Hophni.
; a primitive root (compare h2645 (חָפָה), h3182 (יָחֵף)); to cover (in protection): - cover.

; a primitive root; properly, to incline to; by implication (literally but rarely) to bend; figuratively, to be pleased with, desire: - [idiom] any at all, (have, take) delight, desire, favour, like, move, be (well) pleased, have pleasure, will, would.
; from h2654 (חָפֵץ); pleased with: - delight in, desire, favour, please, have pleasure, whosoever would, willing, wish.

; from h2654 (חָפֵץ); pleasure; hence (abstractly) desire; concretely, a valuable thing; hence (by extension) a matter (as something in mind): - acceptable, delight(-some), desire, things desired, matter, pleasant(-ure), purpose, willingly.
; from h2656 (חֵפֶץ) with suffixes; my delight (is) in her; Cheptsi-bah, a fanciful name for Palestine: - Hephzi-bah.
; a primitive root; properly, to pry into; by implication, to delve, to explore: - dig, paw, search out, seek.

; a primitive root (perhaps rather the same as h2658 (חָפַר) through the idea of detection); to blush; figuratively, to be ashamed, disappointed; causatively, to shame, reproach: - be ashamed, be confounded, be brought to confusion (unto shame), come (be put to) shame, bring reproach.
; from h2658 (חָפַר) or h2659 (חָפֵר); a pit of shame; Chepher, a place in Palestine; also the name of three Israelites: - Hepher.

; from h2658 (חָפַר); a hole; only in connection with h6512 (פֵּרָה), which ought rather to be joined as one word, thus חַפַרְפֵּרָה; by reduplication from h2658 (חָפַר); a burrower, i.e. probably a rat: - [phrase] mole.
; patronymically from h2660 (חֵפֶר); a Chephrite (collectively) or descendants of Chepher: - Hepherites.
; dual of h2660 (חֵפֶר); double pit; Chapharajim, a place in Palestine: - Haphraim.
; a primitive root; to seek; causatively, to conceal oneself (i.e. let be sought), or mask: - change, (make) diligent (search), disquise self, hide, search (for, out).
; from h2664 (חָפַשׂ); something covert, i.e. a trick: - search.
; a primitive root; to spread loose; figuratively, to manumit: - be free.
; from h2666 (חָפַשׁ); something spread loosely, i.e. a carpet: - precious.
; from h2666 (חָפַשׁ); liberty (from slavery): - freedom.
; and חׇפְשִׁית; from h2666 (חָפַשׁ); (with h1004 (בַּיִת), a hospital) prostration by sickness: - several.
; from h2666 (חָפַשׁ); exempt (from bondage, tax or care): - free, liberty.

; from h2686 (חָצַץ); also by interchange for h6086 (עֵץ) properly, a piercer, i.e. an arrow; by implication, a wound; figuratively, (of God) thunderbolt; the shaft of aspear: - [phrase] archer, arrow, dart, shaft, staff, wound.
; or חָצֵב; a primitive root; to cut or carve (wood, stone or other material); by implication, to hew, split, square, quarry, engrave: - cut, dig, divide, grave, hew (out, -er), made, mason.
; a primitive root (compare h2086 (זֵד))); to cut or split in two; to halve: - divide, [idiom] live out half, reach to the midst, participle
; a collective form of h2691 (חָצֵר); village; Chatsor, the name (thus simply) of two places in Palestine and of one in Arabia: - Hazor.
; from h2674 (חָצוֹר) and a Aramaizing form of the feminine of h2319 (חָדָשׁ) (compare h2323 (חֲדָת)); new Chatsor, a place in Palestine: - Hazor, Hadattah (as if two places).
; from h2673 (חָצָה)lemma חָעָה ayin, corrected to חָצָה; the middle (of the night): - mid(-night).
; from h2673 (חָצָה)lemma חָעָה ayin, corrected to חָצָה; the half or middle: - half, middle, mid(-night), midst, part, two parts.
; or חֵצִי; prolongation from h2671 (חֵץ); an arrow: - arrow.
; from h2677 (חֵצִי) and the plural of h4496 (מְנוּחָה), with the article interposed; midst of the resting-places; Chatsi-ham-Menuchoth, an Israelite: - half of the Manahethites.
; patronymically from h2679 (חֲצִי הַמְּנֻחוֹת); a Chatsi-ham-Menachtite or descendant of Chatsi-ham-Menuchoth: - half of the Manahethites.
; a collateral form of h2691 (חָצֵר); a court or abode: - court.
; perhaps originally the same as h2681 (חָצִיר), from the greenness of a courtyard; grass; also a leek (collectively): - grass, hay, herb, leek.
; from an unused root meaning to hold firmly; the bosom (as comprised between the arms): - bosom.
; a collateral form of h2683 (חֵצֶן), and meaning the same {the bosom (as comprised between the arms)}: - arm, lap.
; (Aramaic) a primitive root; properly, to shear or cut close; figuratively, to be severe: - hasty, be urgent.

; a primitive root (compare h2673 (חָצָה)lemma חָעָה ayin, corrected to חָצָה); also as denominative from h2671 (חֵץ) properly, to chop into, pierce or sever; hence, to curtail, to distribute (into ranks); to shoot an arrow: - archer, [idiom] bands, cut off in the midst.
; from h2687 (חָצָץ); also like h2671 (חֵץ) properly, something cutting; hence, gravel (as grit); an arrow: - arrow, gravel (stone).
; or חַצֲצֹן תָּמָר; from h2686 (חָצַץ) and h8558 (תָּמָר); division (i.e. perhaps row) of (the) palm-tree; Chatsetson-tamar, a place in Palestine: - Hazezon-tamar.
; by reduplication from h2690 (חָצַר); a trumpet (from its sundered or quavering note): - trumpet(-er).

; a primitive root; properly, to surround with a stockade, and thus separate from the open country; but used only in the reduplicated form חֲצֹצֵר; or (2 Chronicles 5:12) חֲצֹרֵר; as dem. from h2689 (חֲצֹצְרָה); to trumpet, i.e. blow on that instrument: - blow, sound, trumpeter.
; (masculine and feminine); from h2690 (חָצַר) in its original sense; a yard (as inclosed by a fence); also a hamlet (as similarly surrounded with walls): - court, tower, village.
; from h2691 (חָצֵר) and h0146 (אַדָּר); (the) village of Addar; Chatsar-Addar, a place in Palestine: - Hazar-addar.
; from h2691 (חָצֵר) and a feminine of h1408 (גַּד); (the) village of (female) Fortune; Chatsar-Gaddah, a place in Palestine: - Hazar-gaddah.
; from h2691 (חָצֵר) and h8484 (תִּיכוֹן) with the article interposed; village of the middle; Chatsar-hat-Tikon, a place in Palestine: - Hazar-hatticon.
; by an orthographical variation for h2696 (חֶצְרוֹן); enclosure; Chetsro, an Israelite: - Hezro, Hezrai.
; from h2691 (חָצֵר); court-yard; Chetsron, the name of a place in Palestine; also of two Israelites: - Hezron.
; patronymically from h2696 (חֶצְרוֹן); a Chetsronite or (collectively) descendants of Chetsron: - Hezronites.
; feminine plural of h2691 (חָצֵר); yards; Chatseroth, a place in Palestine: - Hazeroth.
; plural masculine of h2691 (חָצֵר); yards; Chatserim, a place in Palestine: - Hazerim.
; from h2691 (חָצֵר) and h4194 (מָוֶת); village of death; Chatsarmaveth, a place in Arabia: - Hazarmaveth.
; from h2691 (חָצֵר) and h5484 (סוּסָה); village of cavalry; Chatsar-Susah, a place in Palestine: - Hazar-susah.
; from h2691 (חָצֵר) and the plural of h5483 (סוּס); village of horses; Chatsar-Susim, a place in Palestine: - Hazar-susim.
; from h2691 (חָצֵר) and a derivative of h5869 (עַיִן); village of springs; Chatsar-Enon, a place in Palestine: - Hazar-enon.
; from h2691 (חָצֵר) and the same as h5881 (עֵינָן); village of springs; Chatsar-Enan, a place in Palestine: - Hazar-enan.
; from h2691 (חָצֵר) and h7776 (שׁוּעָל); village of (the) fox; Chatsar-Shual, a place in Palestine: - Hazar-shual.

; from h2710 (חָקַק); an enactment; hence, an appointment (of time, space, quantity, labor or usage): - appointed, bound, commandment, convenient, custom, decree(-d), due, law, measure, [idiom] necessary, ordinance(-nary), portion, set time, statute, task.
; a primitive root; to carve; by implication, to delineate; also to entrench: - carved work, portrayed, set a print.
; feminine of h2706 (חֹק), and meaning substantially the same {an enactment; hence, an appointment (of time, space, quantity, labor or usage)}: - appointed, custom, manner, ordinance, site, statute.
; from an unused root probably meaning to bend; crooked; Chakupha, one of the Nethinim: - Hakupha.

; a primitive root; properly, to hack, i.e. engrave (Judges 5:14, to be a scribe simply); by implication, to enact (laws being cut in stone or metal tablets in primitive times) or (gen.) prescribe: - appoint, decree, governor, grave, lawgiver, note, pourtray, print, set.
; from h2710 (חָקַק); an enactment, a resolution: - decree, thought.
; or (fully) חוּקֹק; from h2710 (חָקַק); appointed; Chukkok or Chukok, a place in Palestine: - Hukkok, Hukok.
; a primitive root; properly, to penetrate; hence, to examine intimately: - find out, (make) search (out), seek (out), sound, try.
; from h2713 (חָקַר); examination, enumeration, deliberation: - finding out, number, (un-) search(-able, -ed, out, -ing).
; or (fully) חוֹר; from h2787 (חָרַר); (compare h2751 (חֹרִי)) properly, white or pure (from the cleansing or shining power of fire; hence (figuratively) noble (in rank): - noble.
; from an unused (and vulgar) root probably meaning to evacuate the bowels; excrement: - dung. Also חֲרִי.

; or חֲרֵב; a primitive root; to parch (through drought) i.e. (by analogy,) to desolate, destroy, kill: - decay, (be) desolate, destroy(-er), (be) dry (up), slay, [idiom] surely, (lay, lie, make) waste.
; (Aramaic) a root corresponding to h2717 (חָרַב); to demolish: - destroy.
; from h2717 (חָרַב); drought; also a cutting instrument (from its destructive effect), as a knife, sword, or other sharp implement: - axe, dagger, knife, mattock, sword, tool.
; from h2717 (חָרַב); parched or ruined: - desolate, dry, waste.
; a collaterally form of h2719 (חֶרֶב); drought or desolation: - desolation, drought, dry, heat, [idiom] utterly, waste.
; from h2717 (חָרַב); desolate; Choreb, a (generic) name for the Sinaitic mountains: - Horeb.
; feminine of h2721 (חֹרֶב); properly, drought, i.e. (by implication) a desolation: - decayed place, desolate (place, -tion), destruction, (laid) waste (place).
; feminine of h2720 (חָרֵב); a desert: - dry (ground, land).
; from h2717 (חָרַב); parching heat: - drought.
; or חַרְבוֹנָה; of Persian origin; Charbona or Charbonah, a eunuch of Xerxes: - Harbona, Harbonah.
; a primitive root; properly, to leap suddenly, i.e. (by implication) to be dismayed: - be afraid.
; from h2727 (חָרַג); the leaping insect, i.e. a locust: - beetle.
; a primitive root; to shudder with terror; hence, to fear; also to hasten (with anxiety): - be (make) afraid, be careful, discomfit, fray (away), quake, tremble.
; from h2729 (חָרַד); fearful; also reverential: - afraid, trembling.
; feminine of h2730 (חָרֵד); fear, anxiety: - care, [idiom] exceedingly, fear, quaking, trembling.
; the same as h2731 (חֲרָדָה); Charadah, a place in the Desert: - Haradah.
; patrial from a derivative of h2729 (חָרַד) (compare h5878 (עֵין חֲרֹד)); a Charodite, or inhabitant of Charod: - Harodite.

; a primitive root (compare h2787 (חָרַר)); to glow or grow warm; figuratively (usually) to blaze up, of anger, zeal, jealousy: - be angry, burn, be displeased, [idiom] earnestly, fret self, grieve, be (wax) hot, be incensed, kindle, [idiom] very, be wroth. See h8474 (תַּחָרָה).
; from h2356 (חוֹר) and a collateral (masculine) form of h1412 (גֻּדְגֹּדָה), with the article interposed; hole of the cleft; Chor-hag-Gidgad, a place in the Desert: - Hor-hagidgad.
; ; from h2734 (חָרָה) and h3050 (יָהּ); fearing Jah; Charhajah, an Israelite: - Harhaiah.
; from an unused root meaning to perforate; properly, pierced, i.e. a bead of pearl, gems or jewels (as strung): - chain.
; or (shortened) חָרֻל; apparently, a passive participle of an unused root probably meaning to be prickly; properly, pointed, i.e. a bramble or other thorny weed: - nettle.
; from passive participle of h2763 (חָרַם) and h0639 (אַף); snub-nosed; Charumaph, an Israelite: - Harumaph.
; or (shortened) חָרֹן; from h2734 (חָרָה); a burning of anger: - sore displeasure, fierce(-ness), fury, (fierce) wrath(-ful).
; a patrial from (probably) a collateral form of h2756 (חָרִיף); a Charuphite or inhabitant of Charuph (or Chariph): - Haruphite.

; or חָרֻץ; passive participle of h2782 (חָרַץ); properly, incised or (active) incisive; hence (as noun masculine or feminine) a trench (as dug), gold (as mined), a threshing-sledge (having sharp teeth); (figuratively) determination; also eager: - decision, diligent, (fine) gold, pointed things, sharp, threshing instrument, wall.
; the same as h2742 (חֲרוּץ); earnest; Charuts, an Israelite: - Haruz.
; a fuller form of h2746 (חַרְחֻר); inflammation; Charchur, one of the Nethinim: - Harhur.
; from the same as h2775 (חֶרֶס); perhaps shining; Charchas, an Israelite: - Harhas.
; from h2787 (חָרַר); fever (as hot): - extreme burning.
; from a primitive root meaning to engrave; a chisel or graver; also a style forwriting: - graving tool, pen.
; from the same as h2747 (חֶרֶט); a horoscopist (as drawing magical lines or circles): - magician.
; (Aramaic) the same as h2748 (חַרְטֹם) {a horoscopist (as drawing magical lines or circles)}: - magician.
; from h2734 (חָרָה); a burning (i.e. intense) anger: - fierce, [idiom] great, heat.
; from the same as h2353 (חוּר); white bread: - white.
; from h2356 (חוֹר); cave-dweller or troglodyte; a Chorite or aboriginal Idumaean: - Horims, Horites.
; or חוֹרִי; the same as h2752 (חֹרִי); Chori, the name of two men: - Hori.
; or חָרִט; from the same as h2747 (חֶרֶט); properly, cut out (or hollow), i.e. (by implication) a pocket: - bag, crisping pin.

; from the plural of h2716 (חֶרֶא) and the plural of h3123 (יוֹנָה); or perhaps rather the plural of a single word חֲרָאיוֹן, probably a kind of vegetable excrements of doves {or a vegetable}: - doves' dung.
; from h2778 (חָרַף); autumnal; Chariph, the name of two Israelites: - Hariph.
; or חֲרִץ; from h2782 (חָרַץ); (compare h2742 (חֲרוּץ)) properly, incisure or (passively) incised; hence, a threshing-sledge (with sharp teeth); also a slice (as cut): - [phrase] cheese, harrow.
; from h2790 (חָרַשׁ); ploughing or its season: - earing (time), ground.
; from h2790 (חָרַשׁ) in the sense of silence; quiet, i.e. sultry (as feminine noun, the sirocco or hot east wind): - vehement.
; a primitive root; to braid (i.e. to entangle or snare) or catch (game) in anet: - roast.
; (Aramaic) a root probably allied to the equivalent of h2787 (חָרַר); to scorch: - singe.
; from h2760 (חָרַךְ); properly, a net, i.e. (by analogy) lattice: - lattice.

; a primitive root; to seclude; specifically (by a ban) to devote to religious uses (especially destruction); physical and reflexive, to be blunt as to the nose: - make accursed, consecrate, (utterly) destroy, devote, forfeit, have a flat nose, utterly (slay, make away).

; or (Zechariah 14:11) חֶרֶם; from h2763 (חָרַם); physical (as shutting in) a net (either literally or figuratively); usually a doomed object; abstractly extermination: - (ac-) curse(-d, -d thing), dedicated thing, things which should have been utterly destroyed, (appointed to) utter destruction, devoted (thing), net.
; from h2763 (חָרַם); devoted; Chorem, a place in Palestine: - Horem.
; from h2763 (חָרַם); snub-nosed; Charim, an Israelite: - Harim.
; from h2763 (חָרַם); devoted; Chormah, a place in Palestine: - Hormah.
; from h2763 (חָרַם); abrupt; Chermon, a mount of Palestine: - Hermon.
; plural of h2768 (חֶרְמוֹן); Hermons, i.e. its peaks: - the Hermonites.
; from h2763 (חָרַם); a sickle (as cutting): - sickle.
; from h2787 (חָרַר); parched; Charan, the name of a man and also of a place: - Haran.
; patrial from h2773 (חֹרֹנַיִם); a Choronite or inhabitant of Choronaim: - Horonite.
; dual of a derivative from h2356 (חוֹר); double cave-town; Choronajim, a place in Moab: - Horonaim.
; of uncertain derivation; Charnepher, an Israelite: - Harnepher.
; or (with a directive enclitic) חַרְסָה; from an unused root meaning to scrape; also perhaps from the mediating idea of h2777 (חַרְסוּת) the itch; the sun: - itch, sun.
; the same as h2775 (חֶרֶס); shining; Cheres, a mountain in Palestine: - Heres.
; from h2775 (חֶרֶס) (apparently in the sense of a red tile used for scraping); a potsherd, i.e. (by implication) a pottery; the name of a gate at Jerusalem: - east.

; a primitive root; also denominative (from h2779 (חֹרֶף)) to pull off, i.e. (by implication) to expose (as by stripping); specifically, to betroth (as if a surrender); figuratively, to carp at, i.e. defame; to spend the winter: - betroth, blaspheme, defy, jeopard, rail, reproach, upbraid.
; from h2778 (חָרַף); properly, the crop gathered, i.e. (by implication) the autumn (and winter) season; figuratively, ripeness of age: - cold, winter (-house), youth.
; from h2778 (חָרַף); reproachful; Chareph, an Israelite: - Hareph.
; from h2778 (חָרַף); contumely, disgrace, the pudenda: - rebuke, reproach(-fully), shame.
; a primitive root; properly, to point sharply, i.e. (literally) to wound; figuratively, to be alert, to decide: - bestir self, decide, decree, determine, maim, move.
; (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to h2782 (חָרַץ) in the sense of vigor; the loin (as the seat of strength): - loin.
; of uncertain derivation; a fetter; figuratively, a pain: - band.
; from h2782 (חָרַץ); a sour grape (as sharp in taste): - kernel.
; a primitive root; to grate the teeth: - gnash.
; a primitive root; to glow, i.e. literally (to melt, burn, dry up) or figuratively (to show or incite passion): - be angry, burn, dry, kindle.
; from h2787 (חָרַר); arid: - parched place.
; a collateral form mediating between h2775 (חֶרֶס) and h2791 (חֶרֶשׁ); a piece of pottery: - earth(-en), (pot-) sherd, [phrase] stone.

; a primitive root; to scratch, i.e. (by implication) to engrave, plough; hence (from the use of tools) to fabricate (of any material); figuratively, to devise (in a bad sense); hence (from the idea of secrecy) to be silent, to let alone; hence (by implication) to be deaf (as an accompaniment of dumbness): - [idiom] altogether, cease, conceal, be deaf, devise, ear, graven, imagine, leave off speaking, hold peace, plow(-er, man), be quiet, rest, practise secretly, keep silence, be silent, speak not a word, be still, hold tongue, worker.
; from h2790 (חָרַשׁ); magical craft; also silence: - cunning, secretly.
; the same as h2791 (חֶרֶשׁ) Cheresh, a Levite: - Heresh.
; from h2790 (חָרַשׁ); a forest (perhaps as furnishing the material for fabric): - bough, forest, shroud, wood.
; active participle of h2790 (חָרַשׁ); a fabricator or mechanic: - artificer.
; from h2790 (חָרַשׁ); deaf (whether literally or spiritual): - deaf.
; from h2790 (חָרַשׁ); a fabricator or any material: - artificer, ([phrase]) carpenter, craftsman, engraver, maker, [phrase] mason, skilful, ([phrase]) smith, worker, workman, such as wrought.
; from h2792 (חֶרֶשׁ); magician; Charsha, one of the Nethinim: - Harsha.
; plural of h2796 (חָרָשׁ); mechanics, the name of a valley in Jerusalem: - Charashim, craftsmen.
; from h2790 (חָרַשׁ); mechanical work: - carving, cutting.
; the same as h2799 (חֲרֹשֶׁת); Charosheth, a place in Palestine: - Harosheth.
; a primitive root; to engrave: - graven.
; from h2801 (חָרַת) (but equivalent to h2793 (חֹרֶשׁ)); forest; Chereth, a thicket in Palestine: - Hereth.

; a primitive root; properly, to plait or interpenetrate, i.e. (literally) to weave or (generally) to fabricate; figuratively, to plot or contrive (usually in a malicious sense); hence (from the mental effort) to think, regard, value, compute: - (make) account (of), conceive, consider, count, cunning (man, work, workman), devise, esteem, find out, forecast, hold, imagine, impute, invent, be like, mean, purpose, reckon(-ing be made), regard, think.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h2803 (חָשַׁב); to regard: - repute.
; from h2803 (חָשַׁב); a belt or strap (as being interlaced): - curious girdle.
; from h2803 (חָשַׁב) and h1777 (דִּין); considerate judge; Chasbaddanah, an Israelite: - Hasbadana.
; from h2803 (חָשַׁב); estimation; Cashubah, an Israelite: - Hashubah.
; from h2803 (חָשַׁב); properly, contrivance; by implication, intelligence: - account, device, reason.
; the same as h2808 (חֶשְׁבּוֹן); Cheshbon, a place East of the Jordan: - Heshbon.
; from h2803 (חָשַׁב); a contrivance, i.e. actual (a warlike machine) or mental (a machination): - engine, invention.
; or חֲשַׁבְיָהוּ; from h2803 (חָשַׁב) and h3050 (יָהּ); Jah has regarded; Chashabjah, the name of nine Israelites: - Hashabiah.
; feminine of h2808 (חֶשְׁבּוֹן); inventiveness; Chashnah, an Israelite: - Hashabnah.
; from h2808 (חֶשְׁבּוֹן) and h3050 (יָהּ); thought of Jah; Chashabnejah, the name of two Israelites: - Hashabniah.
; a primitive root; to hush or keep quiet: - hold peace, keep silence, be silent, (be) still.
; from h2803 (חָשַׁב); intelligent; Chashshub, the name of two or three Israelites: - Hashub, Hasshub.
; (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to h2821 (חָשַׁךְ); the dark: - darkness.
; or חֲשֻׂפָא; from h2834 (חָשַׂף); nakedness; Chasupha, one of the Nethinim: - Hashupha, Hasupha.
; (Aramaic) a collateral root to one corresponding to h2363 (חוּשׁ) in the sense of readiness; to be necessary (from the idea of convenience) or (transitively) to need: - careful, have need of.
; from a root corresponding to h2818 (חֲשַׁח); necessity: - be needful.

; a primitive root; also interchangeable with h2821 (חָשַׁךְ) to restrain or (reflex.) refrain; by implication, to refuse, spare, preserve; to observe: - assuage, [idiom] darken, forbear, hinder, hold back, keep (back), punish, refrain, reserve, spare, withhold.
; a primitive root; to be dark (as withholding light); transitively, to darken: - be black, be (make) dark, darken, cause darkness, be dim, hide.
; from h2821 (חָשַׁךְ); the dark; hence (literally) darkness; figuratively, misery, destruction, death, ignorance, sorrow, wickedness: - dark(-ness), night, obscurity.
; from h2821 (חָשַׁךְ); dark (figuratively, i.e. obscure): - meaning
; from h2821 (חָשַׁךְ); darkness: - dark.
; or חֲשֵׁיכָהxlit chăshêkâh corrected to chăshêykâh; from h2821 (חָשַׁךְ); darkness; figuratively, misery: - darkness.
; a primitive root; to make (intrans. be) unsteady, i.e. weak: - feeble.
; (Aramaic) a root corresponding to h2826 (חָשַׁל); to weaken, i.e. crush: - subdue.
; from the same as h2831 (חַשְׁמַן); enriched; Chashum, the name of two or three Israelites: - Hashum.
; the same as h2831 (חַשְׁמַן); opulent; Cheshmon, a place in Palestine: - Heshmon.
; of uncertain derivation; probably bronze or polished spectrum metal: - amber.
; from an unused root (probably meaning firm or capacious in resources); apparently wealthy: - princes.
; feminine of h2831 (חַשְׁמַן); fertile; Chasmonah, a place in the Desert: - Hashmonah.

; from an unused root probably meaning to contain or sparkle; perhaps a pocket (as holding the Urim and Thummim), or rich (as containing gems), used only of the gorget of the highpriest: - breastplate.
; a primitive root; to strip off, i.e. generally to make naked (for exertion or in disgrace), to drain away or bail up (a liquid): - make bare, clean, discover, draw out, take, uncover.
; from h2834 (חָשַׂף); properly, drawn off, i.e. separated; hence, a small company (as divided from the rest): - little flock.

; a primitive root; also interchangeable for h2820 (חָשַׂךְ) to cling, i.e. join, (figuratively) to love, delight in; elliptically; to deliver: - have a delight, (have a) desire, fillet, long, set (in) love.
; from h2836 (חָשַׁק); delight: - desire, pleasure.
; or חָשׁוּק; past participle of h2836 (חָשַׁק); attached, i.e. a fence-rail or rod connecting the posts or pillars: - fillet.
; from h2836 (חָשַׁק); conjoined, i.e. a wheel-spoke or rod connecting the hub with the rim: - felloe.
; from an unused root meaning to bind together; combined, i.e. the nave or hub of awheel (as holding the spokes together): - spoke.
; from the same as h2840 (חִשֻּׁר); properly, a combination or gathering, i.e. of watery clouds: - dark.
; by variation for h7179 (קַשׁ); dry grass: - chaff.
; patronymically from h2364 (חוּשָׁה); a Chushathite or descendant of Chushah: - Hushathite.
; from h2865 (חָתַת); concretely, crushed; also afraid; abstractly, terror: - broken, dismayed, dread, fear.
; from h2865 (חָתַת); terror; Cheth, an aboriginal Canaanite: - Heth.
; a primitive root; to lay hold of; especially to pick up fire: - heap, take (away).
; from h2865 (חָתַת); fear: - terror.
; from h2853 (חָתַל); swathed, i.e. a bandage: - roller.
; from h2844 (חַת); terror: - fear.
; patronymically from h2845 (חֵת); a Chittite, or descendant of Cheth: - Hittite, Hittities.
; from h2865 (חָתַת); fear: - terror.
; a primitive root; properly, to cut off, i.e. (figuratively) to decree: - determine.
; a primitive root; to swathe: - [idiom] at all, swaddle.
; from h2853 (חָתַל); a swathing cloth (figuratively): - swaddling band.
; from h2853 (חָתַל); enswathed; Chethlon, a place in Palestine: - Hethlon.
; a primitive root; to close up; especially to seal: - make an end, mark, seal (up), stop.
; (Aramaic) a root corresponding to h2856 (חָתַם); to seal: - seal.
; feminine active participle of h2856 (חָתַם); a seal: - signet.
; a primitive root; to give (a daughter) away in marriage; hence (generally) to contract affinity by marriage: - join in affinity, father in law, make marriages, mother in law, son in law.
; from h2859 (חָתַן); a relative by marriage (especially through the bride); figuratively, a circumcised child (as a species of religious espousal): - bridegroom, husband, son in law.
; from h2859 (חָתַן); a wedding: - espousal.
; a primitive root; to clutch: - take away.
; from h2862 (חָתַף); properly, rapine; figuratively, robbery: - prey.
; a primitive root; to force a passage, as by burglary; figuratively, with oars: - dig (through), row.

; a primitive root; properly, to prostrate; hence, to break down, either (literally) by violence, or (figuratively) by confusion and fear: - abolish, affright, be (make) afraid, amaze, beat down, discourage, (cause to) dismay, go down, scare, terrify.
; from h2865 (חָתַת); dismay: - casting down.
; the same as h2866 (חֲתַת); Chathath, an Israelite: - cathath. f
Indexes for Dictionary.
; a primitive root; to rejoice: - be glad
; the same as h2896 (טוֹב); good: - fine, good.
; from h2895 (טוֹב) and h0410 (אֵל); pleasing (to) God; Tabeel, the name of a Syrian and of a Persian: - Tabeal, Tabeel.
; passive participle of h2881 (טָבַל); properly, dyed, i.e. a turban (probably as of colored stuff): - dyed attire.
; from an unused root meaning to pile up; properly, accumulated; i.e. (by implication) a summit: - middle, midst.
; a primitive root; to slaughter (animals or men): - kill, (make) slaughter, slay.

; from h2873 (טָבַח); properly, something slaughtered; hence, a beast (or meat, as butchered); abstractly butchery (or concretely, a place of slaughter): - [idiom] beast, slaughter, [idiom] slay, [idiom] sore.
; the same as h2874 (טֶבַח); massacre; Tebach, the name of a Mesopotamian and of an Israelite: - Tebah.
; from h2873 (טָבַח); properly, a butcher; hence, a lifeguardsman (because he was acting as an executioner); also a cook (usually slaughtering the animal for food): - cook, guard.
; (Aramaic) the same as h2876 (טַבָּח); a lifeguardsman: - guard.

; feminine of h2874 (טֶבַח) and meaning the same {properly, something slaughtered; hence, a beast (or meat, as butchered); abstractly butchery (or concretely, a place of slaughter)}: - flesh, slaughter.
; feminine of h2876 (טַבָּח); a female cook: - cook.
; from h2878 (טִבְחָה); slaughter; Tibchath, a place in Syria: - Tibhath.
; a primitive root; to dip, to immerse: - dip, plunge.
; from h2881 (טָבַל) and h3050 (יָהּ); Jah has dipped; Tebaljah, an Israelite: - Tebaliah.
; a primitive root; to sink: - drown, fasten, settle, sink.
; plural of h2885 (טַבַּעַת); rings; Tabbaoth, one of the Nethinim: - Tabaoth.
; from h2883 (טָבַע); properly, a seal (as sunk into the wax), i.e. signet (for sealing); hence (generally) a ring of any kind: - ring.
; from h2895 (טוֹב) and h7417 (רִמּוֹן); pleasing (to) Rimmon; Tabrimmon, a Syrian: - Tabrimmon.
; probably of foreign derivation; Tebeth, the tenth Hebrew month: - Tebeth.
; of uncertain derivation; Tabbath, a place East of the Jordan: - Tabbath.
; or טָהֹר; from h2891 (טָהֵר); pure (in a physical, chemical, ceremonial or moral sense): - clean, fair, pure(-ness).
; from h2891 (טָהֵר); purity: - pureness.

; a primitive root; properly, to be bright; i.e. (by implication) to be pure (physical sound, clear, unadulterated; Levitically, uncontaminated; morally, innocent or holy): - be (make, make self, pronounce) clean, cleanse (self), purge, purify(-ier, self).
; from h2891 (טָהֵר); literally brightness; ceremonially purification: - clearness, glory, purifying.
; feminine of h2892 (טֹהַר); ceremonial purification; moral purity: - [idiom] is cleansed, cleansing, purification(-fying).
; a primitive root; to sweep away: - sweep.
; a primitive root, to be (transitively, do or make) good (or well) in the widest sense: - be (do) better, cheer, be (do, seem) good, (make) goodly, [idiom] please, (be, do, go, play) well.

; from h2895 (טוֹב); good (as an adjective) in the widest sense; used likewise as a noun, both in the masculine and the feminine, the singular and the plural (good, a good or good thing, a good man or woman; the good, goods or good things, good men or women), also as an adverb (well): - beautiful, best, better, bountiful, cheerful, at ease, [idiom] fair (word), (be in) favour, fine, glad, good (deed, -lier, -liest, -ly, -ness, -s), graciously, joyful, kindly, kindness, liketh (best), loving, merry, [idiom] most, pleasant, [phrase] pleaseth, pleasure, precious, prosperity, ready, sweet, wealth, welfare, (be) well(-favoured).
; the same as h2896 (טוֹב); good; Tob, a region apparently East of the Jordan: - Tob.

; from h2895 (טוֹב); good (as a noun), in the widest sense, especially goodness (superlative concretely, the best), beauty, gladness, welfare: - fair, gladness, good(-ness, thing, -s), joy, go well with.
; from h2896 (טוֹב) and h0138 (אֲדֹנִיָּה); pleasing (to) Adonijah; Tob-Adonijah, an Israelite: - Tob-adonijah.
; or טוֹבִיָּהוּ; from h2896 (טוֹב) and h3050 (יָהּ); goodness of Jehovah; Tobijah, the name of three Israelites and of one Samaritan: - Tobiah, Tobijah.
; a primitive root; to spin: - spin.
; a primitive root; to smear, especially with lime: - daub, overlay, plaister, smut.
; from an unused root meaning to go around or bind; a fillet for the forehead: - frontlet.
; a primitive root; to pitch over or reel; hence (transitively) to cast down or out: - carry away, (utterly) cast (down, forth, out), send out.
; from an unused root meaning to range in a regular manner; a row; hence, a wall: - row.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h6697 (צוּר); a rock or hill: - mountain.
; a primitive root; to pounce as a bird of prey: - haste.
; (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to h2901 (טָוָה); hunger (as twisting): - fasting.
; a primitive root; to stretch a bow, as an archer: - (bow-) shot.
; from h2909 (טָחָה) (or h2902 (טוּחַ)) in the sense of overlaying; (in the plural only) the kidneys (as being covered); hence (figuratively) the inmost thought: - inward parts.
; from h2912 (טָחַן); a hand mill; hence, a millstone: - to grind.
; a primitive root; to grind meal; hence, to be aconcubine (that being their employment): - grind(-er).
; from h2912 (טָחַן); a hand mill; hence (figuratively) chewing: - grinding.
; from an unused root meaning to burn; a boil or ulcer (from the inflammation), especially a tumorin the anus or pudenda (the piles): - emerod.
; from (the equiv. of) h2902 (טוּחַ); mortar or plaster: - daubing.

; from an unused root meaning apparently to be sticky (rather perb. a demonstrative); from h2894 (טוּא), through the idea of dirt to be swept away); mud or clay; figuratively, calamity: - clay, dirt, mire.
; (Aramaic) perhaps, by interchange, for a word corresponding to h2916 (טִיט); clay: - miry.
; feminine of (an equivalent to) h2905 (טוּר); a wall; hence, a fortress or a hamlet: - (goodly) castle, habitation, palace, row.
; from h2926 (טָלַל); dew (as covering vegetation): - dew.
; (Aramaic) the same as h2919 (טַל) {dew (as covering vegetation)}: - dew.
; a primitive root; properly, to cover with pieces; i.e. (by implication) to spot or variegate (as tapestry): - clouted, with divers colours, spotted.
; apparently from h2921 (טָלָא) in the (orig.) sense of covering (for protection); (compare h2924 (טָלֶה)) a lamb: - lamb.
; from the plural of h2922 (טְלָא); lambs; Telaim, a place in Palestine: - Telaim.
; by variation for h2922 (טְלָא); a lamb: - lamb.
; from h2904 (טוּל); overthrow or rejection: - captivity.
; a primitive root; properly, to strew over, i.e. (by implication) to cover in or plate (with beams): - cover.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h2926 (טָלַל); to cover with shade: - have a shadow.
; from an unused root meaning to break up or treat violently; oppression; Telem, the name of a place in Idumaea, also of a temple doorkeeper: - Telem.
; from the same as h2728 (חָרְגֹּל); oppressive; Talmon, a temple doorkeeper: - Talmon.
; a primitive root; to be foul, especially in a ceremial or moral sense (contaminated): - defile (self), pollute (self), be (make, make self, pronounce) unclean, [idiom] utterly.
; from h2930 (טָמֵא); foul in a religious sense: - defiled, [phrase] infamous, polluted(-tion), unclean.
; from h2930 (טָמֵא); religious impurity: - filthiness, unclean(-ness).
; a collateral form of h2930 (טָמֵא); to be impure in a religious sense: - be defiled, be reputed vile.
; a primitive root; to hide (by covering over): - hide, lay privily, in secret.
; from an unused root probably meaning to weave; a basket (of interlaced osiers): - basket.
; a primitive root; to soil: - defile.
; a primitive root; to wander; causatively to lead astray: - seduce.
; a primitive root; to taste; figuratively, to perceive: - [idiom] but, perceive, taste.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h2938 (טָעַם); to taste; causatively to feed: - make to eat, feed.

; from h2938 (טָעַם); properly, a taste, i.e. (figuratively) perception; by implication, intelligence; transitively, a mandate: - advice, behaviour, decree, discretion, judgment, reason, taste, understanding.
; (Aramaic) from h2939 (טְעַם); compare h2940 (טַעַם)) properly, a taste, i.e. ajudicial sentence: - account, [idiom] to be commanded, commandment, matter.

; (Aramaic) from h2939 (טְעַם), and equivalent to h2941 (טַעַם); properly, flavor; figuratively, judgment (both subjective and objective); hence, account (both subjectively and objectively): - [phrase] chancellor, [phrase] command, commandment, decree, [phrase] regard, taste, wisdom.
; a primitive root; to load a beast: - lade.
; a primitive root; to stab: - thrust through.
; from h2952 (טָפַף) (perhaps referring to the tripping gait of children); a family (mostly used collectively in the singular): - (little) children (ones), families.

; a primitive root; or perhaps a denominative from h2947 (טֵפַח), from dandling on the palms to flatten out or extend (as a tent); figuratively, to nurse achild (as promotive of growth);: - span, swaddle.
; from h2946 (טָפַח); a spread of the hand, i.e. a palm-breadth (not 'span' of the fingers); architecturally, a corbel (as a supporting palm): - coping, hand-breadth.
; from h2946 (טָפַח) (the same as h2947 (טֵפַח)) {a spread of the hand, i.e. a palm-breadth (not 'span' of the fingers); architecturally, a corbel (as a supporting palm)}: - hand-breadth (broad).
; from h2946 (טָפַח); nursing: - span long.
; a primitive root; properly, to stick on as apatch; figuratively, to impute falsely: - forge(-r), sew up.
; of foreign derivation; a military governor: - captain.
; a primitive root; apparently to trip (with short steps) coquettishly: - mince.
; (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to h6852 (צָפַר), and meaning the same as h6856 (צִפֹּרֶן); a finger-nail; also a hoof or claw: - nail.

; a primitive root; to desire: - long.

; a primitive root (probably rather the same as h2973 (יָאַל) through the idea of mental weakness); properly, to yield, especially assent; hence (pos.) to undertake as an act of volition: - assay, begin, be content, please, take upon, [idiom] willingly, would.

; of Egyptian origin; a channel, e.g. a fosse, canal, shaft; specifically the Nile, as the one river of Egypt, including its collateral trenches; also the Tigris, as the main river of Assyria: - brook, flood, river, stream.
; a primitive root; to desist, i.e. (figuratively) to despond: - (cause to) despair, one that is desperate, be no hope.

; from h1129 (בָּנָה) and h0410 (אֵל); built of God; Jabneel, the name of two places in Palestine: - Jabneel.

; a primitive root; to be ashamed, confused or disappointed; also (as failing) to dry up (as water) or wither (as herbage): - be ashamed, clean, be confounded, (make) dry (up), (do) shame(-fully), [idiom] utterly, wither (away).
; from h3001 (יָבֵשׁ); dry: - dried (away), dry.

; from h3001 (יָבֵשׁ); dry ground: - dry (ground, land).

; a primitive word; in distinction from h3709 (כַּף), the closed one); used (as noun, adverb, etc.) in a great variety of applications, both literally and figuratively, both proximate and remote (as follows) a hand (the open one (indicating power, means, direction, etc.),: - ([phrase] be) able, [idiom] about, [phrase] armholes, at, axletree, because of, beside, border, [idiom] bounty, [phrase] broad, (broken-) handed, [idiom] by, charge, coast, [phrase] consecrate, [phrase] creditor, custody, debt, dominion, [idiom] enough, [phrase] fellowship, force, [idiom] from, hand(-staves, -y work), [idiom] he, himself, [idiom] in, labour, [phrase] large, ledge, (left-) handed, means, [idiom] mine, ministry, near, [idiom] of, [idiom] order, ordinance, [idiom] our, parts, pain, power, [idiom] presumptuously, service, side, sore, state, stay, draw with strength, stroke, [phrase] swear, terror, [idiom] thee, [idiom] by them, [idiom] themselves, [idiom] thine own, [idiom] thou, through, [idiom] throwing, [phrase] thumb, times, [idiom] to, [idiom] under, [idiom] us, [idiom] wait on, (way-) side, where, [phrase] wide, [idiom] with (him, me, you), work, [phrase] yield, [idiom] yourselves.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h3027 (יָד) {a hand (the open one (indicating power, means, direction, etc.)}: - hand, power.

; a primitive root; (compare h3034 (יָדָה)) properly, to handle, i.e. to throw, e.g. lots: - cast.
; from h3039 (יְדִיד); properly, affection; concretely, a darling object: - dearly beloved.

; a primitive root; to know (properly, to ascertain by seeing); used in a great variety of senses, figuratively, literally, euphemistically and inferentially (including observation, care, recognition; and causatively, instruction, designation, punishment, etc.): - acknowledge, acquaintance(-ted with), advise, answer, appoint, assuredly, be aware, (un-) awares, can(-not), certainly, comprehend, consider, [idiom] could they, cunning, declare, be diligent, (can, cause to) discern, discover, endued with, familiar friend, famous, feel, can have, be (ig-) norant, instruct, kinsfolk, kinsman, (cause to let, make) know, (come to give, have, take) knowledge, have (knowledge), (be, make, make to be, make self) known, [phrase] be learned, [phrase] lie by man, mark, perceive, privy to, [idiom] prognosticator, regard, have respect, skilful, shew, can (man of) skill, be sure, of a surety, teach, (can) tell, understand, have (understanding), [idiom] will be, wist, wit, wot.

; (Aramaic) corresponding to h3045 (יָדַע) {to know (properly, to ascertain by seeing); used in a great variety of senses, figuratively, literally, euphemistically and inferentially (including observation, care, recognition; and causatively, instruction, designation, punishment, etc.)}: - certify, know, make known, teach.

; a variation of h3068 (יְהֹוָה) (used after h0136 (אֲדֹנָי), and pronounced by Jews as h0430 (אֱלֹהִים), in order to prevent the repetition of the same sound, since they elsewhere pronounce h3068 (יְהֹוָה) as h0136 (אֲדֹנָי)) {YHWH}: - God.

; from h3068 (יְהֹוָה) and h3045 (יָדַע); Jehovah-known; Jehojada, the name of three Israelites: - Jehoiada. Compare h3111 (יוֹיָדָע).
; from h3068 (יְהֹוָה) and h3559 (כּוּן); Jehovah will establish; Jehojakin, a Jewish king: - Jehoiachin. Compare h3112 (יוֹיָכִין).
; from h3068 (יְהֹוָה) abbreviated and h6965 (קוּם); Jehovah will raise; Jehojakim, a Jewish king: - Jehoiakim. Compare h3113 (יוֹיָקִים).

; a fuller form of h3130 (יוֹסֵף); Jehoseph (i.e. Joseph), a son of Jacob: - Joseph.

; from h3068 (יְהֹוָה) and h6663 (צָדַק); Jehovah-righted; Jehotsadak, an Israelite: - Jehozadek, Josedech. Compare h3136 (יוֹצָדָק).
; from h3068 (יְהֹוָה) and h7311 (רוּם); Jehovah-raised; Jehoram, the name of a Syrian and of three Israelites: - Jehoram, Joram. Compare h3141 (יוֹרָם).
; from h3068 (יְהֹוָה) and h7650 (שָׁבַע); Jehovah-sworn; Jehosheba, an Israelitess: - Jehosheba. Compare h3090 (יְהוֹשַׁבְעַת).
; a form of h3089 (יְהוֹשֶׁבַע); Jehoshabath, an Israelitess: - Jehoshabeath.

; from h3068 (יְהֹוָה) and h8199 (שָׁפַט); Jehovah-judged; Jehoshaphat, the name of six Israelites; also of a valley near Jerusalem: - Jehoshaphat. Compare h3146 (יוֹשָׁפָט).
; probably from the same as h2022 (הַר); elated; hence, arrogant: - haughty, proud.

; or יַהְצָה; or (feminine) יַהְצָה; from an unused root meaning to stamp; perhaps threshing-floor; Jahats or Jahtsah, a place East of the Jordan: - Jahaz, Jahazah, Jahzah.
; from h3068 (יְהֹוָה) and h0001 (אָב); Jehovah-fathered; Joab, the name of three Israelites: - Joab.

; probably from h3068 (יְהֹוָה) and a variation of h2421 (חָיָה); Jehovah-revived; Jocha, the name of two Israelites: - Joha.
; a form of h3076 (יְהוֹחָנָן); Jochanan, the name of nine Israelites: - Johanan.
; a form of h3077 (יְהוֹיָדָע); Jojada, the name of two Israelites: - Jehoiada, Joiada.
; a form of h3078 (יְהוֹיָכִין); Jojakin, an Israelite king: - Jehoiachin.
; a form of h3079 (יְהוֹיָקִים); Jojakim, an Israelite: - Joiakim. Compare h3137 (יוֹקִים).
; a form of h3080 (יְהוֹיָרִיב); Jojarib, the name of four Israelites: - Joiarib.
; from h3068 (יְהֹוָה) contracted and h3513 (כָּבַד); Jehovah-gloried; Jokebed, the mother of Moses: - Jochebed.
; a form of h3081 (יְהוּכַל); Jukal, an Israelite: - Jucal.

; from an unused root meaning to be hot; a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb): - age, [phrase] always, [phrase] chronicals, continually(-ance), daily, ((birth-), each, to) day, (now a, two) days (agone), [phrase] elder, [idiom] end, [phrase] evening, [phrase] (for) ever(-lasting, -more), [idiom] full, life, as (so) long as (... live), (even) now, [phrase] old, [phrase] outlived, [phrase] perpetually, presently, [phrase] remaineth, [idiom] required, season, [idiom] since, space, then, (process of) time, [phrase] as at other times, [phrase] in trouble, weather, (as) when, (a, the, within a) while (that), [idiom] whole ([phrase] age), (full) year(-ly), [phrase] younger.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h3117 (יוֹם); a day: - day (by day), time.
; from h3117 (יוֹם); daily: - daily, (by, in the) day(-time).

; probably from the same as h3196 (יַיִן); effervescing (i.e. hot and active); Javan, the name of a son of Joktan, and of the race (Ionians, i.e. Greeks) descended from him, with their territory; also of a place in Arabia: - Javan.
; from the same as h3196 (יַיִן); properly, dregs (as effervescing); hence, mud: - mire, miry.
; a form of h3082 (יְהוֹנָדָב); Jonadab, the name of an Israelite and of a Rechabite: - Jonadab.
; probably from the same as h3196 (יַיִן); a dove (apparently from the warmth of their mating): - dove, pigeon.
; the same as h3123 (יוֹנָה); Jonah, an Israelite: - Jonah.
; patronymically from h3121 (יָוֵן); a Jevanite, or descendant of Javan: - Grecian.
; active participle of h3243 (יָנַק); a sucker; hence, a twig (of a tree felled and sprouting): - tender plant.
; feminine of h3126 (יוֹנֵק); a sprout: - (tender) branch, young twig.

keynum.phon: yôwnath ʼêlem rᵉchôqîym, yo-nath' ay'-lem rekh-o-keem'
keynum.meaning: ; from h3123 (יוֹנָה) and h0482 (אֵלֶם) and the plural of h7350 (רָחוֹק); dove of (the) silence (i.e. dumb Israel) of (i.e. among) distances (i.e. strangers); the title of a ditty (used for a name of its melody): - Jonath-elem-rechokim.
; a form of h3083 (יְהוֹנָתָן); Jonathan, the name of ten Israelites: - Jonathan.
; future of h3254 (יָסַף); let him add (or perhaps simply active participle adding); Joseph, the name of seven Israelites: - Joseph. Compare h3084 (יְהוֹסֵף).
; from active participle of h3254 (יָסַף) and h3050 (יָהּ); Jah (is) adding; Josiphjah, an Israelite: - Josiphiah.
; perhaps feminine active participle of h3276 (יַעַל); furthermore; Joelah, an Israelite: - Joelah.
; apparently the active participle of h3259 (יָעַד); appointer; Joed, an Israelite: - Joed.
; from h3068 (יְהֹוָה) and h5828 (עֵזֶר); Jehovah (is his) help; Joezer, an Israelite: - Joezer.
; from h3068 (יְהֹוָה) and h5789 (עוּשׁ); Jehovahhastened; Joash, the name of two Israelites: - Joash.
; a form of h3087 (יְהוֹצָדָק); Jotsadak, an Israelite: - Jozadak.
; a form of h3113 (יוֹיָקִים); Jokim, an Israelite: - Jokim.
; active participle of h3384 (יָרָה); sprinkling; hence, a sprinkling (or autumnal showers): - first rain, former (rain).
; from h3384 (יָרָה); rainy; Jorah, an Israelite: - Jorah.
; from h3384 (יָרָה); rainy; Jorai, an Israelite: - Jorai.
; a form of h3088 (יְהוֹרָם); Joram, the name of three Israelites and one Syrian: - Joram.
; from h7725 (שׁוּב) and h2617 (חֵסֵד); kindness will be returned; Jushab-Chesed, an Israelite: - Jushab-hesed.
; from h3427 (יָשַׁב) and h3050 (יָהּ); Jehovah will cause to dwell; Josibjah, an Israelite: - Josibiah.
; probably a form of h3145 (יוֹשַׁוְיָה); Joshah, an Israelite: - Joshah.
; from h3068 (יְהֹוָה) and h7737 (שָׁוָה); Jehovah-set; Joshavjah, an Israelite: - Joshaviah. Compare h3144 (יוֹשָׁה).
; a form of h3092 (יְהוֹשָׁפָט); Joshaphat, an Israelite: - Joshaphat.
; from h3068 (יְהֹוָה) and h8535 (תָּם); Jehovah (is) perfect; Jotham, the name of three Israelites: - Jotham.
; active participle of h3498 (יָתַר); properly, redundant; hence, over and above, as adjective, noun, adverb or conjunction: - better, more(-over), over, profit.
; from an unused root (meaning to sprinkle) and h0410 (אֵל); sprinkled of God; Jezavel, an Israelite: - Jeziel (from the margin).
; from the same as the first part of h3149 (יְזַוְאֵל) and h3050 (יָהּ); sprinkled of Jah; Jizzijah, an Israelite: - Jeziah.
; from the same as h2123 (זִיז); he will make prominent; Jaziz, an Israelite: - Jaziz.
; perhaps from an unused root (meaning to draw up); he will draw out; Jizliah, an Israelite: - Jezliah.
; or יְזַנְיָהוּ; probably for h2970 (יַאֲזַנְיָה); Jezanjah, an Israelite: - Jezaniah.
; from an unused root mean to ooze; sweat, i.e. (by implication) a sweating dress: - any thing that causeth sweat.
; a variation for h0250 (אֶזְרָחִי); a Jizrach (i.e. Ezrachite or Zarchite) or descendant of Zerach: - Izrahite.
; from h2224 (זָרַח) and h3050 (יָהּ); Jah will shine; Jizrachjah, the name of two Israelites: - Izrahiah, Jezrahiah.
; from h2232 (זָרַע) and h0410 (אֵל); God will sow; Jizreel, the name of two places in Palestine and of two Israelites: - Jezreel.
; patronymically from h3157 (יִזְרְעֵאל); a Jizreelite or native of Jizreel: - Jezreelite.
; feminine of h3158 (יִזְרְעֵאלִי); a Jezreelitess: - Jezreelitess.
; from h2247 (חָבָה); hidden; Jechubbah, an Israelite: - Jehubbah.
; a primitive root; to be (or become) one: - join, unite.
; from h3161 (יָחַד); properly, a unit, i.e. (adverb) unitedly: - alike, at all (once), both, likewise, only, (al-) together, withal.
; from h3162 (יַחַד) with pronominal suffix; his unity, i.e. (adverb) together; Jachdo, an Israelite: - Jahdo.
; from h3162 (יַחַד) and h0410 (אֵל); unity of God; Jachdiel, an Israelite: - Jahdiel.
; from h3162 (יַחַד) and h3050 (יָהּ); unity of Jah; Jechdijah, the name of two Israelites: - Jehdeiah.
; from h2372 (חָזָה) and h0410 (אֵל); beheld of God; Jachaziel, the name of five Israelites: - Jahaziel, Jahziel.
; from h2372 (חָזָה) and h3050 (יָהּ); Jah will behold; Jachzejah, an Israelite: - Jahaziah.
; from h2388 (חָזַק) and h0410 (אֵל); God will strengthen; Jechezkel, the name of two Israelites: - Ezekiel, Jehezekel.
; or יְחִזְקִיָּהוּ; from h3388 (יְרוּשָׁא) and h3050 (יָהּ); strengthened of Jah; Jechizkijah, the name of five Israelites: - Hezekiah, Jehizkiah. Compare h2396 (חִזְקִיָּה).
; from the same as h2386 (חֲזִיר); perhaps protection; Jachzerah, an Israelite: - Jahzerah.
; or (2 Chronicles 29:14) יְחַוְאֵל; from h2421 (חָיָה) and h0410 (אֵל); God will live; Jechiel (or Jechavel), the name of eight Israelites: - Jehiel.
; patronymically from h3171 (יְחִיאֵל); a Jechielite or descendant of Jechiel: - Jehieli.
; from h3161 (יָחַד); properly, united, i.e. sole; by implication, beloved; also lonely; (feminine) the life (as not to be replaced): - darling, desolate, only (child, son), solitary.
; from h2421 (חָיָה) and h3050 (יָהּ); Jah will live; Jechijah, an Israelite: - Jehiah.
; from h3176 (יָחַל); expectant: - should hope.
; a primitive root; to wait; by implication, to be patient, hope: - (cause to, have, make to) hope, be pained, stay, tarry, trust, wait.
; from h3176 (יָחַל) and h0410 (אֵל); expectant of God; Jachleel, an Israelite: - Jahleel.
; patronymically from h3177 (יַחְלְאֵל); a Jachleelite or descendant of Jachleel: - Jahleelites.
; a primitive root; probably to be hot; figuratively, to conceive: - get heat, be hot, conceive, be warm.
; from h2560 (חָמַר); a kind of deer: - fallow deer.
; probably from h3179 (יָחַם); hot; Jachmai, an Israelite: - Jahmai.
; from an unused root meaning to take off the shoes; unsandalled: - barefoot, being unshod.
; from h2673 (חָצָה)lemma חָעָה ayin, corrected to חָצָה and h0410 (אֵל); God will allot; Jachtseel, an Israelite: - Jahzeel. Compare h3185 (יַחְצִיאֵל).
; patronymically from h3183 (יַחְצְאֵל); a Jachtseelite (collectively) or descendants of Jachtseel: - Jahzeelites.
; from h2673 (חָצָה)lemma חָעָה ayin, corrected to חָצָה and h0410 (אֵל); allotted of God; Jachtsiel, an Israelite: - Jahziel. Compare h3183 (יַחְצְאֵל).
; a primitive root; to delay: - tarry longer.
; a primitive root; to sprout; used only as denominative from h3188 (יַחַשׂ); to enroll by pedigree: - (number after, number throughout the) genealogy (to be reckoned), be reckoned by genealogies.
; from h3187 (יָחַשׂ); a pedigree or family list (as growing spontaneously): - genealogy.
; from h3161 (יָחַד); unity; Jachath, the name of four Israelites: - Jahath.

; a primitive root; to be (causative) make well, literally (sound, beautiful) or figuratively (happy, successful, right): - be accepted, amend, use aright, benefit, be (make) better, seem best, make cheerful, be comely, [phrase] be content, diligent(-ly), dress, earnestly, find favour, give, be glad, do (be, make) good(-ness), be (make) merry, please ([phrase] well), shew more (kindness), skilfully, [idiom] very small, surely, make sweet, thoroughly, tire, trim, very, be (can, deal, entreat, go, have) well (said, seen).
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h3190 (יָטַב) {to be (causative) make well, literally (sound, beautiful) or figuratively (happy, successful, right)}: - seem good.
; from h3190 (יָטַב); pleasantness; Jotbah, a place in Palestine: - Jotbah.
; from h3192 (יׇטְבָה); Jotbathah, a place in the Desert: - Jotbath, Jotbathah.
; or יוּטָה; from h5186 (נָטָה); extended; Juttah (or Jutah), a place in Palestine: - Juttah.
; probably from the same as h2905 (טוּר); encircled (i.e. inclosed); Jetur, a son of Ishmael: - Jetur.
; from an unused root meaning to effervesce; wine (as fermented); by implication, intoxication: - banqueting, wine, wine(-bibber).
; by erroneous transcription for h3027 (יָד); a hand or side: - (way-) side.

; a primitive root; to be right (i.e. correct); reciprocal, to argue; causatively, to decide, justify or convict: - appoint, argue, chasten, convince, correct(-ion), daysman, dispute, judge, maintain, plead, reason (together), rebuke, reprove(-r), surely, in any wise.
; from h3559 (כּוּן); he (or it) will establish; Jakin, the name of three Israelites and of a temple pillar: - Jachin.
; patronymically from h3199 (יָכִין)lemma יִכִין first vowel, corrected to יָכִין; a Jakinite (collectively) or descendants of Jakin: - Jachinites.

; or (fuller) יָכוֹל; a primitive root; to be able, literally (can, could) or morally (may, might): - be able, any at all (ways), attain, can (away with, (-not)), could, endure, might, overcome, have power, prevail, still, suffer.
; (Aramaic) or יְכִיל; (Aramaic), to h3201 (יָכֹל) {to be able, literally (can, could) or morally (may, might)}: - be able, can, couldest, prevail.
; and יְכׇלְיָהוּ; or (2 Chronicles 26:3) יְכִילְיָה; from h3201 (יָכֹל) and h3050 (יָהּ); Jah will enable; Jekoljah or Jekiljah, an Israelitess: - Jecholiah, Jecoliah.
; and יְכׇנְיָהוּ; or (Jeremiah 27:20) יְכוֹנְיָה; from h3559 (כּוּן) and h3050 (יָהּ); Jah will establish; Jekonjah, a Jewish king: - Jeconiah. Compare h3659 (כׇּנְיָהוּ).

; a primitive root; to bear young; causatively, to beget; medically, to act as midwife; specifically, to show lineage: - bear, beget, birth(-day), born, (make to) bring forth (children, young), bring up, calve, child, come, be delivered (of a child), time of delivery, gender, hatch, labour, (do the office of a) midwife, declare pedigrees, be the son of, (woman in, woman that) travail(-eth, -ing woman).
; from h3205 (יָלַד); something born, i.e. a lad or offspring: - boy, child, fruit, son, young man (one).
; feminine of h3206 (יֶלֶד); a lass: - damsel, girl.
; abstractly from h3206 (יֶלֶד); boyhood (or girlhood): - childhood, youth.
; passive from h3205 (יָלַד); born: - born.
; from h3885 (לוּן); lodging; Jalon, an Israelite: - Jalon.
; from h3205 (יָלַד); born: - (home-) born, child, son.

; a primitive root (compare h1980 (הָלַךְ)); to walk (literally or figuratively); causatively, to carry (in various senses): - [idiom] again, away, bear, bring, carry (away), come (away), depart, flow, [phrase] follow(-ing), get (away, hence, him), (cause to, made) go (away, -ing, -ne, one's way, out), grow, lead (forth), let down, march, prosper, [phrase] pursue, cause to run, spread, take away (-journey), vanish, (cause to) walk(-ing), wax, [idiom] be weak.
; a primitive root; to howl (with a wailing tone) or yell (with a boisterous one): - (make to) howl, be howling.
; from h3213 (יָלַל); a howl: - howling.
; feminine of h3214 (יְלֵל) {a howl}: - a howling.
; a primitive root; to blurt or utter inconsiderately: - devour.
; from an unused root apparently meaning to stick or scrape; scurf or tetter: - scabbed.
; from an unused root meaning to lick up; a devourer; specifically, the young locust: - cankerworm, caterpillar.
; from h3950 (לָקַט); a travelling pouch (as if for gleanings): - scrip.

; from an unused root meaning to roar; a sea (as breaking in noisy surf) or large body of water; specifically (with the article), the Mediterranean Sea; sometimes a large river, or an artifical basin; locally, the west, or (rarely) the south: - sea ([idiom] -faring man, (-shore)), south, west (-ern, side, -ward).

; (Aramaic) corresponding to h3220 (יָם) {a sea (as breaking in noisy surf) or large body of water; specifically (with the article), the Mediterranean Sea; sometimes a large river, or an artifical basin; locally, the west, or (rarely) the south}: - sea.
; from the same as h3117 (יוֹם); a warm spring: - mule.
; from h3117 (יוֹם) and h0410 (אֵל); day of God; Jemuel, an Israelite: - Jemuel.
; perhaps from the same as h3117 (יוֹם); properly, warm, i.e. affectionate; hence, dove (compare h3123 (יוֹנָה)); Jemimah, one of Job's daughters: - Jemimah.
; from h3231 (יָמַן); the right hand or side (leg, eye) of a person or other object (as the stronger and more dexterous); locally, the south: - [phrase] left-handed, right (hand, side), south.
; the same as h3225 (יָמִין); Jamin, the name of three Israelites: - Jamin. See also h1144 (בִּנְיָמִין).
; for h3225 (יָמִין); right: - (on the) right (hand).
; patronymically from h3226 (יָמִין); a Jeminite (collectively) or descendants of Jamin: - Jaminites. See also h1145 (בֶּן־יְמִינִי).
; or יִמְלָה; from h4390 (מָלֵא); full; Jimla or Jimlah, an Israelite: - Imla, Imlah.
; from h4427 (מָלַךְ); he will make king; Jamlek, an Israelite: - Jamlech.

; a primitive root; to be (physically) right (i.e. firm); but used only as denominative from h3225 (יָמִין) and transitive, to be right-handed or take the right-hand side: - go (turn) to (on, use) the right hand.
; from h3231 (יָמַן); prosperity (as betokened by the right hand); Jimnah, the name of two Israelites; also (with the article) of the posterity of one of them: - Imna, Imnah, Jimnah, Jimnites.
; from h3231 (יָמַן); right (i.e. at the right hand): - (on the) right (hand).
; from h4513 (מָנַע); he will restrain; Jimna, an Israelite: - Imna.
; a primitive root; to exchange; by implication, to change places: - boast selves, change.
; probably from h3235 (יָמַר); interchange; Jimrah, an Israelite: - Imrah.
; a primitive root; to touch: - feel.
; a primitive root; to rage or be violent; by implication, to suppress, to maltreat: - destroy, (thrust out by) oppress(-ing, -ion, -or), proud, vex, do violence.

keynum.phon: Yânôwach, yaw-no'-akh or (with enclitic) Yanowchah yaw-no'-khaw
keynum.meaning: ; from h3240 (יָנַח); quiet; Janoach or Janochah, a place in Palestine: - Janoah, Janohah.

; a primitive root; to deposit; by implication, to allow to stay: - bestow, cast down, lay (down, up), leave (off), let alone (remain), pacify, place, put, set (down), suffer, withdraw, withhold. (The Hiphil forms with the dagesh are here referred to, in accordance with the older grammarians; but if any distinction of the kind is to be made, these should rather be referred to h5117 (נוּחַ), and the others here.)
; from h5123 (נוּם); asleep; Janim, a place in Palestine: - Janum (from the margin).
; from h3243 (יָנַק); a sucker or sapling: - young twig.
; a primitive root; to suck; causatively, to give milk: - milch, nurse(-ing mother), (give, make to) suck(-ing child, -ling).

; or יַנְשׁוֹף; apparently from h5398 (נָשַׁף); (compare h5399 (נֶשֶׁף)) an unclean (acquatic) bird; probably the heron (perhaps from its blowing cry, or because the nightheron is meant )): - (great) owl.s

; a primitive root; to set (literally or figuratively); intensively, to found; reflexively, to sit down together, i.e. settle, consult: - appoint, take counsel, establish, (lay the, lay for a) found(-ation), instruct, lay, ordain, set, [idiom] sure.
; from h3245 (יָסַד); a foundation (figuratively, i.e. beginning): - [idiom] began.
; from h3245 (יָסַד); a foundation (literally or figuratively): - bottom, foundation, repairing
; feminine of h3246 (יְסֻד); a foundation: - foundation.
; from h5493 (סוּר); departing: - they that depart
; from h3256 (יָסַר); a reprover: - instruct.
; a primitive root; to pour (intransitive): - be poured.
; from an unused root meaning to watch; observant; Jiskah, sister of Lot: - Iscah.
; from h5564 (סָמַךְ) and h3050 (יָהּ); Jah will sustain; Jismakjah, an Israelite: - Ismachiah.

; a primitive root; to add or augment (often adverbial, to continue to do a thing): - add, [idiom] again, [idiom] any more, [idiom] cease, [idiom] come more, [phrase] conceive again, continue, exceed, [idiom] further, [idiom] gather together, get more, give more-over, [idiom] henceforth, increase (more and more), join, [idiom] longer (bring, do, make, much, put), [idiom] (the, much, yet) more (and more), proceed (further), prolong, put, be (strong-) er, [idiom] yet, yield.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h3254 (יָסַף) {to add or augment (often adverbial, to continue to do a thing)}: - add.
; a primitive root; to chastise, literally (with blows) or figuratively (with words); hence, to instruct: - bind, chasten, chastise, correct, instruct, punish, reform, reprove, sore, teach.
; from h3261 (יָעָה); a shovel: - shovel.
; from an unused root probably meaning to grieve; sorrowful; Jabets, the name of an Israelite, and also of a place in Palestine: - Jabez.

; a primitive root; to fix upon (by agreement or appointment); by implication, to meet (at a stated time), to summon (to trial), to direct (in a certain quarter or position), to engage (for marriage): - agree,(maxke an) appoint(-ment, a time), assemble (selves), betroth, gather (selves, together), meet (together), set (a time).
; from h3259 (יָעַד); appointed; Jedi, an Israelite: - Iddo (from the margin) See h3035 (יִדּוֹ).
; a primitive root; apparently to brush aside: - sweep away.
; from h3261 (יָעָה) and h0410 (אֵל); carried away of God; Jeuel, the name of four Israelites: - Jehiel, Jeiel, Jeuel. Compare h3273 (יְעִיאֵל).
; from h5779 (עוּץ); counsellor; Jeuts, an Israelite: - Jeuz
; a variation of h3298 (יַעֲרֶשְׁיָה); a forest: - wood.
; apparently the passive participle of the same as h3293 (יַעַר); wooded; Jaur, an Israelite: - Jair(from the margin).
; from h5789 (עוּשׁ); hasty; Jeush, the name of an Edomite and of four Israelites: - Jehush, Jeush. Compare h3274 (יְעִישׁ).
; a primitive root; to be bold or obstinate: - fierce.
; from h3267 (יָעַז) and h0410 (אֵל); emboldened of God; Jaaziel, an Israelite: - Jaaziel.
; from h3267 (יָעַז) and h3050 (יָהּ); emboldened of Jah; Jaazijah, an Israelite: - Jaaziah.
; or יַעְזֵר; from h5826 (עָזַר); helpful; Jaazer or Jazer, a place East of the Jordan: - Jaazer, Jazer.
; a primitive root; to clothe: - cover.

; from h5789 (עוּשׁ); hasty; Jeish, the name of an Edomite and of a an Israelite: - Jeush (from the margin). Compare h3266 (יְעוּשׁ).

; a primitive root; properly, to ascend; figuratively, to be valuable (objectively; useful, subjectively; benefited): - [idiom] at all, set forward, can do good, (be, have) profit, (able).

; feminine of h3277 (יָעֵל) {an ibex (as climbing)}: - roe.

; from an unused root meaning to pay attention; properly, heed; by implication, purpose (sake or account); used adverbially to indicate the reason or cause: - because (that), forasmuch ([phrase] as), seeing then, [phrase] that, [phrase] wheras, [phrase] why.
; from the same as h3282 (יַעַן); the ostrich (probably from its answering cry: - ostrich.

; from the same as h3283 (יָעֵן); responsive; Jaanai, an Israelite: - Jaanai.
; a primitive root; to tire (as if from wearisome flight): - faint, cause to fly, (be) weary (self).
; from h3286 (יָעַף); fatigued; figuratively, exhausted: - faint, weary.
; from h3286 (יָעַף); fatigue (adverb, utterly exhausted): - swiftly.e
; a primitive root; to advise; reflexively, to deliberate or resolve: - advertise, take advise, advise (well), consult, (give, take) counsel(-lor), determine, devise, guide, purpose.
; from h6117 (עָקַב); heel-catcher (i.e. supplanter); Jaakob, the Israelitish patriarch: - Jacob.

; from the same as h6130 (עָקָן); Jaakan, an Idumaean: - Jaakan. Compare h1142 (בְּנֵי יַעֲקָן).
; from an unused root probably meaning to thicken with verdure; a copse of bushes; hence, a forest; hence, honey in the comb (as hived in trees): - (honey-) comb, forest, wood.

; feminine of h3293 (יַעַר), and meaning the same {a copse of bushes; hence, a forest; hence, honey in the comb (as hived in trees)}: - (honey-) comb, forest.
; from the plural of h3293 (יַעַר) and the masculine plural active participle of h0707 (אָרַג); woods of weavers; Jaare-Oregim, an Israelite: - Jaare-oregim.
; plural of h3293 (יַעַר); forests; Jearim, a place in Palestine: - Jearim. Compare h7157 (קִרְיַת יְעָרִים).
; from an unused root of uncertain signification and h3050 (יָהּ); Jaareshjah, an Israelite: - Jaresiah.
; from h6213 (עָשָׂה); they will do; Jaasu, an Israelite: - Jaasau.
; from h6213 (עָשָׂה) and h0410 (אֵל); made of God; Jaasiel, an Israelite: - Jaasiel, Jasiel.
; from h6299 (פָּדָה) and h3050 (יָהּ); Jah will liberate; Jiphdejah, an Israelite: - Iphedeiah.
; a primitive root; properly, to be bright, i.e. (by implication) beautiful: - be beautiful, be (make self) fair(-r), deck.
; from h3302 (יָפָה); beautiful (literally or figuratively): - [phrase] beautiful, beauty, comely, fair(-est, one), [phrase] goodly, pleasant, well.
; from h3302 (יָפָה) by reduplication; very beautiful: - very fair.
; or יָפוֹא; (Ezra 3:7), from h3302 (יָפָה); beautiful; Japho, a place in Palestine: - Japha, Joppa.
; a primitive root; properly, to breathe hard, i.e. (by implication) to sigh: - bewail self.
; from h3306 (יָפַח); properly, puffing, i.e. (figuratively) meditating: - such as breathe out.
; from h3302 (יָפָה); beauty: - beauty.
; from h3313 (יָפַע); bright; Japhia, the name of a Canaanite, an Israelite, and a place in Palestine: - Japhia.
; from h6403 (פָּלַט); he will deliver; Japhlet, an Israelite: - Japhlet.
; patronymically from h3310 (יַפְלֵט); a Japhletite or descendant of Japhlet: - Japhleti.
; from h6437 (פָּנָה); he will be prepared; Jephunneh, the name of two Israelites: - Jephunneh.
; a primitive root; to shine: - be light, shew self, (cause to) shine (forth).
; from h3313 (יָפַע); splendor or (figuratively) beauty: - brightness.
; from h6601 (פָּתָה); expansion; Jepheth, a son of Noah; also his posterity: - Japheth.
; from h6605 (פָּתַח); he will open; Jiphtach, an Israelite; also a place in Palestine: - Jephthah, Jiphtah.
; from h6605 (פָּתַח) and h0410 (אֵל); God will open; Jiphtach-el, a place in Palestine: - Jiphthah-el.

; a primitive root; to go (causatively, bring) out, in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively, direct and proxim.: - [idiom] after, appear, [idiom] assuredly, bear out, [idiom] begotten, break out, bring forth (out, up), carry out, come (abroad, out, thereat, without), [phrase] be condemned, depart(-ing, -ure), draw forth, in the end, escape, exact, fail, fall (out), fetch forth (out), get away (forth, hence, out), (able to, cause to, let) go abroad (forth, on, out), going out, grow, have forth (out), issue out, lay (lie) out, lead out, pluck out, proceed, pull out, put away, be risen, [idiom] scarce, send with commandment, shoot forth, spread, spring out, stand out, [idiom] still, [idiom] surely, take forth (out), at any time, [idiom] to (and fro), utter.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h3318 (יָצָא) {to go (causatively, bring) out, in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively, direct and proxim.}: - finish.

; a primitive root; to place (any thing so as to stay); reflexively, to station, offer, continue: - present selves, remaining, resort, set (selves), (be able to, can, with-) stand (fast, forth, -ing, still, up).
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h3320 (יָצַב); to be firm; hence, to speak surely: - truth.
; a primitive root; to place permanently: - establish, leave, make, present, put, set, stay.
; from h6671 (צָהַר); oil (as producing light); figuratively, anointing: - [phrase] anointed oil.

; passive participle of h3331 (יַצַע); spread, i.e. a bed; (architecture) an extension, i.e. wing or lean-to (a single story or collectively): - bed, chamber, couch.
; from h6711 (צָחַק); laughter (i.e. mochery); Jitschak (or Isaac), son of Abraham: - Isaac. Compare h3446 (יִשְׂחָק).

; (Aramaic) from h3321 (יְצַב)lemma יְצב missing vowel, corrected to יְצַבxlit yᵉtsêb corrected to yᵉtsab; fixed, sure; concretely, certainty: - certain(-ty), true, truth.
; a primitive root; to strew as a surface: - make (one's) bed, [idiom] lie, spread.

; a primitive root; properly, to pour out (transitive or intransitive); by implication, to melt or cast as metal; by extension, to place firmly, to stiffen or grow hard: - cast, cleave fast, be (as) firm, grow, be hard, lay out, molten, overflow, pour (out), run out, set down, stedfast.
; passive participle feminine of h3332 (יָצַק); poured out, i.e. run into amould: - when it was cast.
; a primitive root; to press (intransitive), i.e. be narrow; figuratively, be in distress: - be distressed, be narrow, be straitened (in straits), be vexed.

; probably identical with h3334 (יָצַר) (through the squeezing into shape); (compare h3331 (יַצַע)); to mould into a form; especially as apotter; figuratively, to determine (i.e. form a resolution): - [idiom] earthen, fashion, form, frame, make(-r), potter, purpose.
; from h3335 (יָצַר); a form; figuratively, conception (i.e. purpose): - frame, thing framed, imagination, mind, work.

; passive participle of h3335 (יָצַר); structure, i.e. limb or part: - member.ql
; from h3335 (יָצַר); formative; Jitsri, an Israelite: - Isri.
; ; patronymically from h3337 (יֵצֶר); a Jitsrite (collectively) or descendants of Jetser: - Jezerites.
; a primitive root; to burn or set on fire; figuratively, to desolate: - burn (up), be desolate, set (on) fire (fire), kindle.

; from an unused root meaning to excavate; a trough (as dug out); specifically, a wine-vat (whether the lower one, into which the juice drains; or the upper, in which the grapes are crushed): - fats, presses, press-fat, wine(-press).
; from h6908 (קָבַץ) and h0410 (אֵל); God will gather; Jekabtseel, a place in Palestine: - Jekabzeel. Compare h6909 (קַבְצְאֵל).
; a primitive root; to burn: - (be) burn(-ing), [idiom] from the hearth, kindle.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h3344 (יָקַד) {to burn}: - burning.
; (Aramaic) from h3345 (יְקַד); a conflagration: - burning.
; from h3344 (יָקַד) and h5971 (עַם); burning of (the) people; Jokdeam, a place in Palestine: - Jokdeam.
; from an unused root probably meaning to obey; obedient; Jakeh, a symbolical name (for Solomon): - Jakeh.
; from the same as h3348 (יָקֶה); obedience: - gathering, to obey.
; from h3344 (יָקַד); a burning: - burning.
; from h6965 (קוּם); properly, standing (extant), i.e. by implication, a living thing: - (living) substance.
; from h3369 (יָקֹשׁ); properly, entangling; hence, a snarer: - fowler.
; passive participle of h3369 (יָקֹשׁ); properly, entangled, i.e. by implication (intransitively) a snare, or (transitive) a snarer: - fowler, snare.
; from the same as h3348 (יָקֶה) and h0410 (אֵל); obedience of God; Jekuthiel, an Israelite: - Jekuthiel.
; from h6994 (קָטֹן); he will be made little; Joktan, an Arabian patriarch: - Joktan.
; from h6965 (קוּם); he will raise; Jakim, the name of two Israelites: - Jakim. Compare h3079 (יְהוֹיָקִים).
; from h3365 (יָקַר); precious: - dear.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h3357 (יַקִּיר) {precious}: - noble, rare.
; from h6965 (קוּם) and h3050 (יָהּ); Jah will rise; Jekamjah, the name of two Israelites: - Jekamiah. Compare h3079 (יְהוֹיָקִים).
; from h6965 (קוּם) and h5971 (עַם); (the) people will rise; Jekamam, an Israelite: - Jekameam. Compare h3079 (יְהוֹיָקִים), h3361 (יׇקְמְעָם).
; from h6965 (קוּם) and h5971 (עַם); (the) people will be raised; Jokmeam, a place in Palestine: - Jokmeam. Compare h3360 (יְקַמְעָם), h3362 (יׇקְנְעָם).
; from h6969 (קוּן) and h5971 (עַם); (the) people will be lamented; Jokneam, a place in Palestine: - Jokneam.

; a primitive root; properly, to sever oneself, i.e. (by implication) to be dislocated; figuratively, to abandon; causatively, to impale (and thus allow to drop to pieces by rotting): - be alienated, depart, hang (up), be out of joint.
; a primitive root; to awake (intransitive): - (be) awake(-d).
; a primitive root; properly, apparently, to be heavy, i.e. (figuratively) valuable; causatively, to make rare (figuratively, to inhibit): - be (make) precious, be prized, be set by, withdraw.

; from h3365 (יָקַר); valuable (objectively or subjectively): - brightness, clear, costly, excellent, fat, honourable women, precious, reputation.

; a primitive root; to fear; morally, to revere; caus. to frighten: - affright, be (make) afraid, dread(-ful), (put in) fear(-ful, -fully, -ing), (be had in) reverence(-end), [idiom] see, terrible (act, -ness, thing).
