; from h7378 (רִיב) and h1322 (בֹּשֶׁת); shame (i.e. the idol) will contend; Jerubbesheth, a symbolic name for Gideon: - Jerubbesheth.

; a primitive root; to descend (literally, to go downwards; or conventionally to a lower region, as the shore, a boundary, the enemy, etc.; or figuratively, to fall); causatively, to bring down (in all the above applications): - [idiom] abundantly, bring down, carry down, cast down, (cause to) come(-ing) down, fall (down), get down, go(-ing) down(-ward), hang down, [idiom] indeed, let down, light (down), put down (off), (cause to, let) run down, sink, subdue, take down.

; or (2 Chronicles 26:15) יָרָא; a primitive root; properly, to flow as water (i.e. to rain); transitively, to lay or throw (especially an arrow, i.e. to shoot); figuratively, to point out (as if by aiming the finger), to teach: - ([phrase]) archer, cast, direct, inform, instruct, lay, shew, shoot, teach(-er,-ing), through.
; from h3384 (יָרָה) and h0410 (אֵל); founded of God; Jeruel, a place in Palestine: - Jeruel.
; perhaps denominative from h3394 (יָרֵחַ); (born at the) new moon; Jaroach, an Israelite: - Jaroah.
; from h3417 (יָרָק); green, i.e. an herb: - green thing.
; or יְרוּשָׁה feminine passive participle of h3423 (יָרַשׁ); possessed; Jerusha or Jerushah, as Israelitess: - Jerusha, Jerushah.

; rarely יְרוּשָׁלַיִם; a dual (in allusion to its two main hills (the true pointing, at least of the former reading, seems to be that of h3390 (יְרוּשָׁלֵם))); probably from (the passive participle of) h3384 (יָרָה) and h7999 (שָׁלַם); founded peaceful; Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine: - Jerusalem.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h3389 (יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם) {Jerusalem}: - {Jerusalem}
; from a unused root of uncertain signification; a lunation, i.e. month: - month, moon.
; the same as h3391 (יֶרַח); Jerach, an Arabian patriarch: - Jerah.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h3391 (יֶרַח); a month: - month.
; from the same as h3391 (יֶרַח); the moon: - moon. Yrechow. See h3405 (יְרִיחוֹ).
; from h7355 (רָחַם); compassionate; Jerocham, the name of seven or eight Israelites: - Jeroham.
; from h7355 (רָחַם) and h0410 (אֵל); God will compassionate; Jerachmeel, the name of three Israelites: - Jerahmeel.
; patronymically from h3396 (יְרַחְמְאֵל); a Jerachmeelite or descendant of Jerachmeel: - Jerahmeelites.
; probably of Egyptian origin; Jarcha, an Egyptian: - Jarha.
; a primitive root; to precipitate or hurl (rush) headlong; (intransitively) to be rash: - be perverse, turn over.
; from h3384 (יָרָה) and h0410 (אֵל); thrown of God; Jeriel, an Israelite: - Jeriel. Compare h3385 (יְרוּאֵל).
; from h7378 (רִיב); literally he will contend; properly, adjective, contentious; used as noun, an adversary: - that content(-eth), that strive.
; the same as h3401 (יָרִיב); Jarib, the name of three Israelites: - Jarib.
; from h3401 (יָרִיב); contentious; Jeribai, an Israelite: - Jeribai.
; or יְרִיָּהוּ; from h3384 (יָרָה) and h3050 (יָהּ); Jah will throw; Jerijah, an Israelite: - Jeriah, Jerijah.
; or יְרֵחוֹ; or variation (1 Kings 16:34) יְרִיחֹה; perhaps from h3394 (יָרֵחַ); its month; or else from h7306 (רוּחַ); fragrant; Jericho or Jerecho, a place in Palestine: - Jericho.
; or יְרֵימוֹת; or יְרֵמוֹת; feminine plural from h7311 (רוּם); elevations; Jerimoth or Jeremoth, the name of twelve Israelites: - Jermoth, Jerimoth, and Ramoth (from the margin).
; from h3415 (יָרַע); a hanging (as tremulous): - curtain.
; plural of h3407 (יְרִיעָה); curtains; Jerioth, an Israelitess: - Jerioth.
; from an unused root meaning to be soft; the thigh (from its fleshy softness); by euphemistically the generative parts; figuratively, a shank, flank, side: - [idiom] body, loins, shaft, side, thigh.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h3411 (יְרֵכָה); a thigh: - thigh.
; feminine of h3409 (יָרֵךְ); properly, the flank; but used only figuratively, the rear or recess: - border, coast, part, quarter, side.
; from h7311 (רוּם); elevation; Jarmuth, the name of two places in Palestine: - Jarmuth.
; from h7311 (רוּם); elevated; Jeremai, an Israelite: - Jeremai.
; or יִרְמְיָהוּ; from h7311 (רוּם) and h3050 (יָהּ); Jah will rise; Jirmejah, the name of eight or nine Israelites: - Jeremiah.
; a primitive root; properly, to be broken up (with any violent action) i.e. (figuratively) to fear: - be grevious (only Isaiah 15:4; the rest belong to h7489 (רָעַע)).
; from h7495 (רָפָא) and h0410 (אֵל); God will heal; Jirpeel, a place in Palestine: - Irpeel.
; a primitive root; to spit: - [idiom] but, spit.

; from h3417 (יָרָק) (in the sense of vacuity of color); properly, pallor, i.e. hence, the yellowish green of young and sickly vegetation; concretely, verdure, i.e. grass or vegetation: - grass, green (thing).
; from the same as h3418 (יֶרֶק); properly, green; concretely, a vegetable: - green, herbs.
; from h3418 (יֶרֶק); paleness, whether of persons (from fright), or of plants (from drought): - greenish, yellow.
; from h7324 (רוּק) and h5971 (עַם); people will be poured forth; Jorkeam, a place in Palestine: - Jorkeam.
; from the same as h3418 (יֶרֶק); yellowishness: - greenish, yellow.

; or יָרֵשׁ; a primitive root; to occupy (by driving out previous tenants, and possessing in their place); by implication, to seize, to rob, to inherit; also to expel, to impoverish, to ruin: - cast out, consume, destroy, disinherit, dispossess, drive(-ing) out, enjoy, expel, [idiom] without fail, (give to, leave for) inherit(-ance, -or) [phrase] magistrate, be (make) poor, come to poverty, (give to, make to) possess, get (have) in (take) possession, seize upon, succeed, [idiom] utterly.
; from h3423 (יָרַשׁ); occupancy: - possession.
; from h3423 (יָרַשׁ); something occupied; a conquest; also a patrimony: - heritage, inheritance, possession.

; perhaps from an unused root meaning to stand out, or exist; entity; used adverbially or as a copula for the substantive verb ( h1961 (הָיָה)); there is or are (or any other form of the verb to be, as may suit the connection): - (there) are, (he, it, shall, there, there may, there shall, there should) be, thou do, had, hast, (which) hath, (I, shalt, that) have, (he, it, there) is, substance, it (there) was, (there) were, ye will, thou wilt, wouldest.

; a primitive root; properly, to sit down (specifically as judge. in ambush, in quiet); by implication, to dwell, to remain; causatively, to settle, to marry: - (make to) abide(-ing), continue, (cause to, make to) dwell(-ing), ease self, endure, establish, [idiom] fail, habitation, haunt, (make to) inhabit(-ant), make to keep (house), lurking, [idiom] marry(-ing), (bring again to) place, remain, return, seat, set(-tle), (down-) sit(-down, still, -ting down, -ting (place) -uate), take, tarry.
; from h3427 (יָשַׁב) and h0001 (אָב); seat of (his) father; Jeshebab, an Israelite: - Jeshebeab.
; from the active participle of h3427 (יָשַׁב) and h7674 (שֶׁבֶת), with a preposition and the article interposed; sitting in the seat; Joshebbash-Shebeth, an Israelite: - that sat in the seat.
; from h3427 (יָשַׁב) and h5011 (נֹב), with a pronominal suffix and a preposition interposed; his dwelling (is) in Nob; Jishbo-be-Nob, a Philistine: - Ishbi-benob (from the margin).
; from h7623 (שָׁבַח); he will praise; Jishbach, an Israelite: - Ishbah.
; patronymically from h3437 (יָשׁוּב); a Jashubite, or descendant of Jashub: - Jashubites.

; from h7725 (שׁוּב) and h3899 (לֶחֶם); returner of bread; Jashubi-Lechem, an Israelite: - Jashubi-lehem. (Prob. the text should be pointed יֹשְׁבֵי לֶחֶם and rendered '(they were) inhabitants of Lechem,' i.e. of Bethlehem (by contraction). Compare h3902 (לַחְמִי)).
; from h7725 (שׁוּב) and h5971 (עַם); people will return; Jashobam, the name of two or three Israelites: - Jashobeam.

; from h3427 (יָשַׁב) and h7186 (קָשֶׁה); a hard seat; Joshbekashah, an Israelite: - Joshbekashah.

; from h7737 (שָׁוָה); he will level; Jishvah, an Israelite: - Ishvah, Isvah.

; feminine passive participle of h3467 (יָשַׁע); something saved, i.e. (abstractly) deliverance; hence, aid, victory, prosperity: - deliverance, health, help(-ing), salvation, save, saving (health), welfare.

; a primitive root; to extend: - hold out.
; by Aramaic אִישַׁי; from the same as h3426 (יֵשׁ); extant; Jishai, David's father: - Jesse.
; or יִשִּׁיָּהוּ; from h5383 (נָשָׁה) and h3050 (יָהּ); Jah will lend; Jishshijah, the name of five Israelites: - Ishiah, Isshiah, Ishijah, Jesiah.
; from h7760 (שׂוּם) and h0410 (אֵל); God will place; Jesimael, an Israelite: - Jesimael.
; from h3456 (יָשַׁם); desolation: - let death seize (from the margin).
; from h3456 (יָשַׁם); a desolation: - desert, Jeshimon, solitary, wilderness.
; from h3486 (יָשֵׁשׁ); an old man: - (very) aged (man), ancient, very old.
; from h3453 (יָשִׁישׁ); aged; Jeshishai, an Israelite: - Jeshishai.
; a primitive root; to place; intransitively, to be placed: - be put (set).
; a primitive root; to lie waste: - be desolate.
; from h3456 (יָשַׁם); desolate; Jishma, an Israelite: - Ishma.
; from h8085 (שָׁמַע) and h0410 (אֵל); God will hear; Jishmael, the name of Abraham's oldest son, and of five Israelites: - Ishmael.
; patronymically from h3458 (יִשְׁמָעֵאל); a Jishmaelite or descendant of Jishmael: - Ishmaelite.
; or יִשְׁמַעְיָהוּlemma יְשְׁמַעְיָהוּ first vowel, corrected to יִשְׁמַעְיָהוּ; from h8085 (שָׁמַע) and h3050 (יָהּ); Jah will hear; Jishmajah, the name of two Israelites: - Ishmaiah.
; from h8104 (שָׁמַר); preservative; Jishmerai, an Israelite: - Ishmerai.
; a primitive root; properly, to be slack or languid, i.e. (by implication) sleep (figuratively, to die); also to grow old, stale or inveterate: - old (store), remain long, (make to) sleep.
; from h3462 (יָשֵׁן); sleepy: - asleep, (one out of) sleep(-eth, -ing), slept.
; the same as h3463 (יָשֵׁן); Jashen, an Israelite: - Jashen.
; from h3462 (יָשֵׁן); old: - old.
; feminine of h3465 (יָשָׁן); Jeshanah, a place in Palestine: - Jeshanah.

; a primitive root; properly, to be open, wide or free, i.e. (by implication) to be safe; causatively, to free or succor: - [idiom] at all, avenging, defend, deliver(-er), help, preserve, rescue, be safe, bring (having) salvation, save(-iour), get victory.
; or יֵשַׁע; from h3467 (יָשַׁע); liberty, deliverance, prosperity: - safety, salvation, saving.
; from h3467 (יָשַׁע); saving; Jishi, the name of four Israelites: - Ishi.
; or יְשַׁעְיָהוּ; from h3467 (יָשַׁע) and h3050 (יָהּ); Jah has saved; Jeshajah, the name of seven Israelites: - Isaiah, Jesaiah, Jeshaiah.
; from an unused root meaning to polish; a gem supposed to be jasper (from the resemblance in name): - jasper.
; perhaps from h8192 (שָׁפָה); he will scratch; Jishpah, an Israelite: - Ispah.
; probably from the same as h8227 (שָׁפָן); he will hide; Jishpan, an Israelite: - Ishpan.

; a primitive root; to be straight or even; figuratively, to be (causatively, to make) right, pleasant, prosperous: - direct, fit, seem good (meet), [phrase] please (will), be (esteem, go) right (on), bring (look, make, take the) straight (way), be upright(-ly).
; from h3474 (יָשַׁר); the right; Jesher, an Israelite: - Jesher.
; from h3474 (יָשַׁר); the right: - equity, meet, right, upright(-ness).
; from h3474 (יָשַׁר); straight (literally or figuratively): - convenient, equity, Jasher, just, meet(-est), [phrase] pleased well right(-eous), straight, (most) upright(-ly, -ness).
; from h8280 (שָׂרָה) and h0410 (אֵל); he will rule as God; Jisrael, a symbolical name of Jacob; also (typically) of his posterity: - Israel.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h3478 (יִשְׂרָאֵל) {Jisrael, a symbolical name of Jacob; also (typically) of his posterity}: - Israel.
; by variation from h3477 (יָשָׁר) and h0410 (אֵל) with directive enclitic; right towards God; Jesarelah, an Israelite: - Jesharelah.
; patronymically from h3478 (יִשְׂרָאֵל); a Jisreelite or descendant of Jisrael: - of Israel, Israelite.
; feminine of h3481 (יִשְׂרְאֵלִי); a Jisreelitess or female descendant of Jisrael: - Israelitish.
; feminine of h3477 (יָשָׁר); rectitude: - uprightness.
; from h3474 (יָשַׁר); upright; Jeshurun, a symbolic name for Israel: - Jeshurun.
; (strictly yis-saws-kawr'); from h5375 (נָשָׂא) and h7939 (שָׂכָר); he will bring a reward; Jissaskar, a son of Jacob: - Issachar.
; from an unused root meaning to blanch; gray-haired, i.e. an aged man: - stoop for age.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h0853 (אֵת); a sign of the object of a verb: - [phrase] whom.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h3427 (יָשַׁב); to sit or dwell: - dwell, (be) set, sit.
; from an unused root meaning to pin through or fast; a peg: - nail, paddle, pin, stake.
; from an unused root meaning to be lonely; a bereaved person: - fatherless (child), orphan.
; passive participle of h3498 (יָתַר); properly, what is left, i.e. (by implication) a gleaning: - range.
; from h3498 (יָתַר); redundant; Jattir, a place in Palestine: - Jattir.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h3492 (יַתִּיר); preeminent; as an adverb, very: - exceeding(-ly), excellent.
; probably from h8518 (תָּלָה); it will hang, i.e. be high; Jithlah, a place in Palestine: - Jethlah.
; from the same as h3490 (יָתוֹם); orphanage; Jithmah, an Israelite: - Ithmah.
; from an unused root meaning to endure, and h0410 (אֵל); continued of God; Jathniel, an Israelite: - Jathniel.
; from the same as h8577 (תַּנִּין); extensive; Jithnan, a place in Palestine: - Ithnan.

; a primitive root; to jut over or exceed; by implication, to excel; (intransitively) to remain or be left; causatively, to leave, cause to abound, preserve: - excel, leave (a remnant), left behind, too much, make plenteous, preserve, (be, let) remain(-der, -ing, -nant), reserve, residue, rest.

; from h3498 (יָתַר); properly, an overhanging, i.e. (by implication) an excess, superiority, remainder; also a small rope (as hanging free): - [phrase] abundant, cord, exceeding, excellancy(-ent), what they leave, that hath left, plentifully, remnant, residue, rest, string, with.
; the same as h3499 (יֶתֶר); Jether, the name of five or six Israelites and of one Midianite: - Jether, Jethro. Compare h3503 (יִתְרוֹ).
; by variation for h3502 (יִתְרָה); Jithra, an Israelite (or Ishmaelite): - Ithra.
; feminine of h3499 (יֶתֶר); properly, excellence, i.e. (by implication) wealth: - abundance, riches.
; from h3499 (יֶתֶר) with pron. suffix; his excellence; Jethro, Moses' father-in-law: - Jethro. Compare h3500 (יֶתֶר).
; from h3498 (יָתַר); preeminence, gain: - better, excellency(-leth), profit(-able).
; patronymically from h3500 (יֶתֶר); a Jithrite or descendant of Jether: - Ithrite.
; from h3498 (יָתַר); excellent; Jithran, the name of an Edomite and of an Israelite: - Ithran.
; from h3499 (יֶתֶר) and h5971 (עַם); excellence of people; Jithream, a son of David: - Ithream.
; feminine active participle of h3498 (יָתַר); the lobe or flap of the liver (as if redundant or outhanging): - caul.
; of uncertain derivation; Jetheth, an Edomite: - Jetheth. k

; a primitive root; properly, to feel pain; by implication, to grieve; figuratively, to spoil: - grieving, mar, have pain, make sad (sore), (be) sorrowful.
; from h3510 (כָּאַב); suffering (physical or mental), adversity: - grief, pain, sorrow.
; a primitive root; to despond; causatively, to deject: - broken, be grieved, make sad.

; or כָּבֵד; a primitive root; to be heavy, i.e. in a bad sense (burdensome, severe, dull) or in a good sense (numerous, rich, honorable; causatively, to make weighty (in the same two senses): - abounding with, more grievously afflict, boast, be chargeable, [idiom] be dim, glorify, be (make) glorious (things), glory, (very) great, be grievous, harden, be (make) heavy, be heavier, lay heavily, (bring to, come to, do, get, be had in) honour (self), (be) honourable (man), lade, [idiom] more be laid, make self many, nobles, prevail, promote (to honour), be rich, be (go) sore, stop.
; from h3513 (כָּבַד); weight, multitude, vehemence: - grievousness, heavy, great number.

; from h3513 (כָּבַד); heavy; figuratively in a good sense (numerous) or in a bad sense (severe, difficult, stupid): - (so) great, grievous, hard(-ened), (too) heavy(-ier), laden, much, slow, sore, thick.
; the same as h3515 (כָּבֵד); the liver (as the heaviest of the viscera): - liver.
; feminine of h3515 (כָּבֵד); difficulty: - [idiom] heavily.
; a primitive root; to expire or (causatively) to extinguish (fire, light, anger): - go (put) out, quench.
; rarely כָּבֹד; from h3513 (כָּבַד); properly, weight, but only figuratively in a good sense, splendor or copiousness: - glorious(-ly), glory, honour(-able).
; irregular feminine passive participle of h3513 (כָּבַד); weightiness, i.e. magnificence, wealth: - carriage, all glorious, stately.
; from the same as h3525 (כֶּבֶל) in the sense of limitation; sterile; Cabul, the name of two places in Palestine: - Cabul.
; from an unused root meaning to heap up; hilly; Cabon, a place in Palestine: - Cabbon.
; from h3527 (כָּבַר) in the original sense of plaiting; a matrass (of intertwined materials): - pillow.
; from h3527 (כָּבַר); vast, whether in extent (figuratively, of power, mighty; of time, aged), or in number, many: - [phrase] feeble, mighty, most, much, strong, valiant.
; from an unused root meaning to twine or braid together; a fetter: - fetter.
; a primitive root; to trample; hence, to wash (properly, by stamping with the feet), whether literal (including the fulling process) or figurative: - fuller, wash(-ing).
; a primitive root; properly, to plait together, i.e. (figuratively) to augment (especially in number or quantity, to accumulate): - in abundance, multiply.
; from h3527 (כָּבַר); properly, extent of time, i.e. a great while; hence, long ago, formerly, hitherto: - already, (seeing that which), now.
; the same as h3528 (כְּבָר); length; Kebar, a river of Mesopotamia: - Chebar. Compare h2249 (חָבוֹר).
; feminine of h3528 (כְּבָר); properly, length, i.e. a measure (of uncertain dimension): - [idiom] little.
; from h3527 (כָּבַר) in its original sense; a sieve (as netted): - sieve.
; from an unused root meaning to dominate; a ram (just old enough to butt): - lamb, sheep.
; a primitive root; to tread down; hence, negatively, to disregard; positively, to conquer, subjugate, violate: - bring into bondage, force, keep under, subdue, bring into subjection.
; from h3533 (כָּבַשׁ); a footstool (as trodden upon): - footstool.
; or כַּבְשָׂה; feminine of h3532 (כֶּבֶשׂ); a ewe: - (ewe) lamb.
; from h3533 (כָּבַשׁ); a smelting furnace (as reducing metals): - furnace.
; from an unused root meaning to deepen; properly, a pail; but generally of earthenware; a jar for domestic purposes: - barrel, pitcher.
; (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to h3576 (כָּזַב); false: - lying.
; from the same as h3537 (כַּד) in the sense of striking fire from a metal forged; a sparkling gem, probably the ruby: - agate.
; of foreign origin; Kedorlaomer, an early Persian king: - Chedorlaomer.

; from the prefix k and h1931 (הוּא); properly, like this, i.e. by implication, (of manner) thus (or so); also (of place) here (or hither); or (of time) now: - also, here, + hitherto, like, on the other side, so (and much), such, on that manner, (on) this (manner, side, way, way and that way), + mean while, yonder.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h3541 (כֹּה) {properly, like this, i.e. by implication, (of manner) thus (or so); also (of place) here (or hither); or (of time) now}: - hitherto.
; a primitive root; to be weak, i.e. (figuratively) to despond (causatively, rebuke), or (of light, the eye) to grow dull: - darken, be dim, fail, faint, restrain, [idiom] utterly.
; from h3543 (כָּהָה); feeble, obscure: - somewhat dark, darkish, wax dim, heaviness, smoking.
; feminine of h3544 (כֵּהֶה); properly, a weakening; figuratively, alleviation, i.e. cure: - healing.
; (Aramaic) a root corresponding to and h3557 (כּוּל); to be able: - be able, could.

; a primitive root, apparently meaning to mediate in religious services; but used only as denominative from h3548 (כֹּהֵן); to officiate as a priest; figuratively, to put on regalia: - deck, be (do the office of a, execute the, minister in the) priest('s office).
; active participle of h3547 (כָּהַן); literally one officiating, a priest; also (by courtesy) an acting priest (although a layman): - chief ruler, [idiom] own, priest, prince, principal officer.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h3548 (כֹּהֵן) {one officiating, a priest; also (by courtesy) an acting priest (although a layman)}: - priest.
; from h3547 (כָּהַן); priesthood: - priesthood, priest's office.
; (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to h3854 (לַהַג) in the sense of piercing; a window (as a perforation): - window.
; of foreign derivation; Kub, a country near Egypt: - Chub.
; from an unused root meaning to be high or rounded; a helmet (as arched): - helmet. Compare h6959 (קוֹבַע).
; a primitive root; properly, to prick or penetrate; hence, to blister (as smarting or eating into): - burn.
; from h3554 (כָּוָה); a branding: - burning.
; probably from the same as h3522 (כַּבּוֹן) (in the sense of rolling) or h3554 (כָּוָה) (in the sense of blazing); a star (as round or as shining); figuratively, a prince: - star(-gazer).

; a primitive root; properly, to keep in; hence, to measure; figuratively, to maintain (in various senses): - (be able to, can) abide, bear, comprehend, contain, feed, forbearing, guide, hold(-ing in), nourish(-er), be present, make provision, receive, sustain, provide sustenance (victuals).
; from an unused root meaning to store away; a jewel (probably gold beads): - tablet.

; a primitive root; properly, to be erect (i.e. stand perpendicular); hence (causatively) to set up, in a great variety of applications, whether literal (establish, fix, prepare, apply), or figurative (appoint, render sure, proper or prosperous): - certain(-ty), confirm, direct, faithfulness, fashion, fasten, firm, be fitted, be fixed, frame, be meet, ordain, order, perfect, (make) preparation, prepare (self), provide, make provision, (be, make) ready, right, set (aright, fast, forth), be stable, (e-) stablish, stand, tarry, [idiom] very deed.
; probably from h3559 (כּוּן); established; Kun, a place in Syria: - Chun.
; from h3559 (כּוּן); something prepared, i.e. a sacrificial wafer: - cake.
; from h3559 (כּוּן) and h3050 (יָהּ); Jah has sustained; Conanjah, the name of two Israelites: - Conaniah, Cononiah. Compare h3663 (כְּנַנְיָה).

; from an unused root meaning to hold together; a cup (as a container), often figuratively, a lot (as if a potion); also some unclean bird, probably an owl (perhaps from the cup-like cavity of its eye): - cup, (small) owl. Compare h3599 (כִּיס).
; from an unused root meaning properly, to dig through; a pot or furnace (as if excavated): - furnace. Compare h3600 (כִּיר).
; from h3564 (כּוּר) and h6227 (עָשָׁן); furnace of smoke; Cor-Ashan, a place in Palestine: - Chorashan.
; or (Ezra 1:1 (last time),2) כֹּרֶשׁ; from the Persians; Koresh (or Cyrus), the Persian king: - Cyrus.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h3566 (כּוֹרֶשׁ) {Koresh (or Cyrus), the Persian king}: - Cyrus.
; probably of foreign origin; Cush (or Ethiopia), the name of a son of Ham, and of his territory; also of an Israelite: - Chush, Cush, Ethiopia.
; patronymically from h3568 (כּוּשׁ); a Cushite, or descendant of Cush: - Cushi, Cushite, Ethiopian(-s).
; the same as h3569 (כּוּשִׁי); Cushi, the name of two Israelites: - Cushi.
; feminine of h3569 (כּוּשִׁי); a Cushite woman: - Ethiopian.
; perhaps from h3568 (כּוּשׁ); Cushan, a region of Arabia: - Cushan.
; apparently from h3572 (כּוּשָׁן) and the dual of h7564 (רִשְׁעָה); Cushan of double wickedness; Cushan-Rishathajim, a Mesopotamian king: - Chushan-rishathayim.
; from h3787 (כָּשֵׁר); prosperity; in plural freedom: - [idiom] chain.
; or (feminine) כּוּתָה; of foreign origin; Cuth or Cuthah, a province of Assyria: - Cuth.
; a primitive root; to lie (i.e. deceive), literally or figuratively: - fail, (be found a, make a) liar, lie, lying, be in vain.
; from h3576 (כָּזַב); falsehood; literally (untruth) or figuratively (idol): - deceitful, false, leasing, + liar, lie, lying.
; from h3576 (כָּזַב); fallacious; Cozeba, a place in Palestine: - Choseba.
; from h3576 (כָּזַב); false; Cozbi, a Midianitess: - Cozbi.
; from h3576 (כָּזַב); falsified; Kezib, a place in Palestine: - Chezib.

; or (Daniel 11:6) כּוֹחַ; from an unused root meaning to be firm; vigor, literally (force, in a good or a bad sense) or figuratively (capacity, means, produce); also (from its hardiness) a large lizard: - ability, able, chameleon, force, fruits, might, power(-ful), strength, substance, wealth.
; a primitive root; to secrete, by act or word; hence (intensively) to destroy: - conceal, cut down (off), desolate, hide.
; a primitive root; to paint (with stibium): - paint.

; a primitive root; to be untrue, in word (to lie, feign, disown) or deed (to disappoint, fail, cringe): - deceive, deny, dissemble, fail, deal falsely, be found liars, (be-) lie, lying, submit selves.
; from h3584 (כָּחַשׁ); literally a failure of flesh, i.e. emaciation; figuratively, hypocrisy: - leanness, lies, lying.
; from h3584 (כָּחַשׁ); faithless: - lying.
; from h3554 (כָּוָה); a brand or scar: - burning.

; a primitive particle (the full form of the prepositional prefix) indicating causal relations of all kinds, antecedent or consequent; (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed: - and, + (forasmuch, inasmuch, where-) as, assured(-ly), + but, certainly, doubtless, + else, even, + except, for, how, (because, in, so, than) that, + nevertheless, now, rightly, seeing, since, surely, then, therefore, + (al-) though, + till, truly, + until, when, whether, while, whom, yea, yet.
; from a primitive root meaning to strike; a crushing; figuratively, calamity: - destruction.
; from the same as h3589 (כִּיד) (compare h3539 (כַּדְכֹּד)); properly, something struck off, i.e. a spark (as struck): - spark.
; from the same as h3589 (כִּיד); (perhaps smaller than h2595 (חֲנִית)lemma חֲניִת second vowel, corrected to חֲנִית) properly, something to strike with, i.e. a dart: - lance, shield, spear, target.
; the same as h3591 (כִּידוֹן); Kidon, a place in Palestine: - Chidon.
; of uncertain derivation; perhaps tumult: - battle.
; from h3559 (כּוּן); properly, a statue, i.e. idol; but used (by euphemism) forsome heathen deity (perhaps corresponding to Priapus or Baal-peor): - Chiun.

; or כִּיֹּר; from the same as h3564 (כּוּר); properly, something round (as excavated or bored), i.e. a chafing-dish forcoals or a caldron forcooking; hence (from similarity of form) a washbowl; also (for the same reason) a pulpit or platform: - hearth, laver, pan, scaffold.
; or כֵּלַי; from h3557 (כּוּל) in the sense of withholding; niggardly: - churl.
; from an unused root meaning to clap or strike with noise; a club or sledge-hammer: - hammer.
; from the same as h3558 (כּוּמָז); a cluster of stars, i.e. the Pleiades: - Pleiades, seven stars.
; a form for h3563 (כּוֹס); a cup; also a bag formoney or weights: - bag, cup, purse.
; a form for h3564 (כּוּר) (only in the dual); a cooking range (consisting of two parallel stones, across which the boiler is set): - ranges for pots.
; from h3787 (כָּשֵׁר); compare h6418 (פֶּלֶךְ) literally a director, i.e. the spindle or shank of adistaff, by which it is twirled: - spindle.
; from h3541 (כֹּה); just so, referring to the previous or following context: - after that (this) manner, this matter, (even) so, in such a case, thus.

; from h3769 (כָּרַר); a circle, i.e. (by implication) a circumjacent tract or region, especially the Ghor or valley of the Jordan; also a (round) loaf; also a talent (or large [round] coin): - loaf, morsel, piece, plain, talent.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h3603 (כִּכָּר); a talent: - talent.

; or (Jeremiah 33:8) כּוֹל; from h3634 (כָּלַל); properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense): - (in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-) thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever).

; (Aramaic) corresponding to h3605 (כֹּל) {properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)}: - all, any, + (forasmuch) as, + be-(for this) cause, every, + no (manner, -ne), + there (where) -fore, + though, what (where, who) -soever, (the) whole.
; a primitive root; to restrict, by act (hold back or in) or word (prohibit): - finish, forbid, keep (back), refrain, restrain, retain, shut up, be stayed, withhold.
; from h3607 (כָּלָא); a prison: - prison. Compare h3610 (כִּלְאַיִם), h3628 (כְּלִיא).
; apparently from h3607 (כָּלָא) and h0001 (אָב); restraint of (his) father; Kilab, an Israelite: - Chileab.
; dual of h3608 (כֶּלֶא) in the original sense of separation; two heterogeneities: - divers seeds (-e kinds), mingled (seed).
; from an unused root means. to yelp, or else to attack; a dog; hence (by euphemism) a male prostitute: - dog.
; perhaps a form of h3611 (כֶּלֶב), or else from the same root in the sense of forcible; Caleb, the name of three Israelites: - Caleb.
; from h3612 (כָּלֵב) and h0672 (אֶפְרָת); Caleb-Ephrathah, a place in Egypt (if the text is correct): - Caleb-ephrathah.
; probably by erroneous transcription for כָּלֵבִי; patronymically from h3612 (כָּלֵב); a Calebite or descendant of Caleb: - of the house of Caleb.

; a primitive root; to end, whether intransitive (to cease, be finished, perish) or transitived (to complete, prepare, consume): - accomplish, cease, consume (away), determine, destroy (utterly), be (when... were) done, (be an) end (of), expire, (cause to) fail, faint, finish, fulfil, [idiom] fully, [idiom] have, leave (off), long, bring to pass, wholly reap, make clean riddance, spend, quite take away, waste.
; from h3615 (כָּלָה); pining: - fail.
; from h3615 (כָּלָה); a completion; adverb, completely; also destruction: - altogether, (be, utterly) consume(-d), consummation(-ption), was determined, (full, utter) end, riddance.
; from h3634 (כָּלַל); a bride (as if perfect); hence, a son's wife: - bride, daughter-in-law, spouse.
; from the same as h3611 (כֶּלֶב); a bird-trap (as furnished with a clap-stick or treadle to spring it); hence, a basket (as resembling a wicker cage): - basket, cage.
; the same as h3619 (כְּלוּב)xlit kᵉlûb corrected to kᵉlûwb; Kelub, the name of two Israelites: - Chelub.
; a form of h3612 (כָּלֵב); Kelubai, an Israelite: - Chelubai.
; from h3615 (כָּלָה); completed; Keluhai, an Israelite: - Chelluh.
; denominative passive participle from h3618 (כַּלָּה)lemma כַּלָה missing dagesh, corrected to כַּלָּה; bridehood (only in the plural): - espousal.
; from an unused root meaning to be complete; maturity: - full (old) age.
; the same as h3624 (כֶּלַח); Kelach, a place in Assyria: - Calah.
; from h3605 (כֹּל) and h2374 (חֹזֶה); every seer; Col-Chozeh, an Israelite: - Col-hozeh.

; from h3615 (כָּלָה); something prepared, i.e. any apparatus (as an implement, utensil, dress, vessel or weapon): - armour(-bearer), artillery, bag, carriage, [phrase] furnish, furniture, instrument, jewel, that is made of, [idiom] one from another, that which pertaineth, pot, [phrase] psaltery, sack, stuff, thing, tool, vessel, ware, weapon, [phrase] whatsoever.
; or כְּלוּא; from h3627 (כְּלִי) (compare h3608 (כֶּלֶא)); a prison: - prison.
; feminine of h3627 (כְּלִי) (only in the plural); a kidney (as an essential organ); figuratively, the mind (as the interior self): - kidneys, reins.
; a form of h3631 (כִּלָּיוֹן); Kiljon, an Israelite: - Chilion.
; from h3615 (כָּלָה); pining, destruction: - consumption, failing.

; from h3634 (כָּלַל); complete; as noun, the whole (specifically, a sacrifice entirely consumed); as adverb, fully: - all, every whit, flame, perfect(-ion), utterly, whole burnt offering (sacrifice), wholly.
; from h3557 (כּוּל); sustenance; Calcol, an Israelite: - Calcol, Chalcol.
; a primitive root; to complete: - (make) perfect.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h3634 (כָּלַל); to complete: - finish, make (set) up.
; from h3634 (כָּלַל); complete; Kelal, an Israelite: - Chelal.
; a primitive root; properly, to wound; but only figuratively, to taunt or insult: - be (make) ashamed, blush, be confounded, be put to confusion, hurt, reproach, (do, put to) shame.
; of foreign derivation; Kilmad, a place apparently in the Assyrian empire: - Chilmad.
; from h3637 (כָּלַם); disgrace: - confusion, dishonour, reproach, shame.
; from h3639 (כְּלִמָּה); disgrace: - shame.
; or כַּלְנֵה; also כַּלְנוֹ; of foreign derivation; Calneh or Calno, a place in the Assyrian empire: - Calneh, Calno. Compare h3656 (כַּנֶּה).
; a primitive root; to pine after: - long.
; from h3642 (כָּמַהּ); pining; Kimham, an Israelite: - Chimham.

; or כָּמוֹ; (compare h3651 (כֵּן)); a form of the prefix 'k-', but used separately as, thus, so: - according to, (such) as (it were, well as), in comparison of, like (as, to, unto), thus, when, worth.
; or (Jeremiah 48:7) כְּמִישׁ; from an unused root meaning to subdue; the powerful; Kemosh, the god of the Moabites: - Chemosh.
; from an unused root meaning to store up or preserve; 'cummin' (from its use as a condiment): - cummin.
; a primitive root; to store away, i.e. (figuratively) in the memory: - lay up in store.

; a primitive root; properly, to intertwine or contract, i.e. (by implication) to shrivel (as with heat); figuratively, to be deeply affected with passion (love or pity): - be black, be kindled, yearn.
; from h3648 (כָּמַר); properly, an ascetic (as if shrunk with self-maceration), i.e. an idolatrous priest (only in plural): - Chemarims (idolatrous) priests.
; redupl. from h3648 (כָּמַר); obscuration (as if from shrinkage of light, i.e. an eclipse (only in plural): - blackness.

; from h3559 (כּוּן); properly, set upright; hence (figuratively as adjective) just; but usually (as adverb or conjunction) rightly or so (in various applications to manner, time and relation; often with other particles): - [phrase] after that (this, -ward, -wards), as... as, [phrase] (for-) asmuch as yet, [phrase] be (for which) cause, [phrase] following, howbeit, in (the) like (manner, -wise), [idiom] the more, right, (even) so, state, straightway, such (thing), surely, [phrase] there (where) -fore, this, thus, true, well, [idiom] you.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h3651 (כֵּן); so: - thus.
; the same as h3651 (כֵּן), used as a noun; a stand, i.e. pedestal or station: - base, estate, foot, office, place, well.
; from h3661 (כָּנַן) in the sense of fastening; (from infixing its sting; used only in plural (and irregular in Exodus 8:17,18; Hebrews 13:14)) a gnat: - lice, [idiom] manner.
; a primitive root; to address by an additional name; hence, to eulogize: - give flattering titles, surname (himself).
; for h3641 (כַּלְנֶה); Canneh, a place in Assyria: - Canneh.
; from h3661 (כָּנַן); a plant (as set): - [idiom] vineyard.
; from a unused root meaning to twang; a harp: - harp.
; for h3204 (יְכׇנְיָה); Conjah, an Israelite king: - Coniah.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h3644 (כְּמוֹ); so or thus: - so, (in) this manner (sort), thus.
; a primitive root; to set out, i.e. plant: - [idiom] vineyard.
; from h3661 (כָּנַן); planted; Kenani, an Israelite: - Chenani.
; or כְּנַנְיָהוּ; from h3661 (כָּנַן) and h3050 (יָהּ); Jah has planted; Kenanjah, an Israelite: - Chenaniah.
; a primitive root; to collect; hence, to enfold: - gather (together), heap up, wrap self.
; a primitive root; properly, to bend the knee; hence, to humiliate, vanquish: - bring down (low), into subjection, under, humble (self), subdue.
; from h3665 (כָּנַע) in the sense of folding (compare h3664 (כָּנַס)); a package: - wares.
; from h3665 (כָּנַע); humiliated; Kenaan, a son a Ham; also the country inhabited by him: - Canaan, merchant, traffick.
; feminine of h3667 (כְּנַעַן); Kenaanah, the name of two Israelites: - Chenaanah.

; patrial from h3667 (כְּנַעַן); a Kenaanite or inhabitant of Kenaan; by implication, a pedlar (the Canaanites standing for their neighbors the Ishmaelites, who conducted mercantile caravans): - Canaanite, merchant, trafficker.
; a primitive root; properly, to project laterally, i.e. probably (reflexive) to withdraw: - be removed.

; from h3670 (כָּנַף); an edge or extremity; specifically (of a bird or army) a wing, (of a garment or bedclothing) a flap, (of the earth) a quarter, (of a building) a pinnacle: - [phrase] bird, border, corner, end, feather(-ed), [idiom] flying, [phrase] (one an-) other, overspreading, [idiom] quarters, skirt, [idiom] sort, uttermost part, wing(-ed).

; or כִּנֶּרֶתlemma כִּנֶרֶת missing dagesh, corrected to כִּנֶּרֶת; respectively plural and singular feminine from the same as h3658 (כִּנּוֹר); perhaps harp-shaped; Kinneroth or Kinnereth, a place in Palestine: - Chinnereth, Chinneroth, Cinneroth.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h3664 (כָּנַס); to assemble: - gather together.
; from h3655 (כָּנָה); a colleague (as having the same title): - companion.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h3674 (כְּנָת) {a colleague (as having the same title)}: - companion.

; apparently a contraction for h3678 (כִּסֵּא), but probably by erroneous transcription for h5251 (נֵס) {a flag; also a sail; by implication, a flagstaff; generally a signal; figuratively, a token}: - sworn.
; or כֶּסֶה; apparently from h3680 (כָּסָה); properly, fulness or the full moon, i.e. its festival: - (time) appointed.
; or כִּסֵּה; from h3680 (כָּסָה); properly, covered, i.e. a throne (as canopied): - seat, stool, throne.
; for h3778 (כַּשְׂדִּי) {a Kasdite, or descendant of Kesed; by implication, a Chaldaean (as if so descended); also an astrologer (as if proverbial of that people}: - Chaldean.

; a primitive root; properly, to plump, i.e. fill up hollows; by implication, to cover (for clothing or secrecy): - clad self, close, clothe, conceal, cover (self), (flee to) hide, overwhelm. Compare h3780 (כָּשָׂה).
; passive participle of h3680 (כָּסָה); properly, covered, i.e. (as noun) a covering: - covering.
; from h3680 (כָּסָה); a cover (garment); figuratively, a veiling: - covering, raiment, vesture.
; a primitive root; to cut off: - cut down (up).
; from h3688 (כָּסַל); properly, fat, i.e. (figuratively) stupid or silly: - fool(-ish).
; the same as h3684 (כְּסִיל); any notable constellation; specifically Orion (as if a burly one): - constellation, Orion.
; the same as h3684 (כְּסִיל); Kesil, a place in Palestine: - Chesil.
; from h3684 (כְּסִיל); silliness: - foolish.
; a primitive root; properly, to be fat, i.e. (figuratively) silly: - be foolish.

; from h3688 (כָּסַל); properly, fatness, i.e. by implication (literally) the loin (as the seat of the leaf fat) or (generally) the viscera; also (figuratively) silliness or (in a good sense) trust: - confidence, flank, folly, hope, loin.
; feminine of h3689 (כֶּסֶל); in a good sense, trust; in a bad one, silliness: - confidence, folly.
; probably of foreign origin; Kisleu, the 9th Hebrew month: - Chisleu.
; from h3688 (כָּסַל); hopeful; Kislon, an Israelite: - Chislon.
; from h3688 (כָּסַל); fertile; Kesalon, a place in Palestine: - Chesalon.
; feminine plural of passive participle of h3688 (כָּסַל); fattened; Kesulloth, a place in Palestine: - Chesulloth.
; a plural probably of foreign derivation; Casluchim, a people cognate to the Egyptians: - Casluhim.
; from the feminine plural of h3689 (כֶּסֶל) and h8396 (תָּבוֹר); flanks of Tabor; Kisloth-Tabor, a place in Palestine: - Chisloth-tabor.
; a primitive root; to shear: - [idiom] only, poll. Compare h3765 (כִּרְסֵם).
; from h3697 (כָּסַם); spelt (from its bristliness as if just shorn): - fitches, rie.
; a primitive root; to estimate: - make count.
; a primitive root; properly, to become pale, i.e. (by implication) to pine after; also to fear: - (have) desire, be greedy, long, sore.
; from h3700 (כָּסַף); silver (from its pale color); by implication, money: - money, price, silver(-ling).
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h3701 (כֶּסֶף) {silver (from its pale color); by implication, money}: - money, silver.
; perhaps from h3701 (כֶּסֶף); silvery; Casiphja, a place in Babylon: - Casiphia.
; from h3680 (כָּסָה); a cushion or pillow (as covering a seat or bed): - pillow.
; (Aramaic) probably from h3652 (כֵּן); now: - now.
; (Aramaic) or כְּעֶת; (Aramaic), feminine of h3705 (כְּעַן); thus (only in the formula 'and so forth'): - at such a time.
; a primitive root; to trouble; by implication, to grieve, rage, be indignant: - be angry, be grieved, take indignation, provoke (to anger, unto wrath), have sorrow, vex, be wroth.
; or (in Job) כַּעַשׂ; from h3707 (כַּעַס); vexation: - anger, angry, grief, indignation, provocation, provoking, [idiom] sore, sorrow, spite, wrath.

; from h3721 (כָּפַף); the hollow hand or palm (so of the paw of an animal, of the sole, and even of the bowl of a dish or sling, the handle of a bolt, the leaves of a palm-tree); figuratively, power: - branch, [phrase] foot, hand((-ful), -dle, (-led)), hollow, middle, palm, paw, power, sole, spoon.
; from h3721 (כָּפַף); a hollow rock: - rock.
; a primitive root; properly, to bend, i.e. (figuratively) to tame or subdue: - pacify.
; feminine of h3709 (כַּף); a leaf of a palmtree: - branch.
; from h3722 (כָּפַר); properly, a cover, i.e. (by implication) a tankard (or covered goblet); also white frost (as covering the ground): - bason, hoar(-y) frost.
; from an unused root meaning to connect; a girder: - beam.
; from h3722 (כָּפַר); a village (as covered in by walls); also a young lion (perhaps as covered with a mane): - (young) lion, village. Compare h3723 (כָּפָר).
; feminine of h3715 (כְּפִיר); the village (always with the art.); Kephirah, a place in Palestine: - Chephirah.
; a primitive root; to fold together; figuratively, to repeat: - double.
; from h3717 (כָּפַל); a duplicate: - double.
; a primitive root; to bend: - bend.
; from h3719 (כָּפַן); hunger (as making to stoop with emptiness and pain): - famine.
; a primitive root; to curve: - bow down (self).

; a primitive root; to cover (specifically with bitumen); figuratively, to expiate or condone, to placate or cancel: - appease, make (an atonement, cleanse, disannul, forgive, be merciful, pacify, pardon, purge (away), put off, (make) reconcile(-liation).
; from h3722 (כָּפַר); a village (as protected by walls): - village. Compare h3715 (כְּפִיר).

; from h3722 (כָּפַר); properly, a cover, i.e. (literally) a village (as covered in); (specifically) bitumen (as used for coating), and the henna plant (as used for dyeing); figuratively, a redemption-price: - bribe, camphire, pitch, ransom, satisfaction, sum of money, village.
; from h3722 (כָּפַר); expiation (only in plural): - atonement.
; from h3723 (כָּפָר) and h5984 (עַמּוֹנִי), with the article interposed; village of the Ammonite; Kefar-ha-Ammoni, a place in Palestine: - Chefarhaamonai.
; from h3722 (כָּפַר); a lid (used only of the cover of the sacred Ark): - mercy seat.
; a primitive root; to tread down; figuratively, to humiliate: - cover.
; (Aramaic) a root of uncertain correspondence; to fetter: - bind.

; or (Amos 9:1) כַּפְתּוֹר; probably from an unused root meaning to encircle; a chaplet; but used only in an architectonic sense, i.e. the capital of acolumn, or a wreath-like button or disk on the candelabrum: - knop, (upper) lintel.
; or (Amos 9:7) כַּפְתּוֹר; apparently the same as h3730 (כַּפְתֹּר); Caphtor (i.e. a wreath-shaped island), the original seat of the Philistines: - Caphtor.
; patrial from h3731 (כַּפְתֹּר); a Caphtorite (collectively) or native of Caphtor: - Caphthorim, Caphtorim(-s).

; from h3769 (כָּרַר) in the sense of plumpness; a ram (as full-grown and fat), including a battering-ram (as butting); hence, a meadow (as for sheep); also a pad or camel's saddle (as puffed out): - captain, furniture, lamb, (large) pasture, ram. See also h1033 (בֵּית כַּר), h3746 (כָּרִי).
; from the same as h3564 (כּוּר); properly, a deep round vessel, i.e. (specifically) a cor or measure for things dry: - cor, measure. Aramaic the same.
; (Aramaic) probably corresponding to h3738 (כָּרָה) in the sense of piercing(figuratively); to grieve: - be grieved.
; from the same as h3525 (כֶּבֶל); to gird or clothe: - clothed.
; (Aramaic) from a verb corresponding to that of h3736 (כַּרְבֵּל); a mantle: - hat.
; a primitive root; properly, to dig; figuratively, to plot; generally, to bore or open: - dig, [idiom] make (a banquet), open.
; usually assigned as a primitive root, but probably only a special application of h3738 (כָּרָה) (through the common idea of planning implied in a bargain); to purchase: - buy, prepare.
; from h3739 (כָּרָה); a purchase: - provision.
; feminine of h3733 (כַּר); a meadow: - cottage.
; of uncertain derivation; a cherub or imaginary figure: - cherub, (plural) cherubims.
; the same as h3742 (כְּרוּב); Kerub, a place in Babylon: - Cherub.
; (Aramaic) from h3745 (כְּרַז); a herald: - herald.
; (Aramaic) probably of Greek origin; to proclaim: - make a proclamation.
; perhaps an abridged plural of h3733 (כַּר) in the sense of leader (of the flock); a life-guardsman: - captains, Cherethites (from the margin).
; from h3772 (כָּרַת); a cut; Kerith, a brook of Palestine: - Cherith.
; from h3772 (כָּרַת); a cutting (of the matrimonial bond), i.e. divorce: - divorce(-ment).
; expanded from the same as h3522 (כַּבּוֹן); a rim or top margin: - compass.
; probably of foreign origin; the crocus: - saffron.
; of foreign derivation; Karkemish, a place in Syria: - Carchemish.
; of Persian origin; Karkas, a eunuch of Xerxes: - Carcas.
; from h3769 (כָּרַר); a dromedary (from its rapid motion as if dancing): - swift beast.
; from an unused root of uncertain meaning; a garden or vineyard: - vines, (increase of the) vineyard(-s), vintage. See also h1021 (בֵּית הַכֶּרֶם).
; active participle of an imaginary denominative from h3754 (כֶּרֶם); a vinedresser: - vine dresser (as one or two words).
; from h3754 (כֶּרֶם); gardener; Karmi, the name of three Israelites: - Carmi.
; patronymically from h3756 (כַּרְמִי); a Karmite or descendant of Karmi: - Carmites.
; probably of foreign origin; carmine, a deep red: - crimson.
; from h3754 (כֶּרֶם); a planted field (garden, orchard, vineyard or park); by implication, garden produce: - full (green) ears (of corn), fruitful field (place), plentiful (field).
; the same as h3759 (כַּרְמֶל); Karmel, the name of a hill and of a town in Palestine: - Carmel, fruitful (plentiful) field, (place).
; patron from h3760 (כַּרְמֶל); a Karmelite or inhabitant of Karmel (the town): - Carmelite.
; feminine of h3761 (כַּרְמְלִי); a Karmelitess or female inhabitant of Karmel: - Carmelitess.
; of uncertain derivation; Keran, an aboriginal Idumaean: - Cheran.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h3678 (כִּסֵּא); a throne: - throne.
; from h3697 (כָּסַם); to lay waste: - waste.

; a primitive root; to bend the knee; by implication, to sink, to prostrate: - bow (down, self), bring down (low), cast down, couch, fall, feeble, kneeling, sink, smite (stoop) down, subdue, [idiom] very.
; from h3766 (כָּרַע); the leg (from the knee to the ankle) of men or locusts (only in the dual): - leg.
; of foreign origin; byssus or fine vegetable wool: - green.
; a primitive root; to dance (i.e. whirl): - dance(-ing).
; by variation from h7164 (קָרַס); the paunch or belly (as swelling out): - belly.
; of foreign origin; Karshena, a courtier of Xerxes: - Carshena.

; a primitive root; to cut (off, down or asunder); by implication, to destroy or consume; specifically, to covenant (i.e. make an alliance or bargain, originally by cutting flesh and passing between the pieces): - be chewed, be con-(feder-) ate, covenant, cut (down, off), destroy, fail, feller, be freed, hew (down), make a league (covenant), [idiom] lose, perish, [idiom] utterly, [idiom] want.
; passive participle feminine of h3772 (כָּרַת); something cut, i.e. a hewn timber: - beam.
; probably from h3772 (כָּרַת) in the sense of executioner; (compare h2876 (טַבָּח)) (only collectively in the singular as plural) a Kerethite or life-guardsman: - Cherethims, Cherethites.
; apparently by transposition for h3532 (כֶּבֶשׂ); a young sheep: - lamb.
; feminine of h3775 (כֶּשֶׂב); a young ewe: - lamb.
; from an unused root of uncertain meaning; Kesed, a relative of Abraham: - Chesed.

; (occasionally with enclitic) כַּשְׂדִּימָה; towards the Kasdites into Chaldea), patronymically from h3777 (כֶּשֶׂד) (only in the plural); a Kasdite, or descendant of Kesed; by implication, a Chaldaean (as if so descended); also an astrologer (as if proverbial of that people: - Chaldeans, Chaldees, inhabitants of Chaldea.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h3778 (כַּשְׂדִּי); a Chaldaean or inhabitant of Chaldaea; by implication, a Magian or professional astrologer: - Chaldean.
; a primitive root; to grow fat (i.e. be covered with flesh): - be covered. Compare h3680 (כָּסָה).
; from h3782 (כָּשַׁל); properly, a feller, i.e. an axe: - ax.

; a primitive root; to totter or waver (through weakness of the legs, especially the ankle); by implication, to falter, stumble, faint or fall: - bereave (from the margin), cast down, be decayed, (cause to) fail, (cause, make to) fall (down, -ing), feeble, be (the) ruin(-ed, of), (be) overthrown, (cause to) stumble, [idiom] utterly, be weak.
; from h3782 (כָּשַׁל); properly, a tottering, i.e. ruin: - fall.
; a primitive root; properly, to whisper aspell, i.e. to inchant or practise magic: - sorcerer, (use) witch(-craft).
; from h3784 (כָּשַׁף); magic: - sorcery, witchcraft.
; from h3784 (כָּשַׁף); a magician: - sorcerer.
; a primitive root properly, to be straight or right; by implication, to be acceptable; also to succeed or prosper: - direct, be right, prosper.
; from h3787 (כָּשֵׁר); success, advantage: - equity, good, right.
; a primitive root; to grave, by implication, to write (describe, inscribe, prescribe, subscribe): - describe, record, prescribe, subscribe, write(-ing, -ten).
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h3789 (כָּתַב) {to grave, by implication, to write (describe, inscribe, prescribe, subscribe)}: - write(-ten).
; from h3789 (כָּתַב); something written, i.e. a writing, record or book: - register, scripture, writing.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h3791 (כָּתָב) {something written, i.e. a writing, record or book}: - prescribing, writing(-ten).
; from h3789 (כָּתַב); a letter or other mark branded on the skin: - [idiom] any (mark).

; or כִּתִּיִּי; patrial from an unused name denoting Cyprus (only in the plural); a Kittite or Cypriote; hence, an islander in general, i.e. the Greeks or Romans on the shores opposite Palestine: - Chittim, Kittim.
; from h3807 (כָּתַת); beaten, i.e. pure (oil): - beaten.
; from an unused root meaning to compact; a wall (as gathering inmates): - wall.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h3796 (כֹּתֶל) {a wall (as gathering inmates)}: - wall.
; from h3796 (כֹּתֶל) and h0376 (אִישׁ); wall of a man; Kithlish, a place in Palestine: - Kithlish.
; a primitive root; properly, to carve or engrave, i.e. (by implication) to inscribe indelibly: - mark.
; from h3799 (כָּתַם); properly, something carved out, i.e. ore; hence, gold (pure as originally mined): - ((most) fine, pure) gold(-en wedge).
; or כֻּתֹּנֶת; from an unused root meaning to cover (compare h3802 (כָּתֵף)); a shirt: - coat, garment, robe.

; from an unused root meaning to clothe; the shoulder (proper, i.e. upper end of the arm; as being the spot where the garments hang); figuratively, side-piece or lateral projection of anything: - arm, corner, shoulder(-piece), side, undersetter.

; a primitive root; to enclose; hence (in a friendly sense) to crown, (in a hostile one) to besiege; also to wait (as restraining oneself): - beset round, compass about, be crowned inclose round, suffer.
; from h3803 (כָּתַר); properly, a circlet, i.e. a diadem: - crown.
; feminine active participle of h3803 (כָּתַר); the capital of a column: - chapiter.
; a primitive root; to butt or pound: - bray.
; a primitive root; to bruise or violently strike: - beat (down, to pieces), break in pieces, crushed, destroy, discomfit, smite, stamp. l
Indexes for Dictionary.

; or לוֹא; or לֹה; (Deuteronomy 3:11), a primitive particle; not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles: - [idiom] before, [phrase] or else, ere, [phrase] except, ig(-norant), much, less, nay, neither, never, no((-ne), -r, (-thing)), ([idiom] as though...,(can-), for) not (out of), of nought, otherwise, out of, [phrase] surely, [phrase] as truly as, [phrase] of a truth, [phrase] verily, for want, [phrase] whether, without.
; (Aramaic) or לָה; (Aramaic) (Daniel 4:32), corresponding to h3808 (לֹא) {not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no;}: - or even, neither, no(-ne, -r), (can-) not, as nothing, without.
; or לוֹ דבַר; (Samuel 9:4,5), or לִדְבִר; (Joshua 13:26), (probably rather לֹדְבַר ); from h3808 (לֹא) and h1699 (דֹּבֶר); pastureless; Lo-Debar, a place in Palestine: - Debir, Lodebar.
; a primitive root; to tire; (figuratively) to be (or make) disgusted: - faint, grieve, lothe, (be, make) weary (selves).
; from h3811 (לָאָה); weary; Leah, a wife of Jacob: - Leah.
; a primitive root; to muffle: - cover.
; from h3813 (לָאַט) (or perhaps for active participle of h3874 (לוּט)); properly, muffled, i.e. silently: - softly.
; from the prepositional prefix and h0410 (אֵל); (belonging) to God; Lael an Israelite: - Lael.
; or לְאוֹם; from an unused root meaning to gather; a community: - nation, people.
; plural of h3816 (לְאֹם); communities; Leum mim, an Arabian: - Leummim.
; from h3808 (לֹא) and h5971 (עַם) with pronominal suffix; not my people; Lo-Ammi, the symbolic name of a son of Hosea: - Lo-ammi.
; from h3808 (לֹא) and h7355 (רָחַם); not pitied; Lo-Ruchamah, the symbolic name of a son of Hosea: - Lo-ruhamah.

; a form of h3824 (לֵבָב); the heart; also used (figuratively) very widely for the feelings, the will and even the intellect; likewise for the centre of anything: - [phrase] care for, comfortably, consent, [idiom] considered, courag(-eous), friend(-ly), ((broken-), (hard-), (merry-), (stiff-), (stout-), double) heart(-ed), [idiom] heed, [idiom] I, kindly, midst, mind(-ed), [idiom] regard(-ed), [idiom] themselves, [idiom] unawares, understanding, [idiom] well, willingly, wisdom.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h3820 (לֵב) {the heart; also used (figuratively) very widely for the feelings, the will and even the intellect; likewise for the centre of anything}: - heart.
; plural of h3833 (לָבִיא); lionesses; Lebaoth, a place in Palestine: - Lebaoth. See also h1034 (בֵּית לְבָאוֹת).

; a primitive root; properly, to be enclosed (as if with fat); by implication (as denominative from h3824 (לֵבָב)); to unheart; also as denominative from h3834 (לָבִיבָה) i.e. (in a good sense) transport (with love), or (in a bad sense) stultify; to make cakes: - make cakes, ravish, be wise.

; from h3823 (לָבַב); used also like h3820 (לֵב) the heart (as the most interior organ);: - [phrase] bethink themselves, breast, comfortably, courage, ((faint), (tender-) heart(-ed), midst, mind, [idiom] unawares, understanding.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h3824 (לֵבָב) {the heart (as the most interior organ);}: - heart.
; feminine of h3820 (לֵב); the heart: - heart.
; for h3852 (לֶהָבָה); flame: - flame.
; or לְבֹנָה; from h3836 (לָבָן); frankincense (from its whiteness or perhaps that of its smoke): - (frank-) incense.
; the same as h3828 (לְבוֹנָה); Lebonah, a place in Palestine: - Lebonah.
; or לְבֻשׁ; from h3847 (לָבַשׁ); a garment (literally or figuratively); by implication (euphemistically) a wife: - apparel, clothed with, clothing, garment, raiment, vestment, vesture.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h3830 (לְבוּשׁ) {a garment (literally or figuratively); by implication (euphemistically) a wife}: - garment.
; a primitive root; to overthrow; intransposed, to fall: - fall.

; or (Ezekiel 19:2) לְבִיָּא; irregular masculine plural לְבָאִים; irregular feminine plural לְבָאוֹת; from an unused root meaning; compare h0738 (אֲרִי) to roar; a lion (properly, a lioness as the fiercer (although not a roarer;)): - (great, old, stout) lion, lioness, young (lion).
; or rather לְבִבָה; from h3823 (לָבַב) in its original sense of fatness (or perhaps of folding); a cake (either as fried or turned): - cake.
; a primitive root; also as denominative from h3843 (לְבֵנָה) to be (or become) white; to make bricks: - make brick, be (made, make) white(-r).
; or (Genesis 49:12) לָבֵן; from h3835 (לָבַן); white: - white.
; the same as h3836 (לָבָן); Laban, a Mesopotamian; also a place in the Desert: - Laban.
; or לְבָנָה; the same as h3842 (לְבָנָה); Lebana or Lebanah, one of the Nethinim: - Lebana, Lebanah.
; from h3835 (לָבַן); some sort of whitish tree, perhaps the storax: - poplar.
; from h3835 (לָבַן); properly, whiteness, i.e. (by implication) transparency: - paved.
; the same as h3839 (לִבְנֶה); Libnah, a place in the Desert and one in Palestine: - Libnah.
; from h3835 (לָבַן); properly, (the) white, i.e. the moon: - moon. See also h3838 (לְבָנָא).
; from h3835 (לָבַן); a brick (from the whiteness of the clay): - (altar of) brick, tile.
; from h3825 (לְבַב); (the) white mountain (from its snow); Lebanon, a mountain range in Palestine: - Lebanon.
; from h3835 (לָבַן); white; Libni, an Israelite: - Libni.
; patronymically from h3845 (לִבְנִי); a Libnite or descendants of Libni (collectively): - Libnites.

; or לָבֵשׁ; a primitive root; properly, wrap around, i.e. (by implication) to put on agarment or clothe (oneself, or another), literally or figuratively: - (in) apparel, arm, array (self), clothe (self), come upon, put (on, upon), wear.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h3847 (לָבַשׁ) {properly, wrap around, i.e. (by implication) to put on agarment or clothe (oneself, or another), literally or figuratively}: - clothe.
; from an unused root apparently meaning to deepen or hollow (like h3537 (כַּד)); a log or measure forliquids: - log (of oil).
; from an unused root of uncertain signification; Lod, a place in Palestine: - Lod.
; from an usused root meaning to gleam; a flash; figuratively, a sharply polished blade or point of aweapon: - blade, bright, flame, glittering.
; or לַהֶבֶת; feminine of h3851 (לַהַב), and meaning the same {a flash; figuratively, a sharply polished blade or point of aweapon}: - flame(-ming), head (of a spear).
; plural of h3851 (לַהַב); flames; Lehabim, a son of Mizraim, and his descendants: - Lehabim.
; from an unused root meaning to be eager; intense mental application: - study.
; from an unused root meaning to glow (compare h3851 (לַהַב)) or else to be earnest (compare h3854 (לַהַג)); Lahad, an Israelite: - Lahad.
; a primitive root meaning properly, to burn, i.e. (by implication) to be rabid (figuratively, insane); also (from the exhaustion of frenzy) to languish: - faint, mad.
; a primitive root; properly, to lick, i.e. (by implication) to blaze: - burn (up), set on fire, flaming, kindle.
; from h3857 (לָהַט); a blaze; also (from the idea of enwrapping) magic (as covert): - flaming, enchantment.
; a primitive root; properly, to burn in, i.e. (figuratively) to rankle: - wound.
; from the prepositional prefix meaning to or for and h2005 (הֵן); popularly for if; hence, therefore: - for them (by mistake for prepositional suffix).
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h3860 (לָהֵן); therefore; also except: - but, except, save, therefore, wherefore.
; probably from an unused root meaning to gather; an assembly: - company.
; or לֻא; or לוּ; a conditional particle; if; by implication (interj. as a wish) would that!: - if (haply), peradventure, I pray thee, though, I would, would God (that).

; or לֻבִּי; (Daniel 11:43), partrial from a name probably derived from an unused root meaning to thirst, i.e. a dry region; apparently a Libyan or inhabitant of interior Africa (only in plural): - Lubim(-s), Libyans.
; probably of foreign derivation; Lud, the name of two nations: - Lud, Lydia.
; or לוּדִיִּי; patrial from h3865 (לוּד); a Ludite or inhabitants of Lud (only in plural): - Ludim. Lydians.

; a primitive root; properly, to twine, i.e. (by implication) to unite, to remain; also to borrow (as a form of obligation) or (caus.) to lend: - abide with, borrow(-er), cleave, join (self), lend(-er).
; a primitive root; (compare h3867 (לָוָה), h3874 (לוּט) and h3885 (לוּן)) to turn aside , i.e. (literally) to depart, (figuratively) be perverse: - depart, froward, perverse(-ness).
; probably of foreign origin; some kind of nuttree, perhaps the almond: - hazel.
; probably from h3869 (לוּז) (as growing there); Luz, the name of two places in Palestine: - Luz.
; or לֻחַ; from a primitive root; probably meaning to glisten; a tablet (as polished), of stone, wood or metal: - board, plate, table.
; or לֻחוֹת; (Jeremiah 48:5), from the same as h3871 (לוּחַ); floored; Luchith, a place East of the Jordan: - Luhith.
; active participle of h3907 (לָחַשׁ); (the) enchanter; Lochesh, an Israelite: - Hallohesh, Haloshesh (includ. the article).
; a primitive root; to wrap up: - cast, wrap.
; from h3874 (לוּט); a veil: - covering.
; the same as h3875 (לוֹט); Lot, Abraham's nephew: - Lot.
; from h3875 (לוֹט); covering; Lotan, an Idumaean: - Lotan.
; from h3867 (לָוָה); attached; Levi, a son of Jacob: - Levi. See also h3879 (לֵוִי), h3881 (לֵוִיִּי).
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h3880 (לִוְיָה) {something attached, i.e. a wreath}: - Levite.
; from h3867 (לָוָה); something attached, i.e. a wreath: - ornament.
; or לֵוִי; patronymically from h3878 (לֵוִי); a Levite or descendant of Levi: - Leviite.

; from h3867 (לָוָה); a wreathed animal, i.e. a serpent (especially the crocodile or some other large sea-monster); figuratively, the constellation of the dragon; also as a symbol of Babylon: - leviathan, mourning.
; from an unused root meaning to fold back; a spiral step: - winding stair. Compare h3924 (לֻלָאָה).
; or לוּלֵי; from h3863 (לוּא) and h3808 (לֹא); if not: - except, had not, if (...not), unless, were it not that.

; or לִין; a primitive root; to stop (usually over night); by implication, to stay permanently; hence (in a bad sense) to be obstinate (especially in words, to complain): - abide (all night), continue, dwell, endure, grudge, be left, lie all night, (cause to) lodge (all night, in, -ing, this night), (make to) murmur, remain, tarry (all night, that night).
; a primitive root; to gulp; figuratively, to be rash: - swallow down (up).

; a primitive root; properly, to make mouths at, i.e. to scoff; hence (from the effort to pronounce a foreign language) to interpret, or (generally) intercede: - ambassador, have in derision, interpreter, make a mock, mocker, scorn(-er, -ful), teacher.
; a primitive root; to knead: - knead.
; from h3888 (לוּשׁ); kneading; Lush, a place in Palestine: - Laish (from the margin). Compare h3919 (לַיִשׁ).
; (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to h3867 (לָוָה); properly, adhesion, i.e. (as preposition) with: - [idiom] thee.
; from h3868 (לוּז); perverseness: - perverse.
; from an unused root meaning to be new; fresh, i.e. unused or undried: - green, moist.
; from the same as h3892 (לַח); freshness, i.e. vigor: - natural force.
; or לָחֻם; passive participle of h3898 (לָחַם); properly, eaten, i.e. food; also flesh, i.e. body: - while...is eating, flesh.
; from an unused root meaning to be soft; the cheek (from its fleshiness); hence, the jaw-bone: - cheek (bone), jaw (bone).
; a form of h3895 (לְחִי); Lechi, a place in Palestine: - Lehi. Compare also h7437 (רָמַת לֶחִי).
; a primitive root; to lick: - lick (up).
; a primitive root; to feed on; figuratively, to consume; by implication, to battle (as destruction): - devour, eat, [idiom] ever, fight(-ing), overcome, prevail, (make) war(-ring).
; from h3898 (לָחַם); See also h1036 (בֵּית לְעַפְרָה) food (for man or beast), especially bread, or grain (for making it): - (shew-) bread, [idiom] eat, food, fruit, loaf, meat, victuals.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h3899 (לֶחֶם) {(for man or beast), especially bread, or grain (for making it)}: - feast.
; from h3898 (לָחַם), battle: - war.
; from h3899 (לֶחֶם); foodful; (or perhaps erroneous transcription) for h1022 (בֵּית הַלַּחְמִי) Lachmi, an Israelite; or rather probably a brief form: - Lahmi. See also h3433 (יָשֻׁבִי לֶחֶם).
; probably by erroneous transcription for לַחְמָם; from h3899 (לֶחֶם); food-like; Lachmam or Lachmas, a place in Palestine: - Lahmam.
; (Aramaic) from an unused root of uncertain meaning; a concubine: - concubine.
; a primitive root; properly, to press, i.e. (figuratively) to distress: - afflict, crush, force, hold fast, oppress(-or), thrust self.
; from h3905 (לָחַץ); distress: - affliction, oppression.
; a primitive root; to whisper; by implication, to mumble aspell (as a magician): - charmer, whisper (together).

; from h3907 (לָחַשׁ); properly, a whisper, i.e. by implication, (in a good sense) a private prayer, (in a bad one) an incantation; concretely, an amulet: - charmed, earring, enchantment, orator, prayer.

; a form of h3814 (לָאט) or else participle from h3874 (לוּט); properly, covered, i.e. secret; by implication, incantation; also secrecy or (adverb) covertly: - enchantment, privily, secretly, softly.
; probably from h3874 (לוּט); a gum (from its sticky nature), probably ladanum: - myrrh.
; from an unused root meaning to hide; a kind of lizard (from its covert habits): - lizard.
; masculine plural of passive participle of h3913 (לָטַשׁ); hammered (i.e. oppressed) ones; Letushim, an Arabian tribe: - Letushim.
; a primitive root; properly, to hammer out (an edge), i.e. to sharpen: - instructer, sharp(-en), whet.
; a form of h3880 (לִוְיָה); a wreath: - addition.
; or (Isaiah 21:11) לֵיל; also לַיְלָה; from the same as h3883 (לוּל); properly, a twist (away of the light), i.e. night; figuratively, adversity: - (mid-)night (season).
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h3815 (לָאֵל) {Lael an Israelite}: - night.
; from h3915 (לַיִל); a night spectre: - screech owl.
; from h3888 (לוּשׁ) in the sense of crushing; a lion (from his destructive blows): - (old) lion.
; the same as h3918 (לַיִשׁ); Laish, the name of two places in Palestine: - Laish. Compare h3889 (לוּשׁ).

; a primitive root; to catch (in a net, trap or pit); generally, to capture or occupy; also to choose (by lot); figuratively, to cohere: - [idiom] at all, catch (self), be frozen, be holden, stick together, take.
; from h3920 (לָכַד); something to capture with, i.e. a noose: - being taken.
; from h3212 (יָלַךְ); a journey; Lekah, a place in Palestine: - Lecah.
; from an unused root of uncertain meaning; Lakish, a place in Palestine: - Lachish.
; from the same as h3883 (לוּל); a loop: - loop.

; a primitive root; properly, to goad, i.e. (by implication) to teach (the rod being an Oriental incentive): - (un-) accustomed, [idiom] diligently, expert, instruct, learn, skilful, teach(-er, -ing).
; a prolonged and separable form of the prepositional prefix; to or for: - at, for, to, upon.
; or לְמוֹאֵל; from h3926 (לְמוֹ) and h0410 (אֵל); (belonging) to God; Lemuel or Lemoel, a symbolic name of Solomon: - Lemuel.
; or לִמֻּד; from h3925 (לָמַד); instructed: - accustomed, disciple, learned, taught, used.
; from an unused root of uncertain meaning; Lemek, the name of two antediluvian patriarchs: - Lamech.
; from h3886 (לוּעַ); the gullet: - throat.
; a primitive root; to deride: - mock.
; a primitive root; to deride; by implication (as if imitating a foreigner) to speak unintelligibly: - have in derision, laugh (to scorn), mock (on), stammering.
; from h3932 (לָעַג); derision, scoffing: - derision, scorn (-ing).
; from h3932 (לָעַג); a buffoon; also a foreigner: - mocker, stammering.
; from an unused root of uncertain meaning; Ladah, an Israelite: - Laadah.
; from the same as h3935 (לַעְדָּה); Ladan, the name of two Israelites: - Laadan.
; a primitive root; to speak in a foreign tongue: - strange language.
; a primitive root; to swallow greedily; causatively, to feed: - feed.
; from an unused root supposed to mean to curse; wormwood (regarded as poisonous, and therefore accursed): - hemlock, wormwood.
; or לַפִּד; from an unused root probably meaning to shine; a flambeau, lamp or flame: - (fire-) brand, (burning) lamp, lightning, torch.
; feminine plural of h3940 (לַפִּיד); Lappidoth, the husband of Deborah: - Lappidoth.
; from the prepositional prefix (to or for) and h6440 (פָּנִים); anterior: - before.
; a primitive root; properly, to bend, i.e. (by implication) to clasp; also (reflexively) to turn around or aside: - take hold, turn aside (self).
; from h3887 (לוּץ); derision: - scornful(-ning).
; a primitive root; to deride: - scorn.
; from an unused root thought to mean to stop up by a barricade; perhaps fortification; Lakkum, a place in Palestine: - Lakum.

; a primitive root; to take (in the widest variety of applications): - accept, bring, buy, carry away, drawn, fetch, get, infold, [idiom] many, mingle, place, receive(-ing), reserve, seize, send for, take (away, -ing, up), use, win.

; from h3947 (לָקַח); properly, something received, i.e. (mentally) instruction (whether on the part of the teacher or hearer); also (in an active and sinister sense) inveiglement: - doctrine, learning, fair speech.
; from h3947 (לָקַח); learned; Likchi, an Israelite: - Likhi.
; a primitive root; properly, to pick up, i.e. (generally) to gather; specifically, to glean: - gather (up), glean.
; from h3950 (לָקַט); the gleaning: - gleaning.
; a primitive root; to lick or lap: - lap, lick.
; a primitive root; to gather the after crop: - gather.
; from h3953 (לָקַשׁ); the after crop: - latter growth.
; from an unused root of uncertain meaning; apparently juice, i.e. (figuratively) vigor; also a sweet or fat cake: - fresh, moisture.

; or לָשֹׁן; also (in plural) feminine לְשֹׁנָה; from h3960 (לָשַׁן); the tongue (of man or animals), used literally (as the instrument of licking, eating, or speech), and figuratively (speech, an ingot, a fork of flame, a cove of water): - [phrase] babbler, bay, [phrase] evil speaker, language, talker, tongue, wedge.
; from an unused root of uncertain meaning; a room in a building (whether for storage, eating, or lodging): - chamber, parlour. Compare h5393 (נִשְׁכָּה).
; from an unused root of uncertain meaning; a gem, perhaps the jacinth: - ligure.
