; dual of a primitive noun (but used in a singular sense); water; figuratively, juice; by euphemism, urine, semen: - [phrase] piss, wasting, water(-ing, (-course, -flood, -spring)).
; a form for h4509 (מִנְיָמִין); Mijamin, the name of three Israelites: - Miamin, Mijamin.
; from an unused root meaning to portion out; a sort, i.e. species: - kind. Compare h4480 (מִן).
; properly, feminine passive participle of h3245 (יָסַד); something founded, i.e. a foundation: - foundation.
; from h5526 (סָכַךְ); a portico (as covered): - covert.
; from h4160 (מוּץ); pressure: - churning, forcing, wringing.
; from h4185 (מוּשׁ); departure; Mesha, a place in Arabia; also an Israelite: - Mesha.
; from h4310 (מִי) and h0410 (אֵל) with the abbreviated form insep. relatively (see h0834 (אֲשֶׁר)) interposed; who (is) what God (is) ?; Mishael, the name of three Israelites: - Mishael.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h4332 (מִישָׁאֵל); Mishael, an Israelite: - Mishael.

; or מִישֹׁר; from h3474 (יָשַׁר); a level, i.e. a plain (often used (with the article prefix) as a proper name of certain districts); figuratively, concord; also straightness, i.e. (figuratively) justice (sometimes adverbially, justly): - equity, even place, plain, right(-eously), (made) straight, uprightness.
; borrowed from h4336 (מֵישַׁךְ); Meshak, an Israelite: - Meshak.
; (Aramaic) of foreign origin and doubtful significance; name of h4333 (מִישָׁאֵל) Meshak, the Babylonian: - Meshak.
; from h3467 (יָשַׁע); safety; Mesha, an Israelite: - Mesha.
; a variation for h4337 (מֵישָׁע); safety; Mesha, a Moabite: - Mesha.

; from h3474 (יָשַׁר); evenness, i.e. (figuratively) prosperity or concord; also straightness, i.e. (figuratively) rectitude (only in plural with singular sense; often adverbially): - agreement, aright, that are equal, equity, (things that are) right(-eously, things), sweetly, upright(-ly, -ness).
; from h3498 (יָתַר); (compare h3499 (יֶתֶר)) a cord (of a tent); or the string (of a bow): - cord, string.
; sometimes מַכְאוֹב; also (feminine Isaiah 53:3) מַכְאֹבָה; from h3510 (כָּאַב); anguish or (figuratively) affliction: - grief, pain, sorrow.
; transitive participle of h3527 (כָּבַר); plenty: - abundance.
; from the same as h3522 (כַּבּוֹן); knoll; Macbena, a place in Palestine settled by him: - Machbenah.
; patrial from h4343 (מַכְבֵּנָא); a Macbannite or native of Macbena: - Machbanai.
; from h3527 (כָּבַר) in the sense of covering (compare h3531 (כְּבָרָה)); a grate: - grate.
; from h3527 (כָּבַר) in the sense of covering; (compare h4345 (מַכְבֵּר)) a cloth (as netted): - thick cloth.

; or (masculine) מַכֶּה; (plural only) from h5221 (נָכָה); a blow (in 2 Chronicles 2:10, of the flail); by implication, a wound; figuratively, carnage, also pestilence: - beaten, blow, plague, slaughter, smote, [idiom] sore, stripe, stroke, wound(-ed).
; from h3554 (כָּוָה); a burn: - that burneth, burning.
; from h3559 (כּוּן); properly, a fixture, i.e. a basis; generally a place, especially as an abode: - foundation, habitation, (dwelling-, settled) place.
; or מְכֹנָה; feminine of h4349 (מָכוֹן); a pedestal, also a spot: - base.
; or מְכֹרָה; from the same as h3564 (כּוּר) in the sense of dipping; origin (as if a mine): - birth, habitation, nativity.
; probably from h4134 (מוּךְ); pining; Maki, an Israelite: - Machi.
; from h4376 (מָכַר); salesman; Makir, an Israelite: - Machir.
; patronymical from h4353 (מָכִיר); a Makirite or descendant of Makir: - of Machir.
; a primitive root; to tumble (in ruins); figuratively, to perish: - be brought low, decay.
; or מִכְלָה; from h3607 (כָּלָא); a pen (for flocks): - (sheep-)fold. Compare h4357 (מִכְלָה).
; from h3615 (כָּלָה); completion (in plural concrete adverbial, wholly): - perfect. Compare h4356 (מִכְלָאָה).
; from h3634 (כָּלַל); perfection (i.e. concrete adverbial, splendidly): - most gorgeously, all sorts.
; from h3634 (כָּלַל); perfection (of beauty): - perfection.
; from h3634 (כָּלַל); something perfect, i.e. a splendid garment: - all sorts.
; from h0398 (אָכַל); nourishment: - food.
; from the same as h3646 (כַּמֹּן) in the sense of hiding; treasure (as hidden): - treasure.
; (Ezra 2:2 or מִכְמָשׁ; or מִכְמַשׁ; (Nehemiah 11:31), from h3647 (כָּמַס); hidden; Mikmas or Mikmash, a place in Palestine: - Mikmas, Mikmash.
; or מִכְמֹר; from h3648 (כָּמַר) in the sense of blackening by heat; a (hunter's) net (as dark from concealment): - net.
; or מִכְמֹרֶת; feminine of h4364 (מַכְמָר); a (fisher's) net: - drag, net.
; apparently from an unused root meaning to hide; concealment; Mikmethath, a place in Palestine: - Michmethath.
; from h4100 (מָה) and h5068 (נָדַב) with a particle interposed; what (is) like (a) liberal (man) ?; Maknadbai, an Israelite: - Machnadebai.
; the same as h4350 (מְכוֹנָה); a base; Mekonah, a place in Palestine: - Mekonah.
; the same as h4350 (מְכוֹנָה); a spot: - base.
; from h3647 (כָּמַס) in the sense of hiding; (only in dual) drawers (from concealing the private parts): - breeches.
; probably from an unused root meaning to enumerate; an assessment (as based upon a census): - tribute.
; from h3680 (כָּסָה); a covering, i.e. weatherboarding: - covering.
; feminine of h4371 (מֶכֶס); an enumeration; by implication, a valuation: - number, worth.

; from h3680 (כָּסָה); a covering, i.e. garment; specifically, a coverlet (for a bed), an awning (from the sun); also the omentum (as covering the intestines): - clothing, to cover, that which covereth.
; from h3717 (כָּפַל); a fold; Makpelah, a place in Palestine: - Machpelah.
; a primitive root; to sell, literally (as merchandise, a daughter in marriage, into slavery), or figuratively (to surrender): - [idiom] at all, sell (away, -er, self).
; from h4376 (מָכַר); merchandise; also value: - pay, price, ware.
; from h5234 (נָכַר); an acquaintance: - acquaintance.
; from h3738 (כָּרָה); a pit (for salt): - (salt-) pit.
; probably from the same as h3564 (כּוּר) in the sense of stabbing; a sword: - habitation.
; from h4376 (מָכַר); salesman; Mikri, an Israelite: - Michri.
; patrial from an unused name (the same as h4380 (מְכֵרָה)) of a place in Palestine; a Mekerathite, or inhabitant of Mekerah: - Mecherathite.

; or מִכְשֹׁל; masculine from h3782 (כָּשַׁל); a stumbling-block, literally or figuratively (obstacle, enticement (specifically an idol), scruple): - caused to fall, offence, [idiom] (no-) thing offered, ruin, stumbling-block.
; feminine from h3782 (כָּשַׁל); a stumbling-block, but only figuratively (fall, enticement (idol)): - ruin, stumbling-block.
; from h3789 (כָּתַב); a thing written, the characters, or a document (letter, copy, edict, poem): - writing.
; from h3807 (כָּתַת); a fracture: - bursting.
; from h3799 (כָּתַם); an engraving, i.e. (techn.) a poem: - Michtam.
; from h3806 (כָּתַשׁ); a mortar; by analogy, a socket (of a tooth): - hollow place, mortar.
; the same as h4388 (מַכְתֵּשׁ); dell; the Maktesh, a place in Jerusalem: - Maktesh.

; or מָלָא; (Esther 7:5), a primitive root; to fill or (intransitively) be full of, in a wide application (literally and figuratively): - accomplish, confirm, [phrase] consecrate, be at an end, be expired, be fenced, fill, fulfil, (be, become, [idiom] draw, give in, go) full(-ly, -ly set, tale), (over-) flow, fulness, furnish, gather (selves, together), presume, replenish, satisfy, set, space, take a (hand-) full, [phrase] have wholly.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h4390 (מָלֵא); to fill: - fill, be full.

; from h4390 (מָלֵא); full (literally or figuratively) or filling (literally); also (concretely) fulness; adverbially, fully: - [idiom] she that was with child, fill(-ed, -ed with), full(-ly), multitude, as is worth.

; rarely מְלוֹא; or מְלוֹ; (Ezekiel [41:8), from h4390 (מָלֵא); fulness (literally or figuratively): - [idiom] all along, [idiom] all that is (there-) in, fill, ([idiom] that whereof...was) full, fulness, (hand-) full, multitude.
; from h4390 (מָלֵא); a fulfilling (only in plural), i.e. (literally) a setting (of gems), or (technically) consecration (also concretely, a dedicatory sacrifice): - consecration, be set.
; feminine of h4392 (מָלֵא); something fulfilled, i.e. abundance (of produce): - (first of ripe) fruit, fulness.
; feminine of h4394 (מִלֻּא); a filling, i.e. setting (of gems): - enclosing, setting.
; from an unused root meaning to despatch as a deputy; a messenger; specifically, of God, i.e. an angel (also a prophet, priest or teacher): - ambassador, angel, king, messenger.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h4397 (מֲלְאָךְ); an angel: - angel.

; from the same as h4397 (מֲלְאָךְ); properly, deputyship, i.e. ministry; generally, employment (never servile) or work (abstractly or concretely); also property (as the result of labor): - business, [phrase] cattle, [phrase] industrious, occupation, ([phrase] -pied), [phrase] officer, thing (made), use, (manner of) work((-man), -manship).
; from the same as h4397 (מֲלְאָךְ); a message: - message.
; from the same as h4397 (מֲלְאָךְ); ministrative; Malaki, a prophet: - Malachi.
; from h4390 (מָלֵא); fulness, i.e. (concretely) a plump socket (of the eye): - [idiom] fitly.
; or מַלְבֻּשׁ; from h3847 (לָבַשׁ); a garment, or (collectively) clothing: - apparel, raiment, vestment.
; from h3835 (לָבַן) (denominative); a brickkiln: - brickkiln.

; from h4448 (מָלַל) (plural masculine as if from מִלֶּה; a word; collectively, a discourse; figuratively, a topic: - [phrase] answer, by-word, matter, any thing (what) to say, to speak(-ing), speak, talking, word.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h4405 (מִלָּה); a word, command, discourse, or subject: - commandment, matter, thing. word.
; or מִלֹּא; (2 Kings 12:20), from h4390 (מָלֵא); a rampart (as filled in), i.e. the citadel: - Millo. See also h1037 (בֵּית מִלּוֹא).
; from h4414 (מָלַח); sea-purslain (from its saltness): - mallows.
; or מַלּוּכִי; (Nehemiah 12:14), from h4427 (מָלַךְ); remnant; Malluk, the name of five Israelites: - Malluch, Melichu (from the margin).
; feminine passive participle of h4427 (מָלַךְ); something ruled, i.e. a realm: - kingsom, king's, [idiom] royal.
; from h3885 (לוּן); a lodgment, i.e. caravanserai or encampment: - inn, place where...lodge, lodging (place).
; feminine from h3885 (לוּן); a hut, a hammock: - cottage, lodge.
; apparently from h4448 (מָלַל); I have talked (i.e. loquacious) Mallothi, an Israelite: - Mallothi.

; a primitive root; also as denominative from h4417 (מֶלַח) properly, to rub to pieces or pulverize; intransitively, to disappear as dust; to salt whether internally (to season with salt) or externally (to rub with salt): - [idiom] at all, salt, season, temper together, vanish away.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h4414 (מָלַח); to eat salt, i.e. (generally) subsist: - [phrase] have maintenance.
; (Aramaic) from h4415 (מְלַח); salt: - [phrase] maintenance, salt.
; from h4414 (מָלַח); properly, powder, i.e. (specifically) salt (as easily pulverized and dissolved): - salt(-pit).
; from h4414 (מָלַח) in its original sense; a rag or old garment: - rotten rag.
; from h4414 (מָלַח) in its second. sense; a sailor (as following 'the salt'): - mariner.
; from h4414 (מָלַח) (in its denominative sense); understood as land ( h0776 (אֶרֶץ)) properly, salted (i.e. land), i.e. a desert: - barren land(-ness), salt (land).
; from h3898 (לָחַם) (in the sense of fighting); a battle (i.e. the engagement); generally, war (i.e. warfare): - battle, fight(-ing), war(-rior).

; a primitive root; properly, to be smooth, i.e. (by implication) to escape (as if by slipperiness); causatively, to release or rescue; specifically, to bring forth young, emit sparks: - deliver (self), escape, lay, leap out, let alone, let go, preserve, save, [idiom] speedily, [idiom] surely.
; from h4422 (מָלַט), cement (from its plastic smoothness): - clay.
; from h4423 (מֶלֶט) and h3050 (יָהּ); (whom) Jah has delivered; Melatjah, a Gibeonite: - Melatiah.
; from h4449 (מְלַל) (in the sense of cropping (compare h4135 (מוּל))); a head of grain (as cut off): - ear.
; from h3887 (לוּץ); an aphorism; also a satire: - interpretation, taunting.

; a primitive root; to reign; inceptively, to ascend the throne; causatively, to induct into royalty; hence (by implication) to take counsel: - consult, [idiom] indeed, be (make, set a, set up) king, be (make) queen, (begin to, make to) reign(-ing), rule, [idiom] surely.
; from h4427 (מָלַךְ); a king: - king, royal.
; the same as h4428 (מֶלֶךְ); king; Melek, the name of two Israelites: - Melech, Hammelech (by including the article).
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h4428 (מֶלֶךְ); a king: - king, royal.
; (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to h4427 (מָלַךְ) in the sense of consultation; advice: - counsel.
; from h4427 (מָלַךְ); Molek (i.e. king), the chief deity of the Ammonites: - Molech. Compare h4445 (מַלְכָּם).
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h4436 (מַלְכָּה); a queen: - queen.
; from h3920 (לָכַד); a snare: - trap.
; a form of h4436 (מַלְכָּה); queen; Milcah, the name of a Hebrewess and of an Israelite: - Milcah.
; feminine of h4428 (מֶלֶךְ); a queen: - queen.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h4438 (מַלְכוּת); dominion (abstractly or concretely): - kingdom, kingly, realm, reign.
; or מַלְכֻת; or (in plural) מַלְכֻיָּה; from h4427 (מָלַךְ); a rule; concretely, a dominion: - empire, kingdom, realm, reign, royal.
; from h4428 (מֶלֶךְ) and h0410 (אֵל); king of (i.e. appointed by) God; Malkiel, an Israelite: - Malchiel.
; patronymical from h4439 (מַלְכִּיאֵל); a Malkielite or descendant of Malkiel: - Malchielite.

; or מַלְכִּיָּהוּlemma מַלְכִּיָהוּ missing dagesh, corrected to מַלְכִּיָּהוּ; (Jeremiah [38:6), from h4428 (מֶלֶךְ) and h3050 (יָהּ); king of (i.e. appointed by) Jah; Malkijah, the name of ten Israelites: - Malchiah, Malchijah.
; from h4428 (מֶלֶךְ) and h6664 (צֶדֶק); king of right; Malki-Tsedek, an early king in Palestine: - Melchizedek.
; from h4428 (מֶלֶךְ) and h7311 (רוּם); king of a high one (i.e. of exaltation); Malkiram, an Israelite: - Malchiram.
; from h4428 (מֶלֶךְ) and h7769 (שׁוּעַ); king of wealth; Malkishua, an Israelite: - Malchishua.
; or מִלְכּוֹם; from h4428 (מֶלֶךְ) for h4432 (מֹלֶךְ); Malcam or Milcom, the national idol of the Ammonites: - Malcham, Milcom.
; from h4427 (מָלַךְ); a queen: - queen.
; feminine active participle of h4427 (מָלַךְ); queen; Moleketh, an Israelitess: - Hammoleketh (including the article).
; a primitive root; to speak (mostly poetical) or say: - say, speak, utter.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h4448 (מָלַל); to speak: - say, speak(-ing).
; from h4448 (מָלַל); talkative; Milalai, an Israelite: - Milalai.
; from h3925 (לָמַד); a goad for oxen: - goad.
; a primitive root; to be smooth, i.e. (figuratively) pleasant: - be sweet.
; of Persian derivation; the butler or other officer in the Babylonian court: - Melzar.
; a primitive root; to crack a joint; by implication, to wring the neck of afowl (without separating it): - wring off.
; from h3947 (לָקַח); transitively (in dual) the jaws (as taking food); intransitively, spoil (and captives) (as taken): - booty, jaws, prey.
; from h3953 (לָקַשׁ); (compare h3954 (לֶקֶשׁ)) the spring rain; figuratively, eloquence: - latter rain.
; or מַלְקָח; from h3947 (לָקַח); (only in dual) tweezers: - snuffers, tongs.
; from an unused root meaning to spread out; a wardrobe (i.e. room where clothing is spread): - vestry.
; transp. for h4973 (מְתַלְּעָה); a grinder, i.e. back tooth: - great tooth.
; from h4048 (מָגַר) (in the sense of depositing); a granary: - barn.
; from h4058 (מָדַד); a measure: - measure.
; or (transp.) מוֹמֻכָן; (Esther 1:16), of Persian derivation; Memucan or Momucan, a Persian satrap: - Memucan.
; from h4191 (מוּת); a mortal disease; concretely, a corpse: - death.
; from an unused root meaning to alienate; a mongrel, i.e. born of aJewish father and aheathen mother: - bastard.
; from h4376 (מָכַר); merchandise; abstractly, a selling: - [idiom] ought, (that which cometh of) sale, that which...sold, ware.
; feminine of h4465 (מִמְכָּר); a sale: - [phrase] sold as.
; from h4427 (מָלַךְ); dominion, i.e. (abstractly) the estate (rule) or (concretely) the country (realm): - kingdom, king's, reign, royal.
; a form of h4467 (מַמְלָכָה) and equiv. to it {dominion, i.e. (abstractly) the estate (rule) or (concretely) the country (realm)}: - kingdom, reign.
; from h4537 (מָסַךְ); mixture, i.e. (specifically) wine mixed (with water or spices): - drink-offering, mixed wine.
; from an unused root meaning to grieve; sorrow: - bitterness.
; from h4754 (מָרָא)(in the sense of vigor); lusty; Mamre, an Amorite: - Mamre.
; from h4843 (מָרַר); a bitterness, i.e. (figuratively) calamity: - bitterness.
; from h4886 (מָשַׁח), in the sense of expansion; outspread (i.e. with outstretched wings): - anointed.
; from h4910 (מָשַׁל); a ruler or (abstractly) rule: - dominion, that ruled.
; feminine of h4474 (מִמְשָׁל); rule; also (concretely in plural) a realm or a ruler: - dominion, government, power, to rule.
; from the same as h4943 (מֶשֶׁק); a possession: - breeding.
; from h4985 (מָתַק); something sweet (literally or figuratively): - (most) sweet.
; from h4100 (מָה); literally a whatness (so to speak), i.e. manna (so called from the question about it): - manna.
; (Aramaic) from h4101 (מָה); who or what (properly, interrogatively, hence, also indefinitely and relatively): - what, who(-msoever, [phrase] -so).

; or מִנִּי; or מִנֵּי; (constructive plural) (Isaiah 30:11); for h4482 (מֵן); properly, a part of; hence (prepositionally), from or out of in many senses: - above, after, among, at, because of, by (reason of), from (among), in, [idiom] neither, [idiom] nor, (out) of, over, since, [idiom] then, through, [idiom] whether, with.

; (Aramaic) corresponding to h4480 (מִן) {properly, a part of; hence (prepositionally), from or out of}: - according, after, [phrase] because, [phrase] before, by, for, from, [idiom] him, [idiom] more than, (out) of, part, since, [idiom] these, to, upon, [phrase] when.

; from an unused root meaning to apportion; a part; hence, a musical chord (as parted into strings): - in (the same) (Psalm 68:23), stringed instrument (Psalm 150:4), whereby (Psalm 45:8 (defective plural)).
; (Aramaic) or מְנָה; (Aramaic), corresponding to h4487 (מָנָה); to count, appoint: - number, ordain, set.
; (Aramaic) passive participle of h4483 (מְנָא); numbered: - Mene.
; from h5059 (נָגַן); a satire: - music.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h4093 (מַדָּע); wisdom or intelligence: - knowledge, reason, understanding.
; a primitive root; properly, to weigh out; by implication, to allot or constitute officially; also to enumerate or enroll: - appoint, count, number, prepare, set, tell.
; from h4487 (מָנָה); properly, a fixed weight or measured amount, i.e. (techn.) a maneh or mina: - maneh, pound.
; from h4487 (מָנָה); properly, something weighed out, i.e. (figuratively) a portion of time, i.e. an instance: - time.
; from h4487 (מָנָה); properly, something weighed out, i.e. (generally) a division; specifically (of food) a ration; also a lot: - such things as belonged, part, portion.
; from h5090 (נָהַג); the driving (of a chariot): - driving.
; from h5102 (נָהַר); properly, a channel or fissure, i.e. (by implication) a cavern: - den.
; from h5110 (נוּד) a nodding or toss (of the head in derision): - shaking.
; from h5117 (נוּחַ); quiet, i.e. (concretely) a settled spot, or (figuratively) a home: - (place of) rest.
; the same as h4494 (מָנוֹחַ); rest; Manoach, an Israelite: - Manoah.

; or מְנֻחָה; feminine of h4495 (מָנוֹחַ); repose or (adverbially) peacefully; figuratively, consolation (specifically, matrimony); hence (concretely) an abode: - comfortable, ease, quiet, rest(-ing place), still.
; from h5125 (נוּן); a continuator, i.e. heir: - son.
; from h5127 (נוּס); a retreat (literally or figuratively); abstractly, a fleeing: - [idiom] apace, escape, way to flee, flight, refuge.
; or מְנֻסָה; feminine of h4498 (מָנוֹס); retreat: - fleeing, flight.
; from h5214 (נִיר); a yoke (properly, for plowing), i.e. the frame of aloom: - beam.

; from h5375 (נָשָׂא); properly, (abstractly) a raising (as of the hands in prayer), or rising (of flame); figuratively, an utterance; concretely, a beacon (as raised); a present (as taken), mess, or tribute; figuratively, a reproach (as a burden): - burden, collection, sign of fire, (great) flame, gift, lifting up, mess, oblation, reward.

; a primitive root; to pull out (literally or figuratively): - draw(out).

; or מַשֻּׁאָה; for h4875 (מְשׁוֹאָה); ruin: - desolation, destruction.

; from h7843 (שָׁחַת); destructive, i.e. (as noun) destruction, literally (specifically a snare) or figuratively (corruption): - corruption, (to) destroy(-ing), destruction, trap, [idiom] utterly.

; a primitive root; to draw, used in a great variety of applications (including to sow, to sound, to prolong, to develop, to march, to remove, to delay, to be tall, etc.): - draw (along, out), continue, defer, extend, forbear, [idiom] give, handle, make (pro-, sound) long, [idiom] sow, scatter, stretch out.

; from h7931 (שָׁכַן); a residence (including a shepherd's hut, the lair of animals, figuratively, the grave; also the Temple); specifically, the Tabernacle (properly, its wooden walls): - dwelleth, dwelling (place), habitation, tabernacle, tent.

; denominative from h4912 (מָשָׁל); to liken, i.e. (transitively) to use figurative language (an allegory, adage, song or the like); intransitively, to resemble: - be(-come) like, compare, use (as a) proverb, speak (in proverbs), utter.

; apparently from h4910 (מָשַׁל) in some original sense of superiority in mental action; properly, a pithy maxim, usually of metaphorical nature; hence, a simile (as an adage, poem, discourse): - byword, like, parable, proverb.
; for h4861 (מִשְׁאָל); Mashal, a place in Palestine: - Mashal.
; from h4911 (מָשַׁל); a satire: - byword.
; (1) from h4910 (מָשַׁל); (2) from h4911 (מָשַׁל); empire; a parallel: - dominion, like.

; or מִשְׁלֹחַ; also מִשְׁלָח; from h7971 (שָׁלַח); a sending out, i.e. (abstractly) presentation (favorable), or seizure (unfavorable); also (concretely) a place of dismissal, or a business to be discharged: - to lay, to put, sending (forth), to set.

; from h7999 (שָׁלַם); reconciliation; Meshillemith, an Israelite: - Meshillemith. Compare h4919 (מְשִׁלֵּמוֹת).

; from h8080 (שָׁמַן); fat, i.e. (literally and abstractly) fatness; but usually (figuratively and concretely) a rich dish, a fertile field, a robust man: - fat (one, -ness, -test, -test place).

; feminine of h4926 (מִשְׁמָע); audience, i.e. the royal court; also obedience, i.e. (concretely) a subject: - bidding, guard, obey.

; from h8104 (שָׁמַר); a guard (the man, the post or the prison); a deposit (figuratively); also (as observed) a usage (abstractly), or an example (concretely): - diligence, guard, office, prison, ward, watch.

; feminine of h4929 (מִשְׁמָר); watch, i.e. the act (custody), or (concretely) the sentry, the post; objectively preservation, or (concretely) safe; figuratively observance, i.e. (abstractly) duty or (objectively) a usage or party: - charge, keep, or to be kept, office, ordinace, safeguard, ward, watch.

; from h8138 (שָׁנָה); properly, a repetition, i.e. a duplicate (copy of a document), or a double (in amount); by implication, a second (in order, rank, age, quality or location): - college, copy, double, fatlings, next, second (order), twice as much.

; from h8192 (שָׁפָה) (compare h8198 (שִׁפְחָה)); a family, i.e. circle of relatives; figuratively, a class (of persons), a species (of animals) or sort (of things); by extension a tribe or people: - family, kind(-red).

; from h8192 (שָׁפָה); a stall for cattle (only dual): - burden, sheepfold.

; from h8248 (שָׁקָה); properly, causing to drink, i.e. a butler; by implication (intransitively), drink (itself); figuratively, a well-watered region: - butler(-ship), cupbearer, drink(-ing), fat pasture, watered.
; from h8254 (שָׁקַל); weight: - weight.
; from h8259 (שָׁקַף) in its original sense of overhanging; a lintel: - lintel.

; a form for h7796 (שׂוֹרֵק) used denominatively; vineyard; Masrekah, a place in Idumaea: - Masrekah.
; apparently from an unused root meaning to perforate, i.e. hollow out; a pan: - pan.
; a primitive root; to feel of; by implication, to grope: - feel, grope, search.
; from h8354 (שָׁתָה); drink, by implication, drinking (the act); also (by implication) a banquet or (generally) feast: - banquet, drank, drink, feast((-ed), -ing).
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h4960 (מִשְׁתֶּה); a banquet: - banquet.

; or מָתוּק; from h4985 (מָתַק); sweet: - sweet(-er, -ness).

; from an unused root meaning to extend; properly, extent (of time); but used only adverbially (especially with other particle prefixes), when (either relative or interrogative): - long, when.
; or מַתְכֻנֶת; from h8505 (תָּכַן) in the transferred sense of measuring; proportion (in size, number or ingredients): - composition, measure, state, tale.
; from h4100 (מָה) and h8513 (תְּלָאָה); what a trouble!: - what a weariness.

; from h8552 (תָּמַם); wholesomeness; also (adverb) completely: - men (by reading h4962 (מַת)), soundness.

; the same as h4976 (מַתָּן); Mattan, the name of a priest of Baal, and of an Israelite: - Mattan.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h4979 (מַתָּנָה) {a present; specifically (in a good sense), a sacrificial offering, (in a bad sense) a bribe}: - gift.
; feminine of h4976 (מַתָּן); a present; specifically (in a good sense), a sacrificial offering, (in a bad sense) a bribe: - gift.

; probably patrial from an unused noun meaning slenderness; a Mithnite, or inhabitant of Methen: - Mithnite.
; from h4976 (מַתָּן); liberal; Mattenai, the name of three Israelites: - Mattenai.
; or מַתַּנְיָהוּ; from h4976 (מַתָּן) and h3050 (יָהּ); gift of Jah; Mattanjah, the name of ten Israelites: - Mattaniah.
; from h5375 (נָשָׂא); (used as abstractly) supreme exaltation: - exalted.
; a primitive root; to suck, by implication, to relish, or (intransitively) be sweet: - be (made, [idiom] take) sweet.
; from h4985 (מָתַק); figuratively, pleasantness (of discourse): - sweetness.
; from h4985 (מָתַק); sweetness: - sweetness.
; from h4985 (מָתַק); a dainty, i.e. (generally) food: - feed sweetly.
; feminine of h4987 (מֹתֶק); sweetness; Mithkah, a place in the Desert: - Mithcah.
; of Persian origin; Mithredath, the name of two Persians: - Mithredath.
; feminine of h4976 (מַתָּן) abbreviated form; a present: - gift.
; for h4993 (מַתִּתְיָה); gift of Jah; Mattattah, an Israelite: - Mattathah.
; or מַתִּתְיָהוּ; from h4991 (מַתָּת) and h3050 (יָהּ); gift of Jah; Mattithjah, the name of four Israelites: - Mattithiah. n

; a primitive particle of incitement and entreaty, which may usually be rendered; 'I pray', 'now', or 'then'; added mostly to verbs (in the Imperative or Future), or to interjections, occasionally to an adverb or conjunction: - I beseech (pray) thee (you), go to, now, oh.
; apparently from h5106 (נוּא) in the sense of harshness from refusal; properly, tough, i.e. uncooked (flesh): - raw.
; of Egyptian origin; No (i.e. Thebes), the capital of Upper Egypt: - No. Compare h0528 (אָמוֹן).
; or נאוֹדlemma נֹאוד vowel, corrected to נאוֹדxlit nôʼwd corrected to nʼôwd; also (feminine) נֹאדָה; from an unused root of uncertain signification; a (skin or leather) bag (for fluids): - bottle.
; a primitive root; properly, to be at home, i.e. (by implication) to be pleasant (or suitable), i.e. beautiful: - be beautiful, become, be comely.
; from h4998 (נָאָה); a home; figuratively, a pasture: - habitation, house, pasture, pleasant place.
; from h4998 (נָאָה) or h5116 (נָוֶה); suitable, or beautiful: - becometh, comely, seemly.
; a primitive root; properly, to whisper, i.e. (by implication) to utter as aoracle: - say.
; from h5001 (נָאַם); an oracle: - (hath) said, saith.
; a primitive root; to commit adultery; figuratively, to apostatize: - adulterer(-ess), commit(-ing) adultery, woman that breaketh wedlock.
; from h5003 (נָאַף); adultery: - adultery.
; from h5003 (נָאַף); adultery: - adultery.
; a primitive root; in Ecclesiastes 12:5, by interchange for h5132 (נוּץ), to bloom to scorn;: - abhor, (give occasion to) blaspheme, contemn, despise, flourish, [idiom] great, provoke.
; or נֶאָצָה; from h5006 (נָאַץ); scorn: - blasphemy.
; a primitive root; to groan: - groan.
; from h5008 (נָאַק); a groan: - groaning.
; a primitive root; to reject: - abhor, make void.
; the same as h5108 (נוֹב); fruit; Nob, a place in Palestine: - Nob.
; a primitive root; to prophesy, i.e. speak (or sing) by inspiration (in prediction or simple discourse): - prophesy(-ing), make self a prophet.

; (Aramaic) corresponding to h5012 (נָבָא) {to prophesy, i.e. speak (or sing) by inspiration (in prediction or simple discourse) to prophesy, i.e. speak (or sing) by inspiration (in prediction or simple discourse)}: - prophesy.
; a primitive root; to pierce; to be hollow, or (figuratively) foolish: - hollow, vain.
; probably of foreign derivation; Nebo, the name of a Babylonian deity, also of a mountain in Moab, and of a place in Palestine: - Nebo.
; from h5012 (נָבָא); a prediction (spoken or written): - prophecy.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h5016 (נְבוּאָה); inspired teaching: - prophesying.
; of foreign origin; Nebuzaradan, a Babylonian general: - Nebuzaradan.

; or נְבֻּכַדְנֶאצַּר; (2 Kings 24:1,10), or נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּר; (Esther 2:6; Daniel 1:18), or נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּר; or נְבוּכַדְרֶאצּוֹר; (Ezra 2:1; Jeremiah 49:28), or foreign derivation; Nebukadnetstsar (or -retstsar, or -retstsor), king of Babylon: - Nebuchadnezzar, Nebuchadrezzar.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h5019 (נְבוּכַדְנֶאצַּר) {Nebukadnetstsar (or -retstsar, or -retstsor), king of Babylon}: - Nebuchadnezzar.
; of foreign derivation; Nebushazban, Nebuchadnezzar's chief eunuch: - Nebushazban.
; feminine plural from the same as h5011 (נֹב); fruits; Naboth, an Israelite: - Naboth.
; (Aramaic) of uncertain derivation; a largess: - reward.
; a primitive root; to bark (as a dog): - bark.
; from h5024 (נָבַח); a bark; Nobach, the name of an Israelite, and of a place East of the Jordan: - Nobah.
; of foreign origin; Nibchaz, a deity of the Avites: - Nibhaz.
; a primitive root; to scan, i.e. look intently at; by implication, to regard with pleasure, favor or care: - (cause to) behold, consider, look (down), regard, have respect, see.
; from h5027 (נָבַט); regard; Nebat, the father of Jeroboam I: - Nebat.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h5030 (נָבִיא); a prophet: - prophet.
; from h5012 (נָבָא); a prophet or (generally) inspired man: - prophecy, that prophesy, prophet.
; feminine of h5030 (נָבִיא); a prophetess or (generally) inspired woman; by implication, a poetess; by association a prophet's wife: - prophetess.
; or נְבָיֹת; feminine plural from h5107 (נוּב); fruitfulnesses; Nebajoth, a son of Ismael, and the country settled by him: - Nebaioth, Nebajoth.
; from an unused root meaning to burst forth; a fountain: - spring.

; a primitive root; to wilt; generally, to fall away, fail, faint; figuratively, to be foolish or (morally) wicked; causatively, to despise, disgrace: - disgrace, dishounour, lightly esteem, fade (away, -ing), fall (down, -ling, off), do foolishly, come to nought, [idiom] surely, make vile, wither.

; or נֵבֶל; from h5034 (נָבֵל); a skin-bag for liquids (from collapsing when empty); hence, a vase (as similar in shape when full); also a lyre (as having a body of like form): - bottle, pitcher, psaltery, vessel, viol.
; from h5034 (נָבֵל); stupid; wicked (especially impious): - fool(-ish, -ish man, -ish woman), vile person.
; the same as h5036 (נָבָל); dolt; Nabal, an Israelite: - Nabal.

; from h5034 (נָבֵל); a flabby thing, i.e. a carcase or carrion (human or bestial, often collectively); figuratively, an idol: - (dead) body, (dead) carcase, dead of itself, which died, (beast) that (which) dieth of itself.
; feminine of h5036 (נָבָל); foolishness, i.e. (morally) wickedness; concretely, a crime; by extension, punishment: - folly, vile, villany.
; from h5036 (נָבָל); properly, disgrace, i.e. the (female) pudenda: - lewdness.
; apparently from h5036 (נָבָל) and h3909 (לָט); foolish secrecy; Neballat, a place in Palestine: - Neballat.
; a primitive root; to gush forth; figuratively, to utter (good or bad words); specifically, to emit (a foul odor): - belch out, flowing, pour out, send forth, utter (abundantly).
; (Aramaic) from an unused root meaning to shine; a light; plural (collectively) a chandelier: - candlestick.
; of uncertain derivation; Nibshan, a place in Palestine: - Nibshan.

; from an unused root meaning to be parched; the south (from its drought); specifically, the Negeb or southern district of Judah, occasionally, Egypt (as south to Palestine): - south (country, side, -ward).

; a primitive root; properly, to front, i.e. stand boldly out opposite; by implication (causatively), to manifest; figuratively, to announce (always by word of mouth to one present); specifically, to expose, predict, explain, praise: - bewray, [idiom] certainly, certify, declare(-ing), denounce, expound, [idiom] fully, messenger, plainly, profess, rehearse, report, shew (forth), speak, [idiom] surely, tell, utter.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h5046 (נָגַד); to flow (through the idea of clearing the way): - issue.

; from h5046 (נָגַד); a front, i.e. part opposite; specifically a counterpart, or mate; usually (adverbial, especially with preposition) over against or before: - about, (over) against, [idiom] aloof, [idiom] far (off), [idiom] from, over, presence, [idiom] other side, sight, [idiom] to view.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h5048 (נֶגֶד); opposite: - toward.
; a primitive root; to glitter; causatively, to illuminate: - (en-) lighten, (cause to) shine.
; from h5050 (נָגַהּ); brilliancy (literally or figuratively): - bright(-ness), light, (clear) shining.
; the same as h5051 (נֹגַהּ); Nogah, a son of David: - Nogah.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h5051 (נֹגַהּ); dawn: - morning.
; feminine of h5051 (נֹגַהּ); splendor: - brightness.
; a primitive root; to butt with the horns; figuratively, to war against: - gore, push (down, -ing).
; from h5055 (נָגַח); butting, i.e. vicious: - used (wont) to push.

; or נָגִד; from h5046 (נָגַד); a commander (as occupying the front), civil, military or religious; generally (abstractly, plural), honorable themes: - captain, chief, excellent thing, (chief) governor, leader, noble, prince, (chief) ruler.

; or נְגִינַת; (Psalm 61:title), from h5059 (נָגַן); properly, instrumental music; by implication, a stringed instrument; by extension, a poem set to music; specifically, an epigram: - stringed instrument, musick, Neginoth (plural), song.

; a primitive root; properly, to thrum, i.e. beat atune with the fingers; expectation. to play on astringed instrument; hence (generally), to make music: - player on instruments, sing to the stringed instruments, melody, ministrel, play(-er, -ing).

; a primitive root; properly, to touch, i.e. lay the hand upon (for any purpose; euphemistically, to lie with a woman); by implication, to reach (figuratively, to arrive, acquire); violently, to strike (punish, defeat, destroy, etc.): - beat, ([idiom] be able to) bring (down), cast, come (nigh), draw near (nigh), get up, happen, join, near, plague, reach (up), smite, strike, touch.
; from h5060 (נָגַע); a blow (figuratively, infliction); also (by implication) a spot (concretely, a leprous person or dress): - plague, sore, stricken, stripe, stroke, wound.
; a primitive root; to push, gore, defeat, stub (the toe), inflict (a disease): - beat, dash, hurt, plague, slay, smite (down), strike, stumble, [idiom] surely, put to the worse.
; from h5062 (נָגַף); a trip (of the foot); figuratively, an infliction (of disease): - plague, stumbling.
; a primitive root; to flow; figuratively, to stretch out; causatively, to pour out or down; figuratively, to deliver over: - fall, flow away, pour down (out), run, shed, spilt, trickle down.
; a primitive root; to drive (an animal, a workman, a debtor, an army); by implication, to tax, harass, tyrannize: - distress, driver, exact(-or), oppress(-or), [idiom] raiser of taxes, taskmaster.

; a primitive root; to be or come (causatively, bring) near (for any purpose); euphemistically, to lie with a woman; as an enemy, to attack; religious to worship; causatively, to present; figuratively, to adduce an argument; by reversal, to stand back: - (make to) approach (nigh), bring (forth, hither, near), (cause to) come (hither, near, nigh), give place, go hard (up), (be, draw, go) near (nigh), offer, overtake, present, put, stand.
; from h5110 (נוּד) in the sense of piling up; a mound, i.e. wave: - heap.
; a primitive root; to impel; hence, to volunteer (as a soldier), to present spontaneously: - offer freely, be (give, make, offer self) willing(-ly).
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h5068 (נָדַב); be (or give) liberal(-ly): - (be minded of...own) freewill (offering), offer freely (willingly).
; from h5068 (נָדַב); liberal; Nadab, the name of four Israelites: - Nadab.

; from h5068 (נָדַב); properly (abstractly) spontaneity, or (adjectively) spontaneous; also (concretely) a spontaneous or (by inference, in plural) abundant gift: - free(-will) offering, freely, plentiful, voluntary(-ily, offering), willing(-ly), offering).
; from h5068 (נָדַב) and h3050 (יָהּ); largess of Jah; Nedabjah, an Israelite: - Nedabiah.
; (Aramaic) from a root meaning to stick; a layer (of building materials): - row.

; a primitive root; properly, to wave to and fro (rarely to flap up and down); figuratively, to rove, flee, or (causatively) to drive away: - chase (away), [idiom] could not, depart, flee ([idiom] apace, away), (re-) move, thrust away, wander (abroad, -er, -ing).
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h5074 (נָדַד); to depart: - go from.
; passive participle of h5074 (נָדַד); properly, tossed; abstractly, a rolling (on the bed): - tossing to and fro.
; or נָדָא; (2 Kings 17:21), a primitive root; properly, to toss; figuratively, to exclude, i.e. banish, postpone, prohibit: - cast out, drive, put far away.
; from h5077 (נָדָה) in the sense of freely flinging money; a bounty (for prostitution): - gifts.

; from h5074 (נָדַד); properly, rejection; by implication, impurity, especially personal (menstruation) or moral (idolatry, incest): - [idiom] far, filthiness, [idiom] flowers, menstruous (woman), put apart, [idiom] removed (woman), separation, set apart, unclean(-ness, thing, with filthiness).

; a primitive root; to push off; used in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively (to expel, mislead, strike, inflict, etc.): - banish, bring, cast down (out), chase, compel, draw away, drive (away, out, quite), fetch a stroke, force, go away, outcast, thrust away (out), withdraw.
; from h5068 (נָדַב); properly, voluntary, i.e. generous; hence, magnanimous; as noun, a grandee (sometimes a tyrant): - free, liberal (things), noble, prince, willing (hearted).
; feminine of h5081 (נָדִיב); properly, nobility, i.e. reputation: - soul.
; probably from an unused root meaning to give; a present (for prostitution): - gift.
; of uncertain derivation; a sheath (of a sword): - sheath.
; (Aramaic) from the same as h5084 (נָדָן); a sheath; figuratively, the body (as the receptacle of the soul): - body.
; a primitive root; to shove asunder, i.e. disperse: - drive (away, to and fro), thrust down, shaken, tossed to and fro.
; a primitive root; to promise (pos., to do or give something to God): - (make a) vow.
; or נֵדֶר; from h5087 (נָדַר); a promise (to God); also (concretely) a thing promised: - vow(-ed).
; from an unused root meaning to lament; lamentation: - wailing.

; a primitive root; to drive forth (a person, an animal or chariot), i.e. lead, carry away; reflexively, to proceed (i.e. impel or guide oneself); also (from the panting induced by effort), to sigh: - acquaint, bring (away), carry away, drive (away), lead (away, forth), (be) guide, lead (away, forth).
; a primitive root; to groan, i.e. bewail; hence (through the idea of crying aloud), to assemble (as if on proclamation): - lament, wail.
; from h5091 (נָהָה); an elegy: - lamentation, wailing.
; feminine of h5092 (נְהִי); lamentation: - doleful.
; (Aramaic) or נְהִירוּ; (Aramaic), from the same as h5105 (נְהָרָה); illumination, i.e. (figuratively) wisdom: - light.
; a primitive root; properly, to run with asparkle, i.e. flow; hence (transitively), to conduct, and (by inference) to protect, sustain: - carry, feed, guide, lead (gently, on).
; or נַהֲלֹל; the same as h5097 (נַהֲלֹל); Nahalal or Nahalol, a place in Palestine: - Nahalal, Nahallal, Nahalol.
; from h5095 (נָהַל); pasture: - bush.
; a primitive root; to growl: - mourn, roar(-ing).
; from h5098 (נָהַם); a snarl: - roaring.
; feminine of h5099 (נַהַם); snarling: - disquietness, roaring.
; a primitive root; to bray (as an ass), scream (from hunger): - bray.
; a primitive root; to sparkle, i.e. (figuratively) be cheerful; hence (from the sheen of a running stream) to flow, i.e. (figuratively) assemble: - flow (together), be lightened.
; (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to h5102 (נָהַר); a river, especially the Euphrates: - river, stream.
; from h5102 (נָהַר); a stream (including the sea; expectation the Nile, Euphrates, etc.); figuratively, prosperity: - flood, river.
; from h5102 (נָהַר) in its original sense; daylight: - light.
; a primitive root; to refuse, forbid, dissuade, or neutralize: - break, disallow, discourage, make of none effect.
; a primitive root; to germinate, i.e. (figuratively) to (causatively, make) flourish; also (of words), to utter: - bring forth (fruit), make cheerful, increase.
; or נֵיב; from h5107 (נוּב); produce, literally or figuratively: - fruit.
; from h5108 (נוֹב); fruitful; Nobai, an Israelite: - Nebai (from the margin).

; a primitive root; to nod, i.e. waver; figuratively, to wander, flee, disappear; also (from shaking the head in sympathy), to console, deplore, or (from tossing the head in scorn) taunt: - bemoan, flee, get, mourn, make to move, take pity, remove, shake, skip for joy, be sorry, vagabond, way, wandering.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h5116 (נָוֶה); to flee: - get away.
; (only defective נֹד ); from h5110 (נוּד); exile: - wandering.
; the same as h5112 (נוֹד)lemma נוֹדּ extra dagesh, corrected to נוֹד; vagrancy; Nod, the land of Cain: - Nod.
; from h5068 (נָדַב); noble; Nodab, an Arab tribe: - Nodab.
; a primitive root; (compare h5116 (נָוֶה)) to rest (as at home); causatively (through the implied idea of beauty ), to celebrate (with praises): - keept at home, prepare an habitation.

; or (feminine) נָוָה; from h5115 (נָוָה); (adjectively) at home; hence (by implication of satisfaction) lovely; also (noun) a home, of God (temple), men (residence), flocks (pasture), or wild animals (den): - comely, dwelling (place), fold, habitation, pleasant place, sheepcote, stable, tarried.

; a primitive root; to rest, i.e. settle down; used in a great variety of applications, literal and figurative, intransitive, transitive and causative (to dwell, stay, let fall, place, let alone, withdraw, give comfort, etc.): - cease, be confederate, lay, let down, (be) quiet, remain, (cause to, be at, give, have, make to) rest, set down. Compare h3241 (יָנִים).
; or נוֹחַ; from h5117 (נוּחַ); quiet: - rest(-ed, -ing place).
; feminine of h5118 (נוּחַ); quietude; Nochah, an Israelite: - Nohah.
; to quake: - be moved.
; from h5115 (נָוָה); residence; Navith, a place in Palestine: - Naioth (from the margin).
; (Aramaic) or נְוָלִי; (Aramaic), from an unused root probably meaning to be foul; a sink: - dunghill.
; a primitive root; to slumber (from drowsiness): - sleep, slumber.
; from h5123 (נוּם); sleepiness: - drowsiness.
; a primitive root; to resprout, i.e. propagate by shoots; figuratively, to be perpetual: - be continued.
; or נוֹן; (1 Chronicles 7:27), from h5125 (נוּן); perpetuity, Nun or Non, the father of Joshua: - Non, Nun.

; a primitive root; to flit, i.e. vanish away (subside, escape; causatively, chase, impel, deliver): - [idiom] abate, away, be displayed, (make to) flee (away, -ing), put to flight, [idiom] hide, lift up a standard.

; a primitive root; to waver, in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively (as subjoined): - continually, fugitive, [idiom] make, to (go) up and down, be gone away, (be) move(-able, -d), be promoted, reel, remove, scatter, set, shake, sift, stagger, to and fro, be vagabond, wag, (make) wander (up and down).
; from h3259 (יָעַד) and h3050 (יָהּ); convened of Jah; Noadjah, the name of an Israelite, and a false prophetess: - Noadiah.

; a primitive root; to quiver (i.e. vibrate up and down, or rock to and fro); used in a great variety of applications (including sprinkling, beckoning, rubbing, bastinadoing, sawing, waving, etc.): - lift up, move, offer, perfume, send, shake, sift, strike, wave.
; from h5130 (נוּף); elevation: - situation. Compare h5297 (נֹף).
; a primitive root; properly, to flash; hence, to blossom (from the brilliancy of color); also, to fly away (from the quickness of motion): - flee away, bud (forth).
; or נֹצָה; feminine active participle of h5327 (נָצָה) in the sense of flying; a pinion (or wing feather); often (collectively) plumage: - feather(-s), ostrich.
; a primitive root; to suckle: - nurse.
; (Aramaic) from an unused root (corresponding to that of h5216 (נִיר)) meaning to shine; fire: - fiery, fire.
; a primitive root; to be sick, i.e. (figuratively) distressed: - be full of heaviness.
; a primitive root; to spirt, i.e. besprinkle (especially in expiation): - sprinkle.
; from h2102 (זוּד); something boiled, i.e. soup: - pottage.

; or נָזִר; from h5144 (נָזַר); separate, i.e. consecrated (as prince, a Nazirite); hence (figuratively from the latter) an unpruned vine (like an unshorn Nazirite): - Nazarite (by a false alliteration with Nazareth), separate(-d), vine undressed.
; a primitive root; to drip, or shed by trickling: - distil, drop, flood, (cause to) flow(-ing), gush out, melt, pour (down), running water, stream.
; from an unused root of uncertain meaning; a nose-ring: - earring, jewel.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to the root of h5143 (נֵזֶק); to suffer (causatively, inflict) loss: - have (en-) damage, hurt(-ful).
; from an unused root meaning to injure; loss: - damage.

; a primitive root; to hold aloof, i.e. (intransitivey) abstain (from food and drink, from impurity, and even from divine worship (i.e. apostatize)); specifically, to set apart (to sacred purposes), i.e. devote: - consecrate, separate(-ing, self).

; or נֵזֶר; from h5144 (נָזַר); properly, something set apart, i.e. (abstractly) dedication (of a priet or Nazirite); hence (concretely) unshorn locks; also (by implication) a chaplet (especially of royalty): - consecration, crown, hair, separation.
; the same as h5118 (נוּחַ); rest; Noach, the patriarch of the flood: - Noah.
; from h2247 (חָבָה); occult; Nachbi, an Israelite: - Nakbi.
; a primitive root; to guide; by implication, to transport (into exile, or as colonists): - bestow, bring, govern, guide, lead (forth), put, straiten.
; from h5162 (נָחַם); comforted; Nechum, an Israelite: - Nehum.
; or נִחֻם; from h5162 (נָחַם); properly, consoled; abstractly, solace: - comfort(-able), repenting.
; from h5162 (נָחַם); comfortable; Nachum, an Israelite prophet: - Nahum.
; from the same as h5170 (נַחַר); snorer; Nochor, the name of the grandfather and a brother of Abraham: - Nahor.

; apparently passive participle of h5172 (נָחַשׁ) (perhaps in the sense of ringing), i.e. bell-metal; or from the red color of the throat of a serpent ( h5175 (נָחָשׁ), as denominative) when hissing); coppery, i.e. (figuratively) hard: - of brass.
; or נְחֻשָׁה; feminine of h5153 (נָחוּשׁ); copper: - brass, steel. Compare h5176 (נָחָשׁ).
; probably denominative from h2485 (חָלִיל); a flute: - (plural) Nehiloth.
; from the same as h5170 (נַחַר); a nostril: - (dual) nostrils.

; a primitive root; to inherit (as a (figurative) mode of descent), or (generally) to occupy; causatively, to bequeath, or (generally) distribute, instate: - divide, have (inheritance), take as a heritage, (cause to, give to, make to) inherit, (distribute for, divide (for, for an, by), give for, have, leave for, take (for)) inheritance, (have in, cause to, be made to) possess(-ion).

; or (feminine) נַחְלָה; (Psalm 124:4), or נַחֲלָה; (Ezekiel 47:19; Ezekiel 48:28), from h5157 (נָחַל) in its original sense; a stream, especially a winter torrent; (by implication) a (narrow) valley (in which a brook runs); also a shaft (of a mine): - brook, flood, river, stream, valley.

; from h5157 (נָחַל) (in its usual sense); properly, something inherited, i.e. (abstractly) occupancy, or (concretely) an heirloom; generally an estate, patrimony or portion: - heritage, to inherit, inheritance, possession. Compare h5158 (נַחַל).
; from h5158 (נַחַל) and h0410 (אֵל); valley of God; Nachaliel, a place in the Desert: - Nahaliel.
; apparently a patronymic from an unused name (apparently passive participle of h2492 (חָלַם)); dreamed; a Nechelamite, or descendant of Nechlam: - Nehelamite.

; a primitive root; properly, to sigh, i.e. breathe strongly; by implication, to be sorry, i.e. (in a favorable sense) to pity, console or (reflexively) rue; or (unfavorably) to avenge (oneself): - comfort (self), ease (one's self), repent(-er,-ing, self).
; from h5162 (נָחַם); consolation; Nacham, an Israelite: - Naham.
; from h5162 (נָחַם); ruefulness, i.e. desistance: - repentance.
; from h5162 (נָחַם); consolation: - comfort.
; from h5162 (נָחַם) and h3050 (יָהּ); consolation of Jah; Nechemjah, the name of three Israelites: - Nehemiah.
; from h5162 (נָחַם); consolatory; Nachamani, an Israelite: - Nahamani.
; for h0587 (אֲנַחְנוּ); we: - we.
; a primitive root; to be urgent: - require haste.
; and (feminine) נַחֲרָה; from an unused root meaning to snort or snore; a snorting: - nostrils, snorting.
; or נַחְרַי; from the same as h5170 (נַחַר); snorer; Nacharai or Nachrai, an Israelite: - Naharai, Nahari.

; a primitive root; properly, to hiss, i.e. whisper a (magic) spell; generally, to prognosticate: - [idiom] certainly, divine, enchanter, (use) [idiom] enchantment, learn by experience, [idiom] indeed, diligently observe.
; from h5172 (נָחַשׁ); an incantation or augury: - enchantment.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h5154 (נְחוּשָׁה); copper: - brass.
; from h5172 (נָחַשׁ); a snake (from its hiss): - serpent.
; the same as h5175 (נָחָשׁ); Nachash, the name of two persons apparently non-Israelite: - Nahash.
; from h5172 (נָחַשׁ); enchanter; Nachshon, an Israelite: - Naashon, Nahshon.

; for h5154 (נְחוּשָׁה); copper, hence, something made of that metal, i.e. coin, a fetter; figuratively, base (as compared with gold or silver): - brasen, brass, chain, copper, fetter (of brass), filthiness, steel.
; from h5178 (נְחֹשֶׁת); copper; Nechushta, an Israelitess: - Nehushta.
; from h5178 (נְחֹשֶׁת); something made of copper, i.e. the copper serpent of the Desert: - Nehushtan.
; a primitive root; to sink, i.e. descend; causatively, to press or lead down: - be broken, (cause to) come down, enter, go down, press sore, settle, stick fast.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h5181 (נָחַת); to descend; causatively, to bring away, deposit, depose: - carry, come down, depose, lay up, place.

; from h5182 (נְחַת); also (intransitively; perhaps from h5117 (נוּחַ)) a descent, i.e. imposition, unfavorable (punishment) or favorable (food); restfulness: - lighting down, quiet(-ness), to rest, be set on.
; the same as h5183 (נַחַת); quiet; Nachath, the name of an Edomite and of two Israelites: - Nahath.
; from h5181 (נָחַת); descending: - come down.

; a primitive root; to stretch or spread out; by implication, to bend away (including moral deflection); used in a great variety of application: - [phrase] afternoon, apply, bow (down, -ing), carry aside, decline, deliver, extend, go down, be gone, incline, intend, lay, let down, offer, outstretched, overthrown, pervert, pitch, prolong, put away, shew, spread (out), stretch (forth, out), take (aside), turn (aside, away), wrest, cause to yield.
; from h5190 (נָטַל); laden: - that bear.
; from h5197 (נָטַף); a pendant for the ears (especially of pearls): - chain, collar.
; from h5203 (נָטַשׁ); a tendril (as an offshoot): - battlement, branch, plant.
; a primitive root; to lift; by implication, to impose: - bear, offer, take up.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h5190 (נָטַל); to raise: - take up.
; ; from h5190 (נָטַל); a burden: - weighty.
; a primitive root; properly, to strike in, i.e. fix; specifically, to plant (literally or figuratively): - fastened, plant(-er).
; from h5193 (נָטַע); a plant; collectively, a plantation; abstractly, a planting: - plant.
; from h5193 (נָטַע); a plant: - plant.
; plural of h5194 (נֶטַע); Netaim, a place in Palestine: - plants.
; a primitive root; to ooze, i.e. distil gradually; by implication, to fall in drops; figuratively, to speak by inspiration: - drop(-ping), prophesy(-et).
; from h5197 (נָטַף); a drop; specifically, an aromatic gum (probably stacte): - drop, stacte.
; from h5197 (נָטַף); distillation; Netophah, a place in Palestine: - Netophah.
; patronymic from h5199 (נְטֹפָה); a Netophathite, or inhabitant of Netophah: - Netophathite.
; a primitive root; to guard; figuratively, to cherish (anger): - bear grudge, keep(-er), reserve.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h5201 (נָטַר); to retain: - keep.

; a primitive root; properly, to pound, i.e. smite; by implication (as if beating out, and thus expanding) to disperse; also, to thrust off, down, out or upon (inclusively, reject, let alone, permit, remit, etc.): - cast off, drawn, let fall, forsake, join (battle), leave (off), lie still, loose, spread (self) abroad, stretch out, suffer.
; a doubtful word; apparently from h5091 (נָהָה); lamentation: - wailing.
; from h5110 (נוּד); motion (of the lips in speech): - moving.
; feminine of h5205 (נִיד); removal, i.e. exile: - removed.
; or נִיחֹחַ; from h5117 (נוּחַ); properly, restful, i.e. pleasant; abstractly, delight: - sweet (odour).
; (Aramaic) or נִיחֹחַ; (shorter) (Aramaic), corresponding to h5207 (נִיחוֹחַ); pleasure: - sweet odour (savour).
; from h5125 (נוּן); progeny: - son.
; of foreign origin; Nineveh, the capital of Assyria: - Nineveh.
; from h5127 (נוּס); fugitive: - that fleeth.
; probably of foreign origin; Nisan, the first month of the Jewish sacred year: - Nisan.
; from h5340 (נָצַץ); a spark: - spark.
; a root probably identical with that of h5216 (נִיר), through the idea of the gleam of a fresh furrow; to till the soil: - break up.
; or נִר; from h5214 (נִיר); properly, plowing, i.e. (concretely) freshly plowed land: - fallow ground, plowing, tillage.

; or נִר; also נֵיר; or נֵר; or (feminine) נֵרָה; from a primitive root (see h5214 (נִיר); h5135 (נוּר)) properly, meaning to glisten; a lamp (i.e. the burner) or light (literally or figuratively): - candle, lamp, light.
; a primitive root; to smite, i.e. drive away: - be viler.
; or נָכָא; from h5217 (נָכָא); smitten, i.e. (figuratively) afflicted: - broken, stricken, wounded.
; from h5218 (נָכֵא); properly, a smiting, i.e. (concretely) an aromatic gum (perhaps styrax) (as powdered): - spicery(-ces).
; from an unused root meaning to propagate; offspring: - nephew, son's son.

; a primitive root; to strike (lightly or severely, literally or figuratively): - beat, cast forth, clap, give (wounds), [idiom] go forward, [idiom] indeed, kill, make (slaughter), murderer, punish, slaughter, slay(-er, -ing), smite(-r, -ing), strike, be stricken, (give) stripes, [idiom] surely, wound.
; from h5221 (נָכָה); a smiter, i.e. (figuratively) traducer: - abject.
; smitten, i.e. (literally) maimed, or (figuratively) dejected: - contrite, lame.
; probably of Egyptian origin; Neko, an Egyptian king: - Necho. Compare h6549 (פַּרְעֹה נְכֹה).
; from h3559 (כּוּן); prepared; Nakon, probably an Israelite: - Nachon.
; from an unused root meaning to be straightforward; properly, the fore part; used adverbially, opposite: - before, over against.

; from the same as h5226 (נֵכַח); properly, the front part; used adverbially (especially with preposition), opposite, in front of, forward, in behalf of: - (over) against, before, direct(-ly), for, right (on).
; from the same as h5226 (נֵכַח); straightforward, i.e. (figuratively), equitable, correct, or (abstractly), integrity: - plain, right, uprightness.
; feminine of h5228 (נָכֹחַ); properly, straightforwardness, i.e. (figuratively) integrity, or (concretely) a truth: - equity, right (thing), uprightness.
; a primitive root; to defraud, i.e. act treacherously: - beguile, conspire, deceiver, deal subtilly.
; from h5230 (נָכַל); deceit: - wile.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h5233 (נֶכֶס) {treasure}: - goods.
; from an unused root meaning to accumulate; treasure: - riches, wealth.

; a primitive root; properly, to scrutinize, i.e. look intently at; hence (with recognition implied), to acknowledge, be acquainted with, care for, respect, revere, or (with suspicion implied), to disregard, ignore, be strange toward, reject, resign, dissimulate (as if ignorant or disowning): - acknowledge, [idiom] could, deliver, discern, dissemble, estrange, feign self to be another, know, take knowledge (notice), perceive, regard, (have) respect, behave (make) self strange(-ly).
; or נֹכֶר; from h5234 (נָכַר); something strange, i.e. unexpected calamity: - strange.
; ' from h5234 (נָכַר); foreign, or (concretely) a foreigner, or (abstractly) heathendom: - alien, strange ([phrase] -er).
; from h5235 (נֶכֶר) (second form); strange, in a variety of degrees and applications (foreign, non-relative, adulterous, different, wonderful): - alien, foreigner, outlandish, strange(-r, woman).
; probably for h5219 (נְכֹאת); spicery, i.e. (generally) valuables: - precious things.
; apparently a primitive root; to complete: - make an end.
; from h0959 (בָּזָה), despised: - vile.
; apparently for h3223 (יְמוּאֵל); Nemuel, the name of two Israelites: - Nemuel.
; from h5241 (נְמוּאֵל); a Nemuelite, or descendant of Nemuel: - Nemuelite.
; a primitive root; to become clipped or (specifically) circumcised: - (branch to) be cut down (off), circumcise.
; feminine from h5243 (נָמַל); an ant (probably from its almost bisected form): - ant.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h5246 (נָמֵר) {a leopard (from its stripes)}: - leopard.
; from an unused root meaning properly, to filtrate, i.e. be limpid (comp h5247 (נִמְרָה) and h5249 (נִמְרִים)); and thus to spot or stain as if by dripping; a leopard (from its stripes): - leopard.
; from the same as h5246 (נָמֵר); clear water; Nimrah, a place East of the Jordan: - Nimrah. See also h1039 (בֵּית נִמְרָה), h5249 (נִמְרִים).
; or נִמְרֹד; probably of foreign origin; Nimrod, a son of Cush: - Nimrod.
; plural of a masculine corresponding to h5247 (נִמְרָה); clear waters; Nimrim, a place East of the Jordan: - Nimrim. Compare h1039 (בֵּית נִמְרָה).
; probably from h4871 (מָשָׁה); extricated; Nimshi, the (grand-) father of Jehu: - Nimshi.
; from h5264 (נָסַס); a flag; also a sail; by implication, a flagstaff; generally a signal; figuratively, a token: - banner, pole, sail, (en-) sign, standard.
; feminine participle passive of h5437 (סָבַב); properly, an environment, i.e. circumstance or turn of affairs: - cause.
; a primitive root; to retreat: - departing away, remove, take (hold), turn away.
; a primitive root; to test; by implication, to attempt: - adventure, assay, prove, tempt, try.
; a primitive root; to tear away: - destroy, pluck, root.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h5255 (נָסַח) {to tear away}: - pull down.
; from h5258 (נָסַךְ); properly, something poured out, i.e. a libation; also a molten image; by implication, a prince (as anointed): - drink offering, duke, prince(-ipal).
; a primitive root; to pour out, especially a libation, or to cast (metal); by analogy, to anoint aking: - cover, melt, offer, (cause to) pour (out), set (up).
; a primitive root (probably identical with h5258 (נָסַךְ) through the idea of fusion); to interweave, i.e. (figuratively) to overspread: - that is spread.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h5258 (נָסַךְ); to pour out a libation: - offer.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h5262 (נֶסֶךְ); a libation: - drink offering.
; or נֵסֶךְ; from h5258 (נָסַךְ); a libation; also a cast idol: - cover, drink offering, molten image.
; a primitive root; to wane, i.e. be sick: - faint.

; a primitive root; to gleam from afar, i.e. to be conspicuous as a signal; or rather perhaps a denominative from h5251 (נֵס) (and identical with h5263 (נָסַס), through the idea of a flag as fluttering in the wind); to raise a beacon: - lift up as an ensign.

; a primitive root; properly, to pull up, especially the tent-pins, i.e. start on ajourney: - cause to blow, bring, get, (make to) go (away, forth, forward, onward, out), (take) journey, march, remove, set aside (forward), [idiom] still, be on his (go their) way.
; a primitive root; to go up: - ascend.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h5266 (נָסַק) {to go up}: - take up.
; of foreign origin; Nisrok, a Babylonian idol: - Nisroch.
; from h5128 (נוּעַ); motion; Neah, a place in Palestine: - Neah.
; from h5128 (נוּעַ); movement; Noah, an Israelitess: - Noah.

; or נָעֻר; and (feminine) נְעֻרָה; properly, passive participle from h5288 (נַעַר) as denominative; (only in plural collectively or emphatic form) youth, the state (juvenility) or the persons (young people): - childhood, youth.
; from h5128 (נוּעַ) and h0410 (אֵל); moved of God; Neiel, a place in Palestine: - Neiel.
; from h5276 (נָעֵם); delightful (objective or subjective, literal or figurative): - pleasant(-ure), sweet.
; a primitive root; also denominative from h5275 (נַעַל) properly, to fasten up, i.e. with abar or cord; hence, to sandal, i.e. furnish with slippers: - bolt, inclose, lock, shoe, shut up.

; or (feminine) נַעֲלָה; from h5274 (נָעַל); properly, a sandal tongue; by extension a sandal or slipper (sometimes as a symbol of occupancy, a refusal to marry, or of something valueless): - dryshod, (pair of) shoe((-latchet), -s).
; a primitive root; to be agreeable (literally or figuratively): - pass in beauty, be delight, be pleasant, be sweet.
; from h5276 (נָעֵם); pleasure; Naam, an Israelite: - Naam.
; from h5276 (נָעֵם); agreeableness, i.e. delight, suitableness, splendor or grace: - beauty, pleasant(-ness).
; feminine of h5277 (נַעַם); pleasantness; Naamah, the name of an antediluvian woman, of an Ammonitess, and of a place in Palestine: - Naamah.
; patronymic from h5283 (נַעֲמָן); a Naamanite, or descendant of Naaman (collectively): - Naamites.
; from h5278 (נֹעַם); pleasant; Noomi, an Israelitess: - Naomi.
; from h5276 (נָעֵם); pleasantness (plural as concrete): - pleasant.
; the same as h5282 (נַעֲמָן); Naaman, the name of an Israelite and of a Damascene: - Naaman.
; patrial from a place corresponding in name (but not identical) with h5279 (נַעֲמָה); a Naamathite, or inhabitant of Naamah: - Naamathite.
; from an unused root meaning to prick; probably a brier; by implication, a thicket of thorny bushes: - thorn.
; a primitive root; to growl: - yell.

; a primitive root (probably identical with h5286 (נָעַר), through the idea of the rustling of mane, which usually accompanies the lion's roar); to tumble about: - shake (off, out, self), overthrow, toss up and down.

; from h5287 (נָעַר); (concretely) a boy (as active), from the age of infancy to adolescence; by implication, a servant; also (by interch. of sex), a girl (of similar latitude in age): - babe, boy, child, damsel (from the margin), lad, servant, young (man).
; from h5287 (נָעַר) in its derivative sense of tossing about; a wanderer: - young one.
; from h5287 (נָעַר); (compare h5288 (נַעַר)) (abstractly) boyhood: - child, youth.
; feminine of h5288 (נַעַר); a girl (from infancy to adolescence): - damsel, maid(-en), young (woman).
; the same as h5291 (נַעֲרָה); Naarah, the name of an Israelitess, and of a place in Palestine: - Naarah, Naarath.
; from h5288 (נַעַר); youthful; Naarai, an Israelite: - Naarai.
; from h5288 (נַעַר) and h3050 (יָהּ); servant of Jah; Nearjah, the name of two Israelites: - Neariah.
; from h5288 (נַעַר); juvenile; Naaran, a place in Palestine: - Naaran.
; from h5287 (נָעַר); something shaken out, i.e. tow (as the refuse of flax): - tow.
; a variation of h4644 (מֹף); Noph, the capital of Upper Egypt: - Noph.
; from an unused root probably meaning to spring forth; a sprout; Nepheg, the name of two Israelites: - Nepheg.
; from h5130 (נוּף) in the sense of lifting; a height; also a sieve: - border, coast, region, sieve.
; for h5304 (נְפִיסִים); Nephushesim, a Temple-servant: - Nephisesim (from the margin).

; a primitive root; to puff, in various applications (literally, to inflate, blow hard, scatter, kindle, expire; figuratively, to disesteem): - blow, breath, give up, cause to lose (life), seething, snuff.
; from h5301 (נָפַח); a gust; Nophach, a place in Moab: - Nophah.
; or נְפִל; from h5307 (נָפַל); properly, a feller, i.e. a bully or tyrant: - giant.
; plural from an unused root meaning to scatter; expansions; Nephisim, a Temple-servant: - Nephusim (from the margin).
; from h5314 (נָפַשׁ); refreshed; Naphish, a son of Ishmael, and his posterity: - Naphish.
; from an unused root meaning to glisten; shining; a gem, probably the garnet: - emerald.

; a primitive root; to fall, in a great variety of applications (intransitive or causative, literal or figurative): - be accepted, cast (down, self, (lots), out), cease, die, divide (by lot), (let) fail, (cause to, let, make, ready to) fall (away, down, -en, -ing), fell(-ing), fugitive, have (inheritance), inferior, be judged (by mistake for h6419 (פָּלַל)), lay (along), (cause to) lie down, light (down), be ([idiom] hast) lost, lying, overthrow, overwhelm, perish, present(-ed, -ing), (make to) rot, slay, smite out, [idiom] surely, throw down.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h5307 (נָפַל) {to fall, in a great variety of applications (intransitive or causative, literal or figurative)}: - fall (down), have occasion.
; or נֵפֶל; from h5307 (נָפַל); something fallen, i.e. an abortion: - untimely birth.
; a primitive root; to dash to pieces, or scatter: - be beaten in sunder, break (in pieces), broken, dash (in pieces), cause to be discharged, dispersed, be overspread, scatter.
; from h5310 (נָפַץ); a storm (as dispersing): - scattering.
; (Aramaic) a primitive root; to issue; causatively, to bring out: - come (go, take) forth (out).
; (Aramaic) from h5312 (נְפַק); an outgo, i.e. expense: - expense.
; a primitive root; to breathe; passively, to be breathed upon , i.e. (figuratively) refreshed (as if by a current of air): - (be) refresh selves (-ed).

; from h5314 (נָפַשׁ); properly, a breathing creature, i.e. animal of (abstractly) vitality; used very widely in a literal, accommodated or figurative sense (bodily or mental): - any, appetite, beast, body, breath, creature, [idiom] dead(-ly), desire, [idiom] (dis-) contented, [idiom] fish, ghost, [phrase] greedy, he, heart(-y), (hath, [idiom] jeopardy of) life ([idiom] in jeopardy), lust, man, me, mind, mortally, one, own, person, pleasure, (her-, him-, my-, thy-) self, them (your) -selves, [phrase] slay, soul, [phrase] tablet, they, thing, ([idiom] she) will, [idiom] would have it.
; for h5299 (נָפָה); a height: - country.
; from h5130 (נוּף) in the sense of shaking to pieces; a dripping i.e. of honey (from the comb): - honeycomb.
; from h6605 (פָּתַח); opened, i.e. a spring; Nephtoach, a place in Palestine: - Neptoah.
; from h6617 (פָּתַל); properly, wrestled; but used (in the plural) transitively, a struggle: - wrestling.
; plural of foreign origin, Naphtuchim, an Egyptian tribe: - Naptuhim.
; from h6617 (פָּתַל); my wrestling; Naphtali, a son of Jacob, with the tribe descended from him, and its territory: - Naphtali.
; from h5340 (נָצַץ); a flower (from its brilliancy); also a hawk (from it flashing speed): - blossom, hawk.
; a primitive root; to go away: - flee.

; a primitive root; to station, in various applications (literally or figuratively): - appointed, deputy, erect, establish, [idiom] Huzzah (by mistake for a proper name), lay, officer, pillar, present, rear up, set (over, up), settle, sharpen, establish, (make to) stand(-ing, still, up, upright), best state.
; passive participle of h5324 (נָצַב); fixed, i.e. a handle: - haft.
; (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to h5324 (נָצַב); fixedness, i.e. firmness: - strength.

; a primitive root; properly, to go forth, i.e. (by implication) to be expelled, and (consequently) desolate; causatively, to lay waste; also (specifically), to quarrel: - be laid waste, runinous, strive (together).
; feminine of h5322 (נֵץ); a blossom: - flower.

; a primitive root; also as denominative from h5331 (נֶצַח) properly, to glitter from afar, i.e. to be eminent (as a superintendent, especially of the Temple services and its music); to be permanent: - excel, chief musician (singer), oversee(-r), set forward.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h5329 (נָצַח); to become chief: - be preferred.

; or נֵצַח; from h5329 (נָצַח); properly, a goal, i.e. the bright object at adistance travelled towards; hence (figuratively), splendor, or (subjectively) truthfulness, or (objectively) confidence; but usually (adverbially), continually (i.e. to the most distant point of view): - alway(-s), constantly, end, ([phrase] n-) ever(more), perpetual, strength, victory.
; probably identical with h5331 (נֶצַח), through the idea of brilliancy of color; juice of the grape (as blood red): - blood, strength.
; or נְצִב; from h5324 (נָצַב); something stationary, i.e. a prefect, a military post, a statue: - garrison, officer, pillar.
; the same as h5333 (נְצִיב); station; Netsib, a place in Palestine: - Nezib.
; from h5329 (נָצַח); conspicuous; Netsiach, a Temple-servant: - Neziah.
; from h5341 (נָצַר); properly, conservative; but used passively, delivered: - preserved.

; a primitive root; to snatch away, whether in a good or a bad sense: - [idiom] at all, defend, deliver (self), escape, [idiom] without fail, part, pluck, preserve, recover, rescue, rid, save, spoil, strip, [idiom] surely, take (out).
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h5337 (נָצַל); to extricate: - deliver, rescue.
; from h5322 (נֵץ); a blossom: - flower.
; a primitive root; to glare, i.e. be bright-colored: - sparkle.

; a primitive root; to guard, in a good sense (to protect, maintain, obey, etc.) or a bad one (to conceal, etc.): - besieged, hidden thing, keep(-er, -ing), monument, observe, preserve(-r), subtil, watcher(-man).
; from h5341 (נָצַר) in the sense of greenness as a striking color; a shoot; figuratively, a descendant: - branch.
; (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to h5352 (נָקָה); clean: - pure.

; a primitive root; to puncture, literally (to perforate, with more or less violence) or figuratively (to specify, designate, libel): - appoint, blaspheme, bore, curse, express, with holes, name, pierce, strike through.
; a bezel (for a gem): - pipe.
; the same as h5345 (נֶקֶב); dell; Nekeb, a place in Palestine: - Nekeb.
; from h5344 (נָקַב); female (from the sexual form): - female.
; from an unused root meaning to mark (by puncturing or branding); spotted: - speckled.
; active participle from the same as h5348 (נָקֹד); a spotter (of sheep or cattle), i.e. the owner or tender (who thus marks them): - herdman, sheepmaster.
; from the same as h5348 (נָקֹד); a crumb (as broken to spots); also a biscuit (as pricked): - cracknel, mouldy.
; feminine of h5348 (נָקֹד); a boss: - stud.

; a primitive root; to be (or make) clean (literally or figuratively); by implication (in an adverse sense) to be bare, i.e. extirpated: - acquit [idiom] at all, [idiom] altogether, be blameless, cleanse, (be) clear(-ing), cut off, be desolate, be free, be (hold) guiltless, be (hold) innocent, [idiom] by no means, be quit, be (leave) unpunished, [idiom] utterly, [idiom] wholly.
; feminine of h5348 (נָקֹד) (in the figurative sense of marked); distinction; Nekoda, a Temple-servant: - Nekoda.
; a primitive root; to loathe: - weary.
; or נָקִיא; (Joel 4:19; Jonah [1:14), from h5352 (נָקָה); innocent: - blameless, clean, clear, exempted, free, guiltless, innocent, quit.
; or נִקָּיֹן; from h5352 (נָקָה); clearness (literally or figuratively): - cleanness, innocency.
; from an unused root meaning to bore; a cleft: - hole.
; a primitive root; to grudge, i.e. avenge or punish: - avenge(-r, self), punish, revenge (self), [idiom] surely, take vengeance.
; from h5358 (נָקַם); revenge: - [phrase] avenged, quarrel, vengeance.
; feminine of h5359 (נָקָם); avengement, whether the act of the passion: - [phrase] avenge, revenge(-ing), vengeance.
; a primitive root; to feel aversion: - be alienated.

; a primitive root; to strike with more or less violence (beat, fell, corrode); by implication (of attack) to knock together, i.e. surround or circulate: - compass (about, -ing), cut down, destroy, go round (about), inclose, round.
; from h5362 (נָקַף); a threshing (of olives): - shaking.
; from h5362 (נָקַף); probably a rope (as encircling): - rent.
; a primitive root; to bore (penetrate, quarry): - dig, pick out, pierce, put (thrust) out.
; from h5365 (נָקַר), a fissure {to bore (penetrate, quarry)}: - cleft, clift.
; a primitive root; to entrap (with a noose), literally or figuratively: - catch (lay a) snare.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h5367 (נָקַשׁ); used in the sense of h5362 (נָקַף); to knock: - smote.
; the same as h5216 (נִיר); lamp; Ner, an Israelite: - Ner.
; of foreign origin; Nergal, a Cuthite deity: - Nergal.
; from h5370 (נֵרְגַּל) and h8272 (שַׁרְאֶצֶר); Nergal-Sharetser, the name of two Babylonians: - Nergal-sharezer.
; from an unused root meaning to roll to pieces; a slanderer: - talebearer, whisperer.
; of foreign origin; nard, an aromatic: - spikenard.
; or נֵרִיָּהוּ; from h5216 (נִיר) and h3050 (יָהּ); light of Jah; Nerijah, an Israelite: - Neriah.

; or נָסָה; (Psalm 4:6 ( h0007 (אֲבַד))), a primitive root; to lift, in a great variety of applications, literal and figurative, absolute and relative: - accept, advance, arise, (able to, (armor), suffer to) bear(-er, up), bring (forth), burn, carry (away), cast, contain, desire, ease, exact, exalt (self), extol, fetch, forgive, furnish, further, give, go on, help, high, hold up, honorable ([phrase] man), lade, lay, lift (self) up, lofty, marry, magnify, [idiom] needs, obtain, pardon, raise (up), receive, regard, respect, set (up), spare, stir up, [phrase] swear, take (away, up), [idiom] utterly, wear, yield.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h5375 (נָשָׂא) {to lift}: - carry away, make insurrection, take.
; a primitive root; to lead astray, i.e. (mentally) to delude, or (morally) to seduce: - beguile, deceive, [idiom] greatly, [idiom] utterly.
; a primitive root (perhaps identical with h5377 (נָשָׁא), through the idea of imposition); to lend on interest; by implication, to dun fordebt: - [idiom] debt, exact, giver of usury.
; passive participle feminine of h5375 (נָשָׂא); something taken, i.e. a present: - gift.
; a primitive root; to blow; by implication, to disperse: - (cause to) blow, drive away.

; a primitive root; to reach (literally or figuratively): - ability, be able, attain (unto), (be able to, can) get, lay at, put, reach, remove, wax rich, [idiom] surely, (over-) take (hold of, on, upon).
; a primitive root; to forget; figuratively, to neglect; causatively, to remit, remove: - forget, deprive, exact.

; a primitive root (rather identical with h5382 (נָשָׁה), in the sense of h5378 (נָשָׁא)); to lend or (by reciprocity) borrow on security or interest: - creditor, exact, extortioner, lend, usurer, lend on (taker on) usury.
; from h5382 (נָשָׁה), in the sense of failure; rheumatic or crippled (from the incident to Jacob): - which shrank.
; or rather, נְשֻׂאָה; feminine. passive participle of h5375 (נָשָׂא); something borne, i.e. a load: - carriage.
; from h5383 (נָשָׁה); a debt: - debt.
; or נָשִׂא; from h5375 (נָשָׂא); properly, an exalted one, i.e. a king or sheik; also a rising mist: - captain, chief, cloud, governor, prince, ruler, vapour.
; from h5382 (נָשָׁה); oblivion: - forgetfulness.
; (Aramaic) irregular plural feminine of h0606 (אֱנָשׁ) {a man}: - women.
; from h5401 (נָשַׁק); a kiss: - kiss.
; a primitive root; to strike with a sting (as a serpent); figuratively, to oppress with interest on a loan: - bite, lend upon usury.
; from h5391 (נָשַׁךְ); interest on a debt: - usury.
; for h3957 (לִשְׁכָּה); a cell: - chamber.
; a primitive root; to pluck off, i.e. divest, eject or drop: - cast (out), drive, loose, put off (out), slip.
; a primitive root; properly, to blow away, i.e. destroy: - destroy.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h5397 (נְשָׁמָה); vital breath: - breath.
; from h5395 (נָשַׁם); a puff, i.e. wind, angry or vital breath, divine inspiration, intellect. or (concretely) an animal: - blast, (that) breath(-eth), inspiration, soul, spirit.
; a primitive root; to breeze, i.e. blow up fresh (as the wind): - blow.
; from h5398 (נָשַׁף); properly, a breeze, i.e. (by implication) dusk (when the evening breeze prevails): - dark, dawning of the day (morning), night, twilight.
; a primitive root; to catch fire: - burn, kindle.
