; a primitive root; to cover (with wings or obscurity); hence (as denominative from h5775 (עוֹף)) to fly; also (by implication of dimness) to faint (from the darkness of swooning): - brandish, be (wax) faint, flee away, fly (away), [idiom] set, shine forth, weary.
; from h5774 (עוּף); a bird (as covered with feathers, or rather as covering with wings), often collectively: - bird, that flieth, flying, fowl.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h5775 (עוֹף) {a bird (as covered with feathers, or rather as covering with wings), often collectively}: - fowl.
; or עֹפֶרֶת; feminine participle active of h6080 (עָפַר); lead (from its dusty color): - lead.
; from h5775 (עוֹף); birdlike; Ephai, an Israelite: - Ephai (from margin).
; a primitive root; to consult: - take advice ((counsel) together).
; apparently from h5779 (עוּץ); consultation; Uts, a son of Aram, also a Seirite, and the regions settled by them.: - Uz.
; a primitive root; to pack: - be pressed.
; a primitive root (rather identical with through the idea of opening the eyes); to wake (literally or figuratively): - (a-) wake(-n, up), lift up (self), [idiom] master, raise (up), stir up (self).
; a primitive root; to (be) bare: - be made naked.
; (Aramaic) chaff (as the naked husk): - chaff.
; from h5783 (עוּר); skin (as naked); by implication, hide, leather: - hide, leather, skin.
; a primitive root (rather denominatively from h5785 (עוֹר) through the idea of a film over the eyes); to blind: - blind, put out. See also h5895 (עַיִר).
; intensive from h5786 (עָוַר); blind (literally or figuratively): - blind (men, people).
; and (feminine) עַוֶּרֶת; from h5787 (עִוֵּר); blindness: - blind(-ness).
; a primitive root; to hasten: - assemble self.
; for h5789 (עוּשׁ); to hasten, i.e. succor: - speak in season.
; a primitive root; to wrest: - bow self, (make) crooked., falsifying, overthrow, deal perversely, pervert, subvert, turn upside down.
; from h5791 (עָוַת); oppression: - wrong.
; from h5790 (עוּת); succoring; Uthai, the name of two Israelites: - Uthai.
; from h5810 (עָזַז); strong, vehement, harsh: - fierce, [phrase] greedy, mighty, power, roughly, strong.
; from h5810 (עָזַז); a she-goat (as strong), but masculine in plural (which also is used elliptically for goat's hair): - (she) goat, kid.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h5795 (עֵז) {a she-goat (as strong), but masculine in plural (which also is used elliptically for goat's hair)}: - goat.
; or (fully) עוֹז; from h5810 (עָזַז); strength in various applications (force, security, majesty, praise): - boldness, loud, might, power, strength, strong.
; or עֻזָּה; feminine of h5797 (עֹז); strength; Uzza or Uzzah, the name of five Israelites: - Uzza, Uzzah.
; from h5795 (עֵז) and h0235 (אָזַל); goat of departure; the scapegoat: - scapegoat.
; a primitive root; to loosen, i.e. relinquish, permit, etc.: - commit self, fail, forsake, fortify, help, leave (destitute, off), refuse, [idiom] surely.
; from h5800 (עָזַב) in the sense of letting go (for a price, i.e. selling); trade, i.e. the place (mart) or the payment (revenue): - fair, ware.
; from h5794 (עַז) and the root of h0950 (בּוּקָה); stern depopulator; Azbuk, an Israelite: - Azbuk.
; from h5794 (עַז) and h1409 (גָּד); stern troop; Azgad, an Israelite: - Azgad.
; feminine of h5794 (עַז); strong; Azzah, a place in Palestine: - Azzah, Gaza.
; feminine passive participle of h5800 (עָזַב); desertion (of inhabitants): - forsaking.
; the same as h5805 (עֲזוּבָה); Azubah, the name of two Israelitesses: - Azubah.
; from h5810 (עָזַז); forcibleness: - might, strength.
; from h5810 (עָזַז); forcible; collectively and concretely, an army: - power, strong.
; or עַזֻּר; from h5826 (עָזַר); helpful; Azzur, the name of three Israelites: - Azur, Azzur.
; a primitive root; to be stout (literally or figuratively): - harden, impudent, prevail, strengthen (self), be strong.
; from h5810 (עָזַז); strong; Azaz, an Israelite: - Azaz.
; from h5810 (עָזַז) and h3050 (יָהּ); Jah has strengthened; Azazjah, the name of three Israelites: - Azaziah.
; from h5810 (עָזַז); forceful; Uzzi, the name of six Israelites: - Uzzi.
; perhaps for h5818 (עֻזִּיָּה); Uzzija, an Israelite: - Uzzia.
; from h5756 (עוּז) and h0410 (אֵל); strengthened of God; Aziel, an Israelite: - Aziel. Compare h3268 (יַעֲזִיאֵל).
; from h5797 (עֹז) and h0410 (אֵל); strength of God; Uzziel, the name of six Israelites: - Uzziel.
; patronymically from h5816 (עֻזִּיאֵל); an Uzzielite (collectively) or descendants of Uzziel: - Uzzielites.
; or עֻזִּיָּהוּ; from h5797 (עֹז) and h3050 (יָהּ); strength of Jah; Uzzijah, the name of five Israelites: - Uzziah.
; from h5756 (עוּז); strengthfulness; Aziza, an Israelite: - Aziza.
; from h5794 (עַז) and h4194 (מָוֶת); strong one of death; Azmaveth, the name of three Israelites and of a place in Palestine: - Azmaveth. See also h1041 (בֵּית עַזְמָוֶת).
; from h5794 (עַז); strong one; Azzan, an Israelite: - Azzan.
; probably feminine of h5797 (עֹז); probably the sea-eagle (from its strength): - ospray.
; a primitive root; to grub over: - fence about.
; (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to h5823 (עָזַק); a signet-ring (as engraved): - signet.
; from h5823 (עָזַק); tilled; Azekah, a place in Palestine: - Azekah.
; a primitive root; to surround, i.e. protect or aid: - help, succour.
; from h5826 (עָזַר); help; Ezer, the name of two Israelites: - Ezer. Compare h5829 (עֵזֶר).
; from h5826 (עָזַר); aid: - help.
; the same as h5828 (עֵזֶר); Ezer, the name of four Israelites: - Ezer. Compare h5827 (עֶזֶר).
; a variation of h5833 (עֶזְרָה); Ezra, an Israelite: - Ezra.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h5830 (עֶזְרָא); Ezra, an Israelite: - Ezra.
; from h5826 (עָזַר) and h0410 (אֵל); God has helped; Azarel, the name of five Israelites: - Azarael, Azareel.
; or עֶזְרָת; (Psalm 60:11 (13); Psalm 108:12 (13)), feminine of h5828 (עֵזֶר); aid: - help(-ed, -er).
; the same as h5833 (עֶזְרָה); Ezrah, an Israelite: - Ezrah.
; from h5826 (עָזַר) in its original meaning of surrounding; an inclosure; also a border: - court, settle.
; from h5828 (עֵזֶר); helpful; Ezri, an Israelite: - Ezri.
; from h5828 (עֵזֶר) and h0410 (אֵל); help of God; Azriel, the name of three Israelites: - Azriel.
; or עֲזַרְיָהוּ; from h5826 (עָזַר) and h3050 (יָהּ); Jah has helped; Azarjah, the name of nineteen Israelites: - Azariah.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h5838 (עֲזַרְיָה); Azarjah, one of Daniel's companions: - Azariah.
; from h5828 (עֵזֶר) and active participle of h6965 (קוּם); help of an enemy; Azrikam, the name of four Israelites: - Azrikam.
; patrial from h5804 (עַזָּה); an Azzathite or inhabitant of Azzah: - Gazathite, Gazite.
; from h5860 (עִיט) (contracted) in the sense of swooping, i.e. side-long stroke; a stylus or marking stick: - pen.
; (Aramaic) from h3272 (יְעַט); prudence: - counsel.
; a primitive root; to wrap, i.e. cover, veil, cloth, or roll: - array self, be clad, (put a) cover (-ing, self), fill, put on, [idiom] surely, turn aside.
; from an unused root meaning apparently to contain; a receptacle (for milk, i.e. pail; figuratively, breast): - breast.
; from an unused root meaning to sneeze; sneezing: - sneezing.
; of uncertain derivation; a bat: - bat.
; a primitive root; to shroud, i.e. clothe (whether transitive or reflex.); hence (from the idea of darkness) to languish: - cover (over), fail, faint, feebler, hide self, be overwhelmed, swoon.
; a primitive root; to encircle (for attack or protection); especially to crown (literally or figuratively): - compass, crown.
; from h5849 (עָטַר); a crown: - crown.
; the same as h5850 (עֲטָרָה); Atarah, an Israelitess: - Atarah.
; or עֲטָרֹת; plural of h5850 (עֲטָרָה); Ataroth, the name (thus simply) of two places in Palestine: - Ataroth.
; from the same as h5852 (עֲטָרוֹת) and h0146 (אַדָּר); crowns of Addar; Atroth-Addar, a place in Palestine: - Ataroth-adar(-addar).

keynum.phon: ʻAṭrôwth bêyth Yôwʼâb, at-roth' bayth yoawb'
keynum.meaning: ; from the same as h5852 (עֲטָרוֹת) and h1004 (בַּיִת) and h3097 (יוֹאָב); crowns of the house of Joab; Atroth-beth-Joab, a place in Palestine: - Ataroth the house of Joab.

; from the same as h5852 (עֲטָרוֹת) and a name otherwise unused (being from the same as h8226 (שָׂפַן)) meaning hidden; crowns of Shophan; Atroth-Shophan, a place in Palestine: - Atroth, Shophan (as if two places).
; from h5753 (עָוָה); a ruin (as if overturned): - heap.
; or (feminine) עַיָּא; (Nehemiah 11:31), or עַיָּת; (Isaiah 10:28), for h5856 (עִי); Ai, Aja or Ajath, a place in Palestine: - Ai, Aija, Aijath, Hai.
; perhaps from an unused root probably meaning to be bald; bare; Ebal, a mountain of Palestine: - Ebal.
; from h5856 (עִי); ruin; Ijon, a place in Palestine: - Ijon.
; a primitive root; to swoop down upon (literally or figuratively): - fly, rail.
; from h5860 (עִיט); a hawk or other bird of prey: - bird, fowl, ravenous (bird).
; from h5861 (עַיִט); hawk-ground; Etam, a place in Palestine: - Etam.
; from the plural of h5856 (עִי) and the plural of the active participle of h5674 (עָבַר) with the article interposed; ruins of the passers; Ije-ha-Abarim, a place near Palestine: - Ije-abarim.
; plural of h5856 (עִי); ruins; Ijim, a place in the Desert.: - Iim.

; for h5769 (עוֹלָם) {concealed, i.e. the vanishing point; generally, time out of mind (past or future), i.e. (practically) eternity; frequentatively, adverbial (especially with prepositional prefix) always}: - ever.
; from h5927 (עָלָה); elevated; Ilai, an Israelite: - Ilai.
; or עוֹלָם; (Ezra 10:2; Jeremiah 49:36), probably from h5956 (עָלַם); hidden, i.e. distant; Elam, a son of Shem and his descendants, with their country; also of six Israelites: - Elam.
; of doubtful origin and authenticity; probably meaning strength: - mighty.

; probably a primitive word; an eye (literally or figuratively); by analogy, a fountain (as the eye of the landscape): - affliction, outward appearance, [phrase] before, [phrase] think best, colour, conceit, [phrase] be content, countenance, [phrase] displease, eye((-brow), (-d), -sight), face, [phrase] favour, fountain, furrow (from the margin), [idiom] him, [phrase] humble, knowledge, look, ([phrase] well), [idiom] me, open(-ly), [phrase] (not) please, presence, [phrase] regard, resemblance, sight, [idiom] thee, [idiom] them, [phrase] think, [idiom] us, well, [idiom] you(-rselves).
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h5869 (עַיִן); an eye: - eye.
; the same as h5869 (עַיִן); fountain; Ajin, the name (thus simply) of two places in Palestine: - Ain.
; from h5869 (עַיִן) and h1423 (גְּדִי); fountain of a kid; En-Gedi, a place in Palestine: - En-gedi.
; from h5869 (עַיִן) and the plural of h1588 (גַּן); fountain of gardens; En-Gannim, a place in Palestine: - En-gannim.
; or עֵין דּוֹר; or עֵין־דֹּר; from h5869 (עַיִן) and h1755 (דּוֹר); fountain of dwelling; En-Dor, a place in Palestine: - En-dor.
; from h5869 (עַיִן) and the active participle of h7121 (קָרָא); fountain of One calling; En-hak-Kore, a place near Palestine: - En-hakhore.
; from h5869 (עַיִן) and the feminine of a derivative from h2300 (חָדַד); fountain of sharpness; En-Chaddah, a place in Palestine: - En-haddah.
; from h5869 (עַיִן) and the same as h2674 (חָצוֹר); fountain of a village; En-Chatsor, a place in Palestine: - En-hazor.
; from h5869 (עַיִן) and a derivative of h2729 (חָרַד); fountain of trembling; En-Charod, a place in Palestine: - well of Harod.
; or עֵינָם; dual of h5869 (עַיִן); double fountain; Enajim or Enam, a place in Palestine: - Enaim, openly (Genesis 38:21).
; from h5869 (עַיִן) and h4941 (מִשְׁפָּט); fountain of judgment; En-Mishpat, a place near Palestine: - En-mishpat.
; from h5869 (עַיִן); having eyes; Enan, an Israelite: - Enan. Compare h2704 (חֲצַר עֵינָן).
; עַיִן and the dual of h5695 (עֵגֶל); fountain of two calves; En-Eglajim, a place in Palestine: - En-eglaim.
; from h5869 (עַיִן) and the active participle of h7270 (רָגַל); fountain of a traveller; En-Rogel, a place near Jerusalem: - En-rogel.
; from h5869 (עַיִן) and h7416 (רִמּוֹן); fountain of a pomegranate; En-Rimmon, a place in Palestine: - En-rimmon.
; from h5869 (עַיִן) and h8121 (שֶׁמֶשׁ); fountain of the sun; En-Shemesh, a place in Palestine: - Enshemesh.
; from h5869 (עַיִן) and the plural of h8565 (תַּן); fountain of jackals; En-Tannim, a pool near Jerusalem: - dragon well.
; from h5869 (עַיִן) and h8598 (תַּפּוּחַ); fountain of an apple-tree; En-Tappuach, a place in Palestine: - En-tappuah.
; a primitive root; to languish: - be wearied.
; from h5888 (עָיֵף); languid: - faint, thirsty, weary.
; feminine from h5774 (עוּף); obscurity (as if from covering): - darkness.
; the same as h5890 (עֵיפָה); Ephah, the name of a son of Midian, and of the region settled by him; also of an Israelite and of an Israelitess: - Ephah.

; or (in the plural) עָר; or עָיַר; (Judges 10:4), from h5782 (עוּר) a city (a place guarded by waking or a watch) in the widest sense (even of a mere encampment or post): - Ai (from margin), city, court (from margin), town.
; the same as h5892 (עִיר); Ir, an Israelite: - Ir.
; (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to h5782 (עוּר); a watcher, i.e. an angel (as guardian): - watcher.
; from h5782 (עוּר) in the sense of raising (i.e. bearing a burden); properly, a young ass (as just broken to a load); hence an ass-colt: - (ass) colt, foal, young ass.
; from h5782 (עוּר); wakefulness; Ira, the name of three Israelites: - Ira.
; from the same as h6166 (עֲרָד); fugitive; Irad, an antediluvian: - Irad.
; from h5892 (עִיר) and h4417 (מֶלַח) with the article of substance interp.; city of (the) salt; Irham-Melach, a place near Palestine: - the city of salt.
; from h5892 (עִיר) and the plural of h8558 (תָּמָר) with the article interpolated; city of the palmtrees; Ir-hat-Temarim, a place in Palestine: - the city of palmtrees.
; from h5892 (עִיר); a citizen; Iru, an Israelite: - Iru.
; from h5892 (עִיר); urbane; Iri, an Israelite: - Iri.
; from h5892 (עִיר); city-wise; Iram, an Idumaean: - Iram.
; or עֵרֹם; from h6191 (עָרַם); nudity: - naked(-ness).
; from h5892 (עִיר) and h5175 (נָחָשׁ); city of a serpent; Ir-Nachash, a place in Palestine: - Irnahash.
; from h5892 (עִיר) and h8121 (שֶׁמֶשׁ); city of the sun; Ir-Shemesh, a place in Palestine: - Irshemesh.
; or עָשׁ; from h5789 (עוּשׁ); the constellation of the Great Bear (perhaps from its migration through the heavens): - Arcturus.
; probably for h5909 (עַכְבָּר); Akbor, the name of an Idumaean and of two Israelites: - Achbor.
; probably from an unused root in the literal sense of entangling; a spider (as weaving a network): - spider.
; probably from the same as h5908 (עַכָּבִישׁ) in the secondary sense of attacking; a mouse (as nibbling): - mouse.
; apparently from an unused root meaning to hem in; Akko (from its situation on a bay): - Accho.
; from h5916 (עָכַר); troubled; Akor, the name of a place in Palestine: - Achor.
; from an unused root meaning to trouble; troublesome; Akan, an Israelite: - Achan. Compare h5917 (עָכָר).
; a primitive root; properly, to tie, specifically, with fetters; but used only as denominative from h5914 (עֶכֶס); to put on anklets: - make a tinkling ornament.
; from h5913 (עָכַס); a fetter; hence, an anklet: - stocks, tinkling ornament.
; feminine of h5914 (עֶכֶס); anklet; Aksah, an Israelitess: - Achsah.
; a primitive root; properly, to roil water; figuratively, to disturb or affict: - trouble, stir.
; from h5916 (עָכַר); troublesome; Akar, an Israelite: - Achar. Compare h5912 (עָכָן).
; from h5916 (עָכַר); muddler; Okran, an Israelite: - Ocran.
; probably from an unused root meaning to coil; an asp (from lurking coiled up): - adder.
; from h5927 (עָלָה); properly, the top; specifically, the highest (i.e. God); also (adverb) aloft, to Jehovah: - above, high, most High.

; properly, the same as h5920 (עַל) used as a preposition (in the singular or plural often with prefix, or as conjunction with a particle following); above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications: - above, according to(-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, [idiom] as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, [idiom] both and, by (reason of), [idiom] had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-) on, over, than, through(-out), to, touching, [idiom] with.

; (Aramaic) corresponding to h5921 (עַל) {above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications}: - about, against, concerning, for, (there-) fore, from, in, [idiom] more, of, (there-, up-) on, (in-) to, [phrase] why with.
; or עוֹל; from h5953 (עָלַל); a yoke (as imposed on the neck), literally or figuratively: - yoke.
; (Aramaic) from h5922 (עַל); above: - over.
; feminine of h5923 (עֹל); burden; Ulla, an Israelite: - Ulla.
; from an unused root meaning to stutter; stuttering: - stammerer.

; a primitive root; to ascend, intransitively (be high) or actively (mount); used in a great variety of senses, primary and secondary, literal and figurative: - arise (up), (cause to) ascend up, at once, break (the day) (up), bring (up), (cause to) burn, carry up, cast up, [phrase] shew, climb (up), (cause to, make to) come (up), cut off, dawn, depart, exalt, excel, fall, fetch up, get up, (make to) go (away, up); grow (over) increase, lay, leap, levy, lift (self) up, light, (make) up, [idiom] mention, mount up, offer, make to pay, [phrase] perfect, prefer, put (on), raise, recover, restore, (make to) rise (up), scale, set (up), shoot forth (up), (begin to) spring (up), stir up, take away (up), work.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h5930 (עֹלָה); a holocaust: - burnt offering.
; from h5927 (עָלָה); a leaf (as coming up on a tree); collectively, foliage: - branch, leaf.

; or עוֹלָה; feminine active participle of h5927 (עָלָה); a step or (collectively, stairs, as ascending); usually a holocaust (as going up in smoke): - ascent, burnt offering (sacrifice), go up to. See also h5766 (עֶוֶל).
; (Aramaic) feminine from a root corresponding to h5927 (עָלָה); a pretext (as arising artificially): - occasion.
; for h5766 (עֶוֶל); moral perverseness: - iniquity.
; or עַליָה; the same as h5932 (עַלְוָה); Alvah or Aljah, an Idumaean: - Aliah, Alvah.
; passive participle of h5956 (עָלַם) in the denominative sense of h5958 (עֶלֶם); (only in plural as abstract) adolescence; figuratively, vigor: - youth.
; or עַלְיָן; from h5927 (עָלָה); lofty; Alvan or Aljan, an Idumaean: - Alian, Alvan.
; feminine passive participle of an unused root meaning to suck; the leech: - horse-leech.
; a primitive root; to jump for joy, i.e. exult: - be joyful, rejoice, triumph.
; from h5937 (עָלַז); exultant: - that rejoiceth.
; feminine from an unused root meaning to cover; dusk: - dark, twilight.
; from h5927 (עָלָה); a pestle (as lifted): - pestle.
; from h5927 (עָלָה); lofty; Eli, an Israelite highpriest: - Eli.
; from h5927 (עָלָה); high; i.e. comparative: - upper.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h5942 (עִלִּי); supreme (i.e. God): - (most) high.
; feminine from h5927 (עָלָה); something lofty, i.e. a stair-way; also a second-story room (or even one on the roof); figuratively, the sky: - ascent, (upper) chamber, going up, loft, parlour.
; from h5927 (עָלָה); an elevation, i.e. (adj.) lofty (compar.); as title, the Supreme: - (Most, on) high(-er, -est), upper(-most).
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h5945 (עֶלְיוֹן); the Supreme: - Most high.
; from h5937 (עָלַז); exultant: - joyous, (that) rejoice(-ing)
; from h5953 (עָלַל) in the sense of completing; probably a crucible (as working over the metal): - furnace.

; or עֲלִלָה; from h5953 (עָלַל) in the sense of effecting; an exploit (of God), or a performance (of man, often in a bad sense); by implication, an opportunity: - act(-ion), deed, doing, invention, occasion, work.
; for h5949 (עֲלִילָה); (miraculous) execution: - work.
; from h5970 (עָלַץ); exultation: - rejoicing.
; from h5927 (עָלָה); a second-story room: - chamber. Compare h5944 (עֲלִיָּה).

; a primitive root; to effect thoroughly; specifically, to glean (also figuratively); by implication (in a bad sense) to overdo, i.e. maltreat, be saucy to, pain, impose (also literal): - abuse, affect, [idiom] child, defile, do, glean, mock, practise, thoroughly, work (wonderfully).

; from h6131 (עָקַר); eradication; Ekron, a place in Palestine: - Ekron.

; a primitive root; to knot or distort; figuratively, to pervert (act or declare perverse): - make crooked, (prove, that is) perverse(-rt).

; (Aramaic) corresponding to h6145 (עָר) {a foe (as watchful for mischief)}: - enemy.

; a primitive root; to braid, i.e. intermix; technically, to traffic (as if by barter); also or give to be security (as a kind of exchange): - engage, (inter-) meddle (with), mingle (self), mortgage, occupy, give pledges, be(-come, put in) surety, undertake.
; a primitive root (rather identical with h6148 (עָרַב) through the idea of close association); to be agreeable: - be pleasant(-ing), take pleasure in, be sweet.
; a primitive root (rather identical with h6148 (עָרַב) through the idea of covering with a texture); to grow dusky at sundown: - be darkened, (toward) evening.

; or עֲרַב; from h6150 (עָרַב) in the figurative sense of sterility; Arab (i.e. Arabia), a country East of Palestine: - Arabia.
; from h6150 (עָרַב); dusk: - [phrase] day, even(-ing, tide), night.

; or עֶרֶב; (1 Kings 10:15), (with the article [prefix), from h6148 (עָרַב); the web (or transverse threads of cloth); also a mixture, (or mongrel race): - Arabia, mingled people, mixed (multitude), woof.
; from h6148 (עָרַב); a willow (from the use of osiers as wattles): - willow.
; from h6149 (עָרֵב); pleasant: - sweet.
; from h6148 (עָרַב); a mosquito (from its swarming): - divers sorts of flies, swarm.
; or עוֹרֵב; from h6150 (עָרַב); a raven (from its dusky hue): - raven.
; or עוֹרֵב; the same as h6158 (עֹרֵב); Oreb, the name of a Midianite and of the cliff near the Jordan: - Oreb.

; from h6150 (עָרַב) (in the sense of sterility); a desert; especially (with the article prefix) the (generally) sterile valley of the Jordan and its continuation to the Red Sea: - Arabah, champaign, desert, evening, heaven, plain, wilderness. See also h1026 (בֵּית הָעֲרָבָה).

; feminine passive participle of h6048 (עֲנַמֶּלֶךְ) in the sense of a bargain or exchange; something given as security, i.e. (literally) a token (of safety) or (metaphorically) a bondsman: - pledge, surety.
; from h6148 (עָרַב) (in the sense of exchange); a pawn (given as security): - pledge.
; or עַרְבִי; patrial from h6152 (עֲרָב); an Arabian or inhabitant of Arab (i.e. Arabia): - Arabian.
; patrial from h1026 (בֵּית הָעֲרָבָה); an Arbathite or inhabitant of (Beth-) Arabah: - Arbahite.
; a primitive root; to long for: - cry, pant.
; from an unused root meaning to sequester itself; fugitive; Arad, the name of a place near Palestine, also of a Canaanite and an Israelite: - Arad.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h6171 (עָרוֹד); an onager: - wild ass.
; a primitive root; to be (causatively, make) bare; hence, to empty, pour out, demolish: - leave destitute, discover, empty, make naked, pour (out), rase, spread self, uncover.
; feminine from h6168 (עָרָה); a naked (i.e. level) plot: - paper reed.
; or עֲרֻגָה; feminine passive participle of h6165 (עָרַג); something piled up (as if (figuratively) raised by mental aspiration), i.e. a paterre: - bed, furrow.
; from the same as h6166 (עֲרָד); an onager (from his lonesome habits): - wild ass.
; from h6168 (עָרָה); nudity, literally (especially the pudenda) or figuratively (disgrace, blemish): - nakedness, shame, unclean(-ness).
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h6172 (עֶרְוָה); nakedness, i.e. (figuratively) impoverishment: - dishonor.
; or עָרֹם; from h6191 (עָרַם) (in its original sense); nude, either partially or totally: - naked.
; passive participle of h6191 (עָרַם); cunning (usually in a bad sense): - crafty, prudent, subtil.
; or עַרְעָר; from h6209 (עָרַר) reduplicated; a juniper (from its nudity of situation): - health.
; or עֲרֹעֵר; or עַרְעוֹר; the same as h6176 (עֲרוֹעֵר); nudity of situation; Aroer, the name of three places in or near Palestine: - Aroer.
; passive participle of h6206 (עָרַץ); feared, i.e. (concretely) a horrible place or chasm: - cliffs.
; from h5782 (עוּר); watchful; Eri, an Israelite: - Eri.
; patronymically of h6179 (עֵרִי); a Erite (collectively) or descendants of Eri: - Erites.

; from an unused root meaning to comminute; meal: - dough.

; a primitive root; to set in a row, i.e. arrange, put in order (in a very wide variety of applications): - put (set) (the battle, self) in array, compare, direct, equal, esteem, estimate, expert (in war), furnish, handle, join (battle), ordain, (lay, put, reckon up, set) (in) order, prepare, tax, value.

; a primitive root; properly, to strip; but used as denominative from h6189 (עָרֵל); to expose or remove the prepuce, whether literal (to go naked) or figurative (to refrain from using): - count uncircumcised, foreskin to be uncovered.
; from h6188 (עָרֵל); properly, exposed, i.e. projecting loose (as to the prepuce); used only technically, uncircumcised (i.e. still having the prepuce uncurtailed): - uncircumcised (person).
; feminine of h6189 (עָרֵל); the prepuce: - foreskin, [phrase] uncircumcised.

; a primitive root; properly, to be (or make) bare; but used only in the derivative sense (through the idea perhaps of smoothness) to be cunning (usually in a bad sense): - [idiom] very, beware, take crafty (counsel), be prudent, deal subtilly.
; a primitive root; to pile up: - gather together.

; probably from h5782 (עוּר); watchful; Eran, an Israelite: - Eran.

; a primitive root (identical with through the idea of sloping); properly, to bend downward; but used only as a denominative from h6203 (עֹרֶף), to break the neck; hence (figuratively) to destroy: - that is beheaded, break down, break (cut off, strike off) neck.

; probably from h6201 (עָרַף); gloom (as of a lowering sky): - (gross, thick) dark (cloud, -ness).
; a primitive root; to awe or (intransitive) to dread; hence, to harass: - be affrighted (afraid, dread, feared, terrified), break, dread, fear, oppress, prevail, shake terribly.
; a primitive root; to gnaw, i.e. (figuratively) eat (by hyberbole); also (participle) a pain: - fleeing, sinew.
; patrial from an unused name meaning a tush; an Arkite or inhabitant of Erek: - Arkite.
; a primitive root; to bare; figuratively, to demolish: - make bare, break, raise up (perhaps by clerical error for raze), [idiom] utterly.
; from an unused root meaning perhaps to arch; a couch (properly, with a canopy): - bed(-stead), couch.

; from an unused root meaning to glisten (or be green); grass (or any tender shoot): - grass, herb.

; a primitive root; to do or make, in the broadest sense and widest application: - accomplish, advance, appoint, apt, be at, become, bear, bestow, bring forth, bruise, be busy, [idiom] certainly, have the charge of, commit, deal (with), deck, [phrase] displease, do, (ready) dress(-ed), (put in) execute(-ion), exercise, fashion, [phrase] feast, (fight-) ing man, [phrase] finish, fit, fly, follow, fulfill, furnish, gather, get, go about, govern, grant, great, [phrase] hinder, hold (a feast), [idiom] indeed, [phrase] be industrious, [phrase] journey, keep, labour, maintain, make, be meet, observe, be occupied, offer, [phrase] officer, pare, bring (come) to pass, perform, pracise, prepare, procure, provide, put, requite, [idiom] sacrifice, serve, set, shew, [idiom] sin, spend, [idiom] surely, take, [idiom] thoroughly, trim, [idiom] very, [phrase] vex, be (warr-) ior, work(-man), yield, use.
; from h6213 (עָשָׂה) and h0410 (אֵל); God has made; Asahel, the name of four Israelites: - Asahel.

; from h6231 (עָשַׁק); oppressive (as noun, a tyrant): - oppressor.
; or עָשֻׁק; passive participle of h6231 (עָשַׁק); used in plural masculine as abstractly, tyranny: - oppressed(-ion). (Doubtful.)
; or עָשֹׂר; from h6235 (עֶשֶׂר); ten; by abbreviated form ten strings, and so a decachord: - (instrument of) ten (strings, -th).
; from h6245 (עָשַׁת); shining, i.e. polished: - bright.

; a primitive root; to smoke, whether literal or figurative: - be angry (be on a) smoke.

; from h6225 (עָשַׁן); smoke, literally or figuratively (vapor, dust, anger): - smoke(-ing).
; the same as h6227 (עָשָׁן); Ashan, a place in Palestine: - Ashan.
; a primitive root (identical with h6231 (עָשַׁק)); to press upon, i.e. quarrel: - strive with.

; a primitive root (compare h6229 (עָשַׂק)); to press upon, i.e. oppress, defraud, violate, overflow: - get deceitfully, deceive, defraud, drink up, (use) oppress(-ion), -or), do violence (wrong).
; from h6231 (עָשַׁק); oppression; Eshek, an Israelite: - Eshek.

; a primitive root (identical with h6238 (עָשַׁר)); to accumulate; but used only as denominative from h6235 (עֶשֶׂר); to tithe, i.e. to take or give atenth: - [idiom] surely, give (take) the tenth, (have, take) tithe(-ing, -s), [idiom] truly.
; a primitive root; properly, to accumulate; chiefly (specifically) to grow (causatively, make) rich: - be(-come, en-, make, make self, wax) rich, make (1 Kings 22:48 marg). See h6240 (עָשָׂר).
; from h6238 (עָשַׁר); wealth: - [idiom] far (richer), riches.

; for h6235 (עֶשֶׂר); ten (only in combination), i.e. -teen; also (ordinal) -teenth: - (eigh-, fif-, four-, nine-, seven-, six-, thir-) teen(-th), [phrase] eleven(-th), [phrase] sixscore thousand, [phrase] twelve(-th).
; or עִשָּׂרֹן; from h6235 (עֶשֶׂר); (fractional) a tenth part: - tenth deal.

; (Aramaic) corresponding to h6242 (עֶשְׂרִים) {twenty; also (ordinal) twentieth}: - twenty.
; a primitive root; probably to shrink, i.e. fail: - be consumed.

; from h6245 (עָשַׁת); a fabric: - bright.

; from h6245 (עָשַׁת); thinking: - thought.

; or עַשְׁתָּרֹת; plural of h6251 (עַשְׁתְּרָה); Ashtaroth, the name of a Sidonian deity, and of a place East of the Jordan: - Asharoth, Astaroth. See also h1045 (בֵּית עַשְׁתָּרוֹת), h6253 (עַשְׁתֹּרֶת), h6255 (עַשְׁתְּרֹת קַרְנַיִם).
; probably for h6251 (עַשְׁתְּרָה); Ashtoreth, the Phoenician goddess of love (and increase): - Ashtoreth.

; from h5703 (עַד); time, especially (adverb with preposition) now, when, etc.: - [phrase] after, (al-) ways, [idiom] certain, [phrase] continually, [phrase] evening, long, (due) season, so (long) as, (even-, evening-, noon-) tide, (meal-), what) time, when.
; a primitive root; to prepare: - make fit, be ready to become.

; or עַתֻּד; from h6257 (עָתַד); prepared, i.e. full grown; spoken only (in plural) of he-goats, or (figuratively) leaders of the people: - chief one, (he) goat, ram.
; from h6256 (עֵת); timely: - fit.

; (Aramaic) corresponding to h6264 (עָתִיד); prepared: - ready.
; from h6257 (עָתַד); prepared; by implication, skilful; feminine plural the future; also treasure: - things that shall come, ready, treasures.
; from h5790 (עוּת) and h3050 (יָהּ); Jah has helped; Athajah, an Israelite: - Athaiah.
; from h6275 (עָתַק); properly, antique, i.e. venerable or splendid: - durable.
; from h6275 (עָתַק); removed, i.e. weaned; also antique: - ancient, drawn.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h6267 (עַתִּיק); venerable: - ancient.
; from an unused root meaning to sojourn; lodging; Athak, a place in Palestine: - Athach.
; from an unused root meaning to compress; constringent; Athlai, an Israelite: - Athlai.
; or עֲתַלְיָהוּ; from the same as h6270 (עַתְלַי) and h3050 (יָהּ); Jah has constrained; Athaljah, the name of an Israelitess and two Israelites: - Athaliah.
; a primitive root; probably to glow, i.e. (figuratively) be desolated: - be darkened.
; from an unused root meaning to force; forcible; Othni, an Israelite: - Othni.
; from the same as h6273 (עׇתְנִי) and h0410 (אֵל); force of God; Othniel, an Israelite: - Othniel.
; a primitive root; to remove (intransitive or transitive) figuratively, to grow old; specifically, to transcribe: - copy out, leave off, become (wax) old, remove.
; from h6275 (עָתַק); antique, i.e. valued: - durable.
; from h6275 (עָתַק) in the sense of license; impudent: - arrogancy, grievous (hard) things, stiff.
; from h6256 (עֵת) and h7011 (קַיָּם); time of a judge; Eth-Katsin, a place in Palestine: - Ittahkazin (by including directive enclitic).
; a primitive root (rather denominative from h6281 (עֶתֶר)); to burn incense in worship, i.e. intercede (reciprocally, listen to prayer): - intreat, (make) pray(-er).
; a primitive root; to be (causatively, make) abundant: - deceitful, multiply.
; from h6280 (עָתַר); abundance; Ether, a place in Palestine: - Ether.
; from h6280 (עָתַר); also compare h6279 (עָתַר) incense (as increasing to a volume of smoke); hence a worshipper: - suppliant, thick.
; from h6280 (עָתַר); copiousness: - abundance. p

; a primitive root; to puff, i.e. blow away: - scatter into corners.
; feminine of h6311 (פֹּה); properly, mouth in a figurative sense, i.e. direction, region, extremity: - corner, end, quarter, side.

; a primitive root; also denominative from h6288 (פְּאֹרָה), to gleam, i.e. (causatively) embellish; figuratively, to boast; also to explain (i.e. make clear) oneself; to shake a tree: - beautify, boast self, go over the boughs, glorify (self), glory, vaunt self.
; from h6286 (פָּאַר); an embellishment, i.e. fancy head-dress: - beauty, bonnet, goodly, ornament, tire.
; or פֹּרָאה; or פֻּארָה; from h6286 (פָּאַר); properly, ornamentation, i.e. (plural) foliage (including the limbs) as bright green: - bough, branch, sprig.
; from h6286 (פָּאַר); properly, illuminated, i.e. a glow; as noun, a flush (of anxiety): - blackness.
; from h6286 (פָּאַר); ornamental; Paran, a desert of Arabia: - Paran.

; or פִּגֻּל; from an unused root meaning to stink; properly, fetid, i.e. (figuratively) unclean (ceremonially): - abominable(-tion, thing).

; a primitive root; to impinge, by accident or violence, or (figuratively) by importunity: - come (betwixt), cause to entreat, fall (upon), make intercession, intercessor, intreat, lay, light (upon), meet (together), pray, reach, run.

; from h6294 (פֶּגַע) and h0410 (אֵל); accident of God; Pagiel, an Israelite: - Pagiel.
; a primitive root; to relax, i.e. become exhausted: - be faint.
; from h6296 (פָּגַר); a carcase (as limp), whether of man or beast; figuratively, an idolatrous image: - carcase, corpse, dead body.
; a primitive root; to come in contact with, whether by accident or violence; figuratively, to concur: - meet (with, together).
; a primitive root; to sever, i.e. ransom; gener. to release, preserve: - [idiom] at all, deliver, [idiom] by any means, ransom, (that are to be, let be) redeem(-ed), rescue, [idiom] surely.
; from h6299 (פָּדָה) and h0410 (אֵל); God has ransomed; Pedahel, an Israelite: - Pedahel.
; from h6299 (פָּדָה) and h6697 (צוּר); a rock (i.e. God) has ransomed; Pedahtsur, an Israelite: - Pedahzur.
; passive participle of h6299 (פָּדָה). ransomed (and so occurring under h6299 (פָּדָה)); as abstractly (in plural masculine) a ransom: - (that are) to be (that were) redeemed.
; from h6299 (פָּדָה); ransom; Padon, one of the Nethinim.: - Padon.
; or פְּדֻת; from h6929 (קֵדְמָה)lemma קדְמָה missing vowel, corrected to קֵדְמָה; distinction; also deliverance: - division, redeem, redemption.
; or פְּדָיָהוּ; from h6299 (פָּדָה) and h3050 (יָהּ); Jah has ransomed; Pedajah, the name of six Israelites: - Pedaiah.
; or פִּדְיֹם; also פִּדְיוֹן; or פִּדְיֹן; from h6299 (פָּדָה); a ransom: - ransom, that were redeemed, redemption.
; from an unused root meaning to extend; a plateau; or פַּדַּן אֲרָם; from the same and h0758 (אֲרָם); the table-land of Aram; Paddan or Paddan-Aram, a region of Syria: - Padan, Padan-aram.
; a primitive root; to retrieve: - deliver.
; from an unused root meaning to be greasy; suet: - fat.

; from h6284 (פָּאָה); the mouth (as the means of blowing), whether literal or figurative (particularly speech); specifically edge, portion or side; adverbially (with preposition) according to: - accord(-ing as, -ing to), after, appointment, assent, collar, command(-ment), [idiom] eat, edge, end, entry, [phrase] file, hole, [idiom] in, mind, mouth, part, portion, [idiom] (should) say(-ing), sentence, skirt, sound, speech, [idiom] spoken, talk, tenor, [idiom] to, [phrase] two-edged, wish, word.

; or פֹּא; (Job 38:11), or פּוֹ; probably from a primitive inseparable particle 'p' (of demonstrative force) and h1931 (הוּא); this place (French ici), i.e. here or hence: - here, hither, the one (other, this, that) side.
; or פֻּוָּה; from h6284 (פָּאָה); a blast; Puah or Puvvah, the name of two Israelites: - Phuvah, Pua, Puah.
; a primitive root; to be sluggish: - cease, be feeble, faint, be slacked.
; from h6313 (פּוּג); intermission: - rest.
; a primitive root; to puff, i.e. blow with the breath or air; hence, to fan (as a breeze), to utter, to kindle (a fire), to scoff: - blow (upon), break, puff, bring into a snare, speak, utter.
; of foreign origin; Put, a son of Ham, also the name of his descendants or their region, and of a Persian tribe: - Phut, Put.
; from an unused root (probably meaning to disparage) and h0410 (אֵל); contempt of God; Putiel, an Israelite: - Putiel.
; of Egyptian derivation; Potiphar, an Egyptian: - Potiphar.
; of Egyptian derivation; Poti-Phera, an Egyptian: - Poti-pherah.
; from an unused root meaning to paint; dye (specifically, stibium for the eyes): - fair colours, glistering, paint(-ed) (-ing).
; from an unused root meaning to be thick; a bean (as plump): - beans.
; of foreign origin; Pul, the name of an Assyrian king and of an Ethiopian tribe: - Pul.
; a primitive root meaning to turn, i.e. be perplexed: - be distracted.
; patronymically from an unused name meaning a turn; a Punite (collectively) or descendants of an unknown Pun: - Punites.
; from h6323 (פּוּן); perplexity; Punon, a place in the Desert: - Punon.
; from an unused root meaning to glitter; brilliancy; Puah, an Israelitess: - Puah.

; a primitive root; to dash in pieces, literally or figuratively (especially to disperse): - break (dash, shake) in (to) pieces, cast (abroad), disperse (selves), drive, retire, scatter (abroad), spread abroad.
; a primitive root; to waver: - stumble, move.

; a primitive root (identical with h6328 (פּוּק) through the idea of dropping out; compare h5312 (נְפַק)); to issue, i.e. furnish; causatively, to secure; figuratively, to succeed: - afford, draw out, further, get, obtain.
; from h6328 (פּוּק); a stumbling-block: - grief.
; a primitive root; to crush: - break, bring to nought, [idiom] utterly take.
; also (plural) פּוּרִים; or פֻּרִים; from h6331 (פּוּר); a lot (as by means of a broken piece): - Pur, Purim.
; from h6331 (פּוּר); a wine-press (as crushing the grapes): - winepress.
; of Persian origin; Poratha, a son of Haman: - Poratha.
; a primitive root; to spread; figuratively, act proudly: - grow up, be grown fat, spread selves, be scattered.
; patronymically from an unused name meaning a hinge; a Puthite (collectively) or descendants of an unknown Puth: - Puhites (as if from h6312 (פּוּאָה)).
; from h6338 (פָּזַז); pure (gold); hence, gold itself (as refined): - fine (pure) gold.
; a primitive root; to refine (gold): - best (gold).
; a primitive root (identical with h6338 (פָּזַז)); to solidify (as if by refining); also to spring (as if separating the limbs): - leap, be made strong.
; a primitive root; to scatter, whether in enmity or bounty: - disperse, scatter (abroad).
; from h6351 (פָּחַח); a (metallic) sheet (as pounded thin); also a spring net (as spread out like a lamina): - gin, (thin) plate, snare.
; a primitive root; to be startled (by a sudden alarm); hence, to fear in general: - be afraid, stand in awe, (be in) fear, make to shake.
; from h6342 (פָּחַד); a (sudden) alarm (properly, the object feared, by implication, the feeling): - dread(-ful), fear, (thing) great (fear, -ly feared), terror.
; the same as h6343 (פַּחַד); a testicle (as a cause of shame akin to fear): - stone.
; feminine of h6343 (פַּחַד); alarm (i.e. awe): - fear.
; of foreign origin; a prefect (of a city or small district): - captain, deputy, governor.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h6346 (פֶּחָה) {a prefect (of a city or small district)}: - captain, governor.
; a primitive root; to bubble up or froth (as boiling water), i.e. (figuratively) to be unimportant: - light.
; from h6348 (פָּחַז); ebullition, i.e. froth (figuratively, lust): - unstable.
; from h6348 (פָּחַז); frivolity: - lightness.
; a primitive root; to batter out; but used only as denominative from h6341 (פַּח), to spread a net: - be snared.
; perhaps from an unused root probably meaning to be black; a coal, whether charred or live: - coals.
; (Aramaic) from an unused root probably meaning to fashion; a potter: - potter.
; probably from an unused root apparently meaning to dig; a pit, especially forcatching animals: - hole, pit, snare.
; from h6354 (פַּחַת) and h4124 (מוֹאָב); pit of Moab; Pachath-Moab, an Israelite: - Pahathmoab.
; from the same as h6354 (פַּחַת); a hole (by mildew in a garment): - fret inward.
; of foreign derivation; a gem, probably the topaz: - topaz.
; passive participle of h6362 (פָּטַר); opened, i.e. (as noun) a bud: - open.
; from h6362 (פָּטַר); open, i.e. unoccupied: - free.
; intensively from an unused root meaning to pound; a hammer: - hammer.
; (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to that of h6360 (פַּטִּישׁ); a gown (as if hammered out wide): - hose.
; a primitive root; to cleave or burst through, i.e. (causatively) to emit, whether literal or figurative (gape): - dismiss, free, let (shoot) out, slip away.
; or פִּטְרָה; from h6362 (פָּטַר); a fissure, i.e. (concretely) firstling (as opening the matrix): - firstling, openeth, such as open.
; of Egyptian origin; Pi-Beseth, a place in Egypt: - Pi-beseth.
; from an unused root probably meaning to pierce; (figuratively) misfortune: - destruction, ruin.
; or פִּיָּה; feminine of h6310 (פֶּה); an edge: - (two-) edge(-d).

; from h6310 (פֶּה) and the feminine plural of a noun (from the same root as h2356 (חוֹר)), with the article interpolated; mouth of the gorges; Pi-ha-Chiroth, a place in Egypt: - Pi-hahiroth. (In Numbers 14:19 without Pi-.)
; from h6315 (פּוּחַ); a powder (as easily puffed away), i.e. ashes or dust: - ashes.
; apparently from h6310 (פֶּה) and h3605 (כֹּל); mouth of all; Picol, a Philistine: - Phichol.
; or פִּלֶגֶשׁ; of uncertain derivation; a concubine; also (masculine) a paramour: - concubine, paramour.
; probably from an unused root meaning to be plump; obesity: - collops.
; apparently from h6310 (פֶּה) and a variation of h5175 (נָחָשׁ); mouth of a serpent; Pinechas, the name of three Israelites: - Phinehas.
; probably the same as h6325 (פּוּנֹן); Pinon, an Idumaean: - Pinon.
; for h6366 (פֵּיָה); an edge or tooth: - tooth, [idiom] two-edged.
; from h6329 (פּוּק); a tottering: - smite together.
; from h6335 (פּוּשׁ); dispersive; Pishon, a river of Eden: - Pison.
; probably from the same as h6596 (פֹּת); expansive; Pithon, an Israelite: - Pithon.
; from h6379 (פָּכָה); a flask (from which a liquid may flow): - box, vial.
; a primitive root; to pour: - run out.

; from the active participle (of the same form as the first word) feminine of an unused root (meaning to entrap) and plural of h6643 (צְבִי); trap of gazelles; Pokereth-Tsebajim, one of the 'servants of Solomon': - Pochereth of Zebaim.

; a primitive root; properly, perhaps to separate, i.e. distinguish (literally or figuratively); by implication, to be (causatively, make) great, difficult, wonderful: - accomplish, (arise...too, be too) hard, hidden, things too high, (be, do, do a, shew) marvelous(-ly, -els, things, work), miracles, perform, separate, make singular, (be, great, make) wonderful(-ers, -ly, things, works), wondrous (things, works, -ly).
; from h6381 (פָּלָא); a miracle: - marvellous thing, wonder(-ful, -fully).
; or פָּלִיא; from h6381 (פָּלָא); remarkable: - secret, wonderful.
; patronymically from h6396 (פַּלּוּא); a Palluite (collectively) or descendants of Pallu: - Palluites.
; a primitive root; to split (literally or figuratively): - divide.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h6385 (פָּלַג) {to split (literally or figuratively)}: - divided.
; (Aramaic) from h6386 (פְּלַג); a half: - dividing.
; from h6385 (פָּלַג); a rill (i.e. small channel of water, as in irrigation): - river, stream.
; the same as h6388 (פֶּלֶג); earthquake; Peleg, a son of Shem: - Peleg.
; from h6385 (פָּלַג); a runlet, i.e. gully: - division, river.
; from h6385 (פָּלַג); a section: - division.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h6391 (פְּלֻגָּה) {a section}: - division.
; from an unused root meaning to divide; a cleaver, i.e. iron armature (of a chariot): - torch.
; of uncertain derivation; Pildash, a relative of Abraham: - Pildash.
; a primitive root; to distinguish (literally or figuratively): - put a difference, show marvellous, separate, set apart, sever, make wonderfully.
; from h6395 (פָּלָה); distinguished; Pallu, an Israelite: - Pallu, Phallu.
; patronymically from an unused name (from h6395 (פָּלָה)) meaning separate; a Pelonite or inhabitant of an unknown Palon: - Pelonite.
; a primitive root; to slice, i.e. break open or pierce: - bring forth, cleave, cut, shred, strike through.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h6398 (פָּלַח); to serve or worship: - minister, serve.
; from h6398 (פָּלַח); a slice: - piece.
; from h6400 (פֶּלַח); slicing; Pilcha, an Israelite: - Pilcha.
; (Aramaic) from h6399 (פְּלַח); worship: - service.
; a primitive root; to slip out, i.e. escape; causatively, to deliver: - calve, carry away safe, deliver, (cause to) escape.
; from h6403 (פָּלַט); escape; Pelet, the name of two Israelites: - Pelet. See also h1046 (בֵּית פֶּלֶט).
; from h6403 (פָּלַט); escape: - deliverance, escape.
; from h6403 (פָּלַט); delivered; Palti, the name of two Israelites: - Palti, Phalti.
; patronymically from h6406 (פַּלְטִי); a Paltite or descendant of Palti: - Paltite.
; for h6407 (פַּלְטִי); Piltai, an Israelite: - Piltai.
; from the same as h6404 (פֶּלֶט) and h0410 (אֵל); deliverance of God; Paltiel, the name of two Israelites: - Paltiel, Phaltiel.
; or פְּלַטְיָהוּ; from h6403 (פָּלַט) and h3050 (יָהּ); Jah has delivered; Pelatjah, the name of four Israelites: - Pelatiah.
; or פְּלָאיָה; from h6381 (פָּלָא) and h3050 (יָהּ); Jah has distinguished; Pelajah, the name of three Israelites: - Pelaiah.
; or פָּלֵיט; or פָּלֵט; from h6403 (פָּלַט); a refugee: - (that have) escape(-d, -th), fugitive.
; or פְּלֵטָה; feminine of h6412 (פָּלִיט); deliverance; concretely, an escaped portion: - deliverance, (that is) escape(-d), remnant.
; from h6419 (פָּלַל); a magistrate: - judge.
; feminine of h6414 (פָּלִיל); justice: - judgment.
; from h6414 (פָּלִיל); judicial: - judge.
; feminine of h6416 (פְּלִילִי); judicature: - judgment.
; from an unused root meaning to be round; a circuit (i.e. district); also a spindle (as whirled); hence, a crutch: - (di-) staff, participle
; a primitive root; to judge (officially or mentally); by extension, to intercede, pray: - intreat, judge(-ment), (make) pray(-er, -ing), make supplication.
; from h6419 (פָּלַל); judge; Palal, an Israelite: - Palal.
; from h6419 (פָּלַל) and h3050 (יָהּ); Jah has judged; Pelaljah, an Israelite: - Pelaliah.
; probably for h6423 (פְּלֹנִי); a certain one, i.e. so-and-so: - certain.
; from h6395 (פָּלָה); such a one, i.e. a specified person: - such.
; a primitive root; properly, to roll flat, i.e. prepare (a road); also to revolve, i.e. weigh (mentally): - make, ponder, weigh.
; from h6424 (פָּלַס); a balance: - scales, weight.
; a primitive root; properly, perhaps to rend, i.e. (by implication) to quiver: - tremble.
; from h6426 (פָּלַץ); affright: - fearfulness, horror, trembling.
; a primitive root; to roll (in dust): - roll (wallow) self.
; from h6428 (פָּלַשׁ); rolling, i.e. migratory; Pelesheth, a region of Syria: - Palestina, Palestine, Philistia, Philistines.
; patrial from h6429 (פְּלֶשֶׁת); a Pelishtite or inhabitant of Pelesheth: - Philistine.
; from an unused root meaning to flee; swiftness; Peleth, the name of two Israelites: - Peleth.
; from the same form as h6431 (פֶּלֶת); a courier (collectively) or official messenger: - Pelethites.
; (Aramaic) probably for h6310 (פֶּה); the mouth (literally or figuratively): - mouth.
; from an unused root meaning to turn; an angle (of a street or wall): - corner.
; from h6437 (פָּנָה); properly, removal; used only (in the construction) adverb as conjunction, lest: - (lest) (peradventure), that...not.
; of uncertain derivation; probably pastry: - Pannag.

; a primitive root; to turn; by implication, to face, i.e. appear, look, etc.: - appear, at (even-) tide, behold, cast out, come on, [idiom] corner, dawning, empty, go away, lie, look, mark, pass away, prepare, regard, (have) respect (to), (re-) turn (aside, away, back, face, self), [idiom] right (early).
; feminine of h6434 (פֵּן); an angle; by implication, a pinnacle; figuratively, a chieftain: - bulwark, chief, corner, stay, tower.
; or (more properly,) פְּנִיאֵל; from h6437 (פָּנָה) and h0410 (אֵל); face of God; Penuel or Peniel, a place East of Jordan; also (as Penuel) the name of two Israelites: - Peniel, Penuel.

; plural (but always as singular) of an unused noun פָּנֶה; from h6437 (פָּנָה)); the face (as the part that turns); used in a great variety of applications (literally and figuratively); also (with prepositional prefix) as a preposition (before, etc.): - [phrase] accept, a-(be-) fore(-time), against, anger, [idiom] as (long as), at, [phrase] battle, [phrase] because (of), [phrase] beseech, countenance, edge, [phrase] employ, endure, [phrase] enquire, face, favour, fear of, for, forefront(-part), form(-er time, -ward), from, front, heaviness, [idiom] him(-self), [phrase] honourable, [phrase] impudent, [phrase] in, it, look(-eth) (-s), [idiom] me, [phrase] meet, [idiom] more than, mouth, of, off, (of) old (time), [idiom] on, open, [phrase] out of, over against, the partial, person, [phrase] please, presence, propect, was purposed, by reason of, [phrase] regard, right forth, [phrase] serve, [idiom] shewbread, sight, state, straight, [phrase] street, [idiom] thee, [idiom] them(-selves), through ([phrase] -out), till, time(-s) past, (un-) to(-ward), [phrase] upon, upside ([phrase] down), with(-in, [phrase] -stand), [idiom] ye, [idiom] you.
; from h6440 (פָּנִים) with directive enclitic; faceward, i.e. indoors: - (with-) in(-ner part, -ward).
; from h6440 (פָּנִים); interior: - (with-) in(-ner, -ward).
; or פָּנִי; from the same as h6434 (פֵּן); probably a pearl (as round): - ruby.
; probably feminine from h6443 (פָּנִין) contr.; Peninnah, an Israelitess: - Peninnah.
; a primitive root; to enervate: - bring up.

; from h6461 (פָּסַס); properly, the palm (of the hand) or sole (of the foot) (compare h6447 (פַּס)); by implication (plural) a long and sleeved tunic (perhaps simply a wide one; from the original sense of the root, i.e. of many breadths): - (divers) colours.
; (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to h6461 (פָּסַס); the palm (of the hand, as being spread out): - participle
; a primitive root; to cut up, i.e. (figuratively) contemplate: - consider.
; from h6448 (פָּסַג); a cleft; Pisgah, a Mountain East of Jordan: - Pisgah.
; from h6446 (פַּס) and the plural of h1818 (דָּם); palm (i.e. dell) of bloodshed; Pas-Dammim, a place in Palestine: - Pas-dammim. Compare h0658 (אֶפֶס דַּמִּים).
; from h6461 (פָּסַס); expansion, i.e. abundance: - handful.
; a primitive root; to hop, i.e. (figuratively) skip over (or spare); by implication, to hesitate; also (literally) to limp, to dance: - halt, become lame, leap, pass over.
; from h6452 (פָּסַח); a pretermission, i.e. exemption; used only techically of the Jewish Passover (the festival or the victim): - passover (offering).
; from h6452 (פָּסַח); limping; Paseach, the name of two Israelites: - Paseah, Phaseah.
; from h6452 (פָּסַח); lame: - lame.
; from h6458 (פָּסַל); an idol: - carved (graven) image, quarry.
; from an unused root meaning to divide; divider; Pasak, an Israelite: - Pasach.
; a primitive root; to carve, whether wood or stone: - grave, hew.
; from h6458 (פָּסַל); an idol: - carved (graven) image.
; (Aramaic) or פְּסַנְתֵּרִין; a transliteration of the Greek, psalterion; a lyre: - psaltery.
; a primitive root; probably to disperse, i.e. (intransitive) disappear: - cease.
; perhaps from h6461 (פָּסַס); dispersion; Pispah, an Israelite: - Pispah.
; a primitive root; to scream: - cry.
; or פָּעִי; from h6463 (פָּעָה); screaming; Pau or Pai, a place in Edom: - Pai, Pau.
; from h6473 (פָּעַר); a gap; also h1187 (בַּעַל פְּעוֹר)) Peor, a mountain East of Jordan; Baal Peor, (for a deity worshipped there: - Peor. See also h1047 (בֵּית פְּעוֹר).
; a primitive root; to do or make (systematically and habitually), especially to practise: - commit, (evil-) do(-er), make(-r), ordain, work(-er).
; from h6466 (פָּעַל); an act or work (concretely): - act, deed, do, getting, maker, work.
; feminine passive participle of h6466 (פָּעַל); (abstractly) work: - labour, reward, wages, work.
; from h6468 (פְּעֻלָּה); laborious; Peullethai, an Israelite: - Peulthai.
; a primitive root; to tap, i.e. beat regularly; hence (generally) to impel or agitate: - move, trouble.

; or (feminine) פַּעֲמָה; from h6470 (פָּעַם); a stroke, literally or figuratively (in various applications, as follow): - anvil, corner, foot(-step), going, (hundred-) fold, [idiom] now, (this) [phrase] once, order, rank, step, [phrase] thrice, (often-), second, this, two) time(-s), twice, wheel.
; from h6471 (פַּעַם); a bell (as struck): - bell.
; a primitive root; to yawn, i.e. open wide (literally or figuratively): - gape, open (wide).
; from h6473 (פָּעַר); yawning; Paarai, an Israelite: - Paarai.
; a primitive root; to rend, i.e. open (especially the mouth): - deliver, gape, open, rid, utter.
; a primitive root; to break out (in joyful sound): - break (forth, forth into joy), make a loud noise.
; from h6484 (פָּצַר); bluntness: - [phrase] file.
; a primitive root; to peel: - pill.
; from h6478 (פָּצַל); a peeling: - strake.
; a primitive root; to rend (by earthquake): - break.
; a primitive root; to split, i.e. wound: - wound.
; from h6481 (פָּצַע); a wound: - wound(-ing).
; from an unused root meaning to dissever; dispersive; Pitstsets, a priest: - Apses (including the article).
; a primitive root; to peck at, i.e. (figuratively) stun or dull: - press, urge, stubbornness.

; a primitive root; to visit (with friendly or hostile intent); by analogy, to oversee, muster, charge, care for, miss, deposit, etc.: - appoint, [idiom] at all, avenge, bestow, (appoint to have the, give a) charge, commit, count, deliver to keep, be empty, enjoin, go see, hurt, do judgment, lack, lay up, look, make, [idiom] by any means, miss, number, officer, (make) overseer, have (the) oversight, punish, reckon, (call to) remember(-brance), set (over), sum, [idiom] surely, visit, want.

; feminine passive participle of h6485 (פָּקַד); visitation (in many senses, chiefly official): - account, (that have the) charge, custody, that which...laid up, numbers, office(-r), ordering, oversight, [phrase] prison, reckoning, visitation.
; from h6485 (פָּקַד); a deposit: - that which was delivered (to keep), store.
; from h6496 (פָּקִיד); supervision: - ward.
; from h6485 (פָּקַד); punishment; Pekod, a symbolic name for Babylon: - Pekod.
; or פִּקֻּד; from h6485 (פָּקַד); properly, appointed, i.e. a mandate (of God; plural only, collectively, for the Law): - commandment, precept, statute.
; a primitive root; to open (the senses, especially the eyes); figuratively, to be observant: - open.
; from h6491 (פָּקַח); watch; Pekach, an Israelite king: - Pekah.
; from h6491 (פָּקַח); clear-sighted; figuratively, intelligent: - seeing, wise.
; from h6491 (פָּקַח) and h3050 (יָהּ); Jah has observed; Pekachjah, an Israelite king: - Pekahiah.
; from h6491 (פָּקַח) redoubled; opening (of a dungeon), i.e. jail-delivery (figuratively, salvation for sin): - opening of the prison.
; from h6485 (פָּקַד); a superintendent (civil, military or religious): - which had the charge, governor, office, overseer, (that) was set.
; from an unused root meaning to burst; only used as an architectural term of an ornament similar to h6498 (פַּקֻּעָה), a semi-globe: - knop.
; from the same as h6497 (פֶּקַע); the wild cucumber (from splitting open to shed its seeds): - gourd.
; or פָּר; from h6565 (פָּרַר); a bullock (apparently as breaking forth in wild strength, or perhaps as dividing the hoof): - ([phrase] young) bull(-ock), calf, ox.
; a primitive root; to bear fruit: - be fruitful.
; or פֶּרֶה; (Jeremiah 2:24), from h6500 (פָּרָא) in the secondary sense of running wild; the onager: - wild (ass).
; from h6501 (פֶּרֶא); wildly; Piram, a Canaanite: - Piram.
; or פַּרְוָר; of foreign origin; Parbar or Parvar, a quarter of Jerusalem: - Parbar, suburb.

; feminine passive participle of h6504 (פָּרַד); something separated, i.e. a kernel: - seed.

; the same as h6510 (פָּרָה); Parah, a place in Palestine: - Parah.

; or פְּרִידָא; from h6504 (פָּרַד); dispersion; Peruda or Perida, one of 'Solomon's servants': - Perida, Peruda.
; passive participle of h6524 (פָּרַח); blossomed; Paruach, an Israelite: - Paruah.
; of foreign origin; Parvajim, an Oriental region: - Parvaim.
; passive participle of h6565 (פָּרַר) in the sense of spreading out (compare h6524 (פָּרַח)); a skillet (as flat or deep): - pan, pot.
; from an unused root meaning to separate, i.e. decide; a chieftain: - village.

; or פְּרוֹזִי; from h6519 (פְּרָזָה); a rustic: - village.

; a primitive root; to break forth as a bud, i.e. bloom; generally, to spread; specifically, to fly (as extending the wings); figuratively, to flourish: - [idiom] abroad, [idiom] abundantly, blossom, break forth (out), bud, flourish, make fly, grow, spread, spring (up).

; from h6555 (פָּרַץ)lemma פּרַץ missing vowel, corrected to פָּרַץ; violent, i.e. a tyrant: - destroyer, ravenous, robber.

; a primitive root; to loosen; by implication, to expose, dismiss; figuratively, absolve, begin: - avenge, avoid, bare, go back, let, (make) naked, set at nought, perish, refuse, uncover.

; a primitive root; to break out (in many applications, direct and indirect, literal and figurative): - [idiom] abroad, (make a) breach, break (away, down, -er, forth, in, up), burst out, come (spread) abroad, compel, disperse, grow, increase, open, press, scatter, urge.
; from h6555 (פָּרַץ)lemma פּרַץ missing vowel, corrected to פָּרַץ; a break (literally or figuratively): - breach, breaking forth (in), [idiom] forth, gap.

; a primitive root; to break off or crunch; figuratively, to deliver: - break (off), deliver, redeem, rend (in pieces), tear in pieces.

; a primitive root; to break up (usually figuratively), i.e. to violate, frustrate: - [idiom] any ways, break (asunder), cast off, cause to cease, [idiom] clean, defeat, disannul, disappoint, dissolve, divide, make of none effect, fail, frustrate, bring (come) to nought, [idiom] utterly, make void.
; a primitive root; to break apart, disperse, etc.: - break, chop in pieces, lay open, scatter, spread (abroad, forth, selves, out), stretch (forth, out).
; a primitive root; to separate, literally (to disperse) or figuratively (to specify); also (by implication) to wound: - scatter, declare, distinctly, shew, sting.

; from h6567 (פָּרָשׁ); (compare h5483 (סוּס)) a steed (as stretched out to a vehicle, not single nor for mounting ); also (by implication) a driver (in a chariot), i.e. (collectively) cavalry: - horseman.
; or פַּתְשֶׁגֶן; of foreign origin; a transcript: - copy.

; a primitive root; to spread: - spread.

; a primitive root; to spread out (i.e. deploy in hostile array); by analogy, to strip (i.e. unclothe, plunder, flay, etc.): - fall upon, flay, invade, make an invasion, pull off, put off, make a road, run upon, rush, set, spoil, spread selves (abroad), strip (off, self).
; a primitive root; to stride (from spreading the legs), i.e. rush upon: - go.

; a primitive root; to open, i.e. be (causatively, make) roomy; usually figuratively (in a mental or moral sense) to be (causatively, make) simple or (in a sinister way) delude: - allure, deceive, enlarge, entice, flatter, persuade, silly (one).

; of foreign origin; Pethor, a place in Mesopotamia: - Pethor.

; a primitive root; to open wide (literally or figuratively); specifically, to loosen, begin, plough, carve: - appear, break forth, draw (out), let go free, (en-) grave(-n), loose (self), (be, be set) open(-ing), put off, ungird, unstop, have vent.

; from h6605 (פָּתַח); something opened, i.e. a drawn sword: - drawn sword.

; or פֶּתִי; or פְּתָאִי; from h6601 (פָּתָה); silly (i.e. seducible): - foolish, simple(-icity, one).

; from h6617 (פָּתַל); tortuous (i.e. crafty): - crooked.
; of Egyptian derivation; Pithom, a place in Egypt: - Pithom.

; from an unused root meaning to open (the eyes); (compare h6597 (פִּתְאוֹם)) a wink, i.e. moment(used only (with or without preposition) adverbially, quickly or unexpectedly: - at an instant, suddenly, [idiom] very.
; a primitive root; to open up, i.e. (figuratively) interpret (a dream): - interpret(-ation, -er).

; from h3318 (יָצָא); issue, i.e. (human) excrement: - that (which) cometh from (out).

; or צאוֹן; (Psalm 144:13), from an unused root meaning to migrate; a collective name for a flock (of sheep or goats); also figuratively (of men): - (small) cattle, flock ([phrase] -s), lamb ([phrase] -s), sheep(-cote, -fold, -shearer, -herds).
; from the same as h6629 (צֹאן) used denominatively; sheep pasture; Zaanan, a place in Palestine: - Zaanan.

; from an unused root meaning to establish; a palanquin or canopy (as a fixture); also a species of lizard (probably as clinging fast): - covered, litter, tortoise.

; or (feminine) צְבָאָה; from h6633 (צָבָא); a mass of persons (or figuratively, things), especially reg. organized forwar (an army); by implication, a campaign, literally or figuratively (specifically, hardship, worship): - appointed time, ([phrase]) army, ([phrase]) battle, company, host, service, soldiers, waiting upon, war(-fare).
; or (more correctly) צְבִיִּים; or צְבִיִּם; plural of h6643 (צְבִי); gazelles; Tseboim or Tsebijim, a place in Palestine: - Zeboiim, Zeboim.

; a primitive root; to grasp, i.e. hand out: - reach.

; for h6646 (צְבִיָּה); Tsibjah, an Israelite: - Zibiah.
; feminine of h6643 (צְבִי); a female gazelle: - roe.
; (Aramaic) a root corresponding to that of h6648 (צֶבַע); to dip: - wet.
; from an unused root meaning to dip (into coloring fluid); a dye: - divers, colours.
; from the same as h6648 (צֶבַע); variegated; Tsibon, an Idumaean: - Zibeon.

; a primitive root; to aggregate: - gather (together), heap (up), lay up.

; from an unused root apparently meaning to grip; a lock of stalks: - handful.
; contr. from an unused root meaning to sidle off; a side; figuratively, an adversary: - (be-) side.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h6654 (צַד); used adverbially (with preposition) at or upon the side of: - against, concerning.
; (Aramaic) from an unused root corresponding to h6658 (צָדָה) in the sense of intentness; a (sinister) design: - true.

; a primitive root; to chase; by implication, to desolate: - destroy, hunt, lie in wait.

; a primitive root; to be (causatively, make) right (in a moral or forensic sense): - cleanse, clear self, (be, do) just(-ice, -ify, -ify self), (be turn to) righteous(-ness).

; from h6663 (צָדַק); the right (natural, moral or legal); also (abstractly) equity or (figuratively) prosperity: - [idiom] even, ([idiom] that which is altogether) just(-ice), (un-)right(-eous) (cause, -ly, -ness).
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h6666 (צְדָקָה); beneficence: - righteousness.
; from h6663 (צָדַק); rightness (abstractly), subjectively (rectitude), objectively (justice), morally (virtue) or figuratively (prosperity): - justice, moderately, right(-eous) (act, -ly, -ness).
; or צִדְקִיָּהוּ; from h6664 (צֶדֶק) and h3050 (יָהּ); right of Jah; Tsidkijah, the name of six Israelites: - Zedekiah, Zidkijah.
; a primitive root; to glitter, i.e. be golden in color: - [idiom] fine.

; a primitive root; to gleam, i.e. (figuratively) be cheerful; by transference to sound clear (of various animal or human expressions): - bellow, cry aloud (out), lift up, neigh, rejoice, make to shine, shout.
; a primitive root; to glisten; used only as denominative from h3323 (יִצְהָר), to press out oil: - make oil.
; from h6671 (צָהַר); a light (i.e. window); dual double light, i.e. noon: - midday, noon(-day, -tide), window.
; or צָו; from h6680 (צָוָה); an injunction: - commandment, precept.
; or צֹא; from an unused root meaning to issue; soiled (as if excrementitious): - filthy.
; or צֹאָה ; feminine of h6674 (צוֹא); excrement; generally, dirt; figuratively, pollution: - dung, filth(-iness). Marg. for h2716 (חֶרֶא).
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h6677 (צַוָּאר) {the back of the neck (as that on which burdens are bound)}: - neck.

; or צַוָּר; (Nehemiah 3:5), or צַוָּרֹןlemma צַוָּרן missing vowel, corrected to צַוָּרֹן; (Song of Solomon 4:9), or (feminine) צַוָּארָה; (Micah 2:3), intensively from h6696 (צוּר) in the sense of binding; the back of the neck (as that on which burdens are bound): - neck.
; or צוֹבָה; or צֹבָה; from an unused root meaning to station; a station; Zoba or Zobah, a region of Syria: - Zoba, Zobah.

; a primitive root; also denominative from h6718 (צַיִד) to lie alongside (i.e. in wait); by implication, to catch an animal (figuratively, men); to victual (for a journey): - chase, hunt, sore, take (provision).
; a primitive root; (intensively) to constitute, enjoin: - appoint, (for-) bid, (give a) charge, (give a, give in, send with) command(-er, -ment), send a messenger, put, (set) in order.
; a primitive root; to screech (exultingly): - shout.

; from an unused root meaning to sink; an abyss (of the sea): - deep.
; a primitive root; to cover over (the mouth), i.e. to fast: - [idiom] at all, fast.
; or צֹם; from h6684 (צוּם); a fast: - fast(-ing).
; from h6819 (צָעַר); small; Tsuar, an Israelite: - Zuar.
; a primitive root; to overflow: - (make to over-) flow, swim.
; from h6687 (צוּף); comb of honey (from dripping): - honeycomb.
; or צוֹפַי; or צִיף; from h6688 (צוּף); honey-comb; Tsuph or Tsophai or Tsiph, the name of an Israelite and of a place in Palestine: - Zophai, Zuph.
; from an unused root meaning to expand, breadth; Tsophach, an Israelite: - Zophah.
; from h6852 (צָפַר); departing; Tsophar, a friend of Job: - Zophar.
; a primitive root; to twinkle, i.e. glance; by analogy, to blossom (figuratively, flourish): - bloom, blossom, flourish, shew self.
; a primitive root; to compress, i.e. (figuratively) oppress, distress: - constrain, distress, lie sore, (op-) press(-or), straiten.
; a primitive root (identical with through the idea of narrowness (of orifice)); to pour out, i.e. (figuratively) smelt, utter: - be molten, pour.
; or (feminine) צוּקָה; from h6693 (צוּק); a strait, i.e. (figuratively) distress: - anguish, [idiom] troublous.

; a primitive root; to cramp, i.e. confine (in many applications, literally and figuratively, formative or hostile): - adversary, assault, beset, besiege, bind (up), cast, distress, fashion, fortify, inclose, lay siege, put up in bags.

; or צָלֵחַ; a primitive root; to push forward, in various senses (literal or figurative, transitive or intransitive): - break out, come (mightily), go over, be good, be meet, be profitable, (cause to, effect, make to, send) prosper(-ity, -ous, -ously).

; or (feminine) צַלְעָה; from h6760 (צָלַע); a rib (as curved), literally (of the body) or figuratively (of a door, i.e. leaf); hence, a side, literally (of a person) or figuratively (of an object or the sky, i.e. quarter); architecturally, a (especially floor or ceiling) timber or plank (single or collective, i.e. a flooring): - beam, board, chamber, corner, leaf, plank, rib, side (chamber).
