; from h6958 (קוֹא); probably the pelican (from vomiting): - cormorant.
; from h6895 (קָבַב); a hollow, i.e. vessel used as a (dry) measure: - cab.
; a primitive root; to scoop out, i.e. (figuratively) to malign or execrate (i.e. stab with words): - [idiom] at all, curse.
; from h6895 (קָבַב); the paunch (as a cavity) or first stomach of ruminants: - maw.
; from h6895 (קָבַב); the abdomen (as a cavity): - belly.
; from h6895 (קָבַב); a pavilion (as a domed cavity): - tent.
; from h6908 (קָבַץ); a throng: - company.
; or קְבֻרָה; feminine passive participle of h6912 (קָבַר); sepulture; (concretely) a sepulchre: - burial, burying place, grave, sepulchre.
; a primitive root; to admit, i.e. take (literally or figuratively): - choose, (take) hold, receive, (under-) take.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h6901 (קָבַל); to acquire: - receive, take.

; (Aramaic) or קֳבֵל; (Aramaic), (corresponding to h6905 (קָבָל); (adverbially) in front of; usually (with other particles) on account of, so as, since, hence: - [phrase] according to, [phrase] as, [phrase] because, before, [phrase] for this cause, [phrase] forasmuch as, [phrase] by this means, over against, by reason of, [phrase] that, [phrase] therefore, [phrase] though, [phrase] wherefore.
; from h6901 (קָבַל) in the sense of confronting (as standing opposite in order to receive); a battering-ram: - war.
; from h6901 (קָבַל) in the sense of opposite (see h6904 (קֹבֶל)); the presence, i.e. (adverbially) in front of: - before.
; a primitive root; to cover, i.e. (figuratively) defraud: - rob, spoil.
; from h6906 (קָבַע); a goblet (as deep like a cover): - dregs.
; a primitive root; to grasp, i.e. collect: - assemble (selves), gather (bring) (together, selves together, up), heap, resort, [idiom] surely, take up.
; from h6908 (קָבַץ) and h0410 (אֵל); God has gathered; Kabtseel, a place in Palestine: - Kabzeel. Compare h3343 (יְקַבְצְאֵל).
; feminine passive participle of h6908 (קָבַץ); a hoard: - [idiom] gather.
; dual from h6908 (קָבַץ); a double heap; Kibtsajim, a place in Palestine: - Kibzaim.
; a primitive root; to inter: - [idiom] in any wise, bury(-ier).
; or (feminine) קִבְרָה; from h6912 (קָבַר); a sepulchre: - burying place, grave, sepulchre.
; from the feminine plural of h6913 (קֶבֶר) and h8378 (תַּאֲוָה) with the article interposed; graves of the longing; Kibroth-hat-Taavh, a place in the Desert: - Kibroth-hattaavah.
; a primitive root; to shrivel up, i.e. contract or bend the body (or neck) in deference: - bow (down) (the) head, stoop.
; from h6915 (קָדַד); cassia bark (as in shrivelled rolls): - cassia.
; passive participle of h6923 (קָדַם); a pristine hero: - ancient.
; or קָדֹשׁ; from h6942 (קָדַשׁ); sacred (ceremonially or morally); (as noun) God (by eminence), an angel, a saint, a sanctuary: - holy (One), saint.
; a primitive root to inflame to inflame: - burn, kindle.
; from h6919 (קָדַח); inflammation, i.e. febrile disease: - burning ague, fever.
; or קָדִם; from h6923 (קָדַם); the fore or front part; hence (by orientation) the East (often adverbially, eastward, for brevity the east wind): - east(-ward, wind).
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h6918 (קָדוֹשׁ). {sacred (ceremonially or morally); (as noun) God (by eminence), an angel, a saint, a sanctuary}: - holy (One), saint.
; a primitive root; to project (one self), i.e. precede; hence, to anticipate, hasten, meet (usually for help): - come (go, (flee)) before, [phrase] disappoint, meet, prevent.

; or קֵדְמָה; from h6923 (קָדַם); the front, of place (absolutely, the fore part, relatively the East) or time (antiquity); often used adverbially (before, anciently, eastward): - aforetime, ancient (time), before, east (end, part, side, -ward), eternal, [idiom] ever(-lasting), forward, old, past. Compare h6926 (קִדְמָה).
; (Aramaic) or קְדָם; (Aramaic) (Daniel 7:13), corresponding to h6924 (קֶדֶם); before: - before, [idiom] from, [idiom] I (thought), [idiom] me, [phrase] of, [idiom] it pleased, presence.
; feminine of h6924 (קֶדֶם); the forward part (or relatively) East (often adverbially, on the east or in front): - east(-ward).
; from h6923 (קָדַם); priority (in time); also used adverbially (before): - afore, antiquity, former (old) estate.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h6927 (קַדְמָה); former time: - afore(-time), ago.
; from h6923 (קָדַם); precedence; Kedemah, a son of Ishmael: - Kedemah.
; from h6923 (קָדַם); eastern: - east.
; or קַדְמֹנִי; from h6930 (קַדְמוֹן); (of time) anterior or (of place) oriental: - ancient, they that went before, east, (thing of) old.
; from h6923 (קָדַם); beginnings; Kedemoth, a place in eastern Palestine: - Kedemoth.
; (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to h6923 (קָדַם); first: - first.
; from h6924 (קֶדֶם) and h0410 (אֵל); presence of God; Kadmiel, the name of three Israelites: - Kadmiel.
; the same as h6931 (קַדְמוֹנִי); ancient, i.e. aboriginal; Kadmonite (collectively), the name of a tribe in Palestine: - Kadmonites.
; from h6915 (קָדַד); the crown of the head (as the part most bowed): - crown (of the head), pate, scalp, top of the head.
; a primitive root; to be ashy, i.e. darkcolored; by implication, to mourn (in sackcloth or sordid garments): - be black(-ish), be (make) dark(-en), [idiom] heavily, (cause to) mourn.
; from h6937 (קָדַר); dusky (of the skin or the tent); Kedar, a son of Ishmael; also (collectively) Bedouin (as his descendants or representatives): - Kedar.
; from h6937 (קָדַר); dusky place; Kidron, a brook near Jerusalem: - Kidron.
; from h6937 (קָדַר); duskiness: - blackness.
; adverb from h6937 (קָדַר); blackish ones (i.e. in sackcloth); used adverbially, in mourning weeds: - mournfully.

; a primitive root; to be (causatively, make, pronounce or observe as) clean (ceremonially or morally): - appoint, bid, consecrate, dedicate, defile, hallow, (be, keep) holy(-er, place), keep, prepare, proclaim, purify, sanctify(-ied one, self), [idiom] wholly.
; from h6942 (קָדַשׁ); a sanctum; Kedesh, the name of four places in Palestine: - Kedesh.

; from h6942 (קָדַשׁ); a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract, sanctity: - consecrated (thing), dedicated (thing), hallowed (thing), holiness, ([idiom] most) holy ([idiom] day, portion, thing), saint, sanctuary.
; from h6942 (קָדַשׁ); a (quasi) sacred person, i.e. (technically) a (male) devotee (by prostitution) to licentious idolatry: - sodomite, unclean.
; the same as h6945 (קָדֵשׁ); sanctuary; Kadesh, a place in the Desert: - Kadesh. Compare h6947 (קָדֵשׁ בַּרְנֵעַ).

; from the same as h6946 (קָדֵשׁ) and an otherwise unused word (apparently compounded of a correspondent to h1251 (בַּר) and a derivative of h5128 (נוּעַ)) meaning desert of a fugitive; Kadesh of (the) Wilderness of Wandering; Kadesh-Barnea, a place in the Desert: - Kadeshbarnea.
; feminine of h6945 (קָדֵשׁ); a female devotee (i.e. prostitute): - harlot, whore.
; a primitive root; to be dull: - be set on edge, be blunt.
; a primitive root; to convoke: - assemble (selves) (together), gather (selves) (together).
; from h6950 (קָהַל); assemblage (usually concretely): - assembly, company, congregation, multitude.
; from h6950 (קָהַל); an assemblage: - assembly, congregation.
; feminine of active participle from h6950 (קָהַל); a (female) assembler (i.e. lecturer); abstractly, preaching (used as a 'nom de plume', Koheleth): - preacher.
; from h6950 (קָהַל); convocation; Kehelathah, a place in the Desert: - Kehelathah.
; from an unused root meaning to ally oneself; allied; Kehath, an Israelite: - Kohath.
; patronymically from h6955 (קְהָת); a Kohathite (collectively) or descendants of Kehath: - Kohathites.

; or קָו; from h6960 (קָוָה) (compare h6961 (קָוֶה)); a cord (as connecting), especially formeasuring; figuratively, a rule; also a rim, a musical string or accord: - line. Compare h6978 (קַו־קַו)lemma קַו־קַי yod, corrected to קַו־קַו.
; or קָיָה; (Jeremiah 25:27), a primitive root; to vomit: - spue (out), vomit (out, up, up again).
; a form collateral to h3553 (כּוֹבַע); a helmet: - helmet.
; a primitive root; to bind together (perhaps by twisting), i.e. collect; (figuratively) to expect: - gather (together), look, patiently, tarry, wait (for, on, upon).
; from h6960 (קָוָה); a (measuring) cord (as if for binding): - line.
; a primitive root; properly, to cut off, i.e. (figuratively) detest: - begrieved, loathe self.

; or קֹל; from an unused root meaning to call aloud; a voice or sound: - [phrase] aloud, bleating, crackling, cry ([phrase] out), fame, lightness, lowing, noise, [phrase] hold peace, (pro-) claim, proclamation, [phrase] sing, sound, [phrase] spark, thunder(-ing), voice, [phrase] yell.
; from h6963 (קוֹל) and h3050 (יָהּ); voice of Jah; Kolajah, the name of two Israelites: - Kolaiah.

; a primitive root; to rise (in various applications, literal, figurative, intensive and causative): - abide, accomplish, [idiom] be clearer, confirm, continue, decree, [idiom] be dim, endure, [idiom] enemy, enjoin, get up, make good, help, hold, (help to) lift up (again), make, [idiom] but newly, ordain, perform, pitch, raise (up), rear (up), remain, (a-) rise (up) (again, against), rouse up, set (up), (e-) stablish, (make to) stand (up), stir up, strengthen, succeed, (as-, make) sure(-ly), (be) up(-hold, -rising).

; (Aramaic) corresponding to h6965 (קוּם) {to rise (in various applications, literal, figurative, intensive and causative)}: - appoint, establish, make, raise up self, (a-) rise (up), (make to) stand, set (up).
; from h6965 (קוּם); height: - [idiom] along, height, high, stature, tall.
; from h6965 (קוּם); elevation, i.e. (adverbially) erectly (figuratively): - upright.
; a primitive root; to strike a musical note, i.e. chant or wail (at a funeral): - lament, mourning woman.
; probably from h6972 (קוּץ) in the original sense of cutting off; curtailment; Koa, a region of Babylon: - Koa.
; or קֹף; of foreign origin, a monkey: - ape.
; a primitive root; to clip off; used only as denominative from h7019 (קַיִץ); to spend the harvest season: - summer.

; a primitive root (identical with through the idea of severing oneself from (compare h6962 (קוּט))); to be (causatively, make) disgusted or anxious: - abhor, be distressed, be grieved, loathe, vex, be weary.
; a primitive root (identical with through the idea of abruptness in starting up from sleep (compare h3364 (יָקַץ))); to awake (literally or figuratively): - arise, (be) (a-) wake, watch.
; or קֹץ; from h6972 (קוּץ) (in the sense of pricking); a thorn: - thorn.
; the same as h6975 (קוֹץ); Kots, the name of two Israelites: - Koz, Hakkoz (including the article).
; feminine passive participle of h6972 (קוּץ) in its original sense; a forelock (as shorn): - lock.
; from h6957 (קַו) (in the sense of a fastening); stalwart: - [idiom] meted out.

; a primitive root; also denominative from h7023 (קִיר) to trench; by implication, to throw forth; to wall up, whether literal (to build a wall) or figurative (to estop): - break down, cast out, destroy, dig.
; from h6979 (קוּר); (only plural) trenches, i.e. a web (as if so formed): - web.
; or קֹרֵא; (1 Chronicles 26:1), active participle of h7121 (קָרָא); crier; Kore, the name of two Israelites: - Kore.
; or קֹרָה; from h6979 (קוּר); a rafter (forming trenches as it were); by implication, a roof: - beam, roof.
; a primitive root; to bend; used only as denominative for h3369 (יָקֹשׁ), to set a trap: - lay a snare.
; from the passive participle of h6983 (קוֹשׁ) and h3050 (יָהּ); entrapped of Jah; Kushajah, an Israelite: - Kushaiah.
; from h6990 (קָטַט) in the sense of abbreviation; a little, i.e. (adverbially) merely: - very.
; from an unused root meaning to cut off; ruin: - destroying, destruction.
; from the same as h6986 (קֶטֶב); extermination: - destruction.
; from h6999 (קָטַר); perfume: - incense.
; feminine passive participle of h6999 (קָטַר); perfumed; Keturah, a wife of Abraham: - Keturah.
; a primitive root; to clip off, i.e. (figuratively) destroy: - be cut off.
; a primitive root; properly, to cut off, i.e. (figuratively) put to death: - kill, slay.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h6991 (קָטַל); to kill: - slay.
; from h6991 (קָטַל); a violent death: - slaughter.
; a primitive root (rather denominative from h6996 (קָטָן)); to diminish, i.e. be (causatively, make) diminutive or (figuratively) of no account: - be a (make) small (thing), be not worthy.
; from h6994 (קָטֹן); a pettiness, i.e. the little finger: - little finger.

; or קָטֹן; from h6962 (קוּט); abbreviated, i.e. diminutive, literally (in quantity, size or number) or figuratively (in age or importance): - least, less(-er), little (one), small(-est, one, quantity, thing), young(-er, -est).
; the same as h6996 (קָטָן); small; Katan, an Israelite: - Hakkatan (including the article).
; a primitive root; to strip off: - crop off, cut down (up), pluck.

; a primitive root (identical with through the idea of fumigation in a close place and perhaps thus driving out the occupants); to smoke, i.e. turn into fragrance by fire (especially as an act of worship): - burn (incense, sacrifice) (upon), (altar for) incense, kindle, offer (incense, a sacrifice).
; a primitive root; to inclose: - join.
; (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to h7000 (קָטַר); a knot (as tied up), i.e. (figuratively) a riddle; also a vertebra (as if a knot): - doubt, joint.
; from h6999 (קָטַר); perfume: - incense.
; from h6999 (קָטַר); fumigative; Kitron, a place in Palestine: - Kitron.
; from h6999 (קָטַר); a fumigation: - (sweet) incense, perfume.
; from h6996 (קָטָן); littleness; Kattath, a place in Palestine: - Kattath.
; a primitive root; to vomit: - spue.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h7019 (קַיִץ); harvest: - summer.
; or קִיטֹר; from h6999 (קָטַר); a fume, i.e. cloud: - smoke, vapour.
; from h6965 (קוּם); an opponent (as rising against one), i.e. (collectively) enemies: - substance.
; (Aramaic) from h6966 (קוּם); an edict (as arising in law): - decree, statute.
; (Aramaic) from h6966 (קוּם); permanent (as rising firmly): - stedfast, sure.
; from h6965 (קוּם); an arising: - rising up.
; from h6969 (קוּן) in the original sense of fixity; a lance (as striking fast): - spear.
; the same as h7013 (קַיִן) (with a play upon the affinity to h7069 (קָנָה)); Kajin, the name of the first child, also of a place in Palestine, and of an Oriental tribe: - Cain, Kenite(-s).
; from h6969 (קוּן); a dirge (as accompanied by beating the breasts or on instruments): - lamentation.
; the same as h7015 (קִינָה); Kinah, a place in Palestine: - Kinah.
; or קִינִי; (1 Chronicles 2:55), patronymic from h7014 (קַיִן); a Kenite or member of the tribe of Kajin: - Kenite.
; from the same as h7064 (קֵן); fixed; Kenan, an antediluvian: - Cainan, Kenan.
; from h6972 (קוּץ); harvest (as the crop), whether the product (grain or fruit) or the (dry) season: - summer (fruit, house).
; from h6972 (קוּץ); terminal: - out-(utter-) most.
; perhaps from h7006 (קָיָה); the gourd (as nauseous): - gourd.
; from h7036 (קָלוֹן); intense disgrace: - shameful spewing.
; or קִר; (Isaiah 22:5), or (feminine) קִירָה; from h6979 (קוּר); a wall (as built in a trench): - [phrase] mason, side, town, [idiom] very, wall.
; the same as h7023 (קִיר); fortress; Kir, a place in Assyrian; also one in Moab: - Kir. Compare h7025 (קִיר חֶרֶשׂ).

; or (feminine of the latter word) קִיר חֲרֶשֶׂת; from h7023 (קִיר) and h2789 (חֶרֶשׂ); fortress of earthenware; Kir-Cheres or Kir-Chareseth, a place in Moab: - Kir-haraseth, Kir-hareseth, Kirharesh, Kir-heres.
; or קֵרֹס; from the same as h7166 (קַרְסֹל); ankled; Keros, one of the Nethinim: - Keros.
; from h6983 (קוֹשׁ); a bow; Kish, the name of five Israelites: - Kish.
; from h6983 (קוֹשׁ); winding; Kishon, a river of Palestine: - Kishon, Kison.
; from h6983 (קוֹשׁ); bowed; Kishi, an Israelite: - Kishi.
; (Aramaic) of Greek origin; a lyre: - harp.
; contracted from h7043 (קָלַל); light; (by implication) rapid (also adverbial): - light, swift(-ly).
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h6963 (קוֹל) {a voice or sound}: - sound, voice.
; a primitive root (rather identical with h7034 (קָלָה) through the idea of shrinkage by heat); to toast, i.e. scorch partially or slowly: - dried, loathsome, parch, roast.
; a primitive root; to be light (as implied in rapid motion), but figuratively, only (be (causatively, hold) in contempt): - base, contemn, despise, lightly esteem, set light, seem vile.
; for h6950 (קָהַל); to assemble: - gather together.
; from h7034 (קָלָה); disgrace; (by implication) the pudenda: - confusion, dishonour, ignominy, reproach, shame.
; apparently but a form for h6747 (צַלַּחַת); a kettle: - caldron.
; a primitive root; to maim: - lacking in his parts.
; or קָלִיא; from h7033 (קָלָה); roasted ears of grain: - parched corn.
; from h7043 (קָלַל); frivolous; Kallai, an Israelite: - Kallai.
; from h7034 (קָלָה); insignificance; Kelajah, an Israelite: - Kelaiah.
; from h7038 (קָלַט); maiming; Kelita, the name of three Israelites: - Kelita.

; a primitive root; to be (causatively, make) light, literally (swift, small, sharp, etc.) or figuratively (easy, trifling, vile, etc.): - abate, make bright, bring into contempt, (ac-) curse, despise, (be) ease(-y, -ier), (be a, make, make somewhat, move, seem a, set) light(-en, -er, -ly, -ly afflict, -ly esteem, thing), [idiom] slight(-ly), be swift(-er), (be, be more, make, re-) vile, whet.
; from h7043 (קָלַל); brightened (as if sharpened): - burnished, polished.
; from h7043 (קָלַל); vilification: - (ac-) curse(-d, -ing).
; a primitive root; to disparage, i.e. ridicule: - mock, scoff, scorn.
; from h7046 (קָלַס); a laughing-stock: - derision.
; intensive from h7046 (קָלַס); ridicule: - mocking.
; a primitive root; to sling; also to carve (as if a circular motion, or into light forms): - carve, sling (out).
; from h7049 (קָלַע); a sling; also a (door) screen (as if slung across), or the valve (of the door) itself: - hanging, leaf, sling.
; intensive from h7049 (קָלַע); a slinger: - slinger.
; from h7043 (קָלַל); insubstantial: - light.
; from an unused root meaning to prick; a prong, i.e. hay-fork: - fork.
; feminine of active participle of h6965 (קוּם); something that rises, i.e. a stalk of grain: - (standing) corn, grown up, stalk.
; from h6965 (קוּם) and h0410 (אֵל); raised of God; Kemuel, the name of a relative of Abraham, and of two Israelites: - Kemuel.
; from h6965 (קוּם); an elevation; Kamon, a place East of the Jordan: - Camon.
; or קִימוֹשׁ; from an unused root meaning to sting; a prickly plant: - nettle. Compare h7063 (קִמָּשׁוֹן).
; from an unused root probably meaning to grind; flour: - flour, meal.
; a primitive root; to pluck, i.e. destroy: - cut down, fill with wrinkles.
; a primitive root; to wither: - hew down, wither.
; a primitive root; to grasp with the hand: - take an handful.
; from h7061 (קָמַץ); a grasp, i.e. handful: - handful.
; from the same as h7057 (קִמּוֹשׁ); a prickly plant: - thorn.
; contracted from h7077 (קָנַן); a nest (as fixed), sometimes including the nestlings; figuratively, a chamber or dwelling: - nest, room.
; a primitive root; to be (causatively, make) zealous, i.e. (in a bad sense) jealous or envious: - (be) envy(-ious), be (move to, provoke to) jealous(-y), [idiom] very, (be) zeal(-ous).
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h7069 (קָנָה); to purchase: - buy.
; from h7065 (קָנָא); jealous: - jealous. Compare h7072 (קַנּוֹא).
; from h7065 (קָנָא); jealousy or envy: - envy(-ied), jealousy, [idiom] sake, zeal.

; a primitive root; to erect, i.e. create; by extension, to procure, especially by purchase (causatively, sell); by implication to own: - attain, buy(-er), teach to keep cattle, get, provoke to jealousy, possess(-or), purchase, recover, redeem, [idiom] surely, [idiom] verily.

; from h7069 (קָנָה); a reed (as erect); by resemblance a rod (especially for measuring), shaft, tube, stem, the radius (of the arm), beam (of a steelyard): - balance, bone, branch, calamus, cane, reed, [idiom] spearman, stalk.
; feminine of h7070 (קָנֶה); reediness; Kanah, the name of a stream and of a place in Palestine: - Kanah.
; for h7067 (קַנָּא); jealous or angry: - jealous.
; probably from an unused root meaning to hunt; hunter; Kenaz, the name of an Edomite and of two Israelites: - Kenaz.
; patronymic from h7073 (קְנַז), a Kenizzite or descendant of Kenaz: - Kenezite, Kenizzites.
; from h7069 (קָנָה); creation, i.e. (concretely) creatures; also acquisition, purchase, wealth: - getting, goods, [idiom] with money, riches, substance.
; from an unused root (meaning to erect); cinnamon bark (as in upright rolls): - cinnamon.
; a primitive root; to erect; but used only as denominative from h7064 (קֵן); to nestle, i.e. build or occupy as anest: - make...nest.
; from an unused root probably meaning to wrench; perversion: - end.
; from h7069 (קָנָה); possession; Kenath, a place East of the Jordan: - Kenath.
; a primitive root; properly, to distribute, i.e. determine by lot or magical scroll; by implication, to divine: - divine(-r, -ation), prudent, soothsayer, use (divination).
; from h7080 (קָסַם); a lot; also divination (including its fee), oracle: - (reward of) divination, divine sentence, witchcraft.
; a primitive root; to lop off: - cut off.
; from the same as h3563 (כּוֹס) (or as h7185 (קָשָׁה)); properly, a cup, i.e. an ink-stand: - inkhorn.
; perhaps from h7049 (קָלַע) in the sense of enclosing; citadel; Keilah, a place in Palestine: - Keilah.
; from the same as h6970 (קוֹעַ); an incision or gash: - [phrase] mark.
; probably from h7167 (קָרַע); a bowl (as cut out hollow): - charger, dish.
; a primitive root; to shrink, i.e. thicken (as unracked wine, curdled milk, clouded sky, frozen water): - congeal, curdle, dark, settle.
; a primitive root; to contract, i.e. roll together: - cut off.
; from h7088 (קָפַד); shrinking, i.e., terror: - destruction.
; or קִפֹּדlemma קִכֹּד kaf, corrected to קִפֹּד; from h7088 (קָפַד); a species of bird, perhaps the bittern (from its contracted form): - bittern.
; from an unused root meaning to contract, i.e. spring forward; an arrow-snake (as darting on its prey): - great owl.
; a primitive root; to draw together, i.e. close; by implication, to leap (by contracting the limbs); specifically, to die (from gathering up the feet): - shut (up), skip, stop, take out of the way.
; contracted from h7112 (קָצַץ); an extremity; adverbially (with prepositional prefix) after: - [phrase] after, (utmost) border, end, (in-) finite, [idiom] process.
; a primitive root; to clip, or (generally) chop: - cut down, shorn.
; from h7094 (קָצַב); shape (as if cut out); base (as if there cut off): - bottom, size.
; a primitive root; to cut off; (figuratively) to destroy; (partially) to scrape off: - cut off, cut short, scrape (off).

; or (negative only) קֵצֶה; from h7096 (קָצָה); (used in a great variety of applications and idioms; compare h7093 (קֵץ)) an extremity: - [idiom] after, border, brim, brink, edge, end, (in-) finite, frontier, outmost coast, quarter, shore, (out-) side, [idiom] some, ut(-ter-) most (part).
; feminine of h7097 (קָצֶה); (used like h7097 (קָצֶה)) a termination: - coast, corner, (selv-) edge, lowest, (uttermost) participle
; and (feminine) קִצְוָה; from h7096 (קָצָה); (used like h7097 (קָצֶה), but with less variety) a limit: - end, edge, uttermost participle
; from an unused root apparently meaning to incise; fennelflower (from its pungency): - fitches.
; from h7096 (קָצָה) in the sense of determining; a magistrate (as deciding) or other leader: - captain, guide, prince, ruler. Compare h6278 (עֵת קָצִין).
; from h7106 (קָצַע); cassia (as peeled; plural the bark): - cassia.
; the same as h7102 (קְצִיעָה); Ketsiah, a daughter of Job: - Kezia.
; from h7112 (קָצַץ); abrupt; Keziz, a valley in Palestine: - Keziz.
; from h7114 (קָצַר); severed, i.e. harvest (as reaped), the crop, the time, the reaper, or figuratively; also a limb (of a tree, or simply foliage): - bough, branch, harvest (man).
; a primitive root; to strip off, i.e. (partially) scrape; by implication, to segregate (as an angle): - cause to scrape, corner.
; a primitive root; to crack off, i.e. (figuratively) burst out in rage: - (be) anger(-ry), displease, fret self, (provoke to) wrath (come), be wroth.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h7107 (קָצַף); to become enraged: - be furious.
; (Aramaic) from h7108 (קְצַף); rage: - wrath.
; from h7107 (קָצַף); a splinter (as chipped off); figuratively, rage or strife: - foam, indignation, [idiom] sore, wrath.
; from h7107 (קָצַף); a fragment: - bark(-ed).
; a primitive root; to chop off (literally or figuratively): - cut (asunder, in pieces, in sunder, off), [idiom] utmost.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h7112 (קָצַץ) {to chop off (literally or figuratively)}: - cut off.

; a primitive root; to dock off, i.e. curtail (transitive or intransitive, literal or figurative); especially to harvest (grass or grain): - [idiom] at all, cut down, much discouraged, grieve, harvestman, lothe, mourn, reap(-er), (be, wax) short(-en, -er), straiten, trouble, vex.
; from h7114 (קָצַר); shortness (of spirit), i.e. impatience: - anguish.
; from h7114 (קָצַר); short (whether in size, number, life, strength or temper): - few, hasty, small, soon.
; from h7096 (קָצָה); a termination (literally or figuratively); also (by implication) a portion; adverbially (with prepositional prefix) after: - end, part, [idiom] some.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h7117 (קְצָת) {a termination (literally or figuratively); also (by implication) a portion; adverbially (with prepositional prefix) after}: - end, partly.
; contracted from an unused root meaning to chill; cool; figuratively, quiet: - cold, excellent (from the margin).
; from the same as h7119 (קַר); cold: - cold.

; a primitive root (rather identical with h7122 (קָרָא) through the idea of accosting a person met); to call out to (i.e. properly, address by name, but used in a wide variety of applications): - bewray (self), that are bidden, call (for, forth, self, upon), cry (unto), (be) famous, guest, invite, mention, (give) name, preach, (make) proclaim(-ation), pronounce, publish, read, renowned, say.
; a primitive root; to encounter, whether accidentally or in a hostile manner: - befall, (by) chance, (cause to) come (upon), fall out, happen, meet.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h7121 (קָרָא) {to call out to (i.e. properly, address by name, but used in a wide variety of applications)}: - call, cry, read.
; properly, active participle of h7121 (קָרָא); a caller, i.e. partridge (from its cry): - partridge. See also h6981 (קוֹרֵא).
; from h7122 (קָרָא); an encountering, accidental, friendly or hostile (also adverbially, opposite): - [idiom] against (he come), help, meet, seek, [idiom] to, [idiom] in the way.

; a primitive root; to approach (causatively, bring near) for whatever purpose: - (cause to) approach, (cause to) bring (forth, near), (cause to) come (near, nigh), (cause to) draw near (nigh), go (near), be at hand, join, be near, offer, present, produce, make ready, stand, take.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h7126 (קָרַב) {to approach (causatively, bring near) for whatever purpose}: - approach, come (near, nigh), draw near.
; from h7126 (קָרַב); hostile encounter: - battle, war.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h7128 (קְרָב) {hostile encounter}: - war.

; from h7126 (קָרַב); properly, the nearest part, i.e. the center, whether literal, figurative or adverbial (especially with preposition): - [idiom] among, [idiom] before, bowels, [idiom] unto charge, [phrase] eat (up), [idiom] heart, [idiom] him, [idiom] in, inward ([idiom] -ly, part, -s, thought), midst, [phrase] out of, purtenance, [idiom] therein, [idiom] through, [idiom] within self.
; from h7126 (קָרַב); near: - approach, come (near, nigh), draw near.
; from h7126 (קָרַב); approach: - approaching, draw near.
; or קֻרְבָּן; from h7126 (קָרַב); something brought near the altar, i.e. a sacrificial present: - oblation, that is offered, offering.
; perhaps from h6923 (קָדַם) in the sense of striking upon; an axe: - ax.
; feminine of h7119 (קַר); coolness: - cold.

; a primitive root; to light upon (chiefly by accident); causatively, to bring about; specifically, to impose timbers (for roof or floor): - appoint, lay (make) beams, befall, bring, come (to pass unto), floor, (hap) was, happen (unto), meet, send good speed.
; from h7136 (קָרָה); an (unfortunate) occurrence, i.e. some accidental (ceremonial) disqualification: - uncleanness that chanceth.

; or קָרֹב; from h7126 (קָרַב); near (in place, kindred or time): - allied, approach, at hand, [phrase] any of kin, kinsfold(-sman), (that is) near (of kin), neighbour, (that is) next, (them that come) nigh (at hand), more ready, short(-ly).
; a primitive root; to depilate: - make (self) bald.
; or קֹרַח; from h7139 (קָרַח); ice (as if bald, i.e. smooth); hence, hail; by resemblance, rock crystal: - crystal, frost, ice.
; from h7139 (קָרַח); ice; Korach, the name of two Edomites and three Israelites: - Korah.
; from h7139 (קָרַח); bald (on the back of the head): - bald (head).
; from h7139 (קָרַח); bald; Kareach, an Israelite: - Careah, Kareah.
; or קׇרְחָא; (Ezekiel 27:31), from h7139 (קָרַח); baldness: - bald(-ness), [idiom] utterly.
; patronymic from h7141 (קֹרַח); a Korchite (collectively) or descendants of Korach: - Korahite, Korathite, sons of Kore, Korhite.
; from h7139 (קָרַח); a bald spot (on the back of the head); figuratively, a threadbare spot (on the back side of the cloth): - bald head, bare within.
; from h7136 (קָרָה); hostile encounter: - contrary.
; from h7121 (קָרָא); called, i.e. select: - famous, renowned.
; (Aramaic) or קִרְיָה; (Aramaic), corresponding to h7151 (קִרְיָה) {building; a city}: - city.
; from h7121 (קָרָא); a proclamation: - preaching.
; from h7136 (קָרָה) in the sense of flooring, i.e. building; a city: - city.
; plural of h7151 (קִרְיָה); buildings; Kerioth, the name of two places in Palestine: - Kerioth, Kirioth.

; or (with the article interposed) קִרְיַת הָאַרְבַּע; (Nehemiah 11:25), from h7151 (קִרְיָה) and h0704 (אַרְבַּע) or h0702 (אַרְבַּע); city of Arba, or city of the four (giants); Kirjath-Arba or Kirjath-ha-Arba, a place in Palestine: - Kirjath-arba.
; from h7151 (קִרְיָה) and h1168 (בַּעַל); city of Baal; Kirjath-Baal, a place in Palestine: - Kirjathbaal.
; from h7151 (קִרְיָה) and the feminine plural of h2351 (חוּץ); city of streets; Kirjath-Chutsoth, a place in Moab: - Kirjath-huzoth.
; dual of h7151 (קִרְיָה); double city; Kirjathaim, the name of two placed in Palestine: - Kiriathaim, Kirjathaim.

; or (Jeremiah 26:20) with the article interposed; or (Joshua 18:28) simply the former part of the word; or קִרְיַת עָרִים; from h7151 (קִרְיָה) and the plural of h3293 (יַעַר) or h5892 (עִיר); city of forests, or city of towns; Kirjath-Jearim or Kirjath-Arim, a place in Palestine: - Kirjath, Kirjath-jearim, Kirjath-arim.

; or קִרְיַת סֵפֶר; from h7151 (קִרְיָה) and a simpler feminine from the same as h5577 (סַנְסִן), or (for the latter name) h5612 (סֵפֶר); city of branches, or of a book; Kirjath-Sannah or Kirjath-Sepher, a place in Palestine: - Kirjath-sannah, Kirjath-sepher.
; a primitive root; to cover: - cover.
; a primitive root; to push or gore; used only as denominative from h7161 (קֶרֶן), to shoot out horns; figuratively, rays: - have horns, shine.

; from h7160 (קָרַן); a horn (as projecting); by implication, a flask, cornet; by resemblance. an elephant's tooth (i.e. ivory), a corner (of the altar), a peak (of a mountain), a ray (of light); figuratively, power: - [idiom] hill, horn.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h7161 (קֶרֶן); a horn (literally or for sound): - horn, cornet.
; from h7161 (קֶרֶן) and h6320 (פּוּךְ); horn of cosmetic; Keren-hap-Puk, one of Job's daughters: - Keren-happuch.
; a primitive root; properly, to protrude; used only as denominative from h7165 (קֶרֶס) (for alliteration with h7167 (קָרַע)), to hunch, i.e. be hump-backed: - stoop.
; from h7164 (קָרַס); a knob or belaying-pin (from its swelling form): - tache.
; from h7164 (קָרַס); an ankle (as a protuberance or joint): - foot.
; a primitive root; to rend, literally or figuratively (revile, paint the eyes, as if enlarging them): - cut out, rend, [idiom] surely, tear.
; from h7167 (קָרַע); a rag: - piece, rag.

; a primitive root; to pinch, i.e. (partially) to bite the lips, blink the eyes (as a gesture of malice), or (fully) to squeeze off (a piece of clay in order to mould a vessel from it): - form, move, wink.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h7171 (קֶרֶץ) in the sense of a bit (to 'eat the morsels of' any one, i.e. chew him up (figuratively) by slander: - [phrase] accuse.
; from h7169 (קָרַץ); extirpation (as if by constriction): - destruction.
; from h7167 (קָרַע); floor (as if a pavement of pieces or tesseroe), of abuilding or the sea: - bottom, ([idiom] one side of the) floor.
; the same as h7172 (קַרְקַע); ground-floor; Karka (with the article prefix), a place in Palestine: - Karkaa.
; from h6979 (קוּר); foundation; Karkor, a place East of the Jordan: - Karkor.
; from an unused root meaning to split off; a slab or plank; by implication, a deck of aship: - bench, board.
; from h7136 (קָרָה) in the sense of building; a city: - city.
; from h7176 (קֶרֶת); city; Kartah, a place in Palestine: - Kartah.
; from h7176 (קֶרֶת); city-plot; Kartan, a place in Palestine: - Kartan.
; from h7197 (קָשַׁשׁ); straw (as dry): - stubble.
; from an unused root (meaning to be hard); a cucumber (from the difficulty of digestion): - cucumber.
; a primitive root; to prick up the ears, i.e. hearken: - attend, (cause to) hear(-ken), give heed, incline, mark (well), regard.
; from h7181 (קָשַׁב); a hearkening: - [idiom] diligently, hearing, much heed, that regarded.
; or קַשֻּׁב; from h7181 (קָשַׁב); hearkening: - attent(-ive).
; or קַשְׂוָה; from an unused root meaning to be round; a jug (from its shape): - cover, cup.

; a primitive root; properly, to be dense, i.e. tough or severe (in various applications): - be cruel, be fiercer, make grievous, be ((ask a), be in, have, seem, would) hard(-en, (labour), -ly, thing), be sore, (be, make) stiff(-en, (-necked)).

; from h7185 (קָשָׁה); severe (in various applications): - churlish, cruel, grievous, hard((-hearted), thing), heavy, [phrase] impudent, obstinate, prevailed, rough(-ly), sore, sorrowful, stiff(necked), stubborn, [phrase] in trouble.
; (Aramaic) or קשֹׁט; (Aramaic), corresponding to h7189 (קֹשֶׁט); fidelity: - truth.
; a primitive root; to be (causatively, make) unfeeling: - harden.
; or קֹשְׁטְ; from an unused root meaning to balance; equity (as evenly weighed), i.e. reality: - truth.
; from h7185 (קָשָׁה); obstinacy: - stubbornness.
; from h7190 (קְשִׁי); hard ground; Kishjon, a place in Palestine: - Kishion, Keshon.
; from an unused root (probably meaning to weigh out); an ingot (as definitely estimated and stamped for a coin): - piece of money (silver).
; by reduplication from an unused root meaning to shale off as bark; a scale (of a fish); hence a coat of mail (as composed of or covered with jointed plates of metal): - mail, scale.
; a primitive root; to tie, physically (gird, confine, compact) or mentally (in love, league): - bind (up), (make a) conspire(-acy, -ator), join together, knit, stronger, work (treason).
; from h7194 (קָשַׁר); an (unlawful) alliance: - confederacy, conspiracy, treason.
; from h7194 (קָשַׁר); an (ornamental) girdle (for women): - attire, headband.
; a primitive root; to become sapless through drought; used only as denominative from h7179 (קַשׁ); to forage for straw, stubble or wood; figuratively, to assemble: - gather (selves) (together).
; from h7185 (קָשָׁה) in the original sense (of h6983 (קוֹשׁ)) of bending; a bow, forshooting (hence, figuratively, strength) or the iris: - [idiom] arch(-er), [phrase] arrow, bow(-man, -shot).
; intensive (as denominative) from h7198 (קֶשֶׁת); a bowman: - [idiom] archer. r

; a primitive root; to see, literally or figuratively (in numerous applications, direct and implied, transitive, intransitive and causative): - advise self, appear, approve, behold, [idiom] certainly, consider, discern, (make to) enjoy, have experience, gaze, take heed, [idiom] indeed, [idiom] joyfully, lo, look (on, one another, one on another, one upon another, out, up, upon), mark, meet, [idiom] be near, perceive, present, provide, regard, (have) respect, (fore-, cause to, let) see(-r, -m, one another), shew (self), [idiom] sight of others, (e-) spy, stare, [idiom] surely, [idiom] think, view, visions.
; from h7200 (רָאָה); a bird of prey (probably the vulture, from its sharp sight): - glede. Compare h1676 (דָּאָה).
; from h7200 (רָאָה); seeing, i.e. experiencing: - see.
; active participle of h7200 (רָאָה); a seer (as often rendered); but also (abstractly) a vision: - vision.
; for h7203 (רֹאֶה); prophet; Roeh, an Israelite: - Haroeh (including the article).
; from the imperative of h7200 (רָאָה) and h1121 (בֵּן); see ye a son; Reuben, a son of Jacob: - Reuben.
; patronymic from h7205 (רְאוּבֵן); a Reubenite or descendant of Reuben: - children of Reuben, Reubenites.
; from h7200 (רָאָה); sight, i.e. satisfaction: - behold.
; feminine passive participle of h7213 (רָאַם); raised; Reumah, a Syrian woman: - Reumah.
; from h7200 (רָאָה); a mirror (as seen): - looking glass.
; from h7200 (רָאָה); sight, whether abstractly (vision) or concretely (a spectacle): - gazingstock, look to, (that) see(-th).
; from h7200 (רָאָה) and h3050 (יָהּ); Jah has seen; Reajah, the name of three Israelites: - Reaia, Reaiah.
; from h7200 (רָאָה); sight: - beholding.
; a primitive root; to rise: - be lifted up.
; or רְאֵיםlemma רְאיֵם second vowel, corrected to רְאֵים; or רֵים; or רֵם; from h7213 (רָאַם); a wild bull (from its conspicuousness): - unicorn.
; from h7213 (רָאַם); something high in value, i.e. perhaps coral: - coral.
; or רָאמֹתxlit Râmôth corrected to Râʼmôth; plural of h7215 (רָאמָה); heights; Ramoth, the name of two places in Palestine: - Ramoth.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h7218 (רֹאשׁ); the head; figuratively, the sum: - chief, head, sum.

; from an unused root apparently meaning to shake; the head (as most easily shaken), whether literal or figurative (in many applications, of place, time, rank, itc.): - band, beginning, captain, chapiter, chief(-est place, man, things), company, end, [idiom] every (man), excellent, first, forefront, (be-)head, height, (on) high(-est part, (priest)), [idiom] lead, [idiom] poor, principal, ruler, sum, top.

; or רוֹשׁ; (Deuteronomy 32:32), apparently the same as h7218 (רֹאשׁ); a poisonous plant, probably the poppy (from its conspicuous head); generally poison (even of serpents): - gall, hemlock, poison, venom.
; probably the same as h7218 (רֹאשׁ); Rosh, the name of an Israelite and of a foreign nation: - Rosh.
; from the same as h7218 (רֹאשׁ); a beginning: - beginning.
; feminine of h7218 (רֹאשׁ); the head: - head(-stone).

; or רִאשֹׁן; from h7221 (רִאשָׁה); first, in place, time or rank (as adjective or noun): - ancestor, (that were) before(-time), beginning, eldest, first, fore(-father) (-most), former (thing), of old time, past.
; from h7223 (רִאשׁוֹן); first: - first.
; from the same as h7218 (רֹאשׁ); the first, in place, time, order or rank (specifically, a firstfruit): - beginning, chief(-est), first(-fruits, part, time), principal thing.
; from h7218 (רֹאשׁ); a pillow (being for the head): - bolster.

; by contracted from h7231 (רָבַב); abundant (in quantity, size, age, number, rank, quality): - (in) abound(-undance, -ant, -antly), captain, elder, enough, exceedingly, full, great(-ly, man, one), increase, long (enough, (time)), (do, have) many(-ifold, things, a time), (ship-)master, mighty, more, (too, very) much, multiply(-tude), officer, often(-times), plenteous, populous, prince, process (of time), suffice(-lent).
; by contraction from h7232 (רָבַב); (or perhaps the same as h7227 (רַב)) an archer: - archer.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h7227 (רַב) {abundant}: - captain, chief, great, lord, master, stout.

; from h7231 (רָבַב); abundance (in any respect): - abundance(-antly), all, [idiom] common (sort), excellent, great(-ly, -ness, number), huge, be increased, long, many, more in number, most, much, multitude, plenty(-ifully), [idiom] very (age).

; a primitive root; (compare h7241 (רָבִיב)); also as denominative from h7233 (רְבָבָה); properly, to cast together , i.e. increase, especially in number; to multiply by the myriad: - increase, be many(-ifold), be more, multiply, ten thousands.
; a primitive root (rather identical with h7231 (רָבַב) through the idea of projection); to shoot an arrow: - shoot.
; from h7231 (רָבַב); abundance (in number), i.e. (specifically) a myriad (whether definite or indefinite): - many, million, [idiom] multiply, ten thousand.
; a primitive root; to spread: - deck.

; a primitive root; to increase (in whatever respect): - (bring in) abundance ([idiom] -antly), [phrase] archer (by mistake for h7232 (רָבַב)), be in authority, bring up, [idiom] continue, enlarge, excel, exceeding(-ly), be full of, (be, make) great(-er, -ly, [idiom] -ness), grow up, heap, increase, be long, (be, give, have, make, use) many (a time), (any, be, give, give the, have) more (in number), (ask, be, be so, gather, over, take, yield) much (greater, more), (make to) multiply, nourish, plenty(-eous), [idiom] process (of time), sore, store, thoroughly, very.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h7235 (רָבָה) {to increase (in whatever respect)}: - make a great man, grow.
; feminine of h7227 (רַב); great; Rabbah, the name of two places in Palestine, East and West: - Rabbah, Rabbath.
; (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to h7235 (רָבָה); increase (of dignity): - greatness, majesty.

; from h7231 (רָבַב); or רִבּוֹא from h7231 (רָבַב); a myriad, i.e. indefinitely, large number: - great things, ten ((eight) -een, (for) -ty, [phrase] sixscore, [phrase] threescore, [idiom] twenty, (twen) -ty) thousand.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h7239 (רִבּוֹ) {a myriad, i.e. indefinitely, large number}: - [idiom] ten thousand times ten thousand.
; from h7231 (רָבַב); a rain (as an accumulation of drops): - shower.
; from h7234 (רָבַד); a collar (as spread around the neck): - chain.
; or רְבִעִי; from h7251 (רָבַע); fourth; also (fractionally) a fourth: - foursquare, fourth (part).
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h7243 (רְבִיעִי) {fourth; also (fractionally) a fourth}: - fourth.
; from h7231 (רָבַב); multitude; Rabbith, a place in Palestine: - Rabbith.
; a primitive root; to soak (bread in oil): - baken, (that which is) fried.
; from an unused root meaning to be fruitful; fertile; Riblah, a place in Syria: - Riblah.
; from h7227 (רַב) and a foreign word for a Magian; chief Magian; Rab-Mag, a Babylonian official: - Rab-mag.
; from h7227 (רַב) and a foreign word for a eunuch; chief chamberlain; Rab-Saris, a Babylonian official: - Rab-saris.
; a primitive root; to squat or lie out flat, i.e. (specifically) in copulation: - let gender, lie down.

; a primitive root (rather identical with h7250 (רָבַע) through the idea of sprawling 'at all fours' (or possibly the reverse is the order of deriv.); compare h0702 (אַרְבַּע)); properly, to be four (sided); used only as denominative of h7253 (רֶבַע); to be quadrate: - (four-) square(-d).
; from h7250 (רָבַע); prostration (for sleep): - lying down.
; from h7251 (רָבַע); a fourth (part or side): - fourth part, side, square.
; the same as h7253 (רֶבַע); Reba, a Midianite: - Reba.
; from h7251 (רָבַע); a quarter: - fourth participle
; from h7251 (רָבַע); a descendant of the fourth generation, i.e. great great grandchild: - fourth.

; a primitive root; to crouch (on all four legs folded, like a recumbent animal); be implication, to recline, repose, brood, lurk, imbed: - crouch (down), fall down, make a fold, lay, (cause to, make to) lie (down), make to rest, sit.
; from h7257 (רָבַץ); a couch or place of repose: - where each lay, lie down in, resting place.
; from an unused root probably meaning to clog by tying up the fetlock; fettering (by beauty); Ribkah, the wife of Isaac: - Rebekah.
; (Aramaic) from h7229 (רַב); huge (in size); domineering (in character): - (very) great (things).
; (Aramaic) from h7260 (רַבְרַב); a magnate: - lord, prince.
; from h7227 (רַב) and h8248 (שָׁקָה); chief butler; Rabshakeh, a Babylonian official: - Rabshakeh.
; from an unused root meaning to pile together; a lump of clay: - clod.
; a primitive root; to quiver (with any violent emotion, especially anger or fear): - be afraid, stand in awe, disquiet, fall out, fret, move, provoke, quake, rage, shake, tremble, trouble, be wroth.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h7264 (רָגַז) {to quiver (with any violent emotion, especially anger or fear)}: - provoke unto wrath.
; (Aramaic) from h7265 (רְגַז); violent anger: - rage.
; from h7264 (רָגַז); commotion, restlessness (of a horse), crash (of thunder), disquiet, anger: - fear, noise, rage, trouble(-ing), wrath.
; intensive from h7264 (רָגַז); timid: - trembling.
; feminine of h7267 (רֹגֶז); trepidation: - trembling.

; a primitive root; also as denominative from h7272 (רֶגֶל) to walk along; but only in specifically, applications, to reconnoiter, to be atale-bearer (i.e. slander); to lead about: - backbite, search, slander, (e-) spy (out), teach to go, view.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h7272 (רֶגֶל) {a foot, a step; by euphemistically the pudenda}: - foot.

; from h7270 (רָגַל); a foot (as used in walking); by implication, a step; by euphemistically the pudenda: - [idiom] be able to endure, [idiom] according as, [idiom] after, [idiom] coming, [idiom] follow, (broken-)foot(-ed, -stool), [idiom] great toe, [idiom] haunt, [idiom] journey, leg, [phrase] piss, [phrase] possession, time.
; from h7272 (רֶגֶל); a footman (soldier): - (on) foot(-man).
; plural of active participle of h7270 (רָגַל); fullers (as tramping the cloth in washing); Rogelim, a place East of the Jordan: - Rogelim.
; a primitive root (compare h7263 (רֶגֶב), h7321 (רוּעַ), h7551 (רָקַם)); to cast together (stones), i.e. to lapidate: - [idiom] certainly, stone.
; from h7275 (רָגַם); stoneheap; Regem, an Israelite: - Regem.
; feminine of the same as h7276 (רֶגֶם); a pile (of stones), i.e. (figuratively) a throng: - council.
; from h7276 (רֶגֶם) and h4428 (מֶלֶךְ); king's heap; Regem-Melek, an Israelite: - Regem-melech.
; a primitive root; to grumble, i.e. rebel: - murmur.

; a primitive root; properly, to toss violently and suddenly (the sea with waves, the skin with boils); figuratively (in a favorable manner) to settle, i.e. quiet; specifically, to wink (from the motion of the eye-lids): - break, divide, find ease, be a moment, (cause, give, make to) rest, make suddenly.
; from h7280 (רָגַע). a wink (of the eyes), i.e. a very short space of time: - instant, moment, space, suddenly.
; from h7280 (רָגַע); restful, i.e. peaceable: - that are quiet.
; a primitive root; to be tumultuous: - rage.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h7283 (רָגַשׁ); to gather tumultuously: - assemble (together).
; or (feminine) רִגְשָׁה; from h7283 (רָגַשׁ); a tumultuous crowd: - company, insurrection.
; a primitive root; to tread in pieces, i.e. (figuratively) to conquer, or (specifically) to overlay: - spend, spread, subdue.
; a primitive root; to tread down, i.e. subjugate; specifically, to crumble off: - (come to, make to) have dominion, prevail against, reign, (bear, make to) rule,(-r, over), take.
; intensive from h7287 (רָדָה); domineering; Raddai, an Israelite: - Raddai.
; from h7286 (רָדַד) in the sense of spreading; a veil (as expanded): - vail, veil.
; a primitive root; to stun, i.e. stupefy (with sleep or death): - (be fast a-, be in a deep, cast into a dead, that) sleep(-er, -eth).
; a primitive root; to run after (usually with hostile intent; figuratively (of time) gone by): - chase, put to flight, follow (after, on), hunt, (be under) persecute(-ion, -or), pursue(-r).
; a primitive root; to urge severely, i.e. (figuratively) importune, embolden, capture, act insolently: - overcome, behave self proudly, make sure, strengthen.
; from h7292 (רָהַב), bluster(-er): - proud, strength.
; the same as h7293 (רַהַב); Rahab (i.e. boaster), an epithet of Egypt: - Rahab.
; from h7292 (רָהַב); insolent: - proud.
; from h7292 (רָהַב); pride: - strength.
; a primitive root; to fear: - be afraid.
; from an unused root apparently meaning to hollow out; a channel or watering-box; by resemblance a ringlet of hair (as forming parallel lines): - gallery, gutter, trough.
; (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to h7200 (רָאָה); aspect: - form.
; a primitive root; to tramp about, i.e. ramble (free or disconsolate): - have the dominion, be lord, mourn, rule.
; a primitive root; to slake the thirst (occasionally of other appetites): - bathe, make drunk, (take the) fill, satiate, (abundantly) satisfy, soak, water (abundantly).
; from h7301 (רָוָה); sated (with drink): - drunkenness, watered.
; from an unused root probably meaning to cry out; outcry; Rohagah, an Israelite: - Rohgah.
; a primitive root (identical with h7306 (רוּחַ)); properly, to breathe freely, i.e. revive; by implication, to have ample room: - be refreshed, large.
; from h7304 (רָוַח); room, literally (an interval) or figuratively (deliverance): - enlargement, space.

; a primitive root; properly, to blow, i.e. breathe; only (literally) to smell or (by implication, perceive (figuratively, to anticipate, enjoy): - accept, smell, [idiom] touch, make of quick understanding.

; from h7306 (רוּחַ); wind; by resemblance breath, i.e. a sensible (or even violent) exhalation; figuratively, life, anger, unsubstantiality; by extension, a region of the sky; by resemblance spirit, but only of a rational being (including its expression and functions): - air, anger, blast, breath, [idiom] cool, courage, mind, [idiom] quarter, [idiom] side, spirit(-ual), tempest, [idiom] vain, (whirl-) wind(-y).

; (Aramaic) corresponding to h7307 (רוּחַ) {wind; by resemblance breath, i.e. a sensible (or even violent) exhalation; figuratively, life, anger, unsubstantiality; by extension, a region of the sky; by resemblance spirit, but only of a rational being (including its expression and functions)}: - mind, spirit, wind.
; feminine of h7305 (רֶוַח); relief: - breathing, respite.
; from h7301 (רָוָה); satisfaction: - runneth over, wealthy.

; a primitive root; to be high actively, to rise or raise (in various applications, literally or figuratively): - bring up, exalt (self), extol, give, go up, haughty, heave (up), (be, lift up on, make on, set up on, too) high(-er, one), hold up, levy, lift(-er) up, (be) lofty, ([idiom] a-) loud, mount up, offer (up), [phrase] presumptuously, (be) promote(-ion), proud, set up, tall(-er), take (away, off, up), breed worms.
; or רֻם; from h7311 (רוּם); (literally) elevation or (figuratively) elation: - haughtiness, height, [idiom] high.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h7311 (רוּם); {to be high actively, to rise or raise (in various applications, literally or figuratively)}: - extol, lift up (self), set up.
; (Aramaic) from h7313 (רוּם); (literally) altitude: - height.
; from h7311 (רוּם); elevation, i.e. (adverbially) aloft: - on high.
; from h7311 (רוּם); height; Rumah, a place in Palestine: - Rumah.
; feminine of h7315 (רוֹם); elation, i.e. (adverbially) proudly: - haughtily.
; from h7426 (רָמַם); exaltation, i.e. (figuratively and specifically) praise: - be extolled.
; feminine active participle of h7426 (רָמַם); exaltation, i.e. praise: - high.
; (or Romam from h7311 (רוּם) and h5828 (עֵזֶר); I have raised up a help; Romamti-Ezer, an Israelite: - Romamti-ezer.

; a primitive root; to mar (especially by breaking); figuratively, to split the ears (with sound), i.e. shout (for alarm or joy): - blow an alarm, cry (alarm, aloud, out), destroy, make a joyful noise, smart, shout (for joy), sound an alarm, triumph.
; a primitive root; properly, to triturate (in a mortar), i.e. (figuratively) to agitate (by concussion): - tremble.
; a primitive root; to run (for whatever reason, especially to rush): - break down, divide speedily, footman, guard, bring hastily, (make) run (away, through), post.
; a primitive root; to pour out (literally or figuratively), i.e. empty: - [idiom] arm, cast out, draw (out), (make) empty, pour forth (out).
; a primitive root; to slaver (with spittle), i.e. (by analogy) to emit afluid (ulcerous or natural): - run.
; a primitive root; to be destitute: - lack, needy, (make self) poor (man).
; probably for h7468 (רְעוּת); friend; Ruth, a Moabitess: - Ruth.
; (Aramaic) from an unused root probably meaning to attenuate, i.e. (figuratively) hide; a mystery: - secret.
; a primitive root; to emaciate, i.e. make (become) thin (literally or figuratively): - famish, wax lean.
; from h7329 (רָזָה); thin: - lean.
; from h7336 (רָזַן); prince; Rezon, a Syrian: - Rezon.
; from h7329 (רָזָה); thinness: - leanness, [idiom] scant.
; from h7336 (רָזַן); a dignitary: - prince.
; from h7329 (רָזָה); thinness: - leanness.
; a primitive root; to twinkle the eye (in mockery): - wink.
; a primitive root; probably to be heavy, i.e. (figuratively) honorable: - prince, ruler.
; a primitive root; to broaden (intransitive or transitive, literal or figurative): - be an en-(make) large(-ing), make room, make (open) wide.
; from h7337 (רָחַב); a width: - breadth, broad place.
; or רְחוֹב; from h7337 (רָחַב); a width, i.e. (concretely) avenue or area: - broad place (way), street. See also h1050 (בֵּית רְחוֹב).
; or רְחוֹב; the same as h7339 (רְחֹב); Rechob, the name of a place in Syria, also of a Syrian and an Israelite: - Rehob.
; from h7337 (רָחַב); width (literally or figuratively): - breadth, broad, largeness, thickness, wideness.
; from h7337 (רָחַב); roomy, in any (or every) direction, literally or figuratively: - broad, large, at liberty, proud, wide.
; the same as h7342 (רָחָב); proud; Rachab, a Canaanitess: - Rahab.
; or רְחֹבֹת; plural of h7339 (רְחֹב); streets; Rechoboth, a place in Assyria and one in Palestine: - Rehoboth.
; or רְחַבְיָהוּ; from h7337 (רָחַב) and h3050 (יָהּ); Jah has enlarged; Rechabjah, an Israelite: - Rehabiah.
; from h7337 (רָחַב) and h5971 (עַם); a people has enlarged; Rechabam, an Israelite king: - Rehoboam.
; from an unused root meaning to pulverize; a mill-stone: - mill (stone).
; a form of h7349 (רַחוּם); Rechum, the name of a Persian and of three Israelites: - Rehum.
; from h7355 (רָחַם); compassionate: - full of compassion, merciful.

; or רָחֹק; from h7368 (רָחַק); remote, literally or figuratively, of place or time; specifically, precious; often used adverbially (with preposition): - (a-) far (abroad, off), long ago, of old, space, great while to come.
; from the same as h7298 (רַהַט); a panel (as resembling a trough): - rafter.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h7350 (רָחוֹק) {remote, literally or figuratively, of place or time; specifically, precious; often used adverbially (with preposition)}: - far.
; from an unused root meaning to journey; a ewe (the females being the predominant element of a flock) (as a good traveller): - ewe, sheep.
; the same as h7353 (רָחֵל); Rachel, a wife of Jacob: - Rachel.

; a primitive root; to fondle; by implication, to love, especially to compassionate: - have compassion (on, upon), love, (find, have, obtain, shew) mercy(-iful, on, upon), (have) pity, Ruhamah, [idiom] surely.

; from h7355 (רָחַם); compassion (in the plural); by extension, the womb (as cherishing the fetus); by implication, a maiden: - bowels, compassion, damsel, tender love, (great, tender) mercy, pity, womb.
; the same as h7356 (רַחַם); pity; Racham, an Israelite: - Raham.
; from h7355 (רָחַם); (compare h7356 (רַחַם)) the womb: - matrix, womb.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h7356 (רַחַם); (plural) pity: - mercy.
; or (feminine) רָחָמָה; from h7355 (רָחַם); a kind of vulture (supposed to be tender towards its young): - gier-eagle.
; feminine of h7356 (רַחַם); a maiden: - damsel.
; from h7355 (רָחַם); compassionate: - pitiful.
; a primitive root; to brood; by implication, to be relaxed: - flutter, move, shake.
; a primitive root; to lave (the whole or a part of a thing): - bathe (self), wash (self).
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h7364 (רָחַץ) (probably through the accessory idea of ministering as a servant at the bath); to attend upon: - trust.
; from h7364 (רָחַץ); a bath: - wash(-pot).
; feminine of h7366 (רַחַץ); a bathing place: - washing.

; a primitive root; to widen (in any direction), i.e. (intransitively) recede or (transitively) remove (literally or figuratively, of place or relation): - (a-, be, cast, drive, get, go, keep (self), put, remove, be too, (wander), withdraw) far (away, off), loose, [idiom] refrain, very, (be) a good way (off).
; from h7368 (רָחַק); remote: - that are far.
; a primitive root; to gush: - indite.
; from h7306 (רוּחַ); a winnowing-fork (as blowing the chaff away): - shovel.
; a primitive root; to be moist: - be wet.
; from h7372 (רָטַב); moist (with sap): - green.
; from an unused root meaning to tremble; terror: - fear.
; a root compounded from h7373 (רָטֹב) and h2954 (טָפַשׁ); to be rejuvenated: - be fresh.
; a primitive root; to dash down: - dash (in pieces).
; from h7301 (רָוָה); irrigation, i.e. a shower: - watering.

; or רוּב; a primitive root; properly, to toss, i.e. grapple; mostly figuratively, to wrangle, i.e. hold a controversy; (by implication) to defend: - adversary, chide, complain, contend, debate, [idiom] ever, [idiom] lay wait, plead, rebuke, strive, [idiom] thoroughly.
; or רִב; from h7378 (רִיב); a contest (personal or legal): - [phrase] adversary, cause, chiding, contend(-tion), controversy, multitude (from the margin), pleading, strife, strive(-ing), suit.
; from h7378 (רִיב); contentious; Ribai, an Israelite: - Ribai.
; from h7306 (רוּחַ); odor (as if blown): - savour, scent, smell.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h7381 (רֵיחַ) {odor (as if blown)}: - smell.
; or רִפָה; from h7322 (רוּף); (only plural), grits (as pounded): - ground corn, wheat.
; or (probably by orthographical error) דִּיפַת; of foreign origin; Riphath, a grandson of Japheth and his descendants: - Riphath.
; from h7324 (רוּק); emptiness; figuratively, a worthless thing; adverbially, in vain: - empty, to no purpose, (in) vain (thing), vanity.
; or (shorter) רֵק; from h7324 (רוּק); empty; figuratively, worthless: - emptied(-ty), vain (fellow, man).
; from h7386 (רֵיק); emptily; figuratively (objective) ineffectually, (subjective) undeservedly: - without cause, empty, in vain, void.
; from h7325 (רוּר); saliva; by resemblance, broth: - spittle, white (of an egg).
; or רֵאשׁ; or רִישׁ; from h7326 (רוּשׁ); poverty: - poverty.
; from h7401 (רָכַךְ); tender (literally or figuratively); by implication, weak: - faint((-hearted), soft, tender ((-hearted), one), weak.
; from h7401 (רָכַךְ); softness (figuratively): - tenderness.

; a primitive root; to ride (on an animal or in a vehicle); causatively, to place upon (for riding or generally), to despatch: - bring (on (horse-) back), carry, get (oneself) up, on (horse-) back, put, (cause to, make to) ride (in a chariot, on, -r), set.
; from h7392 (רָכַב); a vehicle; by implication, a team; by extension, cavalry; by analogy a rider, i.e. the upper millstone: - chariot, (upper) millstone, multitude (from the margin), wagon.
; from h7392 (רָכַב); rider; Rekab, the name of two Arabs and of two Israelites: - Rechab.
; from h7392 (רָכַב); a charioteer: - chariot man, driver of a chariot, horseman.
; feminine of h7393 (רֶכֶב); a chariot (collectively): - chariots.
; probably feminine from h7401 (רָכַךְ); softness; Rekah, a place in Palestine: - Rechah.
; from passive participle of h7392 (רָכַב); a vehicle (as ridden on): - chariot.
; or רְכֻשׁ; from passive participle of h7408 (רָכַשׁ); property (as gathered): - good, riches, substance.
; from h7402 (רָכַל) a scandal-monger (as travelling about): - slander, carry tales, talebearer.
; a primitive root; to soften (intransitively or transitively), used figuratively: - (be) faint(-hearted), mollify, (be, make) soft(-er), be tender.
; a primitive root; to travel for trading: - (spice) merchant.
; from h7402 (רָכַל); merchant; Rakal, a place in Palestine: - Rachal.
; feminine passive participle of h7402 (רָכַל); trade (as peddled): - merchandise, traffic.
; a primitive root; to tie: - bind.
; from h7405 (רָכַס); a mountain ridge (as of tied summits): - rough place.
; from h7405 (רָכַס); a snare (as of tied meshes): - pride.
; a primitive root; to lay up, i.e. collect: - gather, get.
; from h7408 (רָכַשׁ); a relay of animals on a post-route (as stored up for that purpose); by implication, a courser: - dromedary, mule, swift beast.
; active participle of h7311 (רוּם); high; Ram, the name of an Arabian and of an Israelite: - Ram. See also h1027 (בֵּית הָרָם).
; a primitive root; to hurl; specifically, to shoot; figuratively, to delude or betray (as if causing to fall): - beguile, betray, (bow-) man, carry, deceive, throw.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h7411 (רָמָה); to throw, set, (figuratively) assess: - cast (down), impose.
; feminine active participle of h7311 (רוּם); a height (as a seat of idolatry): - high place.
; the same as h7413 (רָמָה); Ramah, the name of four places in Palestine: - Ramah.
; from h7426 (רָמַם) in the sense of breading (compare h7311 (רוּם)); a maggot (as rapidly bred), literally or figuratively: - worm.
; or רִמֹּן; from h7426 (רָמַם); a pomegranate, the tree (from its upright growth) or the fruit (also an artificial ornament): - pomegranate.

; or (shorter) (רִמֹּן; or רִמּוֹנוֹ; (1 Chronicles 6:62 ( h0077 (אֶבֶץ))), the same as h7416 (רִמּוֹן); in Joshua 19:13: הַמְּתֹאָר is mistaken for part of a name; article with the passive participle of h8388 (תָּאַר); the (one) marked off, i.e. which pertains). Rimmon, the name of a Syrian deity, also of five places in Palestine: - Remmon, Rimmon.

; or רָמַת נֶגֶב; from the plural or construct form of h7413 (רָמָה) and h5045 (נֶגֶב); heights (or height) of the South; Ramoth-Negeb or Ramath-Negeb, a place in Palestine: - south Ramoth, Ramath of the south.
; from h7311 (רוּם); a heap (of carcases): - height.
; from an unused root meaning to hurl; a lance (as thrown); especially the iron point: - buckler, javelin, lancet, spear.
; for h0761 (אֲרַמִּי); a Ramite, i.e. Aramaean: - Syrian.
; from h7311 (רוּם) and h3050 (יָהּ); Jah has raised; Ramjah, an Israelite: - Ramiah.
; from h7411 (רָמָה); remissness, treachery: - deceit(-ful, -fully), false, guile, idle, slack, slothful.
; of foreign origin; a brood mare: - dromedary.
; from an unused root and h3050 (יָהּ) (perhaps meaning to deck); Jah has bedecked; Remaljah, an Israelite: - Remaliah.
; a primitive root; to rise (literally or figuratively): - exalt, get (oneself) up, lift up (self), mount up.
; from the active participle of h7426 (רָמַם); exaltation: - lifting up of self.
; from h7416 (רִמּוֹן) and h6556 (פֶּרֶץ); pomegranate of the breach; Rimmon-Perets, a place in the Desert: - Rimmon-parez.
; a primitive root; to tread upon (as a potter, in walking or abusively): - oppressor, stamp upon, trample (under feet), tread (down, upon).
; a primitive root; properly, to glide swiftly, i.e. to crawl or move with short steps; by analogy to swarm: - creep, move.
; from h7430 (רָמַשׂ); a reptile or any other rapidly moving animal: - that creepeth, creeping (moving) thing.
; from h7411 (רָמָה); height; Remeth, a place in Palestine: - Remeth.

; or רָמוֹת גִּלעָד; (2 Chronicles 22:5), from the plural of h7413 (רָמָה) and h1568 (גִּלְעָד); heights of Gilad; Ramoth-Gilad, a place East of the Jordan: - Ramoth-gilead, Ramoth in Gilead. See also h7216 (רָאמוֹת).
; from h7413 (רָמָה) and h4707 (מִצְפֶּה) with the article interpolated; height of the watch-tower; Ramath-ham-Mitspeh, a place in Palestine: - Ramath-mizpeh.
; patronymic of h7414 (רָמָה); a Ramathite or inhabitant of Ramah: - Ramathite.
; from the dual of h7413 (רָמָה) and the plural of the active participle of h6822 (צָפָה); double height of watchers; Ramathajim-Tsophim, a place in Palestine: - Ramathaimzophim.
; from h7413 (רָמָה) and h3895 (לְחִי); height of a jaw-bone; Ramath-Lechi, a place in Palestine: - Ramath-lehi.

; from the same as h7616 (שָׁבָב); flame (as split into tongues): - spark.
; feminine of h7628 (שְׁבִי); exile (abstractly or concretely and collectively): - captives(-ity).
; feminine of the same as h7629 (שֹׁבִי); captivation; Shobjah, an Israelite: - Shachia (from the margin).
; from the same as h7640 (שֹׁבֶל); a track or passage-way (as if flowing along): - path.
; from an unused root meaning to interweave; a netting for the hair: - caul.
; or שְׁבִעִי; ordinal from h7657 (שִׁבְעִים); seventh: - seventh (time).
; from an unused root meaning to intwine; a netting (ornament to the capital of a column): - net.
; feminine of h7638 (שָׂבָךְ); a net-work, i.e. (in hunting) a snare, (in architecture) a ballustrade; also a reticulated ornament to apillar: - checker, lattice, network, snare, wreath(-enwork).
; from an unused root meaning to flow; a lady's train (as trailing after her): - leg.

; or (feminine) שִׁבֹּלֶת; from the same as h7640 (שֹׁבֶל); a stream (as flowing); also an ear of grain (as growing out); by analogy, a branch: - branch, channel, ear (of corn), (water-)flood, Shibboleth. Compare h5451 (סִבֹּלֶת).
; from the same as h7640 (שֹׁבֶל); a snail (as if floating in its own slime): - snail.
; or (feminine) שִׂבְמָה; probably from h1313 (בָּשָׂם); spice; Sebam or Sibmah, a place in Moab: - Shebam, Shibmah, Sibmah.
; or שֶׁבְנָה; from an unused root meaning to grow; growth; Shebna or Shebnah, an Israelite: - Shebna, Shebnah.
; or שְׁבַנְיָהוּ; from the same as h7644 (שֶׁבְנָא) and h3050 (יָהּ); Jah has grown (i.e. prospered); Shebanjah, the name of three or four Israelites: - Shebaniah.

; or שָׂבֵעַ; a primitive root; to sate, i.e. fill to satisfaction (literally or figuratively): - have enough, fill (full, self, with), be (to the) full (of), have plenty of, be satiate, satisfy (with), suffice, be weary of.
; from h7646 (שָׂבַע); copiousness: - abundance, plenteous(-ness, -ly).
; from h7646 (שָׂבַע); satisfaction (of food or (figuratively) joy): - fill, full(-ness), satisfying, be satisfied.
; from h7646 (שָׂבַע); satiated (in a pleasant or disagreeable sense): - full (of), satisfied (with).

; a primitive root; properly to be complete, but used only as a denominative from h7651 (שֶׁבַע); to seven oneself, i.e. swear (as if by repeating a declaration seven times): - adjure, charge (by an oath, with an oath), feed to the full (by mistake for h7646 (שָׂבַע)), take an oath, [idiom] straitly, (cause to, make to) swear.

; or (masculine) (שִׁבְעָה); from h7650 (שָׁבַע); a primitive cardinal number; seven (as the sacred full one); also (adverbially) seven times; by implication, a week; by extension, an indefinite number: - ([phrase] by) seven(-fold),-s, (-teen, -teenth), -th, times). Compare h7658 (שִׁבְעָנָה).
; the same as h7651 (שֶׁבַע); seven; Sheba, the name of a place in Palestine, and of two Israelites: - Sheba.
; feminine of h7647 (שָׂבָע); satiety: - fulness.
; feminine of h7648 (שֹׂבַע); satiety: - (to have) enough, [idiom] till...be full, (un-) satiable, satisfy, [idiom] sufficiently.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h7651 (שֶׁבַע) {seven (as the sacred full one); also (adverbially) seven times; by implication, a week; by extension, an indefinite number}: - seven (times).
; masculine of h7651 (שֶׁבַע); seven(-th); Shebah, a well in Palestine: - Shebah.
; multiple of h7651 (שֶׁבַע); seventy: - seventy, threescore and ten ([phrase] -teen).
; prolonged for the masculine of h7651 (שֶׁבַע); seven: - seven.
; dual (adverbially) of h7651 (שֶׁבַע); seven-times: - seven(-fold, times).
; a primitive root; to interweave (colored) threads in squares; by implication (of reticulation) to inchase gems in gold: - embroider, set.
; from h7660 (שָׁבַץ); entanglement, i.e. (figuratively) perplexity: - anguish.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to the root of h7733 (שׁוֹבֵק); to quit, i.e. allow to remain: - leave, let alone.
; erroneously שָׁבַר; (Nehemiah 2:13,15), a primitive root; to scrutinize; by implication (of watching) to expect (with hope and patience): - hope, tarry, view, wait.
; from h7663 (שָׂבַר); expectation: - hope.

; a primitive root; to burst (literally or figuratively): - break (down, off, in pieces, up), broken (-hearted), bring to the birth, crush, destroy, hurt, quench, [idiom] quite, tear, view (by mistake for h7663 (שָׂבַר)).
; denominative from h7668 (שֶׁבֶר); to deal in grain: - buy, sell.

; or שֵׁבֶר; from h7665 (שָׁבַר); a fracture, figuratively, ruin; specifically, a solution (of a dream): - affliction, breach, breaking, broken(-footed, -handed), bruise, crashing, destruction, hurt, interpretation, vexation.
; the same as h7667 (שֶׁבֶר); grain (as if broken into kernels): - corn, victuals.
; the same as h7667 (שֶׁבֶר); Sheber, an Israelite: - Sheber.
; from h7665 (שָׁבַר); rupture, i.e. a pang; figuratively, ruin: - breaking, destruction.
; plural of h7667 (שֶׁבֶר); ruins; Shebarim, a place in Palestine: - Shebarim.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h7660 (שָׁבַץ); to entangle, i.e. perplex: - be astonished.

; a primitive root; to repose, i.e. desist from exertion; used in many implied relations (causative, figurative or specific): - (cause to, let, make to) cease, celebrate, cause (make) to fail, keep (sabbath), suffer to be lacking, leave, put away (down), (make to) rest, rid, still, take away.
; from h7673 (שָׁבַת); rest, interruption, cessation: - cease, sit still, loss of time.
; infinitive of h3427 (יָשַׁב); properly, session; but used also concretely, an abode or locality: - place, seat. Compare h3429 (יֹשֵׁב בַּשֶּׁבֶת).
; intensive from h7673 (שָׁבַת); intermission, i.e (specifically) the Sabbath: - ([phrase] every) sabbath.
; from h7676 (שַׁבָּת); a sabbatism or special holiday: - rest, sabbath.
; from h7676 (שַׁבָּת); restful; Shabbethai, the name of three Israelites: - Shabbethai.
; ; a primitive root; to grow, i.e. (causatively) to enlarge, (figuratively) laud: - increase, magnify.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h7679 (שָׂגָא); to increase: - grow, be multiplied.
; probably from h7686 (שָׁגָה); erring; Shage, an Israelite: - Shage.

; a primitive root; to be (causatively, make) lofty, especially inaccessible; by implication, safe, strong; used literally and figuratively: - defend, exalt, be excellent, (be, set on) high, lofty, be safe, set up (on high), be too strong.
; a primitive root; to stray, i.e. (figuratively) sin (with more or less apology): - [idiom] also for that, deceived, err, go astray, sin ignorantly.
; from h7683 (שָׁגַג); a mistake or inadvertent transgression: - error, ignorance, at unawares; unwittingly.
; a primitive root; to enlarge (especially upward, also figuratively): - grow (up), increase.

; a primitive root; to stray (causatively, mislead), usually (figuratively) to mistake, especially (morally) to transgress; by extension (through the idea of intoxication) to reel, (figuratively) be enraptured: - (cause to) go astray, deceive, err, be ravished, sin through ignorance, (let, make to) wander.
; from h7682 (שָׂגַב); aloft; Segub, the name of two Israelites: - Segub.
; a primitive root; to peep, i.e. glance sharply at: - look (narrowly).
; from h7679 (שָׂגָא); (superlatively) mighty: - excellent, great.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h7689 (שַׂגִּיא); large (in size, quantity or number, also adverbial): - exceeding, great(-ly); many, much, sore, very.
; from h7686 (שָׁגָה); a moral mistake: - error.
; or שִׁגָּיֹנָה; from h7686 (שָׁגָה); properly, aberration, i.e. (technically) a dithyramb or rambling poem: - Shiggaion, Shigionoth.
; a primitive root; to copulate with: - lie with, ravish.
; from h7693 (שָׁגַל); a queen (from cohabitation): - queen.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h7694 (שֵׁגָל); a (legitimate) queen: - wife.
; a primitive root; to rave through insanity: - (be, play the) mad (man).
; from h7696 (שָׁגַע); craziness: - furiously, madness.
; from an unused root probably meaning to eject; the fetus (as finally expelled): - that cometh of, increase.
; or שֹׁד; probably from h7736 (שׁוּד) (in its original sense) contracted; the breast of a woman or animal (as bulging): - breast, pap, teat.
; from h7736 (שׁוּד); a doemon (as malignant): - devil.
; or שׁוֹד; (Job 5:21), from h7736 (שׁוּד); violence, ravage: - desolation, destruction, oppression, robbery, spoil(-ed, -er, -ing), wasting.
; a primitive root; to abrade, i.e. harrow afield: - break clods, harrow.

; a primitive root; properly, to be burly, i.e. (figuratively) powerful (passively, impregnable); by implication, to ravage: - dead, destroy(-er), oppress, robber, spoil(-er), [idiom] utterly, (lay) waste.
; or שָׂדַי; from an unused root meaning to spread out; a field (as flat): - country, field, ground, land, soil, [idiom] wild.
; from h7703 (שָׁדַד); a wife (as mistress of the house): - [idiom] all sorts, musical instrument.
; from h7703 (שָׁדַד); the Almighty: - Almighty.
; from the same as h7704 (שָׂדֶה) and h0217 (אוּר); spreader of light; Shedejur, an Israelite: - Shedeur.
; plural from the same as h7704 (שָׂדֶה); flats; Siddim, a valley in Palestine: - Siddim.
; apparently from h7704 (שָׂדֶה); a cultivated field: - blasted, field.
; a primitive root; to scorch: - blast.
; or שִׁדָּפוֹן; from h7710 (שָׁדַף); blight: - blasted(-ing).
; (Aramaic) a primitive root; to endeavor: - labour.
; from an unused root meaning to regulate; a row, i.e. rank (of soldiers), story (of rooms): - board, range.
; probably of foreign origin; Shadrak, the Babylonian name of one of Daniel's companions: - Shadrach.
; (Aramaic) the same as h7714 (שַׁדְרַךְ) {Shadrak, the Babylonian name of one of Daniel's companions}: - Shadrach.
; or שֵׂי; probably from h7582 (שָׁאָה) through the idea of pushing out to graze; a member of a flock, i.e. a sheep or goat: - (lesser, small) cattle, ewe, goat, lamb, sheep. Compare h2089 (זֶה).
; from an unused root meaning to testify; a witness: - record.
; from an unused root probably mean to blanch; a gem, probably the beryl (from its pale green color): - onyx.
; the same as h7718 (שֹׁהַם); Shoham, an Israelite: - Shoham.
; from the same as h5469 (סַהַר); a round pendant for the neck: - ornament, round tire like the moon.
; from an unused root (akin to h5375 (נָשָׂא) and h7722 (שׁוֹא)) meaning to rise; a rising: - arise.
; or (feminine) שׁוֹאָה; or שֹׁאָה; from an unused root meaning to rush over; a tempest; by implication, devastation: - desolate(-ion), destroy, destruction, storm, wasteness.

; or שַׁו; from the same as h7722 (שׁוֹא) in the sense of desolating; evil (as destructive), literally (ruin) or morally (especially guile); figuratively idolatry (as false, subjective), uselessness (as deceptive, objective; also adverbially, in vain): - false(-ly), lie, lying, vain, vanity.
; from the same as h7723 (שָׁוְא); false; Sheva, an Israelite: - Sheva.

; a primitive root; to turn back (hence, away) transitively or intransitively, literally or figuratively (not necessarily with the idea of return to the starting point); generally to retreat; often adverbial, again: - ((break, build, circumcise, dig, do anything, do evil, feed, lay down, lie down, lodge, make, rejoice, send, take, weep)) [idiom] again, (cause to) answer ([phrase] again), [idiom] in any case (wise), [idiom] at all, averse, bring (again, back, home again), call (to mind), carry again (back), cease, [idiom] certainly, come again (back), [idiom] consider, [phrase] continually, convert, deliver (again), [phrase] deny, draw back, fetch home again, [idiom] fro, get (oneself) (back) again, [idiom] give (again), go again (back, home), (go) out, hinder, let, (see) more, [idiom] needs, be past, [idiom] pay, pervert, pull in again, put (again, up again), recall, recompense, recover, refresh, relieve, render (again), requite, rescue, restore, retrieve, (cause to, make to) return, reverse, reward, [phrase] say nay, send back, set again, slide back, still, [idiom] surely, take back (off), (cause to, make to) turn (again, self again, away, back, back again, backward, from, off), withdraw.
; from h7725 (שׁוּב); apostate, i.e. idolatrous: - backsliding, frowardly, turn away (from margin).
; the same as h7726 (שׁוֹבָב); rebellious; Shobab, the name of two Israelites: - Shobab.
; from h7725 (שׁוּב); apostate, i.e. heathenish or (actually) heathen: - backsliding.
; from h7725 (שׁוּב); a return: - returning.
; for h5441 (סֹבֶךְ); a thicket, i.e. interlaced branches: - thick boughs.
; perhaps for h7730 (שׂוֹבֶךְ); Shobak, a Syrian: - Shobach.
; from the same as h7640 (שֹׁבֶל); overflowing; Shobal, the name of an Edomite and two Israelites: - Shobal.
; active participle from a primitive root meaning to leave (compare h7662 (שְׁבַק)); forsaking; Shobek, an Israelite: - Shobek.
; a primitive root; to retreat: - turn back.
; a primitive root; to hedge in: - make to grow.
; a primitive root; properly, to swell up, i.e. figuratively (by implication of insolence) to devastate: - waste.

; a primitive root; properly, to level, i.e. equalize; figuratively, to resemble; by implication, to adjust (i.e. counterbalance, be suitable, compose, place, yield, etc.): - avail, behave, bring forth, compare, countervail, (be, make) equal, lay, be (make, a-) like, make plain, profit, reckon.
; a primitive root; to destroy: - [idiom] substance (from the margin).
; (Aramaic); corresponding to h7737 (שָׁוָה); to resemble: - make like.
; from h7737 (שָׁוָה); plain; Shaveh, a place in Palestine: - Shaveh.
; from the same as h7740 (שָׁוֵה) and the dual of h7151 (קִרְיָה); plain of a double city; Shaveh-Kirjathajim, a place East of the Jordan: - Shaveh Kiriathaim.
; a primitive root; to muse pensively: - meditate.
; a primitive root; to sink, literally or figuratively: - bow down, incline, humble.
; from h7743 (שׁוּחַ); dell; Shuach, a son of Abraham: - Shuah.
; from h7743 (שׁוּחַ); a chasm: - ditch, pit.
; the same as h7745 (שׁוּחָה); Shuchah, an Israelite: - Shuah.
; patronymic from h7744 (שׁוּחַ); a Shuchite or descendant of Shuach: - Shuhite.
; from h7743 (שׁוּחַ); humbly; Shucham, an Israelite: - Shuham.
; patronymic from h7748 (שׁוּחָם); a Shuchamite (collectively): - Shuhamites.
; or (by permutation) סוּט; a primitive root; to detrude, i.e. (intransitively and figuratively) become derelict (wrongly practise; namely, idolatry): - turn aside to.

; a primitive root; properly, to push forth; (but used only figuratively) to lash, i.e. (the sea with oars) to row; by implication, to travel: - go (about, through, to and fro), mariner, rower, run to and fro.
; from h7751 (שׁוּט); a lash (literally or figuratively): - scourge, whip.
; a primitive root; to entwine, i.e. shut in (for formation, protection or restraint): - fence, (make an) hedge (up).
; or (feminine) שׂוֹכָה; from h7753 (שׂוּךְ); a branch (as interleaved): - bough.
; or שֹׂכֹה; or שׂוֹכוֹ; from h7753 (שׂוּךְ); Sokoh or Soko, the name of two places in Palestine: - Shocho, Shochoh, Sochoh, Soco, Socoh.
; probably patronymic from a name corresponding to h7754 (שׂוֹךְ) (feminine); a Sukathite or descendant of an unknown Israelite named Sukah: - Suchathite.
; from an unused root meaning to hang down; a skirt; by implication, a bottom edge: - hem, skirt, train.
; or שֵׁילָל; (Micah 1:8), from h7997 (שָׁלַל); nude (especially bare-foot); by implication, captive: - spoiled, stripped.
; from h7999 (שָׁלַם); peaceful (with the article always prefixed, making it a pet name); the Shulammith, an epithet of Solomon's queen: - Shulamite.
