; or שִׂים; a primitive root; to put (used in a great variety of applications, literal, figurative, inferentially, and elliptically): - [idiom] any wise, appoint, bring, call (a name), care, cast in, change, charge, commit, consider, convey, determine, [phrase] disguise, dispose, do, get, give, heap up, hold, impute, lay (down, up), leave, look, make (out), mark, [phrase] name, [idiom] on, ordain, order, [phrase] paint, place, preserve, purpose, put (on), [phrase] regard, rehearse, reward, (cause to) set (on, up), shew, [phrase] stedfastly, take, [idiom] tell, [phrase] tread down, (over-)turn, [idiom] wholly, work.

; (Aramaic) corresponding to h7760 (שׂוּם) {to put (used in a great variety of applications, literal, figurative, inferentially, and elliptically)}: - [phrase] command, give, lay, make, [phrase] name, [phrase] regard, set.
; from an unused root meaning to exhale; garlic (from its rank odor): - garlic.
; or שֹׁמֵר; active participle of h8104 (שָׁמַר); keeper; Shomer, the name of two Israelites: - Shomer.
; from an unused root meaning to rest; quiet; Shuni, an Israelite: - Shuni.
; patronymic from h7764 (שׁוּנִי); a Shunite (collectively) or descendants of Shuni: - Shunites.
; probably from the same as h7764 (שׁוּנִי); quietly; Shunem, a place in Pal: - Shunem.
; patrial from h7766 (שׁוּנֵם); a Shunammitess, or female inhabitant of Shunem: - Shunamite.
; a primitive root; properly, to be free; but used only causatively and reflexively, to halloo (for help, i.e. freedom from some trouble): - cry (aloud, out), shout.
; from h7768 (שָׁוַע); a halloo: - cry, riches.
; the same as h7769 (שׁוּעַ); Shua, a Canaanite: - Shua, Shuah.
; from h7768 (שָׁוַע) in the original sense of freedom; a noble, i.e. liberal, opulent; also (as noun in the derived sense) a halloo: - bountiful, crying, rich.
; the same as h7771 (שׁוֹעַ); rich; Shoa, an Oriental people: - Shoa.
; from h7768 (שָׁוַע); a halloo: - cry.
; from h7768 (שָׁוַע); wealth; Shua, an Israelitess: - Shua.
; feminine of h7773 (שֶׁוַע); a hallooing: - crying.
; or שֻׁעָל; from the same as h8168 (שֹׁעַל); a jackal (as a burrower): - fox.
; the same as h7776 (שׁוּעָל); Shual, the name of an Israelite and of a place in Palestine: - Shual.
; or שֹׁעֵר active participle of h8176 (שָׁעַר) (as denominative from h8179 (שַׁעַר)); a janitor: - doorkeeper, porter.
; a primitive root; properly, to gape, i.e. snap at; figuratively, to overwhelm: - break, bruise, cover.
; from h8210 (שָׁפַךְ); poured; Shophak, a Syrian: - Shophach.
; patronymic from h8197 (שְׁפוּפָם); a Shuphamite (collectively) or descendants of Shephupham: - Shuphamite.
; or שֹׁפָר; from h8231 (שָׁפַר) in the original sense of incising; a cornet (as giving a clear sound) or curved horn: - cornet, trumpet.
; a primitive root; to run after or over, i.e. overflow: - overflow, water.
; from h7783 (שׁוּק); a street (as run over): - street.
; from h7783 (שׁוּק); the (lower) leg (as a runner): - hip, leg, shoulder, thigh.
; a primitive root; properly, to vanquish; by implication, to rule (causatively, crown): - make princes, have power, reign. See h5493 (סוּר).
; a primitive root (identical with h7786 (שׂוּר) through the idea of reducing to pieces; compare h4883 (מַשּׂוֹר)); to saw: - cut.
; a primitive root; properly, to turn, i.e. travel about (as a harlot or a merchant): - go, singular See also h7891 (שִׁיר).

; a primitive root (identical with through the idea of going round for inspection); to spy out, i.e. (generally) survey, (for evil) lurk for, (for good) care for: - behold, lay wait, look, observe, perceive, regard, see.
; from h7889 (שִׁימוֹן); a foe (as lying in wait): - enemy.
; from h7788 (שׁוּר); a wall (as going about): - wall.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h7791 (שׁוּר) {a wall (as going about)}: - wall.
; the same as h7791 (שׁוּר); Shur, a region of the Desert: - Shur.
; from h7788 (שׁוּר); a bullock (as a traveller): - bull(-ock), cow, ox, wall (by mistake for h7791 (שׁוּר)).
; from h7786 (שׂוּר) in the primitive sense of h5493 (סוּר); properly, a ring, i.e. (by analogy) a row (adverbially): - principal.
; the same as h8321 (שֹׂרֵק); a vine; Sorek, a valley in Palestine: - Sorek.
; or שִׂישׂ; a primitive root; to be bright, i.e. cheerful: - be glad, [idiom] greatly, joy, make mirth, rejoice.
; from h7797 (שׂוּשׂ); joyful; Shavsha, an Israelite: - Shavsha.

; or שׁוֹשָׁן; or שֹׁשָׁן; and (feminine) שׁוֹשַׁנָּה; from h7797 (שׂוּשׂ); a lily (from its whiteness), as aflower of architectural ornament; also a (straight) trumpet (from the tubular shape): - lily, Shoshannim.
; the same as h7799 (שׁוּשַׁן); Shushan, a place in Persia: - Shushan.
; (Aramaic) of foreign origin; a Shushankite (collectively) or inhabitants of some unknown place in Assyrian: - Susanchites.

; or (plural of former) שׁוֹשַׁנִּים עֵדוּתlemma שׁוֹשַׁנִּיס עֵדוּת samekh, corrected to שׁוֹשַׁנִּים עֵדוּת; from h7799 (שׁוּשַׁן) and h5715 (עֵדוּת); lily (or trumpet) of assemblage; Shushan-Eduth or Shoshannim-Eduth, the title of a popular song: - Shoshannim-Eduth, Shushan-eduth.
; probably from h7582 (שָׁאָה) and the same as h8520 (תֶּלַח); crash of breakage; Shuthelach, the name of two Israelites: - Shuthelah.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h5800 (עָזַב); to leave, i.e. (causatively) free: - deliver.
; a primitive root; to tan (by sunburning); figuratively (as if by a piercing ray) to scan: - look up, see.
; a primitive root; to twist (a thread of straw): - twine.
; from h7817 (שָׁחַח); sunk, i.e. downcast: - [phrase] humble.
; for h7879 (שִׂיחַ); communion, i.e. (reflexively) meditation: - thought.
; a primitive root; to donate, i.e. bribe: - hire, give a reward.
; from h7809 (שָׁחַד); a donation (venal or redemptive): - bribe(-ry), gift, present, reward.
; a primitive root; to swim; causatively, to inundate: - (make to) swim.

; a primitive root; to depress, i.e. prostrate (especially reflexive, in homage to royalty or God): - bow (self) down, crouch, fall down (flat), humbly beseech, do (make) obeisance, do reverence, make to stoop, worship.
; from h7811 (שָׂחָה); a pond (for swimming): - to swim in.
; or שְׂחֹק; from h7832 (שָׂחַק); laughter (in merriment or defiance): - derision, laughter(-ed to scorn, -ing), mocked, sport.
; from h7835 (שָׁחַר); dinginess, i.e. perhaps soot: - coal.
; from h7812 (שָׁחָה); pit: - pit.
; a primitive root; to sink or depress (reflexive or causative): - bend, bow (down), bring (cast) down, couch, humble self, be (bring) low, stoop.
; a primitive root; to tread out, i.e. squeeze (grapes): - press.
; a primitive root; to slaughter (in sacrifice or massacre): - kill, offer, shoot out, slay, slaughter.
; a primitive root (identical with h7819 (שָׁחַט) through the idea of striking); to hammer out: - beat.
; from h7819 (שָׁחַט); slaughter: - killing.
; from an unused root probably meaning to burn; inflammation, i.e. an ulcer: - boil, botch.
; or סָחִישׁ; from an unused root apparently meaning to sprout; aftergrowth: - (that) which springeth of the same.
; from the same as h7828 (שַׁחַף); a board (as chipped thin): - cieled with.
; from h7812 (שָׁחָה); a pit-fall (literally or figuratively): - destruction, pit.
; from an unused root probably meaning to roar; a lion (from his characteristic roar): - (fierce) lion.
; apparently from the same as h7826 (שַׁחַל) through some obscure idea, perhaps that of peeling off by concussion of sound; a scale or shell, i.e. the aromatic mussel.: - onycha.
; from an unused root meaning to peel, i.e. emaciate; the gull (as thin): - cuckoo.
; from the same as h7828 (שַׁחַף); emaciation: - consumption.
; from an unused root apparently meaning to strut; haughtiness (as evinced by the attitude): - [idiom] lion, pride.
; from the same as h7830 (שַׁחַץ); proudly; Shachatsom, a place in Palestine: - Shahazimah (from the margin).
; a primitive root; to laugh (in pleasure or detraction); by implication, to play: - deride, have in derision, laugh, make merry, mock(-er), play, rejoice, (laugh to) scorn, be in (make) sport.
; a primitive root; to comminate (by trituration or attrition): - beat, wear.
; from h7833 (שָׁחַק); a powder (as beaten small); by analogy, a thin vapor; by extension, the firmament: - cloud, small dust, heaven, sky.
; a primitive root (identical with h7836 (שָׁחַר) through the idea of the duskiness of early dawn); to be dim or dark (in color): - be black.

; a primitive root; properly, to dawn, i.e. (figuratively) be (up) early at any task (with the implication of earnestness); by extension, to search for (with painstaking): - (do something) betimes, enquire early, rise (seek) betimes, seek diligently) early, in the morning).
; from h7836 (שָׁחַר); dawn (literal, figurative or adverbial): - day(-spring), early, light, morning, whence riseth.
; or שָׁחוֹר; from h7835 (שָׁחַר); properly, dusky, but also (absol.) jetty: - black.
; from h7836 (שָׁחַר); a dawning, i.e. (figuratively) juvenescence: - youth.
; from h7835 (שָׁחַר); swarthy: - black.
; from h7836 (שָׁחַר) and h3050 (יָהּ); Jah has sought; Shecharjah, an Israelite: - Shehariah.
; dual of h7837 (שַׁחַר); double dawn; Shacharajim, an Israelite: - Shaharaim.

; a primitive root; to decay, i.e. (causatively) ruin (literally or figuratively): - batter, cast off, corrupt(-er, thing), destroy(-er, -uction), lose, mar, perish, spill, spoiler, [idiom] utterly, waste(-r).
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h7843 (שָׁחַת) {to decay, i.e. (causatively) ruin (literally or figuratively)}: - corrupt, fault.
; from h7743 (שׁוּחַ); a pit (especially as a trap); figuratively, destruction: - corruption, destruction, ditch, grave, pit.
; or סֵט; from h7750 (שׂוּט); a departure from right, i.e. sin: - revolter, that turn aside.
; a primitive root; to deviate from duty: - decline, go aside, turn.

; feminine of a derivative (only in the plural שִׁטִּים; meaning the sticks of wood) from the same as h7850 (שֹׁטֵט); the acacia (from its scourging thorns): - shittah, shittim. See also h1029 (בֵּית הַשִּׁטָּה).
; a primitive root; to expand: - all abroad, enlarge, spread, stretch out.
; active participle of an otherwise unused root meaning (properly, to pierce; but only as a denominative from h7752 (שׁוֹט)) to flog; a goad: - scourge.
; the same as the plural of h7848 (שִׁטָּה); acacia trees; Shittim, a place East of the Jordan: - Shittim.
; a primitive root; properly, to lurk for, i.e. persecute: - hate, oppose self against.
; a primitive root; to attack, (figuratively) accuse: - (be an) adversary, resist.
; from h7853 (שָׂטַן); an opponent; especially (with the article prefixed) Satan, the arch-enemy of good: - adversary, Satan, withstand.
; from h7853 (שָׂטַן); opposition (by letter): - accusation.
; the same as h7855 (שִׂטְנָה); Sitnah, the name of a well in Pal: - Sitnah.
; a primitive root; to gush; by implication, to inundate, cleanse; by analogy, to gallop, conquer: - drown, (over-) flow(-whelm, rinse, run, rush, (throughly) wash (away).
; or שֵׁטֶף; from h7857 (שָׁטַף); a deluge (literally or figuratively): - flood, outrageous, overflowing.
; (Aramaic) of uncertain derivation; a side: - side.
; active participle of an otherwise unused root probably meaning to write; properly, a scribe, i.e. (by analogy or implication) an official superintendent or magistrate: - officer, overseer, ruler.
; from the same as h7860 (שֹׁטֵר); magisterial; Shitrai, an Israelite: - Shitrai.
; probably from h7737 (שָׁוָה); a gift (as available): - present.
; from the same as h7721 (שׂוֹא) by permutation; elevation: - excellency.
; for h7724 (שְׁוָא); Sheja, an Israelite: - Sheva (from the margin).
; from h7863 (שִׂיא); peak; Sion, the summit of Mount Hermon: - Sion.
; from the same as h7722 (שׁוֹא); ruin; Shijon, a place in Palestine: - Shihon.
; a primitive root; properly, to become aged, i.e. (by implication) to grow gray: - (be) grayheaded.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h7867 (שִׂיב) {properly, to become aged, i.e. (by implication) to grow gray}: - elder.
; from h7867 (שִׂיב); old age: - age.
; by permutation from h7725 (שׁוּב); a return (of property): - captivity.
; from h3427 (יָשַׁב); residence: - while...lay.
; feminine of h7869 (שֵׂיב); old age: - (be) gray (grey hoar,-y) hairs (head,-ed), old age.
; from h7734 (שׂוּג); a withdrawal (into a private place): - pursuing.
; a primitive root probably meaning to boil up (compare h7736 (שׁוּד)); used only as denominative from h7875 (שִׂיד); to plaster: - plaister.
; from h7874 (שִׂיד)lemma שׂיד missing vowel, corrected to שִׂיד; lime (as boiling when slacked): - lime, plaister.
; a primitive root; to keep in memory: - be unmindful. (Render Deuteronomy 32:18, 'A Rock bore thee, thou must recollect; and (yet) thou hast forgotten,' etc.)
; of unknown derivation; Shiza, an Israelite: - Shiza.
; a primitive root; to ponder, i.e. (by implication) converse (with oneself, and hence, aloud) or (transitively) utter: - commune, complain, declare, meditate, muse, pray, speak, talk (with).
; from h7878 (שִׂיחַ); a contemplation; by implication, an utterance: - babbling, communication, complaint, meditation, prayer, talk.
; from h7878 (שִׂיחַ); a shoot (as if uttered or put forth), i.e. (generally) shrubbery: - bush, plant, shrub.
; feminine of h7879 (שִׂיחַ); reflection; be extension, devotion: - meditation, prayer.
; for h7745 (שׁוּחָה); a pit-fall: - pit.
; or שִׁחוֹר; or שִׁחֹר; probably from h7835 (שָׁחַר); dark, i.e. turbid; Shichor, a stream of Egypt: - Shihor, Sihor.
; from the same as h7883 (שִׁיחוֹר) and h3835 (לָבַן); darkish whiteness; Shichor-Libnath, a stream of Palestine: - Shihor-libnath.
; from h7751 (שׁוּט); also compare h7752 (שׁוֹט) an oar; a scourge (figuratively): - oar, scourge.
; from h7951 (שָׁלָה); tranquil; Shiloh, an epithet of the Messiah: - Shiloh.
; or שִׁלֹה; or שִׁילוֹ; or שִׁלוֹ; from the same as h7886 (שִׁילֹה); Shiloh, a place in Palestine: - Shiloh.
; or שִׁילֹנִי; or שִׁלֹנִי; from h7887 (שִׁילֹה); a Shilonite or inhabitant of Shiloh: - Shilonite.
; apparently for h3452 (יְשִׁימוֹן); desert; Shimon, an Israelite: - Shimon.
; from an unused root meaning to urinate; urine: - piss.

; or (the original form) שׁוּר; (1 Samuel 18:6), a primitive root (rather identical with h7788 (שׁוּר) through the idea of strolling minstrelsy); to sing: - behold (by mistake for h7789 (שׁוּר)), sing(-er, -ing man, -ing woman).
; or feminine שִׁירָה; from h7891 (שִׁיר); a song; abstractly, singing: - musical(-ick), [idiom] sing(-er, -ing), song.
; from an unused root meaning to bleach, i.e. whiten; See h8336 (שֵׁשׁ). white, i.e. marble.: -
; from the same as h7893 (שַׁיִשׁ); whiteness; Shisha, an Israelite: - Shisha.
; or שׁוּשַׁק; of Egyptian derivation; Shishak, an Egyptian king: - Shishak.

; a primitive root; to place (in a very wide application): - apply, appoint, array, bring, consider, lay (up), let alone, [idiom] look, make, mark, put (on), [phrase] regard, set, shew, be stayed, [idiom] take.
; from h7896 (שִׁית); a dress (as put on): - attire.
; from h7896 (שִׁית); scrub or trash, i.e. wild growth of weeds or briers (as if put on the field): - thorns.
; from h5526 (סָכַךְ) in the sense of h7753 (שׂוּךְ); a brier (as of a hedge): - prick.
; from h5526 (סָכַךְ) in the sense of h7753 (שׂוּךְ); a booth (as interlaced): - tabernacle.

; a primitive root; to lie down (for rest, sexual connection, decease or any other purpose): - [idiom] at all, cast down, (lover-)lay (self) (down), (make to) lie (down, down to sleep, still with), lodge, ravish, take rest, sleep, stay.
; from h7901 (שָׁכַב); a lying down (of dew, or for the sexual act): - [idiom] carnally, copulation, [idiom] lay, seed.
; from h7901 (שָׁכַב); a (sexual) lying with: - [idiom] lie.
; a primitive root; to roam (through lust): - in the morning (by mistake for h7925 (שָׁכַם)).
; feminine of h7900 (שֹׂךְ) in the sense of h7899 (שֵׂךְ); a dart (as pointed like a thorn): - barbed iron.
; from an unused root apparently meaning to surmount; an observatory (with the article); Seku, a place in Palestine: - Sechu.
; from the same as h7906 (שֵׂכוּ); observant, i.e. (concretely) the mind: - heart.
; infinitive of h7921 (שָׁכֹל); bereavement: - loss of children, spoiling.
; or שַׁכֻּל; from h7921 (שָׁכֹל); bereaved: - barren, bereaved (robbed) of children (whelps).
; or שִׁכֹּר; from h7937 (שָׁכַר); intoxicated, as astate or a habit: - drunk(-ard, -en, -en man).
; or שָׁכֵחַ; a primitive root; to mislay, i.e. to be oblivious of, from want of memory or attention: - [idiom] at all, (cause to) forget.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h7911 (שָׁכַח) through the idea of disclosure of a covered or forgotten thing; to discover (literally or figuratively): - find.
; from h7911 (שָׁכַח); oblivious: - forget.
; feminine from the same as h7906 (שֵׂכוּ); a conspicuous object: - picture.
; intensive perhaps from the same as h7906 (שֵׂכוּ) in the sense of h7753 (שׂוּךְ); a knife (as pointed or edged): - knife.
; from h7936 (שָׂכַר); a man at wages by the day or year: - hired (man, servant), hireling.
; feminine of h7916 (שָׂכִיר); a hiring: - that is hired.
; a primitive root; to weave (i.e. lay) a trap; figuratively, (through the idea of secreting) to allay (passions; physically, abate a flood): - appease, assuage, make to cease, pacify, set.

; a primitive root; to be (causatively, make or act) circumspect and hence, intelligent: - consider, expert, instruct, prosper, (deal) prudent(-ly), (give) skill(-ful), have good success, teach, (have, make to) understand(-ing), wisdom, (be, behave self, consider, make) wise(-ly), guide wittingly.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h7919 (שָׂכַל) {to be (causatively, make or act) circumspect and hence, intelligent}: - consider.

; a primitive root; properly, to miscarry, i.e. suffer abortion; by analogy, to bereave (literally or figuratively): - bereave (of children), barren, cast calf (fruit, young), be (make) childless, deprive, destroy, [idiom] expect, lose children, miscarry, rob of children, spoil.
; or שֵׂכֶל; from h7919 (שָׂכַל); intelligence; by implication, success: - discretion, knowledge, policy, prudence, sense, understanding, wisdom, wise.
; plural from h7921 (שָׁכֹל); childlessness (by continued bereavements): - to have after loss of others.
; (Aramaic) from h7920 (שְׂכַל); intelligence: - understanding.

; a primitive root; properly, to incline (the shoulder to a burden); but used only as denominative from h7926 (שְׁכֶם); literally, to load up (on the back of man or beast), i.e. to start early in the morning: - (arise, be up, get (oneself) up, rise up) early (betimes), morning.
; from h7925 (שָׁכַם); the neck (between the shoulders) as the place of burdens; figuratively, the spur of ahill: - back, [idiom] consent, portion, shoulder.
; the same as h7926 (שְׁכֶם); ridge; Shekem, a place in Palestine: - Shechem.
; for h7926 (שְׁכֶם); Shekem, the name of a Hivite and two Israelites: - Shechem.
; feminine of h7926 (שְׁכֶם); the shoulderbone: - shoulder blade.
; patronymic from h7928 (שֶׁכֶם); a Shikmite (collectively), or descendants of Shekem: - Shichemites.

; a primitive root (apparently akin (by transmission) to h7901 (שָׁכַב) through the idea of lodging; compare h5531 (סִכְלוּת), h7925 (שָׁכַם)); to reside or permanently stay (literally or figuratively): - abide, continue, (cause to, make to) dwell(-er), have habitation, inhabit, lay, place, (cause to) remain, rest, set (up).
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h7931 (שָׁכַן) {to reside or permanently stay (literally or figuratively)}: - cause to dwell, have habitation.
; from h7931 (שָׁכַן); a residence: - habitation.
; from h7931 (שָׁכַן); a resident; by extension, a fellow-citizen: - inhabitant, neighbour, nigh.
; or (prolonged) שְׁכַנְיָהוּ; from h7931 (שָׁכַן) and h3050 (יָהּ); Jah has dwelt; Shekanjah, the name of nine Israelites: - Shecaniah, Shechaniah.

; or (by permutation) סָכַר; (Ezra 4:5), a primitive root (apparently akin (by prosthesis) to h3739 (כָּרָה) through the idea of temporary purchase; compare h7937 (שָׁכַר)); to hire: - earn wages, hire (out self), reward, [idiom] surely.

; a primitive root; to become tipsy; in a qualified sense, to satiate with astimulating drink or (figuratively) influence: - (be filled with) drink (abundantly), (be, make) drunk(-en), be merry. (Superlative of h8248 (שָׁקָה).)
; from h7936 (שָׂכַר); wages: - reward, sluices.
; from h7936 (שָׂכַר); payment of contract; concretely, salary, fare, maintenance; by implication, compensation, benefit: - hire, price, reward(-ed), wages, worth.
; the same as h7939 (שָׂכָר); recompense; Sakar, the name of two Israelites: - Sacar.
; from h7937 (שָׁכַר); an intoxicant, i.e. intensely alcoholic liquor: - strong drink, [phrase] drunkard, strong wine.
; for h7943 (שִׁכָּרוֹן); drunkenness, Shikkeron, a place in Palestine: - Shicron.
; from h7937 (שָׁכַר); intoxication: - (be) drunken(-ness).
; from h7952 (שָׁלָה) abbreviated form; a fault: - error.
; for the rel. h0834 (אֲשֶׁר); used with prepositional prefix, and often followed by some pronominal affix; on account of, whatsoever, whichsoever: - cause, sake.
; for h7600 (שַׁאֲנָן); tranquil: - being at ease.
; a primitive root; to space off; intensive (evenly) to make equidistant: - equally distant, set in order.
; from h7947 (שָׁלַב); a spacer or raised interval, i.e. the stile in aframe or panel: - ledge.
; a primitive root; properly, meaning to be white; used only as denominative from h7950 (שֶׁלֶג); to be snow-white (with the linen clothing of the slain): - be as snow.
; from h7949 (שָׁלַג); snow (probably from its whiteness): - snow(-y).
; or שָׁלַו; (Job 3:26), a primitive root; to be tranquil, i.e. secure or successful: - be happy, prosper, be in safety.
; a primitive root (probably identical with h7953 (שָׁלָה) through the idea of educing); to mislead: - deceive, be negligent.

; a primitive root (rather cognate (by contraction) to the base of h5394 (נָשַׁל), h7997 (שָׁלַל) and their congeners through the idea of extracting); to draw out or off, i.e. remove (the soul by death): - take away.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h7951 (שָׁלָה); to be secure: - at rest.
; (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to h7952 (שָׁלָה); a wrong: - thing amiss.
; the same as h7596 (שְׁאֵלָה) (shortened); request; Shelah, the name of a postdiluvian patriarch and of an Israelite: - Shelah.
; from the same as h3851 (לַהַב) with sibilant prefix; a flare of fire: - (flaming) flame.
; or שְׂלָיו; by orthographical variation from h7951 (שָׁלָה) through the idea of sluggishness; the quail collectively (as slow in flight from its weight): - quails.
; from h7951 (שָׁלָה); security: - prosperity.
; (Aramaic) or שָׁלוּת; (Aramaic), from the same as h7955 (שָׁלָה); a fault: - error, [idiom] fail, thing amiss.
; or שָׁלֵיו; feminine שְׁלֵוָה; from h7951 (שָׁלָה); tranquil; (in a bad sense) careless; abstractly, security: - (being) at ease, peaceable, (in) prosper(-ity), quiet(-ness), wealthy.
; from h7951 (שָׁלָה); security (genuine or false): - abundance, peace(-ably), prosperity, quietness.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h7962 (שַׁלְוָה); safety: - tranquillity. See also h7961 (שָׁלֵו).
; or שִׁלֻּחַ; from h7971 (שָׁלַח); (only in plural) a dismissal, i.e. (of a wife) divorce (especially the document); also (of a daughter) dower: - presents, have sent back.

; or שָׁלֹם; from h7999 (שָׁלַם); safe, i.e. (figuratively) well, happy, friendly; also (abstractly) welfare, i.e. health, prosperity, peace: - [idiom] do, familiar, [idiom] fare, favour, [phrase] friend, [idiom] great, (good) health, ([idiom] perfect, such as be at) peace(-able, -ably), prosper(-ity, -ous), rest, safe(-ty), salute, welfare, ([idiom] all is, be) well, [idiom] wholly.
; or שִׁלֻּם; from h7999 (שָׁלַם); a requital, i.e. (secure) retribution, (venal) a fee: - recompense, reward.
; or (shorter) שַׁלֻּם; the same as h7966 (שִׁלּוּם); Shallum, the name of fourteen Israelites: - Shallum.
; probably for h7967 (שַׁלּוּם); Shallun, an Israelite: - Shallum.

; or שָׁלֹשׁ; masculine שְׁלוֹשָׁה; or שְׁלֹשָׁה; a primitive number; three; occasionally (ordinal) third, or (multiple) thrice: - [phrase] fork, [phrase] often(-times), third, thir(-teen, -teenth), three, [phrase] thrice. Compare h7991 (שָׁלִישׁ).
; or שְׁלֹשִׁים; multiple of h7969 (שָׁלוֹשׁ); thirty; or (ordinal) thirtieth: - thirty, thirtieth. Compare h7991 (שָׁלִישׁ).

; a primitive root; to send away, for, or out (in a great variety of applications): - [idiom] any wise, appoint, bring (on the way), cast (away, out), conduct, [idiom] earnestly, forsake, give (up), grow long, lay, leave, let depart (down, go, loose), push away, put (away, forth, in, out), reach forth, send (away, forth, out), set, shoot (forth, out), sow, spread, stretch forth (out).
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h7971 (שָׁלַח) {to send away, for, or out (in a great variety of applications)}: - put, send.
; from h7971 (שָׁלַח); a missile of attack, i.e. spear; also (figuratively) a shoot of growth; i.e. branch: - dart, plant, [idiom] put off, sword, weapon.
; the same as h7973 (שֶׁלַח); Shelach, a postdiluvian patriarch: - Salah, Shelah. Compare h7975 (שִׁלֹחַ)lemma שִׁלֹּחַ extra dagesh, corrected to שִׁלֹחַ.
; or (in imitation of h7974 (שֶׁלַח)) שֶׁלַח; (Nehemiah 3:15), from h7971 (שָׁלַח); rill; Shiloach, a fountain of Jerusalem: - Shiloah, Siloah.
; feminine of h7964 (שִׁלּוּחַ); a shoot: - branch.
; from h7973 (שֶׁלַח); missive, i.e. armed; Shilchi, an Israelite: - Shilhi.
; plural of h7973 (שֶׁלַח); javelins or sprouts; Shilchim, a place in Palestine: - Shilhim.
; from h7971 (שָׁלַח); a table (as spread out); by implication, a meal: - table.
; a primitive root; to dominate, i.e. govern; by implication, to permit: - (bear, have) rule, have dominion, give (have) power.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h7980 (שָׁלַט) {to dominate, i.e. govern; by implication, to permit}: - have the mastery, have power, bear rule, be (make) ruler.
; from h7980 (שָׁלַט); probably a shield (as controlling, i.e. protecting the person): - shield.
; (Aramaic) from h7980 (שָׁלַט); {power.}: - power.
; (Aramaic) or שִׁלְטֹןlemma שִׁלְטן missing vowel, corrected to שִׁלְטֹן; corresponding to h7983 (שִׁלְטוֹן) {a potentate}: - ruler.
; (Aramaic) from h7981 (שְׁלֵט); empire (abstractly or concretely): - dominion.
; feminine from h7980 (שָׁלַט); a vixen: - imperious.
; from h7951 (שָׁלָה); privacy: - [phrase] quietly.
; feminine from h7953 (שָׁלָה); a fetus or babe (as extruded in birth): - young one.
; from h7980 (שָׁלַט); potent; concretely, a prince or warrior: - governor, mighty, that hath power, ruler.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h7989 (שַׁלִּיט); mighty; abstractly, permission; concretely, a premier: - captain, be lawful, rule(-r).

; or שָׁלוֹשׁ; (1 Chronicles 11:11; 1 Chronicles 12:18), or שָׁלֹשׁ; (2 Samuel 23:13), from h7969 (שָׁלוֹשׁ); a triple, i.e. (as a musical instrument) a triangle (or perhaps rather threestringed lute); also (as an indefinite, great quantity) a three-fold measure (perhaps a treble ephah); also (as an officer) a general of the third rank (upward, i.e. the highest): - captain, instrument of musick, (great) lord, (great) measure, prince, three (from the margin).
; ordinal from h7969 (שָׁלוֹשׁ); third; feminine athird (part); by extension, a third (day, year or time); specifically, a third-story cell): - third (part, rank, time), three (years old).
; a primitive root; to throw out, down or away (literally or figuratively): - adventure, cast (away, down, forth, off, out), hurl, pluck, throw.
; from h7993 (שָׁלַךְ); bird of prey, usually thought to be the pelican (from casting itself into the sea): - cormorant.
; from h7993 (שָׁלַךְ); a felling (of trees): - when cast.
; the same as h7995 (שַׁלֶּכֶת); Shalleketh, a gate in Jerusalem: - Shalleketh.
; a primitive root; to drop or strip; by implication, to plunder: - let fall, make self a prey, [idiom] of purpose, (make a, (take)) spoil.
; from h7997 (שָׁלַל); booty: - prey, spoil.

; a primitive root; to be safe (in mind, body or estate); figuratively, to be (causatively, make) completed; by implication, to be friendly; by extension, to reciprocate (in various applications): - make amends, (make an) end, finish, full, give again, make good, (re-) pay (again), (make) (to) (be at) peace(-able), that is perfect, perform, (make) prosper(-ous), recompense, render, requite, make restitution, restore, reward, [idiom] surely.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h7999 (שָׁלַם); to complete, to restore: - deliver, finish.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h7965 (שָׁלוֹם); prosperity: - peace.
; from h7999 (שָׁלַם); properly, requital, i.e. a (voluntary) sacrifice in thanks: - peace offering.
; from h7999 (שָׁלַם); complete (literally or figuratively); especially friendly: - full, just, made ready, peaceable, perfect(-ed), quiet, Shalem (by mistake for a name), whole.
; the same as h8003 (שָׁלֵם); peaceful; Shalem, an early name of Jerusalem: - Salem.
; from h7999 (שָׁלַם); requital: - recompense.
; the same as h8005 (שִׁלֵּם); Shillem, an Israelite: - Shillem.
; probably for h8008 (שַׂלְמָה); clothing; Salma, the name of two Israelites: - Salma.
; transp. for h8071 (שִׂמְלָה); a dress: - clothes, garment, raiment.
; the same as h8008 (שַׂלְמָה); clothing; Salmah, an Israelite: - Salmon. Compare h8012 (שַׂלְמוֹן).
; from h7965 (שָׁלוֹם); peaceful; Shelomah, David's successor: - Solomon.
; feminine of h7966 (שִׁלּוּם); retribution: - recompense.
; from h8008 (שַׂלְמָה); investiture; Salmon, an Israelite: - Salmon. Compare h8009 (שַׂלְמָה).
; feminine plural of h7965 (שָׁלוֹם); pacifications; Shelomoth, the name of two Israelites: - Shelomith (from the margin), Shelomoth. Compare h8019 (שְׁלֹמִית).
; from h8008 (שַׂלְמָה); clothed; Salmai, an Israelite: - Shalmai.
; from h7965 (שָׁלוֹם); peaceable; Shelomi, an Israelite: - Shelomi.
; patronymically from h8006 (שִׁלֵּם); a Shilemite (collectively) or descendants of Shillem: - Shillemites.
; from h7965 (שָׁלוֹם) and h0410 (אֵל); peace of God; Shelumiel, an Israelite: - Shelumiel.
; or שֶׁלֶמְיָהוּ; from h8002 (שֶׁלֶם) and h3050 (יָהּ); thankoffering of Jah; Shelemjah, the name of nine Israelites: - Shelemiah.
; or שׁלוֹמִית; (Ezra 8:10), from h7965 (שָׁלוֹם); peaceableness; Shelomith, the name of five Israelites and three Israelitesses: - Shelomith.
; of foreign derivation; Shalman, a king apparently of Assyria: - Shalman. Compare h8022 (שַׁלְמַנְאֶסֶר).
; from h7999 (שָׁלַם); a bribe: - reward.
; of foreign derivation; Shalmaneser, an Assyrian king: - Shalmaneser. Comp h8020 (שַׁלְמַן).
; the same as h7888 (שִׁילוֹנִי); Shiloni, an Israelite: - Shiloni.
; from h7956 (שֵׁלָה); a Shelanite (collectively), or descendants of Shelah: - Shelanites.
; a primitive root; to pull out, up or off: - draw (off), grow up, pluck off.
; from h8025 (שָׁלַף); extract; Sheleph, a son of Jokthan: - Sheleph.

; a primitive root perhaps originally to intensify, i.e. treble; but apparently used only as denominative from h7969 (שָׁלוֹשׁ), to be (causatively, make) triplicate (by restoration, in portions, strands, days or years): - do the third time, (divide into, stay) three (days, -fold, parts, years old).
; from h8027 (שָׁלַשׁ); triplet; Shelesh, an Israelite: - Shelesh.
; from h8027 (שָׁלַשׁ); a descendant of the third degree, i.e. great grandchild: - third (generation).
; feminine from the same as h8028 (שֶׁלֶשׁ); triplication; Shilshah, an Israelite: - Shilshah.
; feminine from h8027 (שָׁלַשׁ); trebled land; Shalishah, a place in Palestine: - Shalisha.

; or שִׁלְשֹׁם; from the same as h8028 (שֶׁלֶשׁ); trebly, i.e. (in time) day before yesterday: - [phrase] before (that time, -time), excellent things (from the margin), [phrase] heretofore, three days, [phrase] time past.

; a primitive particle (rather from the relative pronoun, h0834 (אֲשֶׁר)); there (transferring to time) then; often thither, or thence: - in it, [phrase] thence, there (-in, [phrase] of, [phrase] out), [phrase] thither, [phrase] whither.

; a primitive word (perhaps rather from through the idea of definite and conspicuous position; compare h8064 (שָׁמַיִם)); an appellation, as amark or memorial of individuality; by implication honor, authority, character: - [phrase] base, (in-) fame(-ous), named(-d), renown, report.
; the same as h8034 (שֵׁם); name; Shem, a son of Noah (often includ. his posterity): - Sem, Shem.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h8034 (שֵׁם) {an appellation, as amark or memorial of individuality; by implication honor, authority, character}: - name.
; from h8074 (שָׁמֵם); desolation; Shamma, an Israelite: - Shamma.
; apparently from h8034 (שֵׁם) and h0083 (אֵבֶר); name of pinion, i.e. illustrious; Shemeber, a king of Zeboim: - Shemeber.
; perhaps for h8093 (שִׁמְעָה); Shimah, an Israelite: - Shimah. Compare h8043 (שִׁמְאָם).

; or שְׂמֹאל; a primitive word (rather perhaps from the same as h8071 (שִׂמְלָה) (by insertion of the aleph) through the idea of wrapping up); properly, dark (as enveloped), i.e. the north; hence (by orientation), the left hand: - left (hand, side).
; a primitive root (denominative from h8040 (שְׂמֹאול)); to use the left hand or pass in that direction): - (go, turn) (on the, to the) left.
; from h8040 (שְׂמֹאול); situated on the left side: - left.
; for h8039 (שִׁמְאָה) (compare h0038 (אֲבִיָּם)); Shimam, an Israelite: - Shimeam.
; of uncertain derivation; Shamgar, an Israelite judge: - Shamgar.
; a primitive root; to desolate: - destory(-uction), bring to nought, overthrow, perish, pluck down, [idiom] utterly.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h8045 (שָׁמַד) {to desolate}: - consume.
; from h8074 (שָׁמֵם); ruin; by implication, consternation: - astonishment, desolate(-ion), waste, wonderful thing.
; the same as h8047 (שַׁמָּה); Shammah, the name of an Edomite and four Israelites: - Shammah.
; for h8048 (שַׁמָּה); desolation; Shamhuth, an Israelite: - Shamhuth.
; from the passive participle of h8085 (שָׁמַע) and h0410 (אֵל); heard of God; Shemuel, the name of three Israelites: - Samuel, Shemuel.
; from h8074 (שָׁמֵם); renowned; Shammua, the name of four Israelites: - Shammua, Shammuah.
; feminine passive participle of h8074 (שָׁמֵם); something heard, i.e. an announcement: - bruit, doctrine, fame, mentioned, news, report, rumor, tidings.
; passive participle of h8103 (שִׁמְצָה); observed; Shamur, an Israelite: - Shamir (from the margin).
; plural of h8047 (שַׁמָּה); ruins; Shammoth, an Israelite: - Shamoth.

; a primitive root; probably to brighten up, i.e. (figuratively) be (causatively, make) blithe or gleesome: - cheer up, be (make) glad, (have, make) joy(-ful), be (make) merry, (cause to, make to) rejoice, [idiom] very.
; from h8055 (שָׂמַח); blithe or gleeful: - (be) glad, joyful, (making) merry((-hearted), -ily), rejoice(-ing).
; from h8056 (שָׂמֵחַ); blithesomeness or glee, (religious or festival): - [idiom] exceeding(-ly), gladness, joy(-fulness), mirth, pleasure, rejoice(-ing).
; a primitive root; to fling down; incipiently to jostle; figuratively, to let alone, desist, remit: - discontinue, overthrow, release, let rest, shake, stumble, throw down.
; from h8058 (שָׁמַט); remission (of debt) or suspension of labor): - release.
; from h8073 (שַׁמְלַי); destructive; Shammai, the name of three Israelites: - Shammai.
; apparently from h8034 (שֵׁם) and h3045 (יָדַע); name of knowing; Shemida, an Israelite: - Shemida, Shemidah.
; patronymically from h8061 (שְׁמִידָע); a Shemidaite (collectively) or descendants of Shemida: - Shemidaites.
; from h5564 (סָמַךְ); a run (as sustaining the Oriental sitter): - mantle.

; dual of an unused singular שָׁמֶה; from an unused root meaning to be lofty; the sky (as aloft; the dual perhaps alluding to the visible arch in which the clouds move, as well as to the higher ether where the celestial bodies revolve): - air, [idiom] astrologer, heaven(-s).

; (Aramaic) corresponding to h8064 (שָׁמַיִם) {the sky (as aloft; the dual perhaps alluding to the visible arch in which the clouds move, as well as to the higher ether where the celestial bodies revolve)}: - heaven.
; from h8083 (שְׁמֹנֶה); eight: - eight.
; feminine of h8066 (שְׁמִינִי); probably an eight-stringed lyre: - Sheminith.
; from h8104 (שָׁמַר) in the original sense of pricking; a thorn; also (from its keenness for scratching) a gem, probably the diamond: - adamant (stone), brier, diamond.
; the same as h8068 (שָׁמִיר); Shamir, the name of two places in Palestine: - Shamir. Compare h8053 (שָׁמוּר).
; or שְׁמָרִימוֹת; probably from h8034 (שֵׁם) and plural of h7413 (רָמָה); name of heights; Shemiramoth, the name of two Israelites: - Shemiramoth.

; perhaps by permutation for the feminine of h5566 (סֶמֶל) (through the idea of a cover assuming the shape of the object beneath); a dress, especially a mantle: - apparel, cloth(-es, -ing), garment, raiment. Compare h8008 (שַׂלְמָה).
; probably for the same as h8071 (שִׂמְלָה); Samlah, an Edomite: - Samlah.
; for h8014 (שַׂלְמַי); Shamlai, one of the Nethinim: - Shalmai (from the margin).

; a primitive root; to stun (or intransitively, grow numb), i.e. devastate or (figuratively) stupefy (both usually in a passive sense): - make amazed, be astonied, (be an) astonish(-ment), (be, bring into, unto, lay, lie, make) desolate(-ion, places), be destitute, destroy (self), (lay, lie, make) waste, wonder.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h8074 (שָׁמֵם) {to stun (or intransitively, grow numb), i.e. devastate or (figuratively) stupefy (both usually in a passive sense)}: - be astonied.
; from h8074 (שָׁמֵם); ruined: - desolate.
; or שִׁמָמָה; feminine of h8076 (שָׁמֵם); devastation; figuratively, astonishment: - (laid, [idiom] most) desolate(-ion), waste.
; from h8074 (שָׁמֵם); stupefaction: - astonishment.
; probably from h8074 (שָׁמֵם) (in the sense of poisoning); a lizard (from the superstition of its noxiousness): - spider.
; a primitive root; to shine, i.e. (by analogy) be (causatively, make) oily or gross: - become (make, wax) fat.

; from h8080 (שָׁמַן); grease, especially liquid (as from the olive, often perfumed); figuratively, richness: - anointing, [idiom] fat (things), [idiom] fruitful, oil(-ed), ointment, olive, [phrase] pine.
; from h8080 (שָׁמַן); greasy, i.e. gross; figuratively, rich: - fat, lusty, plenteous.

; or שְׁמוֹנֶה; feminine שְׁמֹנָה; or שְׁמוֹנָה; apparently from h8082 (שָׁמֵן) through the idea of plumpness; a cardinal number, eight (as if a surplus above the 'perfect' seven); also (as ordinal) eighth: - eight(-een, -eenth), eighth.
; or שְׁמוֹנִים; multiple from h8083 (שְׁמֹנֶה); eighty, also eightieth: - eighty(-ieth), fourscore.

; a primitive root; to hear intelligently (often with implication of attention, obedience, etc.; causatively, to tell, etc.): - [idiom] attentively, call (gather) together, [idiom] carefully, [idiom] certainly, consent, consider, be content, declare, [idiom] diligently, discern, give ear, (cause to, let, make to) hear(-ken, tell), [idiom] indeed, listen, make (a) noise, (be) obedient, obey, perceive, (make a) proclaim(-ation), publish, regard, report, shew (forth), (make a) sound, [idiom] surely, tell, understand, whosoever (heareth), witness.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h8085 (שָׁמַע) {to hear intelligently (often with implication of attention, obedience, etc.; causatively, to tell, etc.)}: - hear, obey.
; for the same as h8088 (שֵׁמַע); Shema, the name of a place in Palestine and of four Israelites: - Shema.
; from h8085 (שָׁמַע); something heard, i.e. a sound, rumor, announcement; abstractly, audience: - bruit, fame, hear(-ing), loud, report, speech, tidings.
; from h8085 (שָׁמַע); a report: - fame.
; for h8087 (שֶׁמַע); Shema, a place in Palestine: - Shema.
; from h8085 (שָׁמַע); obedient; Shama, an Israelite: - Shama.
; for h8093 (שִׁמְעָה); Shima, the name of four Israelites: - Shimea, Shimei, Shamma.
; feminine of h8088 (שֵׁמַע); annunciation; Shimah, an Israelite: - Shimeah.
; for h8093 (שִׁמְעָה); Shemaah, an Israelite: - Shemaah.
; from h8085 (שָׁמַע); hearing; Shimon, one of Jacob's sons, also the tribe descended from him: - Simeon.
; from h8088 (שֵׁמַע); famous; Shimi, the name of twenty Israelites: - Shimeah (from the margin), Shimei, Shimhi, Shimi.
; patronymically from h8096 (שִׁמְעִי); a Shimite (collectively) or descendants of Shimi: - of Shimi, Shimites.
; or שְׁמַעְיָהוּ; from h8085 (שָׁמַע) and h3050 (יָהּ); Jah has heard; Shemajah, the name of twenty-five Israelites: - Shemaiah.
; patronymically from h8095 (שִׁמְעוֹן); a Shimonite (collectively) or descendants of Shimon: - tribe of Simeon, Simeonites.
; feminine of h8088 (שֵׁמַע); annunciation; Shimath, an Ammonitess: - Shimath.
; patronymically from h8093 (שִׁמְעָה); a Shimathite (collectively) or descendants of Shimah: - Shimeathites.
; from an unused root meaning to emit a sound; an inkling: - a little.
; feminine of h8102 (שֶׁמֶץ); scornful whispering (of hostile spectators): - shame.

; a primitive root; properly, to hedge about (as with thorns), i.e. guard; generally, to protect, attend to, etc.: - beward, be circumspect, take heed (to self), keep(-er, self), mark, look narrowly, observe, preserve, regard, reserve, save (self), sure, (that lay) wait (for), watch(-man).
; from h8104 (שָׁמַר); something preserved, i.e. the settlings (plural only) of wine: - dregs, (wines on the) lees.
; the same as h8105 (שֶׁמֶר); Shemer, the name of three Israelites: - Shamer, Shemer.
; from h8104 (שָׁמַר); an observance: - [idiom] be (much) observed.
; feminine of an unused noun from h8104 (שָׁמַר) meaning a guard; watchfulness: - watch.
; feminine of passive participle of h8104 (שָׁמַר); something guarded, i.e. an eye-lid: - waking.
; from h8105 (שֶׁמֶר) in its original sense; guardianship; Shimron, the name of an Israelite and of a place in Palestine: - Shimron.
; from the active participle of h8104 (שָׁמַר); watch-station; Shomeron, a place in Palestine: - Samaria.
; from h8110 (שִׁמְרוֹן) and a derivative of h4754 (מָרָא); guard of lashing; Shimron-Meron, a place in Palestine: - Shimon-meron.
; from h8105 (שֶׁמֶר) in its original sense; watchful; Shimri, the name of four Israelites: - Shimri.
; or שְׁמַרְיָהוּ; from h8104 (שָׁמַר) and h3050 (יָהּ); Jah has guarded; Shemarjah, the name of four Israelites: - Shamariah, Shemariah.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h8111 (שֹׁמְרוֹן); Shomrain, a place in Palestine: - Samaria.
; feminine of h8113 (שִׁמְרִי); female guard; Shimrith, a Moabitess: - Shimrith.
; patronymically from h8110 (שִׁמְרוֹן); a Shimronite (collectively) or descendants of Shimron: - Shimronites.
; patrial from h8111 (שֹׁמְרוֹן); a Shomeronite (collectively) or inhabitants of Shomeron: - Samaritans.
; from h8104 (שָׁמַר); guardship; Shimrath, an Israelite: - Shimrath.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to the root of h8121 (שֶׁמֶשׁ) through the idea of activity implied in day-light; to serve: - minister.

; from an unused root meaning to be brilliant; the sun; by implication, the east; figuratively, a ray, i.e. (architectural) a notched battlement: - [phrase] east side(-ward), sun (rising), [phrase] west(-ward), window. See also h1053 (בֵּית שֶׁמֶשׁ).
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h8121 (שֶׁמֶשׁ); the sun: - sun.
; from h8121 (שֶׁמֶשׁ); sunlight; Shimshon, an Israelite: - Samson.
; (Aramaic) from h8122 (שֶׁמֶשׁ); sunny; Shimshai, a Samaritan: - Shimshai.
; apparently from h8121 (שֶׁמֶשׁ); sunlike; Shamsherai, an Israelite: - Shamsherai.
; patronymically from an unused name from h7762 (שׁוּם) probably meaning garlic-smell; a Shumathite (collectively) or descendants of Shumah: - Shumathites.
; from h8150 (שָׁנַן); compare h8143 (שֶׁנְהַבִּים) a tooth (as sharp); specifically ivory; figuratively, a cliff: - crag, [idiom] forefront, ivory, [idiom] sharp, tooth.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h8127 (שֵׁן); a tooth: - tooth.
; the same as h8127 (שֵׁן); crag; Shen, a place in Palestine: - Shen.
; a primitive root; to hate (personally): - enemy, foe, (be) hate(-ful, -r), odious, [idiom] utterly.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h8130 (שָׂנֵא) {to hate (personally)}: - hate.
; a primitive root; to alter: - change.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h8132 (שָׁנָא) {to alter}: - alter, change, (be) diverse.
; probably from h8132 (שָׁנָא) and h0001 (אָב); a father has turned; Shinab, a Canaanite: - Shinab.
; from h8130 (שָׂנֵא); hate: - [phrase] exceedingly, hate(-ful, -red).
; from h8132 (שָׁנָא); change, i.e. repetition: - [idiom] angels.
; apparently of Babylonian origin; Shenatstsar, an Israelite: - Senazar.

; a primitive root; to fold, i.e. duplicate (literally or figuratively); by implication, to transmute (transitive or intransitive): - do (speak, strike) again, alter, double, (be given to) change, disguise, (be) diverse, pervert, prefer, repeat, return, do the second time.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h8142 (שֵׁנָה) {sleep}: - sleep.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h8141 (שָׁנֶה) {a year (as a revolution of time)}: - year.
; (in plural or (feminine) שָׁנָה; from h8138 (שָׁנָה); a year (as a revolution of time): - [phrase] whole age, [idiom] long, [phrase] old, year([idiom] -ly).
; or שֵׁנָא; (Psalm 127:2), from h3462 (יָשֵׁן); sleep: - sleep.
; from h8127 (שֵׁן) and the plural apparently of a foreign word; probably, tooth of elephants, i.e. ivory tusk: - ivory.
; of uncertain derivation; crimson, properly, the insect or its color, also stuff dyed with it: - crimson, scarlet (thread).
; from h8138 (שָׁנָה); properly, double, i.e. second; also adverbially, again: - again, either (of them), (an-) other, second (time).
; from h8130 (שָׂנֵא); hated: - hated.

; dual of h8145 (שֵׁנִי); feminine שְׁתַּיִם; two; also (as ordinal) twofold: - both, couple, double, second, twain, [phrase] twelfth, [phrase] twelve, [phrase] twenty (sixscore) thousand, twice, two.
; from h8150 (שָׁנַן); something pointed, i.e. a gibe: - byword, taunt.
; or שְׂנִיר; from an unused root meaning to be pointed; peak; Shenir or Senir, a summit of Lebanon: - Senir, Shenir.
; a primitive root; to point (transitive or intransitive); intensively, to pierce; figuratively, to inculcate: - prick, sharp(-en), teach diligently, whet.
; a primitive root; to compress (with a belt): - gird up.
; probably of foreign derivation; Shinar, a plain in Babylonia: - Shinar.
; from h3462 (יָשֵׁן); sleep: - sleep.
; or שָׁשָׂה; (Isaiah 10:13), a primitive root; to plunder: - destroyer, rob, spoil(-er).
; a primitive root; to plunder: - rifle, spoil.
; a primitive root; to split or tear; figuratively, to upbraid: - cleave, (be) cloven (footed), rend, stay.
; from h8156 (שָׁסַע); a fissure: - cleft, clovenfooted.
; a primitive root; to cut in pieces, i.e. slaughter: - hew in pieces.

; a primitive root; to gaze at or about (properly, for help); by implication, to inspect, consider, compassionate, be nonplussed (as looking around in amazement) or bewildered: - depart, be dim, be dismayed, look (away), regard, have respect, spare, turn.
; (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to h8159 (שָׁעָה); properly, a look, i.e. a moment: - hour.
; feminine from an unused root meaning to stamp; a clatter (of hoofs): - stamping.
; probably of foreign derivation; linsey-woolsey, i.e. cloth of linen and wool carded and spun together: - garment of divers sorts, linen and wollen.
; or שָׂעִר; from h8175 (שָׂעַר); shaggy; as noun, a he-goat; by analogy, a faun: - devil, goat, hairy, kid, rough, satyr.
; formed the same as h8163 (שָׂעִיר); a shower (as tempestuous): - small rain.
; formed like h8163 (שָׂעִיר); rough; Seir, a mountain of Idumaea and its aboriginal occupants, also one in Palestine: - Seir.
; feminine of h8163 (שָׂעִיר); a she-goat: - kid.
; formed as h8166 (שְׂעִירָה); roughness; Seirah, a place in Palestine: - Seirath.
; from an unused root meaning to hollow out; the palm; by extension, a handful: - handful, hollow of the hand.
; or שַׁעֲלַבִּין; plural from h7776 (שׁוּעָל); fox-holes; Shaalbim or Shaalabbin, a place in Palestine: - Shaalabbin, Shaalbim.
; patrial from h8169 (שַׁעַלְבִים); a Shaalbonite or inhabitant of Shaalbin: - Shaalbonite.
; plural of h7776 (שׁוּעָל); foxes; Shaalim, a place in Palestine: - Shalim.
; a primitive root; to support one's self: - lean, lie, rely, rest (on, self), stay.

; a primitive root; (in a good acceptation) to look upon (with complacency), i.e. fondle, please or amuse (self); (in a bad one) to look about (in dismay), i.e. stare: - cry (out) (by confusion with h7768 (שָׁוַע)), dandle, delight (self), play, shut.
; from h5586 (סָעַף); fluctuation; Shaaph, the name of two Israelites: - Shaaph.
; a primitive root; to storm; by implication, to shiver, i.e. fear: - be (horribly) afraid, fear, hurl as a storm, be tempestuous, come like (take away as with) a whirlwind.
; a primitive root; to split or open, i.e. (literally, but only as denominative from h8179 (שַׁעַר)); compare see h7778 (שׁוֹעֵר) to act as gatekeeper; (figuratively) to estimate: - think.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h8181 (שֵׂעָר); hair: - hair.
; from h8175 (שָׂעַר); a tempest; also a terror: - affrighted, [idiom] horribly, [idiom] sore, storm. See h8181 (שֵׂעָר).
; from h8176 (שָׁעַר) in its original sense; an opening, i.e. door or gate: - city, door, gate, port ([idiom] -er).
; from h8176 (שָׁעַר); a measure (as a section): - (hundred-) fold.
; or שַׂעַר; (Isaiah 7:20), from h8175 (שָׂעַר) in the sense of dishevelling; hair (as if tossed or bristling): - hair(-y), [idiom] rough.
; from h8176 (שָׁעַר); harsh or horrid, i.e. offensive: - vile.
; feminine of h8178 (שַׂעַר); a hurricane: - storm, tempest.
; or שְׂעוֹרָה (feminine meaning the plant); and (masculine meaning the grain); also שְׂעֹר; or שְׂעוֹר; from h8175 (שָׂעַר) in the sense of roughness; barley (as villose): - barley.
; feminine of h8181 (שֵׂעָר); hairiness: - hair.
; or שַׁעֲרִירִיָּה; or שַׁעֲרֻרִת; feminine from h8176 (שָׁעַר) in the sense of h8175 (שָׂעַר); something fearful: - horrible thing.
; from h8176 (שָׁעַר) and h3050 (יָהּ); Jah has stormed; Shearjah, an Israelite: - Sheariah.
; masculine plural of h8184 (שְׂעֹרָה); barley grains; Seorim, an Israelite: - Seorim.
; dual of h8179 (שַׁעַר); double gates; Shaarajim, a place in Palestine: - Shaaraim.
; of Persian derivation; Shaashgaz, a eunuch of Xerxes: - Shaashgaz.
; from h8173 (שָׁעַע); enjoyment: - delight, pleasure.
; a primitive root; to abrade, i.e. bare: - high, stick out.

; or (in dual and plural) שֶׂפֶת; probably from h5595 (סָפָה) or h8192 (שָׁפָה) through the idea of termination (compare h5490 (סוֹף)); the lip (as a natural boundary); by implication, language; by analogy, a margin (of a vessel, water, cloth, etc.): - band, bank, binding, border, brim, brink, edge, language, lip, prating, (sea-)shore, side, speech, talk, (vain) words.
; from h8192 (שָׁפָה) in the sense of clarifying; a cheese (as strained from the whey): - cheese.
; or שְׁפִי; from h8192 (שָׁפָה); baldness (compare h8205 (שְׁפִי)); Shepho or Shephi, an Idumaean: - Shephi, Shepho.
; or שְׁפוּט; from h8199 (שָׁפַט); a judicial sentence, i.e. punishment: - judgment.
; or שְׁפוּפָן; from the same as h8207 (שְׁפִיפֹן); serpent-like; Shephupham or Shephuphan, an Israelite: - Shephuphan, Shupham.

; feminine from an unused root meaning to spread out (as a family; see h4940 (מִשְׁפָּחָה)); a female slave (as a member of the household): - (bond-, hand-) maid(-en, -servant), wench, bondwoman, womanservant.

; a primitive root; to judge, i.e. pronounce sentence (for or against); by implication, to vindicate or punish; by extenssion, to govern; passively, to litigate (literally or figuratively): - [phrase] avenge, [idiom] that condemn, contend, defend, execute (judgment), (be a) judge(-ment), [idiom] needs, plead, reason, rule.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h8199 (שָׁפַט); to judge: - magistrate.
; from h8199 (שָׁפַט); a sentence, i.e. infliction: - judgment.
; from h8199 (שָׁפַט); judge; Shaphat, the name of four Israelites: - Shaphat.
; or שְׁפַטְיָהוּ; from h8199 (שָׁפַט) and h3050 (יָהּ); Jah has judged; Shephatjah, the name of ten Israelites: - Shephatiah.
; from h8199 (שָׁפַט); judge-like; Shiphtan, an Israelite: - Shiphtan.
; from h8192 (שָׁפָה); bareness; concretely, a bare hill or plain: - high place, stick out.
; plural of an unused noun from the same as h8207 (שְׁפִיפֹן) and meaning the same; serpents; Shuppim, an Israelite: - Shuppim.
; from an unused root meaning the same as h7779 (שׁוּף); a kind of serpent (as snapping), probably the cerastes or horned adder: - adder.
; from h8231 (שָׁפַר); beautiful; Shaphir, a place in Palestine: - Saphir.
; (Aramaic) intensive of a form corresponding to h8208 (שָׁפִיר); beautiful: - fair.

; a primitive root; to spill forth (blood, a libation, liquid metal; or even a solid, i.e. to mound up); also (figuratively) to expend (life, soul, complaint, money, etc.); intensively, to sprawl out: - cast (up), gush out, pour (out), shed(-der, out), slip.
; from h8210 (שָׁפַךְ); an emptying place, e.g. an ash-heap: - are poured out.
; feminine of a derivative from h8210 (שָׁפַךְ); a pipe (for pouring forth, e.g. wine), i.e. the penis: - privy member.

; a primitive root; to depress or sink (expectation figuratively, to humiliate, intransitive or transitive): - abase, bring (cast, put) down, debase, humble (self), be (bring, lay, make, put) low(-er).
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h8213 (שָׁפֵל) {to depress or sink (expectation figuratively, to humiliate, intransitive or transitive)}: - abase, humble, put down, subdue.
; (Aramaic) from h8214 (שְׁפַל); low: - basest.
; from h8213 (שָׁפֵל); an humble rank: - low estate (place).
; from h8213 (שָׁפֵל); depressed, literally or figuratively: - base(-st), humble, low(-er, -ly).
; feminine of h8216 (שֶׁפֶל); depression: - low place.
; from h8213 (שָׁפֵל); Lowland, i.e. (with the article) the maritime slope of Palestine: - low country, (low) plain, vale(-ley).
; from h8213 (שָׁפֵל); remissness: - idleness.
; probably from h8192 (שָׁפָה); bare spot; Shepham, a place in or near Palestine: - Shepham.
; from h8193 (שָׂפָה); the beard (as a lippiece): - beard, (upper) lip.
; formed like h8221 (שְׁפָם); baldly; Shapham, an Israelite: - Shapham.
; feminine plural of h8221 (שְׁפָם); Siphmoth, a place in Palestine: - Siphmoth.
; patrial from h8221 (שְׁפָם); a Shiphmite or inhabitant of Shepham: - Shiphmite.
; a primitive root; to conceal (as a valuable): - treasure.
; from h8226 (שָׂפַן); a species of rockrabbit (from its hiding), i.e. probably the hyrax: - coney.
; from an unused root meaning to abound; resources: - abundance.
; feminine of h8228 (שֶׁפַע); copiousness: - abundance, company, multitude.
; from h8228 (שֶׁפַע); copious; Shiphi, an Israelite: - Shiphi.
; a primitive root; to glisten, i.e. (figuratively) be (causatively, make) fair: - [idiom] goodly.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h8231 (שָׁפַר); to be beautiful: - be acceptable, please, [phrase] think good.
; from h8231 (שָׁפַר); beauty: - [idiom] goodly.
; the same as h8233 (שֶׁפֶר); Shepher, a place in the Desert: - Shapper.
; from h8231 (שָׁפַר); brightness: - garnish.
; the same as h8235 (שִׁפְרָה); Shiphrah, an Israelitess: - Shiphrah.
; from h8231 (שָׁפַר); splendid, i.e. a tapestry or canopy: - royal pavilion.
; (Aramaic) from h8231 (שָׁפַר); the dawn (as brilliant with aurora): - [idiom] very early in the morning.
; a primitive root; to locate, i.e. (generally) hang on or (figuratively) establish, reduce: - bring, ordain, set on.
; from h8239 (שָׁפַת); a (double) stall (for cattle); also a (two-pronged) hook (for flaying animals on): - hook, pot.
; from h7857 (שָׁטַף) (for alliteration with h7110 (קֶצֶף)); an outburst (of anger): - little.

; from h8264 (שָׁקַק); properly, a mesh (as allowing a liquid to run through), i.e. coarse loose cloth or sacking (used in mourning and for bagging); hence, a bag (for grain, etc.): - sack(-cloth, -clothes).
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h7785 (שׁוֹק); the leg: - leg.
; a primitive root; to fasten: - bind.
; a primitive root; to be alert, i.e. sleepless; hence to be on the lookout (whether for good or ill): - hasten, remain, wake, watch (for).
; a denominative from h8247 (שָׁקֵד); to be (intensively, make) almond-shaped: - make like (unto, after the fashion of) almonds.
; from h8245 (שָׁקַד); the almond (tree or nut; as being the earliest in bloom): - almond (tree).
; a primitive root; to quaff, i.e. (causatively) to irrigate or furnish apotion to: - cause to (give, give to, let, make to) drink, drown, moisten, water. See h7937 (שָׁכַר), h8354 (שָׁתָה).
; from h8248 (שָׁקָה); (plural collective) a draught: - drink.
; from h8248 (שָׁקָה); a beverage; moisture, i.e. (figuratively) refreshment: - drink, marrow.
; or שִׁקֻּץ; from h8262 (שָׁקַץ); disgusting, i.e. filthy; especially idolatrous or (concretely) an idol: - abominable filth (idol, -ation), detestable (thing).
; a primitive root; to repose (usually figurative): - appease, idleness, (at, be at, be in, give) quiet(-ness), (be at, be in, give, have, take) rest, settle, be still.
; from h8252 (שָׁקַט); tranquillity: - quietness.
; a primitive root; to suspend or poise (especially in trade): - pay, receive(-r), spend, [idiom] throughly, weigh.
; from h8254 (שָׁקַל); probably a weight; used as a commercial standard: - shekel.
; or (feminine) שִׁקְמָה; of uncertain derivation; a sycamore (usually the tree): - sycamore (fruit, tree).
; (abbreviated Amos 8:8); a primitive root; to subside; by implication, to be overflowed, cease; causatively, to abate, subdue: - make deep, let down, drown, quench, sink.
; from h8257 (שָׁקַע); a depression: - hollow strake.
; a primitive root; properly, to lean out (of a window), i.e. (by implication) peep or gaze (passively, be a spectacle): - appear, look (down, forth, out).
; from h8259 (שָׁקַף); a loophole (for looking out), to admit light and air: - window.
; passive participle of h8259 (שָׁקַף); (compare h8260 (שֶׁקֶף)) an embrasure or opening with bevelled jam: - light, window.
; a primitive root; to be filthy, i.e. (intensively) to loathe, pollute: - abhor, make abominable, have in abomination, detest, [idiom] utterly.
; from h8262 (שָׁקַץ); filth, i.e. (figuratively and specifically) an idolatrous object: - abominable(-tion).
; a primitive root; to course (like a beast of prey); by implication, to seek greedily: - have appetite, justle one against another, long, range, run (to and fro).
; a primitive root; to ogle, i.e. blink coquettishly: - wanton.
; a primitive root; to cheat, i.e. be untrue (usually in words): - fail, deal falsely, lie.
; from h8266 (שָׁקַר); an untruth; by implication, a sham (often adverbial): - without a cause, deceit(-ful), false(-hood, -ly), feignedly, liar, [phrase] lie, lying, vain (thing), wrongfully.
; from h8248 (שָׁקָה); a trough (for watering): - trough.
; from h8323 (שָׂרַר); a head person (of any rank or class): - captain (that had rule), chief (captain), general, governor, keeper, lord,(-task-)master, prince(-ipal), ruler, steward.
; from h8324 (שָׁרַר); (compare h8306 (שָׁרִיר)) a string (as twisted ), i.e. (specifically) the umbilical cord (also figuratively, as the centre of strength): - navel.
; (Aramaic) a root corresponding to that of h8293 (שֵׁרוּת); to free, separate; figuratively, to unravel, commence; by implication (of unloading beasts) to reside: - begin, dissolve, dwell, loose.
; of foreign derivation; Sharetser, the name of an Assyrian and an Israelite: - Sharezer.
; from an unused root meaning to glare; quivering glow (of the air), expectation. the mirage: - heat, parched ground.
; from h8273 (שָׁרָב) and h3050 (יָהּ); Jah has brought heat; Sherebjah, the name of two Israelites: - Sherebiah.
; for h7626 (שֵׁבֶט); a rod of empire: - sceptre.
; a primitive root; to intwine: - wrap together, wreath.
; a primitive root; (compare h8279 (שֶׂרֶד)) properly, to puncture, i.e. (figuratively through the idea of slipping out) to escape or survive: - remain.
; from h8277 (שָׂרַד); stitching (as pierced with a needle): - service.
; from h8277 (שָׂרַד); a (carpenter's) scribing-awl (for pricking or scratching measurements): - line.
; a primitive root; to prevail: - have power (as a prince).
; a primitive root; to free: - direct.
; feminine of h8269 (שַׂר); a mistress, i.e. female noble: - lady, princess, queen.
; the same as h8282 (שָׂרָה); Sarah, Abraham's wife: - Sarah.
; probably feminine of h7791 (שׁוּר); a fortification (literally or figuratively): - sing (by mistake for h7891 (שִׁיר)), wall.
; from h8324 (שָׁרַר) in its original sense of pressing; a wrist-band (as compact or clasping): - bracelet.
; from h8276 (שָׂרַג); tendril; Serug, a postdiluvian patriarch: - Serug.
; probably from h8281 (שָׁרָה) (in the sense of dwelling (compare h8271 (שְׁרֵא)) and h2580 (חֵן); abode of pleasure; Sharuchen, a place in Palestine: - Sharuhen.
; from h8308 (שָׂרַךְ); a thong (as laced or tied): - (shoe-)latchet.
; probably abridged from h3474 (יָשַׁר); plain, Sharon, the name of a place in Palestine: - Lasharon, Sharon.
; patrial from h8289 (שָׁרוֹן); a Sharonite or inhabitant of Sharon: - Sharonite.
; passive participle from the same as h8321 (שֹׂרֵק); a grapevine: - principal plant. See h8320 (שָׂרֻק), h8321 (שֹׂרֵק).
; or (by permutation) שְׁרִיקָה; feminine passive participle of h8319 (שָׁרַק); a whistling (in scorn); by analogy, a piping: - bleating, hissing.
; from h8281 (שָׁרָה) abbreviated; freedom: - remnant.
; by permutation for h5629 (סֶרַח); superfluity; Serach, an Israelitess: - Sarah, Serah.
; a primitive root; to gash: - cut in pieces, make (cuttings) pieces.
; and שָׂרֶטֶת; from h8295 (שָׂרַט); an incision: - cutting.
; from h8269 (שַׂר); dominative; Sarai, the wife of Abraham: - Sarai.
; probably from h8324 (שָׁרַר); hostile; Sharay, an Israelite: - Sharai.
; from h8276 (שָׂרַג); a tendril (as entwining): - branch.
; from h8277 (שָׂרַד); a survivor: - [idiom] alive, left, remain(-ing), remnant, rest.
; the same as h8300 (שָׂרִיד); Sarid, a place in Palestine: - Sarid.

; or שִׁרְיֹן; and שִׁרְיָן; also (feminine) שִׁרְיָה; and שִׁרְיֹנָה; from h8281 (שָׁרָה) in the original sense of turning; a corslet (as if twisted): - breastplate, coat of mail, habergeon, harness. See h5630 (סִרְיֹן).
; and שִׂרְיֹן; the same as h8304 (שְׂרָיָה) (i.e. sheeted with snow); Shirjon or Sirjon, a peak of the Lebanon: - Sirion.
; or שְׂרָיָהוּ; from h8280 (שָׂרָה) and h3050 (יָהּ); Jah has prevailed; Serajah, the name of nine Israelites: - Seraiah.
; from the same as h8321 (שֹׂרֵק) in the original sense of piercing; hetchelling (or combing flax), i.e. (concretely) tow (by extension, linen cloth): - fine.
; from h8324 (שָׁרַר) in the original sense as in h8270 (שֹׁר) (compare h8326 (שֹׁרֶר)); a cord, i.e. (by analogy) sinew: - navel.
; from h8324 (שָׁרַר) in the sense of twisted, i.e. firm; obstinacy: - imagination, lust.
; a primitive root; to interlace: - traverse.
; probably by an orthographical error for h7709 (שְׁדֵמָה); a common: - field.
; of foreign derivation; Sarsekim, a Babylonian general: - Sarsechim.
; a primitive root; to prolong, i.e. (reflex) be deformed by excess of members: - stretch out self, (have any) superfluous thing.
; for h5587 (סָעִף); cogitation: - thought.
; a primitive root; to be (causatively, set) on fire: - (cause to, make a) burn((-ing), up) kindle, [idiom] utterly.
; from h8313 (שָׂרַף); burning, i.e. (figuratively) poisonous (serpent); specifically, a saraph or symbolical creature (from their copper color): - fiery (serpent), seraph.
; the same as h8314 (שָׂרָף); Saraph, an Israelite: - Saraph.
; from h8313 (שָׂרַף); cremation: - burning.
; a primitive root; to wriggle, i.e. (by implication) swarm or abound: - breed (bring forth, increase) abundantly (in abundance), creep, move.
; from h8317 (שָׁרַץ); a swarm, i.e. active mass of minute animals: - creep(-ing thing), move(-ing creature).
; a primitive root; properly, to be shrill, i.e. to whistle or hiss (as a call or in scorn): - hiss.
; from h8319 (שָׁרַק); bright red (as piercing to the sight), i.e. bay: - speckled. See h8291 (שָׂרוּק).

; or שׂוֹרֵק; and (feminine) שֹׂרֵקָה; from h8319 (שָׁרַק) in the sense of redness (compare h8320 (שָׂרֻק)); a vine stock (properly, one yielding purple grapes, the richest variety): - choice(-st, noble) wine. Compare h8291 (שָׂרוּק).
; from h8319 (שָׁרַק); a derision: - hissing.
; a primitive root; to have (transitively, exercise; reflexively, get) dominion: - [idiom] altogether, make self a prince, (bear) rule.
; a primitive root; to be hostile (only active participle an opponent): - enemy.
; from h8324 (שָׁרַר); hostile; Sharar, an Israelite: - Sharar.
; from h8324 (שָׁרַר) in the sense of twisting (compare h8270 (שֹׁר)); the umbilical cord, i.e. (by extension) a bodice: - navel.
; a primitive root; to root, i.e. strike into the soil, or (by implication) to pluck from it: - (take, cause to take) root (out).
; from h8327 (שָׁרַשׁ); a root (literally or figuratively): - bottom, deep, heel, root.
; the same as h8328 (שֶׁרֶשׁ); Sheresh, an Israelite: - Sharesh.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h8328 (שֶׁרֶשׁ) {a root (literally or figuratively)}: - root.
; from h8327 (שָׁרַשׁ); a chain (as rooted, i.e. linked): - chain. Compare h8333 (שַׁרְשְׁרָה).
; (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to h8327 (שָׁרַשׁ); eradication, i.e. (figuratively) exile: - banishment.
; from h8327 (שָׁרַשׁ) (compare h8331 (שַׁרְשָׁה)); a chain; (architectural) probably a garland: - chain.
; a primitive root; to attend as a menial or worshipper; figuratively, to contribute to: - minister (unto), (do) serve(-ant, -ice, -itor), wait on.
; infinitive of h8334 (שָׁרַת); service (in the Temple): - minister(-ry).
; or (for alliteration with h4897 (מֶשִׁי)) שְׁשִׁי; for h7893 (שַׁיִשׁ); bleached stuff, i.e. white linen or (by analogy) marble: - [idiom] blue, fine (twined) linen, marble, silk.
; masculine שִׁשָּׁה; a primitive number; compare h7797 (שׂוּשׂ) six (as an overplus beyond five or the fingers of the hand); as ord. sixth: - six(-teen, -teenth), sixth.
; a primitive root; apparently, to annihilate: - leave by the sixth part (by confusion with h8341 (שָׁשָׁה)).
; of foreign derivation; Sheshbatstsar, Zerubbabel's Persian name: - Sheshbazzar.

; from an unused root meaning to lie waste; a desolation (of surface), i.e. desert; figuratively, a worthless thing; adverbially, in vain: - confusion, empty place, without form, nothing, (thing of) nought, vain, vanity, waste, wilderness.

; or תִּיכֹן; from h8432 (תָּוֶךְ); central: - middle(-most), midst.

; a primitive root; to strew, i.e. encamp: - sit down.

; from h3559 (כּוּן); or probably identical with h8498 (תְּכוּנָה); something arranged or fixed, i.e. a place: - seat.

; from h3615 (כָּלָה); completeness: - perfection.
; from h3615 (כָּלָה); completion; by implication, an extremity: - end, perfect(-ion).

; from h8510 (תֵּל) and h0024 (אָבִיב); mound of green growth; Tel-Abib, a place in Chaldaea: - Tel-abib.

; or תְּלַשַּׂר; of foreign derivation; Telassar, a region of Assyria: - Telassar.
