; (Aramaic) corresponding to h7950 (שֶׁלֶג); snow: - snow.
; a primitive root; to suspend (especially to gibbet): - hang (up).
; or תּלֻנָּה; from h3885 (לוּן) in the sense of obstinacy; a grumbling: - murmuring.
; probably from an unused root meaning to dissever; breach; Telach, an Israelite: - Telah.
; from h8510 (תֵּל) and the feminine of h2798 (חֲרָשִׁים); mound of workmanship; Tel-Charsha, a place in Babylonia: - Tel-haresha, Tel-harsa.
; probably from h8518 (תָּלָה); a quiver (as slung): - quiver.
; (Aramaic) or תַּלְתִּי; (Aramaic), ordinal from h8532 (תְּלָת); third: - third.
; a primitive root; to pile up, i.e. elevate: - eminent. Compare h2048 (הָתַל).
; from an unused root meaning to accumulate; a bank or terrace: - furrow, ridge.
; from h8525 (תֶּלֶם); ridged; Talmai, the name of a Canaanite and a Syrian: - Talmai.
; from h3925 (לָמַד); a pupil: - scholar.
; from h8510 (תֵּל) and h4417 (מֶלַח); mound of salt; Tel-Melach, a place in Babylonia: - Tel-melah.
; a denominative from h8438 (תּוֹלָע); to crimson, i.e. dye that color: - [idiom] scarlet.
; feminine from an unused root meaning to tower; something tall, i.e. (plural collective) slenderness: - armoury.
; (Aramaic) from h8532 (תְּלָת); a tertiary rank: - third.
; (Aramaic) masculine תְּלָתָה; (Aramaic), or תְּלָתָא; (Aramaic), corresponding to h7969 (שָׁלוֹשׁ); three or third: - third, three.
; (Aramaic) multiple of h8532 (תְּלָת); ten times three: - thirty.
; by reduplication, from h8524 (תָּלַל) through the idea of vibration; a trailing bough (as pendulous): - bushy.
; from h8552 (תָּמַם); complete; usually (morally) pious; specifically, gentle, dear: - coupled together, perfect, plain, undefiled, upright.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h8033 (שָׁם); there: - [idiom] thence, there, [idiom] where.
; from h8552 (תָּמַם); completeness; figuratively, prosperity; usually (morally) innocence: - full, integrity, perfect(-ion), simplicity, upright(-ly, -ness), at a venture. See h8550 (תֻּמִּים).
; feminine of h8537 (תֹּם); innocence: - integrity.
; a primitive root; to be in consternation: - be amazed, be astonished, marvel(-lously), wonder.
; (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to h8539 (תָּמַהּ); a miracle: - wonder.
; from h8539 (תָּמַהּ); consternation: - astonishment.
; of uncertain derivation; Tammuz, a Phoenician deity: - Tammuz.

; or תְּמֹל; probably for h0865 (אֶתְמוֹל); sometimes with h8032 (שִׁלְשׁוֹם) properly, ago, i.e. a (short or long) time since; especially yesterday, or day before yesterday: - [phrase] before (-time), [phrase] these (three) days, [phrase] heretofore, [phrase] time past, yesterday.

; or תְּמֻנָה; from h4327 (מִין); something portioned (i.e. fashioned) out, as ashape, i.e. (indefinitely) phantom, or (specifically) embodiment, or (figuratively) manifestation (of favor): - image, likeness, similitude.
; from h4171 (מוּר); barter, compensation: - (ex-) change(-ing), recompense, restitution.
; from h4191 (מוּת); execution (as a doom): - death, die.
; of uncertain derivation; Temach, one of the Nethinim: - Tamah, Thamah.

; from an unused root meaning to stretch; properly, continuance (as indefinite extension); but used only (attributively as adjective) constant (or adverbially, constantly); ellipt. the regular (daily) sacrifice: - alway(-s), continual (employment, -ly), daily, (n-)ever(-more), perpetual.

; from h8552 (תָּמַם); entire (literally, figuratively or morally); also (as noun) integrity, truth: - without blemish, complete, full, perfect, sincerely (-ity), sound, without spot, undefiled, upright(-ly), whole.
; plural of h8537 (תֹּם); perfections, i.e. (techn.) one of the epithets of the objects in the high-priest's breastplate as an emblem of complete Truth: - Thummim.
; a primitive root; to sustain; by implication, to obtain, keep fast; figuratively, to help, follow close: - (take, up-) hold (up), maintain, retain, stay (up).

; a primitive root; to complete, in a good or a bad sense, literal, or figurative, transitive or intransitive: - accomplish, cease, be clean (pass-) ed, consume, have done, (come to an, have an, make an) end, fail, come to the full, be all gone, [idiom] be all here, be (make) perfect, be spent, sum, be (shew self) upright, be wasted, whole.
; from h4487 (מָנָה); a portion assigned; Timnah, the name of two places in Palestine: - Timnah, Timnath, Thimnathah.
; patrial from h8553 (תִּמְנָה); a Timnite or inhabitant of Timnah: - Timnite.
; from h4513 (מָנַע); restraint; Timna, the name of two Edomites: - Timna, Timnah.
; or תִּמְנַת סֶרַח; from h8553 (תִּמְנָה) and h2775 (חֶרֶס); portion of (the) sun; Timnath-Cheres, a place in Palestine: - Timnath-heres, Timnath-serah.
; from h4529 (מָסָה); liquefaction, i.e. disappearance: - melt.
; from an unused root meaning to be erect; a palm tree: - palm (tree).
; the same as h8558 (תָּמָר); Tamar, the name of three women and a place: - Tamar.
; from the same root as h8558 (תָּמָר); a palm trunk: - palm tree.
; (plural or (feminine) תִּמֹּרָה; (singular and plural), from the same root as h8558 (תָּמָר); (architectural) a palm-like pilaster (i.e. umbellate): - palm tree.
; or תַּמְרֻק; or תַּמְרִיק; from h4838 (מָרַק); properly, a scouring, i.e. soap or perfumery forthe bath; figuratively, a detergent: - [idiom] cleanse, (thing for) purification(-fying).
; from h4843 (מָרַר); bitterness (plural as collective): - [idiom] most bitter(-ly).
; from the same root as h8558 (תָּמָר); an erection, i.e. pillar (probably for a guide-board): - high heap.

; from an unused root probably meaning to elongate; a monster (as preternaturally formed), i.e. a sea-serpent (or other huge marine animal); also a jackal (or other hideous land animal): - dragon, whale. Compare h8577 (תַּנִּין).
; a primitive root; to present (a mercenary inducement), i.e. bargain with (a harlot): - hire.
; a primitive root (identical with through the idea of attributing honor); to ascribe (praise), i.e. celebrate, commemorate: - lament, rehearse.
; probably feminine of h8565 (תַּן); a female jackal: - dragon.
; from h5106 (נוּא); alienation; by implication, enmity: - breach of promise, occasion.
; from h5107 (נוּב); produce: - fruit, increase.
; perhaps from the same as h0594 (אֲנָךְ) through the idea of protraction; a pinnacle, i.e. extremity: - tip.
; from h5123 (נוּם); drowsiness, i.e. sleep: - slumber(-ing).
; from h5130 (נוּף); a brandishing (in threat); by implication, tumult; specifically, the official undulation of sacrificial offerings: - offering, shaking, wave (offering).
; from h5216 (נִיר); a fire-pot: - furnace, oven.
; or תַּנְחֻם; and (feminine) תַּנְחוּמָה; from h5162 (נָחַם); compassion, solace: - comfort, consolation.
; for h8575 (תַּנְחוּם) (feminine); Tanchumeth, an Israelite: - Tanhumeth.
; or תַּנִּים; (Ezekiel 29:3), intensive from the same as h8565 (תַּן); a marine or land monster, i.e. sea-serpent or jackal: - dragon, sea-monster, serpent, whale.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h8147 (שְׁנַיִם); second: - second.
; (Aramaic) from h8578 (תִּנְיָן); a second time: - again.

; from h5395 (נָשַׁם); properly, a hard breather, i.e. the name of two unclean creatures, a lizard and abird (both perhaps from changing color through their irascibility), probably the tree-toad and the water-hen: - mole, swan.
; a primitive root; to loathe, i.e. (morally) detest: - (make to be) abhor(-red), (be, commit more, do) abominable(-y), [idiom] utterly.

; a primitive root; to vacillate, i.e. reel or stray (literally or figuratively); also causative of both: - (cause to) go astray, deceive, dissemble, (cause to, make to) err, pant, seduce, (make to) stagger, (cause to) wander, be out of the way.
; or תֹּעִי; from h8582 (תָּעָה); error Tou or Toi, a Syrian king: - Toi, Tou.
; from h5749 (עוּד); attestation, i.e. a precept, usage: - testimony.
; from h5927 (עָלָה); a channel (into which water is raised for irrigation); also a bandage or plaster (as placed upon a wound): - conduit, cured, healing, little river, trench, watercourse.
; from h5953 (עָלַל); caprice (as a fit coming on), i.e. vexation; concretely a tyrant: - babe, delusion.
; from h5956 (עָלַם); a secret: - thing that is hid, secret.
; or תַּעֲנֻג; and (feminine) תַּעֲנֻגָה; from h6026 (עָנַג); luxury: - delicate, delight, pleasant.
; from h6031 (עָנָה); affliction (of self), i.e. fasting: - heaviness.
; or תַּעְנָךְ; of uncertain derivation; Taanak or Tanak, a place in Palestine: - Taanach, Tanach.
; a primitive root; to cheat; by analogy, to maltreat: - deceive, misuse.
; from h6105 (עָצַם); might (plural collective): - power.
; from h6168 (עָרָה); a knife or razor (as making bare); also a scabbard (as being bare, i.e. empty): - (pen-) knife, razor, scabbard, shave, sheath.
; from h6148 (עָרַב); suretyship, i.e. (concretely) a pledge: - [phrase] hostage.
; from h8591 (תָּעַע); a fraud: - error.
; from h8608 (תָּפַף) contracted; a tambourine: - tabret, timbrel.
; or תִּפְאֶרֶת; from h6286 (פָּאַר); ornament (abstractly or concretely, literally or figuratively): - beauty(-iful), bravery, comely, fair, glory(-ious), honour, majesty.

; from h5301 (נָפַח); an apple (from its fragrance), i.e. the fruit or the tree (probably includ. others of the pome order, as the quince, the orange, etc.): - apple (tree). See also h1054 (בֵּית תַּפּוּחַ).
; the same as h8598 (תַּפּוּחַ); Tappuach, the name of two places in Palestine, also of an Israelite: - Tappuah.
; from h6327 (פּוּץ); a dispersal: - dispersion.
; from h0644 (אָפָה); cookery, i.e. (concretely) a cake: - baked piece.
; from an unused root meaning to smear; plaster (as gummy) or slime; (figuratively) frivolity: - foolish things, unsavoury, untempered.
; from the same as h8602 (תָּפֵל); quagmire; Tophel, a place near the Desert: - Tophel.
; from the same as h8602 (תָּפֵל); frivolity: - folly, foolishly.
; from h6419 (פָּלַל); intercession, supplication; by implication, a hymn: - prayer.
; from h6426 (פָּלַץ); fearfulness: - terrible.
; from h6452 (פָּסַח); ford; Tiphsach, a place in Mesopotamia: - Tipsah.
; a primitive root; to drum, i.e. play (as) on the tambourine: - taber, play with timbrels.
; a primitive root; to sew: - (women that) sew (together).

; a primitive root; to manipulate, i.e. seize; chiefly to capture, wield, specifically, to overlay; figuratively, to use unwarrantably: - catch, handle, (lay, take) hold (on, over), stop, [idiom] surely, surprise, take.
; from the base of h8608 (תָּפַף); a smiting, i.e. (figuratively) contempt: - tabret.
; the same as h8611 (תֹּפֶת); Topheth, a place near Jerusalem: - Tophet, Topheth.
; probably a form of h8612 (תֹּפֶת); Tophteh, a place of cremation: - Tophet.
; (Aramaic) perhaps from h8199 (שָׁפַט); judicial, i.e. a lawyer: - sheriff.
; from h6960 (קָוָה); (compare h6961 (קָוֶה)) literally a cord (as an attachment); figuratively, expectancy: - expectation(-ted), hope, live, thing that I long for.
; the same as h8615 (תִּקְוָה); Tikvah, the name of two Israelites: - Tikvah.
; from h6965 (קוּם); resistfulness: - power to stand.
; from h6965 (קוּם); an opponent: - rise up against.
; from h8628 (תָּקַע) (in the musical sense); a trumpet: - trumpet.
; a form of h8619 (תָּקוֹעַ); Tekoa, a place in Palestine: - Tekoa, Tekoah.
; or תְּקֹעִי; patronymically from h8620 (תְּקוֹעַ); a Tekoite or inhabitant of Tekoah: - Tekoite.
; or תְּקֻפָה; from h5362 (נָקַף); a revolution, i.e. (of the sun) course, (of time) lapse: - circuit, come about, end.
; from h8630 (תָּקַף); powerful: - mightier.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h8623 (תַּקִּיף) {powerful}: - mighty, strong.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h8254 (שָׁקַל); to balance: - Tekel, be weighed.
; a primitive root; to equalize, i.e. straighten (intransitive or transitive); figuratively, to compose: - set in order, make straight.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h8626 (תָּקַן); to straighten up, i.e. confirm: - establish.

; a primitive root; to clatter, i.e. slap (the hands together), clang (an instrument); by analogy, to drive (a nail or tent-pin, a dart, etc.); by implication, to become bondsman by handclasping): - blow (a trumpet), cast, clap, fasten, pitch (tent), smite, sound, strike, [idiom] suretiship, thrust.
; from h8628 (תָּקַע); a blast of a trumpet: - sound.
; a primitive root; to overpower: - prevail (against).
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h8630 (תָּקַף); to become (causatively, make) mighty or (figuratively) obstinate: - make firm, harden, be(-come) strong.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h8633 (תֹּקֶף); power: - might, strength.
; from h8630 (תָּקַף); might or (figuratively) positiveness: - authority, power, strength.
; probably for h8653 (תַּרְעֵלָה); a reeling; Taralah, a place in Palestine: - Taralah.
; from h7235 (רָבָה); multiplication, i.e. progeny: - increase.
; from h7235 (רָבָה); multiplication, i.e. percentage or bonus in addition to principal: - increase, unjust gain.
; a denominative from h7270 (רָגַל); to cause to walk: - teach to go.
; a denominative from h7275 (רָגַם) in the sense of throwing over; to transfer, i.e. translate: - interpret.
; from h7290 (רָדַם); a lethargy or (by implication) trance: - deep sleep.
; of foreign derivation; Tirhakah, a king of Kush: - Tirhakah.
; or תְּרֻמָה; (Deuteronomy 12:11), from h7311 (רוּם); a present (as offered up), especially in sacrifice or as tribute: - gift, heave offering (shoulder), oblation, offered(-ing).
; formed as h8641 (תְּרוּמָה); a sacrificial offering: - oblation.

; from h7321 (רוּעַ); clamor, i.e. acclamation of joy or a battle-cry; especially clangorof trumpets, as an alarum: - alarm, blow(-ing) (of, the) (trumpets), joy, jubile, loud noise, rejoicing, shout(-ing), (high, joyful) sound(-ing).
; from h7322 (רוּף) in the sense of its congener h7495 (רָפָא); a remedy: - medicine.
; probably from h7329 (רָזָה); a species of tree (apparently from its slenderness), perhaps the cypress: - cypress.
; of uncertain derivation; Terach, the father of Abraham; also a place in the Desert: - Tarah, Terah.
; of uncertain derivation; Tirchanah, an Israelite: - Tirhanah.
; (Aramaic) feminine תַּרְתֵּין; corresponding to h8147 (שְׁנַיִם); two: - second, [phrase] twelve, two.
; and תַּרְמוּת; or תַּרְמִית; from h7411 (רָמָה); fraud: - deceit(-ful), privily.
; probably for h0766 (אֹרֶן); a pole (as a mast or flagstaff): - beacon, mast.
; (Aramaic) corresponding to h8179 (שַׁעַר); a door; by implication, a palace: - gate mouth.
; (Aramaic) from h8651 (תְּרַע); a doorkeeper: - porter.
; from h7477 (רָעַל); reeling: - astonishment, trembling.
; patrial from an unused name meaning gate; a Tirathite or inhabitant of an unknown Tirah: - Tirathite.
; plural from h7495 (רָפָא); a healer; Teraphim (singular or plural) a family idol: - idols(-atry), images, teraphim.
; from h7521 (רָצָה); delightsomeness; Tirtsah, a place in Palestine; also an Israelitess: - Tirzah.
; of foreign derivation; Teresh, a eunuch of Xerxes: - Teresh.
; probably of foreign derivation (compare h8659 (תַּרְשִׁישׁ)); a gem, perhaps the topaz: - beryl.

; probably the same as h8658 (תַּרְשִׁישׁ) (as the region of the stone, or the reverse); Tarshish, a place on the Mediterranean, hence, the ephithet of a merchant vessel (as if for or from that port); also the name of a Persian and of an Israelite: - Tarshish, Tharshish.
; of foreign derivation; Tirshatha, the title of a Persian deputy or governor: - Tirshatha.
; of foreign derivation; Tartan, an Assyrian: - Tartan.
; of foreign derivation; Tartak, a deity of the Avvites: - Tartak.
; from h7722 (שׁוֹא); a crashing or loud clamor: - crying, noise, shouting, stir.
; patrial from an unused name meaning recourse; a Tishbite or inhabitant of Tishbeh (in Gilead): - Tishbite.
; from h7660 (שָׁבַץ); checkered stuff (as reticulated): - broidered.
; or תְּשֻׁבָה; from h7725 (שׁוּב); a recurrence (of time or place); a reply (as returned): - answer, be expired, return.
; from h7760 (שׂוּם); a deposit, i.e. pledging: - [phrase] fellowship.
; or תְּשֻׁעָה; from h7768 (שָׁוַע) in the sense of h3467 (יָשַׁע); rescue (literal or figurative, persons, national or spiritual): - deliverance, help, safety, salvation, victory.
; from h7783 (שׁוּק) in the original sense of stretching out after; a longing: - desire.
; from h7788 (שׁוּר) in the sense of arrival; a gift: - present.
; ordinal from h8672 (תֵּשַׁע); ninth: - ninth.
; or (masculine) תִּשְׁעָה; perhaps from h8159 (שָׁעָה) through the idea of a turn to the next or full number ten; nine or (ordinal) ninth: - nine ([phrase] -teen, [phrase] -teenth, -th).
; multiple from h8672 (תֵּשַׁע); ninety: - ninety.
; of foreign derivation; Tattenai, a Persian: - Tatnai.
